description:
Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes.
It controls your blood sugar levels and helps prevent serious complications in the future.
Your doctor may prescribe it alone or along with other diabetes medicines.
Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR may be taken on an empty stomach or with a meal.
However, the dose will depend on your condition and blood sugar levels; therefore, use it as advised by your doctor and do not stop taking this medicine unless the doctor recommends otherwise.
Also, take it regularly and at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
It is also crucial to stay on the diet and exercise program recommended by the doctor while taking this medicine.The most common side effects of this medicine include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, abdominal pain, and constipation.
These effects are usually minor and improve with time.
Low blood sugar level (hypoglycemia) is a possible side effect if you are also taking other diabetes medicines, so you need to know how to recognize and deal with it.
Contact the doctor if the side effects are worrisome or do not go away.Before taking Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR, let the doctor know if you have ever had kidney disease, heart or pancreas problems, or drink a lot of alcohol.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctors before taking this medicine.
Some other medicines you are taking may also interfere with this combination drug; therefore, make sure your doctor knows about all the other medicines you are using.
Limit your alcohol intake while taking this medicine because it can increase your risk of developing low blood sugar levels.
You may also need regular tests such as kidney function and blood glucose levels to check that the medicine is working properly.

faq.question: What is Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR used for?
faq.answer: Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR is used for adults with type 2 diabetes to help lower high blood sugar when diet and exercise are not enough. It combines three components that work together to control sugar levels throughout the day.

faq.question: Who should not take Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR?
faq.answer: Individuals should not take Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR if they are allergic to metformin, pioglitazone, or sitagliptin. It should also be avoided in individuals who have severe kidney problems, liver disease, heart failure, current or past bladder cancer, or diabetic ketoacidosis (dangerous build‑up of acids in blood).

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR cause pancreatitis (inflamed pancreas)?
faq.answer: Yes, pancreatitis has been reported with sitagliptin present in Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR. Seek immediate medical attention for severe, persistent belly pain that may reach the back, with or without nausea or vomiting.

faq.question: Is Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR safe if I have heart problems?
faq.answer: Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR should not be used if you have current or past heart failure. If you recently had a heart attack or have severe circulation or breathing problems, tell your doctor before use.

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR affect my kidneys or require stopping before scans?
faq.answer: Kidney function will be checked regularly during Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR treatment. Stop the product before an iodine contrast scan (X‑ray dye), and restart only when your doctor says it is safe, to lower the risk of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)?
faq.answer: Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR alone cannot cause low blood sugar, but low sugar can happen if it is taken with insulin or sulfonylureas. Your doctor may lower those doses, and you should watch for shaking, sweating, a fast heartbeat, hunger, or confusion.

faq.question: When should I stop or pause Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR?
faq.answer: Stop Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR, and get medical help for signs of lactic acidosis, or a severe allergic reaction (rash, hives, blistering/peeling, swelling of face/lips/tongue, trouble breathing). Your doctor may advise you to pause before major surgery, and during severe dehydration, and follow your doctor’s plan to restart safely.

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR treat type-1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No. Alsita-MP 1000 Tablet SR cannot treat type-1 diabetes. It is used only for type 2 diabetes.

description:
Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes.
It controls your blood sugar levels and helps prevent serious complications in the future.
Your doctor may prescribe it alone or along with other diabetes medicines.
Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR may be taken on an empty stomach or with a meal.
However, the dose will depend on your condition and blood sugar levels; therefore, use it as advised by your doctor and do not stop taking this medicine unless the doctor recommends otherwise.
Also, take it regularly and at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
It is also crucial to stay on the diet and exercise program recommended by the doctor while taking this medicine.The most common side effects of this medicine include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, abdominal pain, and constipation.
These effects are usually minor and improve with time.
Low blood sugar level (hypoglycemia) is a possible side effect if you are also taking other diabetes medicines, so you need to know how to recognize and deal with it.
Contact the doctor if the side effects are worrisome or do not go away.Before taking Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR, let the doctor know if you have ever had kidney disease, heart or pancreas problems, or drink a lot of alcohol.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctors before taking this medicine.
Some other medicines you are taking may also interfere with this combination drug; therefore, make sure your doctor knows about all the other medicines you are using.
Limit your alcohol intake while taking this medicine because it can increase your risk of developing low blood sugar levels.
You may also need regular tests such as kidney function and blood glucose levels to check that the medicine is working properly.

faq.question: What is Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR used for?
faq.answer: Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR is used for adults with type 2 diabetes to help lower high blood sugar when diet and exercise are not enough. It combines three components that work together to control sugar levels throughout the day.

faq.question: Who should not take Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR?
faq.answer: Individuals should not take Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR if they are allergic to metformin, pioglitazone, or sitagliptin. It should also be avoided in individuals who have severe kidney problems, liver disease, heart failure, current or past bladder cancer, or diabetic ketoacidosis (dangerous build‑up of acids in blood).

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR cause pancreatitis (inflamed pancreas)?
faq.answer: Yes, pancreatitis has been reported with sitagliptin present in Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR. Seek immediate medical attention for severe, persistent belly pain that may reach the back, with or without nausea or vomiting.

faq.question: Is Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR safe if I have heart problems?
faq.answer: Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR should not be used if you have current or past heart failure. If you recently had a heart attack or have severe circulation or breathing problems, tell your doctor before use.

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR affect my kidneys or require stopping before scans?
faq.answer: Kidney function will be checked regularly during Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR treatment. Stop the product before an iodine contrast scan (X‑ray dye), and restart only when your doctor says it is safe, to lower the risk of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)?
faq.answer: Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR alone cannot cause low blood sugar, but low sugar can happen if it is taken with insulin or sulfonylureas. Your doctor may lower those doses, and you should watch for shaking, sweating, a fast heartbeat, hunger, or confusion.

faq.question: When should I stop or pause Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR?
faq.answer: Stop Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR, and get medical help for signs of lactic acidosis, or a severe allergic reaction (rash, hives, blistering/peeling, swelling of face/lips/tongue, trouble breathing). Your doctor may advise you to pause before major surgery, and during severe dehydration, and follow your doctor’s plan to restart safely.

faq.question: Can Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR treat type-1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No. Alsita-MP 500 Tablet SR cannot treat type-1 diabetes. It is used only for type 2 diabetes.

description:
Altraday Capsule SR is a combination of two medicines.
It is used to reduce pain and inflammation in conditions like rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and osteoarthritis.
It may also be used to relieve muscle pain, back pain, toothache, or pain in the ear and throat.
Altraday Capsule SR can be taken with or without food.
The dose will depend on what you are taking it for and how well it helps your symptoms.
You should take it as advised by your doctor.
Do not take more or use it for a longer duration than recommended by the doctor.The most common side effects of this medicine include nausea, flatulence, indigestion, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and constipation.
If any of these side effects bother you or get worse, you should speak to your doctor.
Your doctor may be able to suggest ways of preventing or reducing the side effects.Before taking it, you should let your doctor know if you have a history of ulcer or bleeding in your stomach, high blood pressure, or have any trouble with your heart, kidneys, or liver.
Let your doctor also know about all the other medicines you are taking because they may affect, or be affected by, this medicine.Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before starting treatment.
You should also avoid drinking alcohol while you are taking this medicine, as alcohol can cause excessive drowsiness.

faq.question: What is Altraday Capsule SR?
faq.answer: Altraday Capsule SR is a combination of two medicines: Aceclofenac and Rabeprazole. This medication helps in relieving pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac works by lowering the levels of chemical substances in the body that cause pain and inflammation. Rabeprazole helps in preventing the digestive problem that may occur due to Aceclofenac.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Altraday Capsule SR when my pain is relieved?
faq.answer: Altraday Capsule SR, when used for long-term pain relief, should be continued for as long as advised by your physician. It can be discontinued if you are using it for short-term pain relief.

faq.question: Can the use of Altraday Capsule SR cause nausea and vomiting?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Altraday Capsule SR can cause nausea and vomiting. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. In case of vomiting, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small frequent sips. Talk to your doctor if vomiting persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like dark colored and strong-smelling urine and a low frequency of urination. Do not take any other medicine without speaking to your doctor.

faq.question: Can the use of Altraday Capsule SR cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Altraday Capsule SR can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: Can I take Altraday Capsule SR with Vitamin B-complex?
faq.answer: Yes, Altraday Capsule SR can be taken with Vitamin B-complex preparations. While Altraday Capsule SR helps to relieve pain, Vitamin B-complex can help to correct the vitamin deficiency that might be causing your symptoms.

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for Altraday Capsule SR?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

description:
Amaryl 1mg Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called sulfonylureas and is used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus in adults.
It helps control blood sugar levels in people with diabetes thereby preventing serious complications of diabetes such as kidney damage and blindness.
Amaryl 1mg Tablet may be used alone or along with other medicines.
It should be taken just before or with the first meal of the day.
Take it regularly at the same time each day to get the maximum benefit.
Your doctor will decide what dose is best for you and this may change from time to time according to your blood sugar levels.Keep taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet, even if you feel well or your blood sugar levels are controlled.
If you stop it without consulting your doctor, your blood sugar levels could rise to put you at risk of diabetes complications such as kidney damage, blindness, nerve problems, and loss of limbs.
Remember that it is only part of a treatment program that should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.
Your lifestyle plays a big part in controlling diabetes.The most common side effects of taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet include low blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia).
It is important to have regular meals and always carry a fast-acting source of glucose such as sugary food or fruit juice with you.
Drinking alcohol can also increase your risk of low blood sugar levels and hence should be avoided.
Some people may experience an increase in weight with this medicine.You should not take Amaryl 1mg Tablet if you have type 1 diabetes mellitus, diabetic ketoacidosis (high levels of acid in your blood), or if you have severe kidney or liver disease.
Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had heart disease, thyroid disease, or some hormonal conditions, as it may not be suitable.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Your blood sugar levels should be checked regularly and your doctor may also advise blood tests to monitor your blood cell counts and liver function.

faq.question: Does Amaryl 1mg Tablet make you sleepy?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1mg Tablet itself does not cause sleepiness. However, it may cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar) when used with other anti-diabetes medicine. Because of this you may feel sleepy or have problems in sleeping.

faq.question: Is Amaryl 1mg Tablet safe for kidneys?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1mg Tablet does not affect kidneys in patients with normal kidney function. However, its use should be avoided in patients with severe kidney disease since Amaryl 1mg Tablet is principally eliminated by the kidneys.

faq.question: Does Amaryl 1mg Tablet cause memory loss?
faq.answer: No, it is not known that Amaryl 1mg Tablet causes memory loss. However, the use of Amaryl 1mg Tablet may cause low blood sugar which may cause problems with concentration and reduced alertness.

faq.question: Who should not take Amaryl 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1mg Tablet should be avoided by patients who are allergic to it, have severe kidney or liver disease, have G6PD-deficiency (an inherited condition affecting red blood cells) or are due to have surgery. Additionally, patients who are trying to get pregnant, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have insulin-dependent diabetes (type 1 diabetes mellitus) should avoid taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet.

faq.question: How long does it take for Amaryl 1mg Tablet to start working?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1mg Tablet takes about 2 to 3 hours to reduce blood sugar levels. You may not feel any difference, but this does not mean the medicine is not working. Continue taking the medication as directed by your doctor and if you have any concerns, discuss it with your doctor.

faq.question: How long do I need to take Amaryl 1mg Tablet? Can I stop the medication?
faq.answer: Usually, the treatment for diabetes is suggested for a long term. You may have to continue the treatment life long. Amaryl 1mg Tablet only controls the sugar levels but does not cure it. Do not stop taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet without talking to your doctor. If you stop taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet suddenly your diabetes may get worse.

faq.question: What can happen if I take more than the recommended dose of Amaryl 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1mg Tablet should be taken strictly as advised by the doctor. Overdose of Amaryl 1mg Tablet may significantly decrease your blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia). If you think you have taken an excess dose and experience a dip in your sugar level, consume enough sugar (e.g., a small bar of sugar cubes, sweet juice or sweetened tea) and inform a doctor immediately. Severe cases of hypoglycemia accompanied by loss of consciousness and coma require immediate medical treatment and admission into hospital.

faq.question: Can you take Amaryl 1mg Tablet on an empty stomach?
faq.answer: No. Taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet on an empty stomach can cause your blood sugar levels to become too low. Low blood sugar can cause dizziness, shaking, anxiety, irritability, a fast heartbeat, and confusion. Therefore, you should always take the medicine with breakfast or the first meal of the day. If you are skipping your meal, then you should also avoid taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet.

faq.question: Can Amaryl 1mg Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, Amaryl 1mg Tablet can cause dizziness as a side effect. If this happens to you, sit or lie down until the symptoms pass. Always carry some sugary food or fruit juice with you in case you experience dizziness while travelling.

faq.question: What should you not eat while taking Amaryl 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: It is advisable to avoid foods that are high in saturated and trans fats, instead consume fats from fish and nuts. Control your carbohydrate intake as this directly affects your blood sugar.

faq.question: Is Amaryl 1mg Tablet safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, Amaryl 1mg Tablet tablet is safe when used as directed by the doctor. However, it may show some side effects. For best results, it should be used in the correct dose and at the same time each day.

faq.question: Can people with diabetes have proteins?
faq.answer: Yes, people with diabetes must include proteins along with other essential nutrients in their daily diet. Proteins are one of the major energy providers among all essential nutrients. Besides, being the building blocks of the human body, proteins break down into glucose to release energy. Unlike carbohydrates, the metabolism of proteins into glucose is much slower. Therefore, the release of energy usually takes a few hours after consumption. Thus, the spike in blood sugar levels might occur after a few hours when you are on a high-protein diet.

faq.question: Are artificial sweeteners good for people with diabetes?
faq.answer: No, artificial sweeteners are not good for people with diabetes. They are composed of chemicals that can cause mild to severe side effects. Thus, it is better to limit or avoid their use as much as you can.

faq.question: Can diabetes cause kidney failure?
faq.answer: Yes, uncontrolled diabetes can cause kidney failure. In the long run, diabetes can affect the kidneys leading to a condition called diabetic nephropathy. Diabetic nephropathy is a condition that is a major cause of kidney failure in patients with diabetes. The best way to prevent damage to kidneys is by keeping diabetes in check, making dietary changes, monitoring sugar levels regularly, getting routine blood tests done, and taking prescribed medications on time.

faq.question: Can diabetes be cured?
faq.answer: Diabetes is a condition that causes changes in your blood glucose levels, which if left uncontrolled, can lead to serious health complications affecting the heart, brain, kidneys, and eyes. However, with simple lifestyle changes, diet, and medications, one can manage their condition and lead a healthy life.

faq.question: What is the use of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1 mg Tablet is used to lower raised blood sugar levels in Type 2 diabetes mellitus (non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus - NIDDM).

faq.question: How does Amaryl 1 mg Tablet work?
faq.answer: The Amaryl 1 mg Tablet contains Glimepiride which acts on insulin-secreting cells called beta cells inside the pancreas and activates calcium channels on cells which lets insulin pass out of the cell. This insulin then makes each cell in the body take up glucose and utilize it, thus lowering raised blood glucose. Therefore, it prevents symptoms of type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: What if i miss my dose?
faq.answer: A patient is advised to take the missed dose as soon as possible or skip to the next dose if it's been too late. A patient should never attempt to take a double dose to compensate for the missed dose as it may prove harmful.

faq.question: Is Amaryl 1 mg Tablet safe with warfarin (blood thinner) if taken by a heart stroke patient?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1 mg Tablet is not recommended with warfarin as these two drugs are contraindicated with each other and hence may result in any harmful symptom when taken together in heart patients.

faq.question: In which conditions should I avoid intake of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Avoid intake of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet and consult a doctor if you have an allergy to sulfa drugs, diabetic ketoacidosis, heart disease, liver or kidney disease, an enzyme deficiency called glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency (G6PD).

faq.question: How should I handle symptoms of low blood sugar level after taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Your blood sugar might get decreased, so regular blood glucose monitoring is required. Signs and symptoms of low blood sugar level are feeling very hungry, dizziness, irritability, confusion, anxiety or shakiness. Try to eat or drink a fast-acting sugar source (like fruit juice, hard candy, crackers, raisins or non-diet soda).

faq.question: Is Amaryl 1 mg Tablet also recommended for type 1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No, Amaryl 1 mg Tablet is only prescribed to treat type 2 diabetes and not type 1 diabetes. If you are type 1 diabetic patient consult with a doctor so that insulin forms can be prescribed for the same.

faq.question: Is Amaryl 1 mg Tablet safe with oral contraceptives?
faq.answer: The patient is advised to talk to a doctor before taking contraceptive pills if he/she is already taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet , then the doctor may change the dose of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet . This is because oral contraceptive pills change body responds to the sugar.

faq.question: How long do I need to take Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Take Amaryl 1 mg Tablet for as long as it is prescribed by your doctor. Do not discontinue Amaryl 1 mg Tablet without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?

faq.question: What is the dosage of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: The dosage of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet is decided by your doctor. Use it in the dose and duration as prescribed.

faq.answer: Amaryl 1 mg Tablet does not cause sleepiness by itself. However, it may cause low blood sugar when used with other anti-diabetic medicine. As a result, you may feel sleepy or have problems in sleeping.

faq.question: Is Amaryl 1 mg Tablet safe for kidneys?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1 mg Tablet is not recommended for patients with kidney dysfunction. Therefore, if you have any kidney problem, inform your doctor before taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet .

faq.question: Does Amaryl 1 mg Tablet cause memory loss?
faq.answer: No, Amaryl 1 mg Tablet does not cause memory loss. However, the use of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet may result in low blood sugar which could impair concentration and alertness.

faq.question: Who should not take Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: If you are allergic to Amaryl 1 mg Tablet , have severe liver or kidney disease, G6PD-deficiency (an inherited condition affecting red blood cells), type 1 diabetes mellitus (insulin-dependent diabetes) or are about to undergo surgery, avoid taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet . Additionally, patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding, or planning to conceive should also avoid taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet .

faq.question: How long does it take for Amaryl 1 mg Tablet to start working?
faq.answer: Amaryl 1 mg Tablet takes 2 to 3 hours to lower blood sugar levels. Even if you don’t notice a difference, the medicine is still effective. Keep taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet as advised by your doctor and if you have any concerns, please discuss with your doctor.

faq.question: What can happen if I take more than the recommended dose of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Overdose of Amaryl 1 mg Tablet may cause hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar), lasting from 12 to 72 hours, and may recur after an initial recovery. Symptoms may not appear for up to 24 hours after ingestion. Vomiting, nausea and epigastric pain may occur. In case of overdose, please seek medical help immediately.

faq.question: Can you take Amaryl 1 mg Tablet on an empty stomach?
faq.answer: No, do not take Amaryl 1 mg Tablet on empty stomach as it may cause too low blood sugar levels and the symptoms include anxiety, dizziness, irritability, shaking, confusion and a fast heartbeat. Therefore, you always take Amaryl 1 mg Tablet with breakfast or the first meal of the day. It is important that you eat every meal when you are on Amaryl 1 mg Tablet .

faq.question: Can Amaryl 1 mg Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Yes, Amaryl 1 mg Tablet may cause weight gain. It stimulates the pancreas to release insulin. It may stimulate hunger and cause mild weight gain in some people. To maintain a stable weight, patients are advised to eat a healthy balanced diet and exercise regularly. However, if you notice changes in your weight, or if you change your lifestyle, or you are in a stress situation, inform your doctor as this may require dose adjustment.

faq.question: Can I consume alcohol while taking Amaryl 1 mg Tablet ?

faq.question: Can the use of Amaryl M 1mg Tablet PR lead to lactic acidosis?

faq.question: Can the use of Amaryl M 1mg Tablet PR lead to Vitamin B12 deficiency?

description:
Amifru-S Tablet is used to treat resistant hypertension, chronic cardiac failure, and hepatic cirrhosis.
It is commonly used when fluid buildup (edema) or high blood pressure cannot be controlled by a single medicine.
It helps remove excess salt and water from the body, reducing swelling and fluid overload.
Take Amifru-S Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor, preferably with breakfast and/or lunch along with a full glass of water.
Avoid taking it in the evening to prevent nighttime urination.
For the best results, take the medicine at the same time every day and do not stop on your own, even if you start feeling better.Continue to follow your doctor’s advice about dietary salt and fluid intake.
In conditions like hypertension or heart failure, your doctor may recommend limiting salt, avoiding alcohol, and maintaining a healthy weight.
Regular follow-up visits are important, as your doctor may monitor blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels (especially potassium and sodium).The most common side effects of Amifru-S Tablet include electrolyte disturbances, hyponatremia (low sodium level in blood), dehydration, and hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).
Because this medicine increases urine output, you may feel thirsty or need to urinate more often.
To reduce side effects, drink adequate water, avoid excessive sweating or dehydration, and do not use salt substitutes containing potassium unless your doctor advises it.Do not take Amifru-S Tablet if you have kidney failure, severe liver disease (hepatic encephalopathy), high potassium levels, or low sodium levels, or if you are dehydrated.
It is also contraindicated in pregnancy and breastfeeding due to potential harm to the baby.
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that may lower blood pressure or increase potassium levels, such as ACE inhibitors, potassium supplements, or certain painkillers (NSAIDs).
Be cautious while driving or operating machinery, as dizziness or drowsiness may occur, especially at the start of treatment.

faq.question: What are the recommended storage conditions for Amifru-S Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: What are the contraindications associated with the use of Amifru-S Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Amifru-S Tablet should be avoided in patients with hypersensitivity to furosemide, sulfonylureas or spironolactone or any other ingredient of the product. The use of this medicine should also be avoided in patients with anuria, acute renal insufficiency, hepatic coma and pre-coma, low blood pressure (hypotension), cardiac arrhythmias, patients taking aminoglycosides or cephalosporins, kidney dysfunction due to drugs which cause renal damage, patients with high potassium levels (hyperkalemia), Addison's disease and in children with moderate to severe renal impairment.

faq.question: What is Amifru-S Tablet?
faq.answer: Amifru-S Tablet is a fixed-dose combination of furosemide (a loop diuretic) and spironolactone (an antagonist of aldosterone). Both are diuretics and they help to remove excess fluid from the body. The use of this combination is advised in patients with resistant hypertension, congestive heart failure (heart failure leading to fluid accumulation in the lung and rest of the body), and liver cirrhosis with fluid retention (edema).

faq.question: Is it safe to use Amifru-S Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, Amifru-S Tablet is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients it may cause common side effects like dizziness, dehydration, decreased sodium level in blood, breast enlargement in males, decreased magnesium level in blood, decreased calcium level in blood, increased blood uric acid. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Amifru-S Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Amifru-S Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better. Do not drive or use any machines.

faq.question: Can the use of Amifru-S Tablet cause gout?
faq.answer: Yes, Amifru-S Tablet can cause gout. Amifru-S Tablet contains furosemide which can increase the blood uric acid levels by increasing its absorption from the kidneys. Increased uric acid levels can cause a gout attack. Inform your doctor if you have hyperuricemia (excess of uric acid in blood) or a history of gout before taking this medicine. Use of Amifru-S Tablet should be avoided in patients with gout.

faq.question: What is Ambrodil-S Syrup?
faq.answer: Ambrodil-S Syrup is a combination of Ambroxol and Salbutamol / Albuterol which relieve cough. Ambroxol is a mucolytic which thins and loosens mucus (phlegm), making it easier to cough out. Salbutamol is a bronchodilator which widens the airways by relaxing its muscles. Together, they make breathing easier.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Ambrodil-S Syrup?
faq.answer: Yes, Ambrodil-S Syrup is safe to you in most of the patients. However, in some patients it may cause some unwanted side effects like tremor, headache, insomnia (difficulty in sleeping), palpitations, dizziness, nervousness, muscle cramp, increased heart rate. Inform your doctor as soon as possible if you experience any problem due to the medication.

faq.question: Can Ambrodil-S Syrup cause headaches and shakiness?
faq.answer: Yes, you may experience headache and shakiness with the use of Ambrodil-S Syrup. Ambrodil-S Syrup is a combination of ambroxol and salbutamol. Salbutamol may cause these side effects. For headaches, drink plenty of water, get sufficient rest and avoid alcohol. Usually headaches go away after a week. If they persist for a long time, contact your doctor. Feeling shaky is a common side effect of Ambrodil-S Syrup and goes away after sometime.

faq.question: What are the instructions for storage and disposal of Ambrodil-S Syrup?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in. The pack should be tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Empagreat-S 10 Tablet if my blood sugar becomes normal?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking Empagreat-S 10 Tablet without your doctor’s advice. Type 2 diabetes is a long-term condition that requires ongoing treatment, even if your sugar levels improve.

faq.question: Do I need to follow a special diet while taking Empagreat-S 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: A healthy, balanced diet is important for managing diabetes. Your doctor or dietitian may suggest specific dietary changes to get the best results from Empagreat-S 10 Tablet.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Empagreat-S 10 Tablet with other diabetes medications?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be prescribed along with other diabetes medicines, but your doctor will decide the best combination based on your condition and response to treatment.

faq.question: Can Empagreat-S 10 Tablet cause dehydration?
faq.answer: Yes, especially empagliflozin, which increases urination. Drink enough fluids throughout the day to stay hydrated and avoid dizziness or low blood pressure.

faq.question: Can Montas-L Tablet be stopped when allergy symptoms are relieved?

faq.question: Can using Montas-L Tablet cause dry mouth?

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Montas-L Tablet?
faq.answer: Alcohol can increase drowsiness and may worsen side effects such as sleepiness or light-headedness. faq.question: Will Montas-L Tablet be more effective if taken in higher doses?

faq.question: What is Montas-L Tablet and how does it work?
faq.answer: Montas-L Tablet is a combination tablet that helps relieve allergy and respiratory discomfort symptoms. It contains medicines that block certain chemicals in the body that trigger allergic reactions and help reduce symptoms such as sneezing, a runny nose, throat irritation, and cough. By targeting the underlying pathways of allergy and cough reflex, it supports symptom relief when used as directed by your doctor.

faq.question: Does Montas-L Tablet cause mood or behavior changes?
faq.answer: Most people do not experience mood or behavior changes with Montas-L Tablet. However, if you notice unusual mood swings, increased irritability, agitation, or behavior that seems out of character after starting the medicine, talk to your doctor. These changes are uncommon and may need evaluation to rule out other causes.

faq.question: Does Montas-L Tablet help with a blocked nose?
faq.answer: Montas-L Tablet is intended to relieve allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, and throat irritation, which can be associated with nasal discomfort. Consult your doctor for the most appropriate treatment for nasal blockage.

faq.question: How many Montas-L Tablet can be taken in a day?
faq.answer: The number of Montas-L Tablet tablets you can take in a day depends on your age, symptoms, and your doctor’s prescription. Do not exceed the dose and frequency recommended by your doctor. If you are unsure how many tablets to take or if your symptoms are changing, talk to your doctor for specific instructions.

faq.question: How do I know if my cough is bacterial?
faq.answer: A cough from a bacterial infection is often accompanied by other signs, such as thick yellow or green sputum, fever, or worsening symptoms over several days rather than improvement. However, distinguishing a bacterial cough from a viral one can be difficult without clinical evaluation. If your cough persists, worsens, or is accompanied by high fever and difficulty breathing, talk to your doctor for proper evaluation and tests.

faq.question: Does Montas-L Tablet affect the kidneys?
faq.answer: There is no direct evidence that Montas-L Tablet negatively affects kidney function in people with normal kidney health when taken at prescribed doses. However, if you have existing kidney problems, are taking other medicines, or have concerns about kidney health, it’s important to inform your doctor. They can determine whether any monitoring or dose adjustments are needed.

faq.question: Is Montas-L Tablet safe for use during pregnancy?
faq.answer: Montas-L Tablet should be used during pregnancy only if the expected benefit outweighs the potential risk to the developing baby. The safety can vary depending on the trimester and the reason for use. Always discuss your symptoms, medical history, and stage of pregnancy with your doctor before starting Montas-L Tablet.

faq.question: Can Montas-L Tablet cause skin rashes?
faq.answer: Yes, in rare cases, Montas-L Tablet may cause an allergic skin reaction. Symptoms can include itching, redness, or raised rashes. Even though the medicine is used to treat allergy symptoms, some individuals may be sensitive to its ingredients. If you notice a new rash, swelling of the face, or any unusual skin reaction after taking Montas-L Tablet, stop using it and seek medical advice immediately.

faq.question: Is Montas-L Tablet safe for children, infants, and elderly patients?
faq.answer: Montas-L Tablet can be used in both children and older adults, but only when a doctor advises it. In children, the dose needs to be carefully adjusted based on age and body weight, as giving too much can cause side effects. In older adults, the medicine may be started at a lower dose and monitored closely to ensure it is safe and working properly.

faq.question: What is Montas-L and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Montas-L is a medicine used to help control allergy symptoms and allergy-related breathing problems in children when prescribed by a doctor. It may relieve symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itching, watery eyes, and allergic cough. In some children, it may also help prevent wheezing linked to allergies or asthma. Montas-L contains two medicines: levocetirizine, which reduces allergy symptoms, and montelukast, which helps reduce inflammation in the airways. A doctor should confirm that your child’s symptoms are allergy-related before starting this medicine.

faq.question: Can Montas-L help with cough?
faq.answer: Montas-L may help with cough if the cough is related to allergies or asthma because it works by reducing allergic reactions in the airways. However, it is usually not helpful for a cough caused by viral infections such as the common cold. Do not combine Montas-L with other cough or allergy medicines unless the doctor advises it, as this may lead to accidental double-dosing. Consult your child’s doctor if the cough continues or is associated with fever, wheezing, or breathing difficulty.

faq.question: Can I change the dose of Montas-L if my child starts feeling better?
faq.answer: Do not increase or decrease the dose of Montas-L on your own. Always follow the dose prescribed by your child’s doctor. Increasing the dose may cause unwanted effects such as excessive sleepiness or mood changes, while reducing or stopping it suddenly may cause allergy symptoms to return. If you think your child is experiencing side effects, consult your doctor before making any changes.

faq.question: How should Montas-L be stored?
faq.answer: Montas-L should be stored at room temperature in a dry place, away from direct heat and sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. As with all medicines, it should be kept out of the sight and reach of children to prevent accidental ingestion.

faq.question: Can I start Montas-L if my child has a sports event soon?
faq.answer: You should not start Montas-L without consulting your child’s doctor. In some children, this medicine may cause mild sleepiness, dizziness, or tiredness, which could affect concentration or physical performance. If your child has an important sports event or activity, discuss this with the doctor before starting the medicine.

faq.question: Is Montas-L safe if my child has a mood disorder?
faq.answer: Montas-L should be used with caution in children who have mood or behavioral disorders. In rare cases, medicines containing montelukast have been associated with mood changes, anxiety, irritability, sleep disturbances, or unusual behavior. If your child already has a mood disorder, consult the doctor before giving Montas-L. Monitor your child for any unusual emotional or behavioral changes while using the medicine.

faq.question: Can Montas-L treat an asthma attack that has already started?
faq.answer: No, Montas-L should not be used to treat an asthma attack that is already in progress. It is usually prescribed to help prevent allergy-related breathing symptoms over time. If your child has an asthma attack, you should use the reliever medicine prescribed by the doctor and seek medical help if needed.

faq.question: How should I give Montas-L to my child?
faq.answer: Give Montas-L exactly as prescribed by your child’s doctor. Follow the recommended dose and timing carefully. Do not combine it with other allergy medicines unless advised. Because this medicine may cause sleepiness in some children, the doctor may recommend giving the medicine at a specific time of day. Make sure your child drinks enough fluids and follows the doctor’s instructions for safe use.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Montas-L?

Monitor your child for unusual behavior, sleep problems, or skin reactions after starting the medicine, and consult the doctor if any concerning symptoms occur.

faq.question: What is the difference between hives and a drug rash?
faq.answer: Hives usually appear as raised, itchy welts on the skin that can move from one area to another and may come and go quickly. A drug rash, on the other hand, often appears as a more fixed rash that stays in one area and may last longer. Both can occur as allergic reactions to medicines. If you notice facial swelling, breathing difficulty, or a severe rash, seek medical help immediately.

faq.question: How long should children take montelukast-containing medicines like Montas-L?

faq.question: What precautions should I follow while administering Montas-L?

faq.answer: Montas-L Syrup may help with cough if the cough is related to allergies or asthma because it works by reducing allergic reactions in the airways. However, it is usually not helpful for a cough caused by viral infections such as the common cold. Do not combine Montas-L Syrup with other cough or allergy medicines unless the doctor advises it, as this may lead to accidental double-dosing. Consult your child’s doctor if the cough continues or is associated with fever, wheezing, or breathing difficulty.

faq.question: Can I change the dose of Montas-L Syrup if my child starts feeling better?
faq.answer: Do not increase or decrease the dose of Montas-L Syrup on your own. Always follow the dose prescribed by your child’s doctor. Increasing the dose may cause unwanted effects such as excessive sleepiness or mood changes, while reducing or stopping it suddenly may cause allergy symptoms to return. If you think your child is experiencing side effects, consult your doctor before making any changes.

faq.question: How should Montas-L Syrup be stored?
faq.answer: Montas-L Syrup should be stored at room temperature in a dry place, away from direct heat and sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. As with all medicines, it should be kept out of the sight and reach of children to prevent accidental ingestion.

faq.question: Can I start Montas-L Syrup if my child has a sports event soon?
faq.answer: You should not start Montas-L Syrup without consulting your child’s doctor. In some children, this medicine may cause mild sleepiness, dizziness, or tiredness, which could affect concentration or physical performance. If your child has an important sports event or activity, discuss this with the doctor before starting the medicine.

faq.question: Is Montas-L Syrup safe if my child has a mood disorder?
faq.answer: Montas-L Syrup should be used with caution in children who have mood or behavioral disorders. In rare cases, medicines containing montelukast have been associated with mood changes, anxiety, irritability, sleep disturbances, or unusual behavior. If your child already has a mood disorder, consult the doctor before giving Montas-L Syrup. Monitor your child for any unusual emotional or behavioral changes while using the medicine.

faq.question: Can Montas-L Syrup treat an asthma attack that has already started?
faq.answer: No, Montas-L Syrup should not be used to treat an asthma attack that is already in progress. It is usually prescribed to help prevent allergy-related breathing symptoms over time. If your child has an asthma attack, you should use the reliever medicine prescribed by the doctor and seek medical help if needed.

faq.question: How should I give Montas-L Syrup to my child?
faq.answer: Give Montas-L Syrup exactly as prescribed by your child’s doctor. Follow the recommended dose and timing carefully. Do not combine it with other allergy medicines unless advised. Because this medicine may cause sleepiness in some children, the doctor may recommend giving the medicine at a specific time of day. Make sure your child drinks enough fluids and follows the doctor’s instructions for safe use.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Montas-L Syrup?
faq.answer: Montas-L Syrup may cause mild side effects such as sleepiness, headache, stomach upset, or dry mouth in some children. A few children may also experience sleep-related changes, including nightmares, irritability, or mood changes. Rarely, allergic reactions such as rash, hives, or swelling may occur. Monitor your child for unusual behavior, sleep problems, or skin reactions after starting the medicine, and consult the doctor if any concerning symptoms occur.

faq.question: How long should children take montelukast-containing medicines like Montas-L Syrup?
faq.answer: Only a doctor can determine how long a child should take medicines that contain montelukast. The duration depends on the child’s symptoms, allergy triggers, and overall health. Do not continue the medicine indefinitely or stop it suddenly without medical advice. If you notice changes in behavior, mood, or sleep, consult your doctor promptly.

faq.question: What precautions should I follow while administering Montas-L Syrup?
faq.answer: While giving Montas-L Syrup, avoid combining it with other medicines that cause drowsiness unless advised by the doctor. Do not use it as a routine treatment for every cough or cold. Watch for sleep disturbances, unusual behavior, rash, or swelling while your child is taking the medicine. Seek urgent medical attention if your child develops breathing difficulty, facial swelling, a severe rash, or significant mood changes. Always follow the dosage instructions provided by the doctor.

faq.question: Can the use of Montu-L Tablet cause drowsiness or sleepiness?
faq.answer: Some people may feel drowsy or sleepy when taking Montu-L Tablet, though this is uncommon. If you notice that you feel unusually tired or sleepy after taking it, be cautious when driving or operating machinery. If drowsiness becomes bothersome or affects your daily activities, talk to your doctor.

faq.question: Can Montu-L Tablet be stopped when allergy symptoms are relieved?
faq.answer: You should not stop taking Montu-L Tablet simply because your allergy symptoms have improved. Your doctor should determine the course and duration of the medicine based on your condition. Abruptly stopping before the recommended duration may not fully control your symptoms, so always talk to your doctor before discontinuing.

faq.question: Can using Montu-L Tablet cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Dry mouth is a possible side effect of Montu-L Tablet. Drinking water at regular intervals, using sugar-free candies or chewing gum may help. If dry mouth persists or becomes uncomfortable, talk to your doctor about ways to manage it.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Montu-L Tablet?
faq.answer: Alcohol can increase drowsiness and may worsen side effects such as sleepiness or light-headedness. While there is no direct contraindication, combining alcohol with Montu-L Tablet may make you feel more sedated or less alert. It is generally best to avoid or limit alcohol while taking this medicine and discuss any concerns with your doctor.

faq.question: Will Montu-L Tablet be more effective if taken in higher doses?
faq.answer: Taking more than the recommended dose of Montu-L Tablet may increase the chance of side effects. Always follow the dose and frequency prescribed by your doctor. If you feel your symptoms are not well controlled, talk to your doctor rather than increasing the dose on your own.

faq.question: What is Montu-L Tablet and how does it work?
faq.answer: Montu-L Tablet is a combination tablet that helps relieve allergy and respiratory discomfort symptoms. It contains medicines that block certain chemicals in the body that trigger allergic reactions and help reduce symptoms such as sneezing, a runny nose, throat irritation, and cough. By targeting the underlying pathways of allergy and cough reflex, it supports symptom relief when used as directed by your doctor.

faq.question: Does Montu-L Tablet cause mood or behavior changes?
faq.answer: Most people do not experience mood or behavior changes with Montu-L Tablet. However, if you notice unusual mood swings, increased irritability, agitation, or behavior that seems out of character after starting the medicine, talk to your doctor. These changes are uncommon and may need evaluation to rule out other causes.

faq.question: Does Montu-L Tablet help with a blocked nose?
faq.answer: Montu-L Tablet is intended to relieve allergy-related symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, and throat irritation, which can be associated with nasal discomfort. It may help improve overall symptoms, but if your blocked nose is due to severe congestion, other targeted treatments (such as a nasal decongestant recommended by your doctor) may provide more direct relief. Consult your doctor for the most appropriate treatment for nasal blockage.

faq.question: How many Montu-L Tablet can be taken in a day?
faq.answer: The number of Montu-L Tablet tablets you can take in a day depends on your age, symptoms, and your doctor’s prescription. Do not exceed the dose and frequency recommended by your doctor. If you are unsure how many tablets to take or if your symptoms are changing, talk to your doctor for specific instructions.

faq.question: Does Montu-L Tablet affect the kidneys?
faq.answer: There is no direct evidence that Montu-L Tablet negatively affects kidney function in people with normal kidney health when taken at prescribed doses. However, if you have existing kidney problems, are taking other medicines, or have concerns about kidney health, it’s important to inform your doctor. They can determine whether any monitoring or dose adjustments are needed.

faq.question: Is Montu-L Tablet safe for use during pregnancy?
faq.answer: Montu-L Tablet should be used during pregnancy only if the expected benefit outweighs the potential risk to the developing baby. The safety can vary depending on the trimester and the reason for use. Always discuss your symptoms, medical history, and stage of pregnancy with your doctor before starting Montu-L Tablet.

faq.question: Can Montu-L Tablet cause skin rashes?
faq.answer: Yes, in rare cases, Montu-L Tablet may cause an allergic skin reaction. Symptoms can include itching, redness, or raised rashes. Even though the medicine is used to treat allergy symptoms, some individuals may be sensitive to its ingredients. If you notice a new rash, swelling of the face, or any unusual skin reaction after taking Montu-L Tablet, stop using it and seek medical advice immediately.

faq.question: Is Montu-L Tablet safe for children, infants, and elderly patients?
faq.answer: Montu-L Tablet can be used in both children and older adults, but only when a doctor advises it. In children, the dose needs to be carefully adjusted based on age and body weight, as giving too much can cause side effects. In older adults, the medicine may be started at a lower dose and monitored closely to ensure it is safe and working properly.

faq.question: What is Montina-L Tablet?
faq.answer: Montina-L Tablet is a combination of two medicines: Montelukast and Levocetirizine. Levocetirizine is an antiallergic which helps to relieve allergy symptoms like a runny nose, sneezing, watery eyes, and cough. It works by lowering chemicals in the body that cause allergy symptoms. Montelukast works by blocking another chemical messenger (leukotriene) and reducing inflammation (swelling) in the airways and nose. This further helps to relieve the symptoms.

faq.question: Can the use of Montina-L Tablet cause drowsiness or sleepiness?
faq.answer: Yes, the most common side effect of Montina-L Tablet is sleepiness. Do not drive, operate heavy machinery, or engage in other activities that need your full attention unless your doctor says that you may do so. Do not drink alcohol or take other central nervous system depressants, such as cough and cold medicines. Also, avoid taking certain pain relief medicines and medicines that help you sleep, as they can lead to severe drowsiness or worsen it, causing falls or accidents.

faq.question: Can Montina-L Tablet be stopped when allergy symptoms are relieved?
faq.answer: No, Montina-L Tablet should be continued as advised by the doctor. If you experience any side effects of this medicine or the symptoms of allergy worsen, consult the doctor for re-evaluation.

faq.question: Can the use of Montina-L Tablet cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Montina-L Tablet can cause dry mouth. If you experience dry mouth, drink plenty of water. Take regular sips during the day and keep some water by your bed at night. You may use lip balm if your lips are also dry.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Montina-L Tablet?
faq.answer: No, do not take alcohol while taking Montina-L Tablet. Drinking alcohol will increase the severity of drowsiness/sleepiness caused by Montina-L Tablet.

faq.question: Will Montina-L Tablet be more effective if taken in higher doses?
faq.answer: No, taking a higher dose of this medicine than recommended will not make it more effective. Consuming higher than the recommended dose of Montina-L Tablet can cause increased side effects. If the symptoms are getting severe, please consult the doctor for re-evaluation.

faq.question: What are the instructions for the storage and disposal of Montina-L Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, or other people.

faq.question: What is Empha-L 10 Tablet, and how does it work?
faq.answer: Empha-L 10 Tablet combines two medications, empagliflozin and linagliptin, used to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes. Empagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess glucose through urine, while linagliptin increases insulin secretion and lowers glucose production by inhibiting the DPP-4 enzyme.

faq.question: Who is Empha-L 10 Tablet prescribed for?
faq.answer: Empha-L 10 Tablet is prescribed for adults with type 2 diabetes to improve blood sugar levels when diet and exercise alone are not enough. It may also be used in people with type 2 diabetes who have cardiovascular disease to reduce the risk of heart-related complications.

faq.question: How should I take Empha-L 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Empha-L 10 Tablet is taken once daily, with or without food, as directed by your doctor. It is important to follow your prescribed dosage and schedule. Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Can Empha-L 10 Tablet be used for type 1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No, Empha-L 10 Tablet is not recommended for individuals with type 1 diabetes or those with diabetic ketoacidosis. It is specifically for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: Can Empha-L 10 Tablet cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)?
faq.answer: Empha-L 10 Tablet alone is unlikely to cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), but the risk may increase when taken with other diabetes medications such as insulin or sulfonylureas. Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly and follow your healthcare provider's recommendations to prevent hypoglycemia.

faq.question: Can Empha-L 10 Tablet be taken during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
faq.answer: Empha-L 10 Tablet is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss alternative diabetes treatments with your doctor.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Empha-L 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: While taking Empha-L 10 Tablet, avoid alcohol as it can increase the risk of low blood sugar or dehydration. Also, make sure to stay hydrated, especially if you're engaging in activities that may cause fluid loss, such as exercise or hot weather.

faq.question: Can Empha-L 10 Tablet help with weight loss?
faq.answer: Empagliflozin, one of the components of Empha-L 10 Tablet, may promote mild weight loss by helping your body excrete excess glucose through urine. However, Empha-L 10 Tablet is not specifically prescribed for weight loss and should be used only as directed for managing type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: How should Empha-L 10 Tablet be stored?
faq.answer: Store Empha-L 10 Tablet at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light. Keep it out of reach of children and pets, and do not use the medication after its expiration date.

faq.question: What should I do in case of an overdose?
faq.answer: If you suspect an overdose, seek emergency medical attention immediately. Symptoms of an overdose may include severe dizziness, fainting, or signs of low blood sugar, such as confusion, sweating, and rapid heartbeat.

faq.question: Can Empha-L 10 Tablet be used with other diabetes medications?
faq.answer: Yes, Empha-L 10 Tablet can be used with other diabetes medications if prescribed by your doctor. However, it is important to monitor your blood sugar levels carefully, as combining multiple medications can increase the risk of hypoglycemia or other side effects.

faq.question: Can I have food after taking Choline Zytee-L Gel?

description:
AMLOkind 5 Tablet belongs to a class of medicines known as calcium channel blockers.
It is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) and prevent angina (heart-related chest pain).
It lowers blood pressure and reduces the heart's workload, which helps prevent heart attacks and strokes.
AMLOkind 5 Tablet may be prescribed alone or along with other medicines.
The dose depends on what you are taking it for and the severity of your condition.
You can take it at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is best to take it at about the same time each day.
You should take this medicine for as long as it is prescribed for you.
Even if you feel well, do not stop this medicine on your own because high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Keeping yourself active with regular exercise, managing your weight, and eating a healthy diet will also help control your blood pressure.The most common side effects include headache, edema, fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and somnolence.

faq.question: How long does it take for AMLOkind 5 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: AMLOkind 5 Tablet starts working on the day it is taken. However, it may take weeks to see the full effect. You should continue taking the medicine even if you feel better or if you do not notice any considerable difference. Consult your doctor if you have any concerns or you feel worse after taking the medicine.

faq.question: Does AMLOkind 5 Tablet cause itching?
faq.answer: AMLOkind 5 Tablet may cause itching in some patients, though it is an uncommon side effect. However, if you experience severe itching contact your doctor.

faq.question: Is AMLOkind 5 Tablet bad for the kidneys?
faq.answer: No, there is no evidence that AMLOkind 5 Tablet causes deterioration of kidney problems. AMLOkind 5 Tablet can be used in normal doses in patients with kidney problems. In fact, its blood pressure-lowering effect, it helps to prevent injury to the kidneys due to hypertension.

faq.question: Should I take AMLOkind 5 Tablet in the morning or at night?
faq.answer: AMLOkind 5 Tablet can be taken anytime of the day. Usually, it is advised to be taken in the morning, but your doctor may advise to take it in the evening as well. You should take it at the same time each day so that you remember to take it and consistent levels of medicine are maintained in the body.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take AMLOkind 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should keep on taking AMLOkind 5 Tablet for as long as your doctor has recommended you to take it. You may need to take it lifelong. Do not stop taking it, even if you feel well or your blood pressure is well controlled. If you stop taking AMLOkind 5 Tablet, your blood pressure may increase again and your condition may worsen.

faq.question: Is AMLOkind 5 Tablet a beta-blocker?
faq.answer: No, AMLOkind 5 Tablet is not a beta-blocker. It belongs to a class of medicines known as calcium channel blockers. It lowers blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels so that blood can easily flow through the blood vessels.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of AMLOkind 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: AMLOkind 5 Tablet may cause some serious side effects such as liver problems (yellowing of skin, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite), pancreatitis (severe stomach pain, nausea, and vomiting), and recurrent chest pain which may be indicative of a heart attack. However, these side effects are rarely seen. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medicine to you because the benefit to you is greater than the risk of any potential side effects. Follow your doctor's advice.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking AMLOkind 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: Consult your doctor first before starting any new prescription or non-prescription medicines or supplements. Take low sodium and low-fat diet, and adhere to the lifestyle changes as advised by your doctor. Avoid eating grapefruit (chakotra) or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOkind 5 Tablet. Stop smoking and taking alcohol as this helps to lower your blood pressure and prevents heart problems.

faq.question: I have developed ankle edema and swelling over my feet after using a AMLOkind 5 Tablet. What should I do?
faq.answer: AMLOkind 5 Tablet can cause ankle or foot swelling. To reduce swelling raise your legs while you are sitting down. Talk to your doctor if it does not go away.

faq.question: What lifestyle changes should be made while using Amtas-AT 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Making lifestyle changes can boost your health while taking Amtas-AT 25 Tablet. Avoid smoking, as smoking increases your risk of having heart attack and stroke. faq.question: Can I stop taking Amtas-AT 25 Tablet if I feel well?

faq.question: What are the contraindications associated with the use of Amtas-AT 25 Tablet?

faq.question: Can the use of Amtas-AT 25 Tablet cause headache?

faq.question: What is Amtas-E Tablet used for?

faq.question: Who should not take Amtas-E Tablet?
faq.answer: Do not take Amtas-E Tablet if you are allergic to amlodipine, enalapril, or any other ingredient in the medicine; have a history of angioedema (swelling of the lips, tongue, or throat); have severe kidney or liver disease; severe aortic stenosis (narrowing of the heart’s aortic valve); or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (a condition where the heart muscle, especially the left ventricle, becomes abnormally thick). Amtas-E Tablet should also not be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

faq.question: What precautions should I take before using Amtas-E Tablet?

faq.question: Are there any serious side effects of Amtas-E Tablet?
faq.answer: Serious side effects of Amtas-E Tablet include angioedema (swelling of the lips, face, or throat); signs of kidney or liver problems (yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, abdominal pain, or inability to urinate); a severe drop in blood pressure; fainting; persistent vomiting; or diarrhea. faq.question: How long should I use Amtas-E Tablet, and when will I see results?

faq.question: What is Linares-E Tablet, and how does it work?
faq.answer: Linares-E Tablet combines two medications, empagliflozin and linagliptin, used to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes. Empagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess glucose through urine, while linagliptin increases insulin secretion and lowers glucose production by inhibiting the DPP-4 enzyme.

faq.question: Who is Linares-E Tablet prescribed for?
faq.answer: Linares-E Tablet is prescribed for adults with type 2 diabetes to improve blood sugar levels when diet and exercise alone are not enough. It may also be used in people with type 2 diabetes who have cardiovascular disease to reduce the risk of heart-related complications.

faq.question: How should I take Linares-E Tablet?
faq.answer: Linares-E Tablet is taken once daily, with or without food, as directed by your doctor. It is important to follow your prescribed dosage and schedule. Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Can Linares-E Tablet be used for type 1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No, Linares-E Tablet is not recommended for individuals with type 1 diabetes or those with diabetic ketoacidosis. It is specifically for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: Can Linares-E Tablet cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)?
faq.answer: Linares-E Tablet alone is unlikely to cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), but the risk may increase when taken with other diabetes medications such as insulin or sulfonylureas. Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly and follow your healthcare provider's recommendations to prevent hypoglycemia.

faq.question: Can Linares-E Tablet be taken during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
faq.answer: Linares-E Tablet is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss alternative diabetes treatments with your doctor.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Linares-E Tablet?
faq.answer: While taking Linares-E Tablet, avoid alcohol as it can increase the risk of low blood sugar or dehydration. Also, make sure to stay hydrated, especially if you're engaging in activities that may cause fluid loss, such as exercise or hot weather.

faq.question: Can Linares-E Tablet help with weight loss?
faq.answer: Empagliflozin, one of the components of Linares-E Tablet, may promote mild weight loss by helping your body excrete excess glucose through urine. However, Linares-E Tablet is not specifically prescribed for weight loss and should be used only as directed for managing type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: How should Linares-E Tablet be stored?
faq.answer: Store Linares-E Tablet at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light. Keep it out of reach of children and pets, and do not use the medication after its expiration date.

faq.question: What should I do in case of an overdose?
faq.answer: If you suspect an overdose, seek emergency medical attention immediately. Symptoms of an overdose may include severe dizziness, fainting, or signs of low blood sugar, such as confusion, sweating, and rapid heartbeat.

faq.question: Can Linares-E Tablet be used with other diabetes medications?
faq.answer: Yes, Linares-E Tablet can be used with other diabetes medications if prescribed by your doctor. However, it is important to monitor your blood sugar levels carefully, as combining multiple medications can increase the risk of hypoglycemia or other side effects.

faq.question: How long does it take for aMTas 5 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: aMTas 5 Tablet starts working on the day it is taken. However, it may take weeks to see the full effect. faq.question: Does aMTas 5 Tablet cause itching?

faq.question: Is aMTas 5 Tablet bad for the kidneys?
faq.answer: No, there is no evidence that aMTas 5 Tablet causes deterioration of kidney problems. aMTas 5 Tablet can be used in normal doses in patients with kidney problems. In fact, its blood pressure-lowering effect, it helps to prevent injury to the kidneys due to hypertension.

faq.question: Should I take aMTas 5 Tablet in the morning or at night?

faq.question: For how long do I need to take aMTas 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should keep on taking aMTas 5 Tablet for as long as your doctor has recommended you to take it. You may need to take it lifelong. faq.question: Is aMTas 5 Tablet a beta-blocker?
faq.answer: No, aMTas 5 Tablet is not a beta-blocker. It belongs to a class of medicines known as calcium channel blockers. It lowers blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels so that blood can easily flow through the blood vessels.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of aMTas 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: aMTas 5 Tablet may cause some serious side effects such as liver problems (yellowing of skin, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite), pancreatitis (severe stomach pain, nausea, and vomiting), and recurrent chest pain which may be indicative of a heart attack. However, these side effects are rarely seen. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medicine to you because the benefit to you is greater than the risk of any potential side effects. Follow your doctor's advice.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking aMTas 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: Consult your doctor first before starting any new prescription or non-prescription medicines or supplements. Stop smoking and taking alcohol as this helps to lower your blood pressure and prevents heart problems.

faq.question: I have developed ankle edema and swelling over my feet after using a aMTas 5 Tablet. What should I do?

description:
Anastronat tablet is a prescription medication containing Anastrozole as its active ingredient.
It is primarily used in treating advanced breast cancer in post-menopausal women.
Breast cancer is one of the most common cancers among women, and Anastronat tablet helps slow down or halt the growth of cancer cells by reducing the levels of oestrogen in the body.
This medicine works by blocking the enzyme aromatase, which is responsible for oestrogen production.
Since some types of breast cancer depend on oestrogen to grow, lowering its levels aids in controlling the spread of the disease.
Anastronat tablet is typically prescribed as part of a long-term treatment plan, and its benefits are maximised when taken regularly according to your doctor’s instructions.
You should take Anastronat tablet exactly as prescribed.
The dose and duration will be determined by your doctor based on your condition.
It should be swallowed whole with a glass of water, preferably after meals to minimise stomach upset.
Do not skip doses and never take more than the recommended amount.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is nearly time for your next dose.
Like all medications, Anastronat tablet may cause some side effects, although not everyone experiences them.
Common side effects may include hot flushes, joint pain, tiredness, nausea, or weakness.
Inform your doctor if any side effects persist or become bothersome.
Regular follow-ups and health check-ups are crucial while using this medicine to monitor your response and overall health.
Before starting treatment with Anastronat tablet, inform your doctor if you have any history of liver or kidney problems, osteoporosis, heart conditions, or if you are taking other medicines.
This medicine is not intended for use in pre-menopausal women, pregnant women, or breastfeeding mothers.
Following your doctor’s advice, maintaining a healthy diet, and exercising regularly can support your recovery and enhance treatment outcomes.

faq.question: Can Anastronat tablet be used in men?
faq.answer: Anastronat tablet has been approved for use only in advanced breast cancer in post-menopausal women. However, various studies for using Anastrozole in older men with lower levels of testosterone are ongoing. Anastrozole has been found to improve Testosterone levels in adult males and help in increasing height in boys. Thus, studies on the use of Anastrozole to increase adult height in boys with early puberty are ongoing. The long-term efficacy and safety of using Anastrozole (and similar medicines) in males have not yet been established, and their routine use is therefore not recommended.

faq.question: What is the ideal duration for Anastronat tablet therapy?
faq.answer: Approximately 5 years of therapy with the Anastronat tablet has been found to yield optimum results. However, the duration will depend on the response to treatment. Follow your doctor's instructions and do not discontinue this medication without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Can Anastronat tablet cause bone weakness?
faq.answer: Yes, long-term use of Anastronat tablet may reduce bone mineral density, which can increase the risk of osteoporosis or fractures. Your doctor may recommend regular bone density tests, calcium/vitamin D supplements, or lifestyle changes to protect your bones.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Anastronat tablet with other medicines?
faq.answer: Always inform your doctor about all medicines, vitamins, or herbal supplements you are taking. Some medicines may interfere with the effectiveness of Anastronat tablet or increase side effects. Your doctor will advise you on safe combinations.

Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR is used to treat and prevent heart-related chest pain (angina).
Angina occurs when the heart muscle is not getting enough blood.
This medicine works by relaxing and widening blood vessels so blood can flow more easily to the heart.
Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR should be taken in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.
It may be taken with or without food, preferably at a fixed time each day.
Do not consume more than the recommended dose, as this may have harmful effects on your body.
You can develop tolerance to this medicine over time, which means that the same dose becomes less effective.
You have to stick to a really specific dosing schedule to prevent this from happening.The most common side effect of this medicine is a headache, which may be severe.
This can sometimes be helped by drinking plenty of fluids and avoiding alcohol.
You may also experience lightheadedness, which could increase your risk of having a fall.
There are other, rarer side effects, some of them serious.
Ask your doctor and read the leaflet that comes with the medicine to make sure you are keeping safe.Do not use this medicine if you are taking medicines to treat high blood pressure in your lungs (pulmonary hypertension), erectile dysfunction, or if you have anemia or glaucoma (increased pressure inside the eye).
Always tell your doctor what other health conditions you have and what other medicines you are taking.
It is best not to drink alcohol with this medicine as it increases some of the side effects.
If you are affected by dizziness, avoid driving.
If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, ask your doctor before taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can I take sildenafil if I am taking Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR?
faq.answer: No, you should not take sildenafil if you are taking Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR. Taking these two medicines together can cause an excessive fall in blood pressure, which may even be life-threatening.

faq.question: What effect does Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR have on blood pressure?
faq.answer: Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR decreases the blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels, but is not recommended for the treatment of high blood pressure. The drop in blood pressure may cause lightheadedness, especially when changing your position suddenly.

faq.question: Does the effect of Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR wear off after some time?
faq.answer: Yes, excessive use of Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR may cause tolerance, which means that Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR may lose its effectiveness on you. Therefore, usually the doctors prescribe the smallest dose required for effective relief of an acute angina attack. This helps maintain the effectiveness of Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR.

faq.question: What does too much Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR do?
faq.answer: Excess Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR may result in low blood pressure, sweating, nausea, vomiting, headache, weak and fast pulse. It may also cause weakness, lightheadedness on standing, and the patient might even faint. The patient will require emergency medical treatment in such a case.

faq.question: Can I stop using Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR as I feel better now?
faq.answer: Stopping Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR suddenly may bring on attacks of angina, especially if you have been using it for several weeks or more. Talk to your doctor, who will advise you to reduce the dose gradually over 4 to 6 weeks before you stop using it completely.

faq.question: Does Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR stop heart attacks?
faq.answer: Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR is prescribed to prevent attacks of heart-related chest pain (angina) in patients with coronary artery disease. In this disease, the blood vessels (coronary arteries) that supply blood to the heart become narrowed, because of which the heart has to work harder to get enough oxygen. Angiplat 2.5 Capsule TR prevents angina by relaxing the blood vessels so that the heart does not have to work very hard. Also, relaxation of the coronary arteries increases the oxygen supply to the heart.

faq.question: Can I feel dizzy after taking Angizaar 25 Tablet?

faq.question: Is Angizaar 25 Tablet a good blood pressure medicine?

faq.question: For how long do I need to take Angizaar 25 Tablet?

faq.question: Does Angizaar 25 Tablet cause weight gain?

faq.question: Can I just stop taking Anti-Thyrox 10 Tablet?
