description:
Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR is a medicine used to treat hypertension (high blood pressure).
This combination medicine controls blood pressure when a single medication is not effective.
By lowering the blood pressure, it helps in preventing future heart attack and stroke.
You can take Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR at any time of day, on empty stomach, but it is best to take it at the same time each day.
Keep taking it for as long as advised by your doctor.
Even if you feel well, do not stop this medicine on your own because high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Keeping active with regular exercise, reducing your weight and eating a healthy diet will also help control your blood pressure.
Follow your doctor’s advice while taking this medicine.It may cause side effects like fatigue, ankle swelling, headache, slow heart rate, and nausea.
It may also cause dizziness, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.
To reduce the swelling, raise your legs while sitting down.
You may be asked for regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes level while on the treatment.Before taking it, let your doctor know if you have any liver or kidney problems.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
You also need to tell your doctor what other medicines you are taking especially those used to treat high blood pressure or heart conditions.

faq.question: What is Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR used for?
faq.answer: Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR is used to treat high blood pressure. This medicine helps lower blood pressure and improve blood flow to the heart, thereby preventing the risk of heart attack or stroke.

faq.question: How does Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR work in controlling high blood pressure?
faq.answer: Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR works in two ways: Atenolol in Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR slows down your heart rate to reduce how hard your heart has to work, while Nifedipine in Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR relaxes and widens your blood vessels so blood can flow more easily. Together, they effectively manage hypertension.

faq.question: What serious side effects of Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR should I watch out for?
faq.answer: Serious side effects of Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR include a slow heart rate, extreme dizziness, shortness of breath, swelling, chest pain that worsens, or signs of liver problems such as yellowing of the skin or eyes. Contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of these.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR once my blood pressure is normal?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR suddenly, even if your blood pressure becomes normal. Stopping the medicine without your doctor’s advice can lead to a dangerous spike in blood pressure levels and may increase the risk of chest pain or a heart attack.

faq.question: Who should avoid using Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR?
faq.answer: Individuals should avoid using Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR if they have severe heart problems, very low blood pressure, slow heart rate, asthma, or serious kidney or liver issues. Individuals should also avoid Beta-Nicardia Capsule SR if they are taking medicines like rifampicin or monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs).

Betacard 25 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called beta-blockers.
It is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension), angina (heart-related chest pain), and irregular heart rhythms (arrhythmia).
It helps prevent cardiovascular complications such as heart attacks and strokes.
Betacard 25 Tablet may be prescribed alone or together with other medications.
The dose and frequency depend on what you are taking it for and the severity of your condition.
It may be taken empty stomach or with a meal, but take it regularly at the same time each day to get the most benefit.

These are usually mild and short-lived.
It may also cause shortness of breath or low blood pressure in some people.
To reduce the risk of side effects, your doctor will probably start the medicine at a low dose and gradually increase it.

faq.question: How many hours does Betacard 25 Tablet take to reduce high blood pressure?
faq.answer: Usually, Betacard 25 Tablet starts working within 3 hours, but it can take up to 2 weeks to reach its full effect. It is important to keep taking your medicine in the prescribed dose and duration to get the maximum benefit of Betacard 25 Tablet.

faq.question: Should I take Betacard 25 Tablet in the morning or at night?
faq.answer: Betacard 25 Tablet can be taken anytime in the morning or evening, usually prescribed once or twice daily. However, your very first dose of Betacard 25 Tablet may make you feel dizzy, so it is better to take your first dose at bedtime. After that, if you do not feel dizzy, you may take it any time of the day. Follow the advice of your doctor. It is advised to take it at the same time each day so that you remember to take it and consistent levels of medicine are maintained in the body.

faq.question: What if I take more than the prescribed dose of Betacard 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you take more than the prescribed dose, your heart rate may slow down and you may find it difficult to breathe. It can also cause dizziness and trembling. If you experience any of such side effects, seek immediate medical assistance. Avoid driving yourself to avoid any mishap. Get someone else to drive you or call for an ambulance. Take the Betacard 25 Tablet packet or leaflet inside it, plus any remaining medicine, with you.

faq.question: What are the most common side effects of Betacard 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: The most common side effects of Betacard 25 Tablet include cold extremities (feeling extreme cold), fatigue, slow heart rate, nausea, diarrhea and dizziness. However, these are usually mild and short-lived and not everyone will experience these side effects. But, if these do not resolve and bother you, consult your doctor to know about ways of coping up with them. Your doctor may also suggest ways of preventing them in future.

faq.question: Can Betacard 25 Tablet cause dizziness? How do I prevent it?

However, this is temporary and usually goes away as the treatment continues. It would be best to avoid alcohol while being on treatment, as it may worsen the dizziness.

faq.question: What should I tell my doctor before taking Betacard 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Betacard 25 Tablet is not suitable for everyone. Therefore, it is advised to inform your doctor if you are allergic to Betacard 25 Tablet or any of its ingredients before starting treatment. You must tell the doctor if you have low blood pressure or a slow heart rate, serious blood circulation problems in your limbs (such as Raynaud's phenomenon), which may make your fingers and toes tingle or turn pale or blue. Let your doctor know about all the other medicines you are taking because they may affect, or be affected by, this medicine. Also, inform your doctor if you're trying to get pregnant, are already pregnant, or breastfeeding to prevent any harmful effects on the baby.

It helps minimize symptoms of inflammation, such as redness, swelling, and itching.
It also has antimicrobial activity against infection-causing microorganisms.
Betnovate-N Cream is intended for external use only and should be used as advised by your doctor.
Apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected areas of the skin, using clean, dry hands.
If it gets into your eyes, nose, mouth, or vagina, rinse with water.
It may take several days to weeks for your symptoms to improve, but you should keep using this medicine regularly as prescribed by your doctor.
The course of the treatment should be completed to ensure better efficacy of the medicine.The most common side effects of this medicine include itching, redness, and a burning sensation at the application site.
These are usually self-limiting.
Serious side effects such as rash, itchy bumpy skin, or redness of the skin.
You must consult the doctor if you experience any of these serious side effects or worsening of common side effects.Before using this medicine, tell your doctor if you are taking or have recently taken any other medicines for the same or other diseases.
Pregnant and breastfeeding women should use this medicine with proper consultation and caution.
If you are known to be allergic to any ingredients of the medicine, do not use this medicine.
During the treatment, do not touch or scratch the infected skin areas, as this may worsen or spread the infection.

faq.question: How do I use Betnovate-N Cream?
faq.answer: When using Betnovate-N Cream, apply a thin layer to the affected skin and gently rub it in. Make sure the skin is clean and dry before application. Avoid getting it into your eyes or mouth. Treatment should not be continued for more than 7 days without medical supervision.

faq.question: How long does Betnovate-N Cream take to work?
faq.answer: The time to notice improvement with Betnovate-N Cream varies by condition and person. You may see some reduction in symptoms such as redness or itching within a few days, but full benefit often takes several days to weeks, depending on the severity of the skin issue and how you respond to treatment. Always follow your doctor’s instructions.

faq.question: Who should not use Betnovate-N Cream?
faq.answer: Betnovate-N Cream should not be used by individuals who are allergic to its ingredients, or in conditions such as rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, and certain viral skin infections like herpes or chickenpox. It is also not recommended for children under 2 years of age and should typically not be used for fungal infections unless directed by a doctor.

faq.question: What serious side effects of Betnovate-N Cream should I look out for?
faq.answer: If you notice a new or worsening rash, spreading redness, pus, swelling of the face or lips, or any sign of an allergic reaction, stop using the medicine and seek medical help. In rare cases, prolonged or extensive use of topical corticosteroids like Betnovate-N Cream may lead to thinning of the skin, stretch marks, or systemic effects such as changes in hormone balance.

faq.question: What happens if I use Betnovate-N Cream too much or for too long?
faq.answer: Using Betnovate-N Cream too frequently or for longer than recommended may increase the risk of side effects. Long-term use of potent topical steroids can cause skin thinning, stretch marks, or discoloration, and if absorbed systemically, could affect hormone levels. It can also increase the risk of infection due to suppressed local immunity. Your doctor will balance the benefits and risks and advise on the shortest effective course.

faq.question: Can I use Betnovate-N Cream on my face?
faq.answer: Use of Betnovate-N Cream on facial skin should be approached with caution, as facial skin is thin and more sensitive to steroid effects. Unless specifically prescribed by your doctor for a diagnosed condition, avoid applying it to the face or near the eyes.

faq.question: Does Betnovate-N Cream cause skin thinning?
faq.answer: Yes, prolonged, continuous use of topical corticosteroids, such as those in Betnovate-N Cream, can lead to thinning or fragile skin, especially in delicate areas like the face or skin folds. This is more likely if it is used for extended periods or under occlusion (covered with a bandage or dressing). Your healthcare provider will guide you on how long and where it is safe to use.

faq.question: Can I use Betnovate-N Cream for acne?
faq.answer: No, Betnovate-N Cream is not intended for treating acne or pimples. Using steroid-containing products on acne-prone skin can worsen acne and contribute to other skin changes. It should only be used when a doctor has diagnosed a specific inflammatory skin condition that warrants a combination of steroid and antibiotic treatment.

faq.question: Is Betnovate-N Cream effective against fungal infections?
faq.answer: Betnovate-N Cream contains a corticosteroid and an antibiotic, which do not work against fungal organisms such as those that cause ringworm or yeast infections. Using it on a fungal infection can temporarily mask symptoms and potentially worsen the infection. Proper diagnosis is important before use.

faq.question: Can Betnovate-N Cream be used on the eyes or eyelids?
faq.answer: Avoid getting Betnovate-N Cream in the eyes or applying it directly to eyelids unless specifically directed by a healthcare professional. Contact with the eye can cause irritation or increase the risk of changes in eye pressure.

faq.question: Is Betnovate-N Cream used to remove dark spots?
faq.answer: Betnovate-N Cream is prescribed for certain inflammatory skin conditions and is not indicated to remove dark spots or pigmentation. Using it for cosmetic purposes, such as lightening skin or treating pigmentation, is not recommended and may cause side effects.

faq.question: Can we apply Betnovate-N Cream to private parts?
faq.answer: Application of Betnovate-N Cream in sensitive areas such as genital skin or folds should only be done under medical advice. The skin in these regions can absorb more medicine and may be more prone to steroid-related effects. Unless specifically directed by your doctor, do not use this medicine on your private parts.

faq.question: What is Asmabron-N Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Asmabron-N Tablet is used in the treatment and prevention of asthma. It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages, thus widening them, and making it easier to breathe. It also relieves allergy symptoms like a runny nose, sneezing, throat irritation, watery eyes, and congestion or stuffiness.

faq.question: Can I suddenly stop taking Asmabron-N Tablet if I feel better?
faq.answer: No, stopping Asmabron-N Tablet suddenly, even if you feel better, can cause asthma attacks to come back or get worse. Always consult your doctor before stopping this medicine.

faq.question: Is Asmabron-N Tablet suitable for children?
faq.answer: Asmabron-N Tablet is not recommended for children under 2 years old, and doses for older children vary; they should be supervised by a doctor.

faq.question: How long does it take for Asmabron-N Tablet to work?
faq.answer: The exact time Asmabron-N Tablet takes to work is not known. However, you may notice improvement in your breathing in a few weeks of regular use. Continue taking it as prescribed even if symptoms improve.

faq.question: Are there any serious allergic reactions of Asmabron-N Tablet to watch for?
faq.answer: Although rare, signs like rash, swelling, or difficulty breathing require immediate medical help, as this can be a severe allergic reaction due to Asmabron-N Tablet.

faq.question: How long does BEtnovate Cream take to start working?

faq.question: What precautions do I need to take while using BEtnovate Cream?

description:
Bilos 25 Tablet is a medicine used to treat high blood pressure and heart failure.
Lowering blood pressure helps prevent future heart attacks and strokes.
This medicine is also effective in preserving kidney function in patients with diabetes.
Bilos 25 Tablet can be prescribed either alone or in combination with other medicines.
It may be taken with or without food during the day or at night.
However, try to take it at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
It is important to continue taking it regularly even if you feel well or if your blood pressure is controlled.
Most people with high blood pressure do not feel ill, but if you stop taking this medicine, your condition could get worse.
This is a widely used medicine and is considered safe for long-term use.Making some changes in your lifestyle will also help lower your blood pressure.
These may include regular exercise, losing weight, smoking cessation, reducing alcohol intake, and reducing the amount of salt in your diet as advised by your doctor.
This medicine is tolerated well by most patients and has few side effects.
Dizziness, particularly after the first dose, is known to occur in some people.
This may be associated with headaches.
Let your doctor know if these side effects bother you or do not go away.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor know if you have any kidney or liver problems.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and potassium levels in your blood at regular intervals while you are taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can I feel dizzy after taking Bilos 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Bilos 25 Tablet can make you feel dizzy. This may occur when you suddenly get up from a lying or sitting position. To lower the chance of feeling dizzy or passing out, rise slowly if you have been sitting or lying down.

faq.question: Is Bilos 25 Tablet a good blood pressure medicine?
faq.answer: Bilos 25 Tablet is used by many people for reducing blood pressure levels. This medicine generally has very few side effects. In addition to lowering blood pressure, it also protects kidney function in high blood pressure patients having diabetes and impaired kidney function (diabetic nephropathy). It is also used to treat chronic heart failure when treatment with other medicines fails to prove effective. It also helps to decrease the risk of stroke in patients who are hypertensive and have thicker left ventricle (heart chamber).

faq.question: What are some of the lifestyle changes I should make while using Bilos 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Lifestyle changes play a major role in keeping you healthy if you are taking Bilos 25 Tablet. Avoid taking excess salt in your diet and find ways to reduce or manage stress in your life. Practice yoga or meditation or take up a hobby. Ensure that you have a sound sleep every night as this also helps to reduce stress levels and helps to keep your blood pressure normal. Stop smoking and alcohol consumption as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and take a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables, and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Bilos 25 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take Bilos 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: You may have to take Bilos 25 Tablet for a long term, even life long. Bilos 25 Tablet only controls blood pressure but does not cure it. Talk to your doctor in case you have any concerns regarding Bilos 25 Tablet, but do not stop taking it without consulting the doctor.

faq.question: Does Bilos 25 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: No, Bilos 25 Tablet does not cause weight gain. However, if the medicine starts affecting your kidney function then your body may swell due to the accumulation of water, resulting in weight gain. Call your doctor if you experience unexplained weight gain or swelling in your feet, ankles, or hands.

faq.question: What are the long-term side effects of Bilos 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Long-term use of Bilos 25 Tablet is generally considered to be safe. However, in some cases, long-term use of Bilos 25 Tablet may adversely affect the functioning of the kidneys. Therefore, the doctor may prescribe regular blood tests to keep a track of how well the kidneys are working.

faq.question: Is Bilos 25 Tablet bad for the kidneys?
faq.answer: Yes, Bilos 25 Tablet may impair the kidney function of patients, especially those who have severe heart failure, chronic kidney disease, or narrow or blocked blood vessels that lead to the kidneys (renal artery stenosis). It may also affect kidney function in patients who have experienced severe fluid loss or dehydration due to vomiting, diarrhea, or excessive use of diuretics. Therefore, Bilos 25 Tablet should be used cautiously in these patients and their kidney function should be regularly monitored.

faq.question: How long does Bilos 25 Tablet take to work?
faq.answer: The blood pressure-lowering effect of Bilos 25 Tablet can be seen after about 6 hours of taking it. The effect of the medicine lasts for about 24 hours. However, you may have to take the medicine for about 3-6 weeks to see the full benefits.

faq.question: When and how should Bilos 25 Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: Take Bilos 25 Tablet exactly as per your doctor’s advice. Bilos 25 Tablet tablets are meant for oral intake. Swallow the tablet with water. You can take it with or without food. The dose will depend on the condition you are being treated for. It is recommended that you take your first dose before bedtime, as it can make you dizzy. After taking the first dose, you can take it at any time of the day but try to take it at the same time each day.

faq.question: What is the most important information that I need to know about Bilos 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Taking Bilos 25 Tablet during the last 6 months of pregnancy can cause serious harm or even endanger the life of the unborn baby. Hence, it is important to inform the doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. If you become pregnant while taking Bilos 25 Tablet, stop taking Bilos 25 Tablet and call your doctor immediately.

Binafide Duo Respules is used for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (a lung disorder in which the flow of air to the lungs is blocked).
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages and making it easier to breathe.
It relieves coughing, wheezing, and feeling short of breath.
Your doctor will instruct you on how often to use your inhaler.
The effects of Binafide Duo Respules may be noticeable after a few days but usually reach their maximum after a few weeks.
Use it regularly for the best results.
Continue using it even if you do not have any symptoms, for as long as it is prescribed.
This medicine should not be used to relieve sudden shortness of breath.
If sudden shortness of breath occurs, use your rescue inhaler instead.The most common side effects include dry mouth, cough, tremor, headache, palpitations, muscle cramps, and sometimes shortness of breath.
You can help prevent some of these effects by rinsing your mouth and throat with water or brushing your teeth after using your inhaler.
Other, rarer side effects may be serious.
Talk to your doctor if you are worried about them.Before using Binafide Duo Respules, tell your doctor if you have any problems with your kidneys or liver, so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
Also, tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding to make sure it is safe for you.

faq.question: Can Binafide Duo Respules interact with other medicines?
faq.answer: Yes, Binafide Duo Respules can interact with certain medicines, so you should inform your doctor about all medicines, inhalers, and supplements you are using. It may interact with other anticholinergic medicines, other inhalers or heart medicines, diuretics (water tablets), digoxin, MAO inhibitors, and some antidepressants. These combinations may increase the risk of heart rhythm problems, low potassium levels, or stronger side effects. Always consult your doctor before starting or combining Binafide Duo Respules with any other medicine.

faq.question: What is Binafide Duo Respules used for and how does it work?
faq.answer: Binafide Duo Respules is used to help relieve breathing problems such as wheezing, shortness of breath, and chest tightness in conditions like asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It contains ipratropium bromide and levosalbutamol, which work together to relax and widen the airways in the lungs, making it easier to breathe. The medicine is usually given through a nebulizer so it can act directly in the lungs for faster symptom relief. It should be used only as prescribed by a doctor.

faq.question: Can I take more than the recommended dose of Binafide Duo Respules frequently?
faq.answer: No, taking more than the recommended dose of Binafide Duo Respules will not make it work better and may increase the risk of side effects such as fast heartbeat, tremors, or dizziness. Always use it exactly as prescribed by your doctor. If breathing symptoms are not relieved or continue to worsen, do not repeat doses too frequently on your own and seek medical advice promptly.

faq.question: What side effects should I watch for while using Binafide Duo Respules?
faq.answer: Binafide Duo Respules may cause dizziness, stomach upset, throat irritation, tremors, or a fast heartbeat in some people. These effects are usually mild and improve with time. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how the medicine affects you. Seek medical help immediately if you develop severe breathing difficulty, rash, swelling of the face, fainting, or persistent worsening symptoms.

faq.question: Can Binafide Duo Respules cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, Binafide Duo Respules may cause dryness of the mouth in some people. If this occurs, drink plenty of water and take small sips frequently during the day. Keeping water nearby at night may also help reduce discomfort.

faq.question: How should Binafide Duo Respules be stored and disposed of?
faq.answer: Keep Binafide Duo Respules in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions on the package label, usually in a cool and dry place. Dispose of any unused medicine safely and keep it out of reach of children and pets.

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Binafide Duo Respules?
faq.answer: If you miss a dose of Binafide Duo Respules, take it as soon as you remember unless it is almost time for your next scheduled dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the next dose to make up for the missed one. If you frequently miss doses, consult your doctor for guidance.

faq.question: Can Binafide Duo Respules be taken with food?
faq.answer: Binafide Duo Respules is used by inhalation through a nebulizer, so food does not significantly affect how it works. However, maintaining good hydration and avoiding foods that worsen breathing discomfort or acidity may help overall comfort. Always follow your doctor’s instructions for use.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while using Binafide Duo Respules?
faq.answer: It is generally better to avoid alcohol while using Binafide Duo Respules unless your doctor advises otherwise. Alcohol may increase dizziness, palpitations, or discomfort in some people. It is best to limit or avoid it. If you feel very dizzy, unusually sleepy, or unwell after mixing alcohol with this medicine, contact your doctor.

faq.question: Who should avoid Binafide Duo Respules?
faq.answer: Binafide Duo Respules should be used only if prescribed by a doctor, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use with caution in people with glaucoma, prostate problems, or heart rhythm disorders. Always inform your doctor about your medical history and other medicines before using it. Seek medical advice if you develop chest pain, severe dizziness, swelling, or unusual weakness while using this medicine.

faq.question: Can Binafide Duo Respules be used for sudden breathlessness?
faq.answer: No, Binafide Duo Respules is not meant for sudden breathing attacks. Use your rescue inhaler for quick relief and seek medical help if symptoms are severe.

faq.question: What if I vomit after taking Biopyrin 650 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you vomit shortly after taking Biopyrin 650 Tablet, the amount of medicine absorbed into your body will depend on how quickly you vomited after taking it. If you vomit within 15 to 30 minutes of taking the dose, the dose may be repeated.

faq.question: What is Biopyrin 650 Tablet, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Biopyrin 650 Tablet is a widely used pain reliever and fever reducer. It works by blocking certain chemical signals in the brain that cause pain and raise body temperature. It is used for fever and mild to moderate pain such as headaches, toothaches, muscle aches, and body pain.

faq.question: How long will it take Biopyrin 650 Tablet to reduce my fever, and when will I start feeling better?
faq.answer: Biopyrin 650 Tablet generally begins to reduce fever and relieve pain within 30 to 60 minutes of an oral dose. The effect usually peaks at 1 to 2 hours and typically lasts 4 to 6 hours, after which another dose may be taken if needed.

faq.question: Can I take Biopyrin 650 Tablet and ibuprofen together?
faq.answer: Yes, in most adults, paracetamol and ibuprofen can be taken together safely. They belong to different classes of medicines and work in different ways, so combining them does not increase the risk of side effects. However, people with stomach ulcers or inflammatory bowel disease, kidney problems, or pregnant women should consult their doctor before taking them together.

faq.question: Is Biopyrin 650 Tablet safe for children, and can it be given to kids under 12?
faq.answer: Yes, Biopyrin 650 Tablet is widely considered safe for children, including infants. Do not give adult-strength tablets to young children. Always consult a doctor before giving it to your child.

faq.question: How much Biopyrin 650 Tablet can I take in a day, and how long should I wait between doses?
faq.answer: For most adults, do not exceed 4 g (4000 mg) in 24 hours. The medicine's effect typically lasts up to 4 to 6 hours, after which another dose may be taken if needed. Paracetamol may be present in many other medicines for cold, flu, and pain relief. Taking Biopyrin 650 Tablet with them may increase the total dose in your body, increasing the risk of liver damage.

faq.question: What happens if I take Biopyrin 650 Tablet even if I do not have a fever?
faq.answer: If taken at the recommended dose without fever, Biopyrin 650 Tablet will simply relieve pain without causing any abnormal drop in body temperature. If you regularly take it for ongoing pain without a clear reason, or if your symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor for proper assessment.

faq.question: Can I take Biopyrin 650 Tablet if I have a known liver condition?
faq.answer: The liver primarily processes (metabolizes) paracetamol, and taking too much can cause serious liver damage. If you have a known liver condition, discuss your situation with your doctor, as you may require dose adjustment and monitoring.

faq.question: What should I do if I accidentally take a double dose of Biopyrin 650 Tablet?
faq.answer: Taking one extra dose of paracetamol is usually not harmful for a healthy adult. It is slightly above the usual single dose but well below dangerous levels. In such a case, skip the next dose for 8–10 hours. Avoid alcohol, and do not take any other medicines containing paracetamol. Stay hydrated and eat light. description:
Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet is used to treat high blood pressure by relaxing blood vessels, allowing blood to flow more easily.
It is also used to treat symptoms of an enlarged prostate gland (benign prostatic hyperplasia) in men by relaxing the muscles in the prostate and bladder neck, making it easier to urinate.
Controlling high blood pressure (hypertension) lowers the risk of having a heart attack or stroke.
This medicine may also be used to treat Raynaud's disease.
It may be prescribed alone or in combination with other medicines.
Take it regularly and take it in the dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
High blood pressure does not usually have symptoms, so keep taking it even if you feel well.The most common side effects of this medicine include weakness, dizziness, headache, nausea, and unusual beating of the heart (palpitation).
Most side effects disappear when you get used to the medicine.
It may also cause your blood pressure to go too low, especially when you first start taking this medicine.
Your doctor may be able to help with ways of preventing or reducing these side effects.If you are pregnant, thinking about becoming pregnant, or breastfeeding, ask your doctor before using this medicine.
Also, inform your doctor if you have a history of heart failure, liver disease, or kidney disease, and if you are having eye surgery for a cataract.
Your blood pressure will need to be checked regularly while using this medicine.

faq.question: Is Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet a sleeping pill?
faq.answer: No, Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet is not a sleeping pill. On the contrary, it may cause difficulty falling asleep as an uncommon side effect of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet. A rare side effect of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet is an increased tendency to fall asleep if you have a sleep disorder (narcolepsy).

faq.question: Can Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet get you high?
faq.answer: No, Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet does not get you high. It does not have any abuse potential or any dependence. The common psychiatric side effects of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet include nervousness and depression.

faq.question: How should Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: Always take this medicine exactly as advised by your doctor. Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet should be taken by mouth and can be taken before or after meals and drinks. Usually, it is advised to take the dose two or three times a day at evenly spaced intervals.

faq.question: What precaution should be followed while taking Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet in certain cases can make you feel lightheaded or weak, particularly when you first take it. This can happen when standing up and can occasionally cause fainting. If you feel light-headed or weak after taking the medicine, lie down and try to get up slowly when you feel better. Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet is usually started at the lowest possible dose and gradually increased, depending on how you respond to treatment. Do not change the dose or stop taking the tablets without first checking with your doctor.

faq.question: How long do I need to take Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet?
faq.answer: Your doctor will decide the duration of treatment based on the condition you are being treated for. For instance, if you are being treated for high blood pressure, then you may have to take it for life.

faq.question: What is Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension), Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia, and Cold Finger Syndrome (Raynaud's disease).

faq.question: How does Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet work?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet contains Prazosin, an alpha-blocker that acts by relaxing and widening the constricted blood vessels. This reduces the heart's workload and makes the heart more efficient at pumping blood throughout the body. Thus, it reduces high blood pressure and reduces the chances of a future heart attack or stroke.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet when my blood pressure is under control?
faq.answer: No, do not discontinue Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet on your own. To treat your condition effectively, keep taking Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet for the prescribed duration.

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet ?
faq.answer: In case, you have missed a dose of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet , you are advised to take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is time for you to take your next dose, then do not take both doses together. Take only one dose; taking a double dose of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet will lead to low blood pressure.

faq.question: How long can Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet can be safely taken as long as your doctor has prescribed it to you. Conditions such as high blood pressure are lifelong, and one should not abruptly discontinue it without discussing it with a doctor.

faq.question: Can use of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet may cause dizziness. It is advised to avoid driving or operate any heavy machinery while taking Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet . In case you feel dizzy or light-headed, it is advised to rest for some time until you feel better.

faq.question: Can Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet cause priapism (prolonged penile erection)?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet may cause priapism (prolonged erections) sometimes. If you have an erection that lasts more than four hours, inform your doctor and seek emergency medical help, as if not treated, it can lead to tissue scarring or erectile dysfunction.

faq.question: Can Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet cause nasal congestion?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet can cause nasal congestion due to dilation of vessels in the nasal mucosa.

faq.question: Is Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet a sleeping pill?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet is not a sleeping pill. It is used to lower blood pressure in patients with hypertension.

faq.question: Can Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet get you high?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet cannot get you high as it doesn’t have the potential of abuse or dependence.

faq.question: Is Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet used for anxiety?
faq.answer: Though prazosin may help with anxiety, especially related to chronic PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder), it is not used for anxiety.

faq.question: How should Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet should be swallowed as a whole with water. It can be taken before or after food and drinks.

faq.question: What precautions should be followed while taking Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet ?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet might cause dizziness or light-headedness, which may be caused by low blood pressure upon sitting or standing up quickly. To prevent this, avoid standing or sitting up quickly. Lie down and try getting up slowly after you feel better.

faq.question: What class of drug is Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet ?
faq.answer: Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet belongs to the class of drugs called alpha-blockers. It relaxes the blood vessels and helps treat high blood pressure.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet ?
faq.answer: Side effects of Biozocin 2.5 XL Tablet are drowsiness, headache, weakness, dizziness, nausea, and feeling exhausted. If the side effects are persistent, reach out to your doctor.

description:
Bisacad Tablet is a medicine used to treat constipation.
It is a laxative and helps you empty your bowels.
Sometimes it is used by hospitals before surgery, or for some internal examinations or treatments.
It works by increasing the movement in the intestine.
Bisacad Tablet is best taken at night when it is used to treat constipation.
It should be swallowed whole and must not be chewed, broken, or crushed.
It is recommended to start with the lowest dose and increase if you need to, but do not exceed the maximum daily dose.
You should not use this medicine for more than the recommended number of days unless your doctor tells you to.
Some lifestyle changes can help with constipation, for example, drinking plenty of fluids, exercising regularly, and eating more fiber-rich foods such as fruits, vegetables, and cereals.The most common side effects of taking this medicine are abdominal pain and diarrhoea.
These are usually mild and go away after a couple of days.
If they persist, your doctor may suggest ways of preventing or reducing them.Before using this medicine, you should tell your doctor if you have a blockage in your bowel, an upset stomach, or if your bowel movements have been different for more than two weeks.
Some medicines and some foods can interfere with the way this medicine works, so discuss this with your doctor to make sure you are safe.
You should not normally take other treatments for constipation while using this medicine, and should also avoid dairy products at the same time.
Bisacad Tablet is not generally recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Bisacad Tablet?
faq.answer: Bisacad Tablet is safe if you use it for a prescribed duration and dose as recommended by your doctor. In case of any side effects, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is Bisacad Tablet a stimulant laxative?
faq.answer: Yes, Bisacad Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as stimulant laxatives which increase bowel movements. Bisacad Tablet is used for recent or long-term constipation. It can also be used to clear the bowels before surgery, labor or radiological investigation.

faq.question: Is Bisacad Tablet habit forming?
faq.answer: Bisacad Tablet can be habit-forming. Long-term use can make your body depend on the laxative for regular bowel movements, damage the bowel, cause malnutrition, and problems with the amounts of water and salts in your body. Do not use this medicine for longer than directed by your doctor. If your constipation keeps returning, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is Bisacad Tablet effective?
faq.answer: Yes, Bisacad Tablet is effective if used for an approved indication at prescribed doses for the prescribed duration as advised by your doctor.

faq.question: Can I take Bisacad Tablet for constipation?
faq.answer: Bisacad Tablet is used for the treatment of recent or long-term constipation. Bisacad Tablet can also be used to clear the bowels before surgery, labor or radiological investigation. Bisacad Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as stimulant laxatives. Stimulant laxatives increase bowel movements, thus help in relieving constipation.

faq.question: Can I take Bisacad Tablet with senna?
faq.answer: Bisacad Tablet and senna both belong to a group of medicines called laxatives. However, no drug-drug interactions have been reported between the two, this does not mean that interactions cannot occur. Therefore, please consult your doctor before taking the two medicines together.

faq.question: Can the use of Bisacad Tablet help lose weight?
faq.answer: Bisacad Tablet does not cause weight loss. Please consult your doctor in case you experience weight loss while taking Bisacad Tablet or if you need treatment for weight management.

faq.question: Does Bisacad Tablet cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Diarrhea is a common side effect of Bisacad Tablet. Please consult your doctor if you experience intolerable diarrhea with Bisacad Tablet.

faq.question: Does Bisacad Tablet cause cramping?
faq.answer: Abdominal cramps or pain is a common side effect of Bisacad Tablet. Please consult your doctor if you experience cramps while taking Bisacad Tablet.

description:
Bisflow Tablet is a medicine used to treat constipation.
It is a laxative and helps you empty your bowels.
Sometimes it is used by hospitals before surgery, or for some internal examinations or treatments.
It works by increasing the movement in the intestine.
Bisflow Tablet is best taken at night when it is used to treat constipation.
It should be swallowed whole and must not be chewed, broken, or crushed.
It is recommended to start with the lowest dose and increase if you need to, but do not exceed the maximum daily dose.
You should not use this medicine for more than the recommended number of days unless your doctor tells you to.
Some lifestyle changes can help with constipation, for example, drinking plenty of fluids, exercising regularly, and eating more fiber-rich foods such as fruits, vegetables, and cereals.The most common side effects of taking this medicine are abdominal pain and diarrhoea.
These are usually mild and go away after a couple of days.
If they persist, your doctor may suggest ways of preventing or reducing them.Before using this medicine, you should tell your doctor if you have a blockage in your bowel, an upset stomach, or if your bowel movements have been different for more than two weeks.
Some medicines and some foods can interfere with the way this medicine works, so discuss this with your doctor to make sure you are safe.
You should not normally take other treatments for constipation while using this medicine, and should also avoid dairy products at the same time.
Bisflow Tablet is not generally recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Bisflow Tablet?
faq.answer: Bisflow Tablet is safe if you use it for a prescribed duration and dose as recommended by your doctor. In case of any side effects, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is Bisflow Tablet a stimulant laxative?

faq.question: Is Bisflow Tablet habit forming?
faq.answer: Bisflow Tablet can be habit-forming. Do not use this medicine for longer than directed by your doctor. If your constipation keeps returning, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is Bisflow Tablet effective?

faq.question: Can I take Bisflow Tablet for constipation?

Bisflow Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as stimulant laxatives. Stimulant laxatives increase bowel movements, thus help in relieving constipation.

faq.question: Can I take Bisflow Tablet with senna?
faq.answer: Bisflow Tablet and senna both belong to a group of medicines called laxatives. However, no drug-drug interactions have been reported between the two, this does not mean that interactions cannot occur. Therefore, please consult your doctor before taking the two medicines together.

faq.question: Can the use of Bisflow Tablet help lose weight?

description:
Bravia-DSR Capsule is a combination medicine used to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease (acid reflux).
It works by relieving the symptoms of acidity, such as heartburn, stomach pain, or irritation.
It also neutralizes the acid and promotes easy passage of gas to reduce stomach discomfort.
Bravia-DSR Capsule should be taken on an empty stomach in the dose and duration advised by your doctor.
The exact dose will depend on your condition and response to treatment.
Continue taking it for as long as prescribed, even if your symptoms improve, as stopping early may cause them to return or worsen.
Inform your healthcare provider about all other medicines you are taking, as some may interact with Bravia-DSR Capsule.Common side effects include diarrhea, stomach pain, headache, weakness and flatulence.
These are usually mild and temporary.
However, contact your doctor immediately if any side effects persist or cause concern.
This medicine may cause dizziness or drowsiness, so avoid driving or activities requiring alertness until you know how it affects you.Refrain from drinking alcohol, as it can increase drowsiness.
Lifestyle measures such as drinking cold milk and avoiding spicy foods, coffee, tea, and chocolate can enhance treatment effectiveness.
Before starting Bravia-DSR Capsule, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems, or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding.

faq.question: What is Bravia-DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: Bravia-DSR Capsule is a combination of two medicines: Domperidone and Rabeprazole. This combination is used to treat acidity and heartburn or gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD); a condition where the acid in the stomach flows back up into the food pipe (esophagus). It is also used to treat gastric and duodenal ulcers. Domperidone helps to control vomiting by increasing the movement of the gut, allowing the food to move more easily through the stomach.

faq.question: What are the contraindications of Bravia-DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: The use of Bravia-DSR Capsule is considered to be harmful for patients with a known hypersensitivity to rabeprazole or domperidone or any other inactive ingredients of the medicine. Caution is advised in patients with underlying kidney or liver disease.

faq.question: Can the use of Bravia-DSR Capsule cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Bravia-DSR Capsule can cause dry mouth. Dryness of mouth occurs due to Domperidone. If you experience dry mouth, drink plenty of water. Keep some water on your bedside at night. Cut down the intake of alcohol and avoid smoking. If you have dry mouth, try to use alcohol-free mouthwash as its use can increase the risk of tooth decay.

faq.question: Can the use of Bravia-DSR Capsule cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Bravia-DSR Capsule can cause diarrhea. In case you experience diarrhea, drink plenty of water or other fluids. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. Talk to your doctor if diarrhea persists and if you notice any signs of dehydration, like less urination with dark colored and strong-smelling urine.

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for Bravia-DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Bravia-DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: Yes, Bravia-DSR Capsule is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients it may cause common side effects like diarrhea, stomach pain, flatulence, dryness in mouth, dizziness, headache and other uncommon and rare side effects. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem while taking this medicine.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Bravia-DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: It is best to take Bravia-DSR Capsule before the first meal of the day or on an empty stomach.

faq.question: Can the use of Bravia-DSR Capsule cause abnormal heartbeat?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Bravia-DSR Capsule can increase the risk of developing irregular heartbeat (serious arrhythmias). This is a serious side effect but the chance that it may happen is very low. The risk may be slightly higher in those who are more than 60 years of age.

description:
Brethnol Syrup is used to relieve symptoms of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary diseases (COPD) such as coughing, wheezing, and breathlessness.
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages, thus widening it and making it easier to breathe.
You can take Brethnol Syrup with or without food.
The dose will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
Try to take it at the same time each day.
It is important to keep taking this medicine until your doctor tells you not to.
Use this medicine regularly to get the most benefit from it even if you feel well.This medicine is generally safe however it may cause tremors, headaches, palpitation, fast heart rate, nervousness, and muscle cramps in some people.
These are often not dangerous and should gradually improve as your body gets used to the medicine.
There are other, rarer, side effects and you should call your doctor straight away if you get chest pain, a very bad headache, or very bad dizziness.Before using this medicine, you should tell your doctor if you have high blood pressure, an overactive thyroid gland, a history of heart problems, diabetes, or low levels of potassium in your blood to make sure it is safe.
Also, make sure your doctor knows if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine.
This medicine can make you feel dizzy or shaky so avoid driving, cycling, or using tools or machinery until you feel better.
You should not smoke as it causes damage to your lungs and will make your condition worse.

faq.question: What would happen if I take higher than the recommended dose of Brethnol Syrup?
faq.answer: Taking a higher than the recommended dose of Brethnol Syrup may cause seizures, chest pain, nervousness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, dizziness and lack of energy. High doses of Brethnol Syrup may also cause fast, irregular or pounding heartbeat, uncontrollable shaking of any part of the body, and difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep. In any such case, seek immediate medical attention.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Brethnol Syrup if I have heart disease?
faq.answer: Yes, Brethnol Syrup is considered safe, but its use depends on the severity of your heart problem. If you experience chest pain or any other symptom of worsening heart disease while taking Brethnol Syrup, seek immediate medical advice.

faq.question: Being a diabetic, what should I remember while taking Brethnol Syrup?
faq.answer: Brethnol Syrup may cause blood sugar levels to rise. Therefore, your doctor may adjust your dose of insulin or antidiabetic medicines. Keep a regular check on your blood glucose levels and do not miss any appointments. Consult your doctor if you experience a sudden rise in blood sugar levels.

faq.question: I have started using Brethnol Syrup and I am experiencing headaches and shakiness. Is this because of Brethnol Syrup and will these go away?
faq.answer: Yes, it could be due to Brethnol Syrup. Feeling shaky is a common side effect of Brethnol Syrup which goes away after some time. For headaches, drink plenty of water, get sufficient rest and avoid alcohol. Usually headaches go away after a week. If they persist for a long time, contact your doctor.

faq.question: When should I take Brethnol Syrup?
faq.answer: Use Brethnol Syrup as and when you need it. Brethnol Syrup relieves the symptoms of asthma like coughing, shortness of breath and tightness in the chest. You can also take it to prevent asthma attacks in circumstances where you know it may occur (e.g., after strenuous exercise or unavoidable exposure to allergen).

faq.question: Can I smoke if I have been prescribed Brethnol Syrup?
faq.answer: No, you should not smoke while taking Brethnol Syrup. Smoking irritates the lungs. The medicine may make breathing more difficult, especially in patients who have asthma. Take advice from your doctor if you are finding it hard to avoid smoking.

description:
Breztri Aerosphere is a combination of three medicines.
It is used in the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
It works in various ways and reduces the symptoms of the disease such as coughing, chest tightness, and shortness of breath.
Breztri Aerosphere should be used in the dose and duration as prescribed by your doctor.
Use it regularly and as long as your doctor has prescribed it to get maximum benefits from the medicine.
Don't stop using the medicine even if you feel better unless your doctor tells you to.
If you stop, your breathing problems could get worse.Breztri Aerosphere is generally safe and effective, but some common side effects include nausea, headache, and thrush.
These side effects are usually mild and should gradually improve as your body gets used to this medicine.
Let your doctor know if you are bothered by any of this, or if you experience any other side effects which you think are caused by the medicine.Before using Breztri Aerosphere, let your doctor know if you have any preexisting medical conditions.
Let your doctor also know all the other medicines you are taking.
Additionally, to make sure it is safe for you, tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine.
You should smoke while on treatment with this medicine.
Smoking causes damage to your lungs and will make your condition worse.

faq.question: What is Breztri Aerosphere used for?
faq.answer: Breztri Aerosphere is used to help people with long‑term lung diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), chronic bronchitis, or emphysema breathe more easily. It helps reduce flare‑ups and keeps the airways open for smoother breathing over time.

faq.question: Can I use Breztri Aerosphere for sudden shortness of breath?
faq.answer: No. Breztri Aerosphere is not a rescue inhaler. It does not work quickly enough to relieve sudden attacks of breathlessness. You should always keep a fast‑acting rescue inhaler handy for sudden breathing problems.

faq.question: Who should not use Breztri Aerosphere?
faq.answer: Individuals should not use Breztri Aerosphere if they are allergic to any of its ingredients (budesonide, glycopyrrolate, or formoterol). It is also not suitable for children under 18 years. People with severe kidney or liver problems should consult their doctor before using it.

faq.question: What should I tell my doctor before starting Breztri Aerosphere?
faq.answer: Before starting Breztri Aerosphere, tell your doctor if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, seizures, thyroid problems, diabetes, prostate issues, glaucoma, or liver or kidney disease. These conditions can affect how your body reacts to this medicine.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Breztri Aerosphere?
faq.answer: Serious side effects of Breztri Aerosphere may include chest pain, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, worsening breathing, allergic reactions such as swelling or rash, or symptoms of infection like fever or chills. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience any of these symptoms.

faq.question: Does Breztri Aerosphere weaken the immune system?
faq.answer: Breztri Aerosphere contains budesonide, a type of corticosteroid, which may slightly lower your body’s ability to fight infections. Wash your mouth after each use and contact your doctor if you develop thrush (white patches in your mouth) or a persistent cough.

faq.question: Can using Breztri Aerosphere affect my eyes or bones?
faq.answer: Long‑term use of Breztri Aerosphere may increase the risk of eye problems such as glaucoma or cataracts and may slightly weaken bones. Regular check‑ups can help detect these issues early.

faq.question: Can I stop using Breztri Aerosphere once I feel better?
faq.answer: No. You should continue using Breztri Aerosphere every day as prescribed, even when you feel well. Stopping it suddenly can cause your COPD symptoms to return or worsen.

faq.question: What should I avoid while using Breztri Aerosphere?
faq.answer: While using Breztri Aerosphere, avoid exposure to people with contagious infections such as chickenpox or measles, as the steroid part of this medicine can reduce your resistance to infections.

faq.question: Are there any foods which I should avoid while taking Broncordil Plus Syrup?

description:
Fungicip 200 Tablet is used to treat fungal infections of the mouth, throat, vagina, and other parts of the body including fingernails and toenails.
It kills fungi by destroying the fungal cell membrane thereby stopping the growth of fungi.
Fungicip 200 Tablet should be taken in the dose and duration as prescribed by your doctor.
It should be swallowed whole and can be taken with or without food.
The dosage and length of treatment will depend on the condition you are being treated for.
Sometimes this will be in cycles of use and non-use.
To get the most benefit, take this medicine at evenly spaced times and continue using it until your prescription is finished, even if your symptoms disappear after a few days.
If you stop treatment too early, the infection may return and if you miss doses you can increase your risk of infections that are resistant to further treatment.
Tell your doctor if the infection does not get better or if it gets worse.
Avoid taking antacid treatments within one hour before or two hours after you take it.The most common side effects of this medicine include stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, headache, and nausea.
You could ask your doctor about ways of preventing or reducing these effects.
Stop taking medicine and inform your doctor if you notice signs of an allergic reaction such as rash, swelling of the lips, throat, or face, swallowing or breathing problems, dizziness, and nausea.Do not take Fungicip 200 Tablet if you are pregnant unless your doctor has told you to.
Inform your doctor if you have a history of heart failure, a weak immune system (including HIV/AIDS), kidney problems, or liver problems such as yellow skin (jaundice).
This medicine may not be suitable for you.
If your course of treatment is for more than a month, your doctor may monitor your liver function.
This medicine may make you dizzy so do not drive or operate machines until it is safe.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Brufen 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: Brufen 200 Tablet is safe for most patients. However, in some patients, it may cause some unwanted side effects like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, heartburn and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem due to this medication.

faq.question: What should I tell my doctor before starting treatment with Brufen 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: Before starting treatment with Brufen 200 Tablet, tell your doctor if you have any other health problems, like kidney or liver-related issues. This is because certain medical conditions may affect your treatment and you may even need dose modifications. Let your doctor know about all the other medicines you are taking because they may affect, or be affected by, this medicine. Inform your doctor if you are planning a baby, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

faq.question: What if I forget to take a dose of Brufen 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you forget a dose of Brufen 200 Tablet, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next scheduled dose in the prescribed time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one as this may increase the chances of developing side effects.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Brufen 200 Tablet when my pain is relieved?
faq.answer: Brufen 200 Tablet should be continued as advised by your doctor, if you are using the medicine for a condition associated with long-term pain. It can be discontinued if you are using it for short-term pain relief.

faq.question: Can the use of Brufen 200 Tablet cause nausea and vomiting?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Brufen 200 Tablet may cause nausea and vomiting. Taking it with milk, food or antacids can prevent nausea. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. In case of vomiting, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small frequent sips. Talk to your doctor if vomiting persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like dark colored and strong-smelling urine or a low frequency of urination. Do not take any other medicines without speaking to your doctor.

faq.question: Are there any specific contraindications associated with the use of Brufen 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Brufen 200 Tablet is considered to be harmful for patients with known allergy to any of the components of this medicine. It should be avoided in patients with known allergy to other painkillers (NSAIDs). The use of this medicine should preferably be avoided in patients with a history of stomach ulcers or in patients with active or recurrent stomach ulcer/bleeding. It should also be avoided in patients with a history of heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease.

faq.question: Is Brufen 200 Tablet helpful in relieving stomach pain?
faq.answer: No, Brufen 200 Tablet should not be taken for stomach pain without consulting a physician. This drug can increase stomach acid secretion which may aggravate an unknown underlying condition.

faq.question: Can the use of Brufen 200 Tablet cause damage to kidneys?
faq.answer: Yes, the long-term use of Brufen 200 Tablet can cause damage to the kidneys. Normal kidneys produce a chemical called prostaglandins that protect the kidneys from damage. Use of painkillers lowers the levels of prostaglandins in the body, leading to kidney damage because of long-term use. Therefore, the use of painkillers is not recommended in patients with underlying kidney disease.

faq.question: Is it safe to take a higher than the recommended dose of Brufen 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, taking a higher than the recommended dose of Brufen 200 Tablet can increase the risks of side effects like nausea, vomiting, heartburn, indigestion and diarrhea. In fact, using this medicine for a long-term can also damage your kidneys on long-term use. If you are experiencing increased severity of pain or if the pain is not relieved by the recommended doses of this medicine, please consult your doctor for re-evaluation.

faq.question: Can Brufen 200 Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, Brufen 200 Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, do not drive or use any machines. It is better to rest for sometime and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: What if I give too much of Azax 200 Suspension by mistake?
faq.answer: Azax 200 Suspension is unlikely to cause any harm if an extra dose is given by mistake. However, if you think you have given too much of Azax 200 Suspension to your child, immediately speak to a doctor. faq.question: Will I get cured after taking Zovirax 200 Tablet for shingles?
faq.answer: Zovirax 200 Tablet is an antiviral medicine effective against herpes simplex and varicella zoster viruses. It does not cure infections caused by these viruses but helps to minimize the symptoms and shorten the duration of infection. It does not remove the viruses from the body but prevents the viruses from dividing and spreading.

faq.question: Does Zovirax 200 Tablet prevent transmission of infection to others?
faq.answer: No, you can infect other people, even while you are being treated with Zovirax 200 Tablet. Herpes infections are contagious, so avoid letting infected areas come into contact with other people. Avoid touching your eyes after touching an infected area. Wash your hands frequently to prevent transmitting the infection to others. You should practice safe sex by using condoms. You should not have sex if you have genital sores or blisters.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Zovirax 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: Serious side effects are rare, but if you experience them, you should seek medical advice right away. These rare side effects include hives, blistering or peeling rash, yellow skin or eyes, unusual bruising or bleeding, loss of consciousness, fits, difficulty in breathing, hallucinations and swelling of the face, tongue, lips or throat.

faq.question: Do elderly patients need to be more careful while taking Zovirax 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: Older adults (over age 65 years) tend to experience more side effects when taking Zovirax 200 Tablet. The reason being, their kidneys do not flush the drug out of their system as quickly as a younger person’s kidneys would do. Elderly patients should drink plenty of water while taking Zovirax 200 Tablet, and their kidney function should be monitored. These patients should be given a lower dose and should be monitored for neurological problems.

faq.question: What can happen if somebody takes more than the recommended dose of Zovirax 200 Tablet accidentally?
faq.answer: Accidental, repeated overdoses of oral Zovirax 200 Tablet over several days have resulted in nausea, vomiting, confusion and headache. Consult your doctor in case of overdose.

faq.question: Can I get resistant to Zovirax 200 Tablet treatment?
faq.answer: Patients with advanced HIV disease or patients with an impaired immunity have reported resistance to Zovirax 200 Tablet. If you are not responding to Zovirax 200 Tablet, the possibility of drug resistance should be checked.

faq.question: Is hair loss caused due to Zovirax 200 Tablet permanent?
faq.answer: Hair loss is an uncommon side effect of Zovirax 200 Tablet. It stops when the medicine is discontinued.

description:
Brufen MR Capsule belongs to the class of medications called ‘analgesics’ used in treating acute muscle spasms associated with low back pain.
Low back pain, also called lumbago, is a condition that affects the lower portion of the spine.
It often occurs due to injury, strain, or sprain in the muscles, bones, or ligaments present in the lower back.
In most cases, the only symptom of this condition is a pain in the lower back.
Brufen MR Capsule contains Ibuprofen and Tizanidine.
Ibuprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).
It works by reducing prostaglandins' production (chemical substances that cause pain and inflammation) at the affected site (muscle) and reduce pain.
Tizanidine is a short-acting muscle relaxant.
It works by reducing the activity of the nerves in the brain that control muscles.
This effect helps to reduce muscle spasms, thereby improving pain and muscle movements.
You should take this medicine exactly as prescribed by the doctor.
The common side-effects of Brufen MR Capsule are drowsiness, tiredness, dizziness, low blood pressure, dry mouth, nausea, stomach upset, heartburn, abdominal pain, indigestion, and decrease or increase in heart rate.
These side-effects are usually mild and temporary.
However, if any of these side-effects persist or get worse, inform your doctor immediately.
It is not recommended to take Brufen MR Capsule if you are allergic to ibuprofen, tizanidine, NSAIDs, or any contents of this medicine.
Do not take Brufen MR Capsule if you have bleeding or ulcers in the stomach or intestine, severe liver, kidney, or heart problems, severe dehydration (due to vomiting or diarrhoea), active bleeding (including in the brain), and conditions that cause the abnormal formation of red blood cells.
It is not recommended for use in children, adolescents, pregnant women, and breastfeeding mothers.
It should be used with caution in elderly people as dose adjustments are necessary.
Alcohol consumption may increase the risk of side-effects.
Brufen MR Capsule may cause drowsiness and dizziness, so do not drive or operate heavy machinery if you are fully alert.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Brufen 400 Tablet?

faq.question: Can I stop taking Brufen 400 Tablet when my pain is relieved?

faq.question: Can the use of Brufen 400 Tablet cause nausea and vomiting?

faq.question: Are there any specific contraindications associated with the use of Brufen 400 Tablet?

The use of this medicine should preferably be avoided in patients with a history of stomach ulcers or in patients with active or recurrent stomach ulcer/bleeding. faq.question: What is MEtrogyl 400 Tablet and what is it used for?
faq.answer: MEtrogyl 400 Tablet is an antibiotic used to treat infections caused by certain bacteria and parasites. It is commonly prescribed for infections of the stomach and intestines (such as amoebiasis and giardiasis), vaginal infections like trichomoniasis and bacterial vaginosis, dental and gum infections, and other infections caused by bacteria that grow without oxygen. It works by killing the germs responsible for the infection.

faq.question: Is MEtrogyl 400 Tablet safe for patients with liver conditions?
faq.answer: The liver processes MEtrogyl 400 Tablet, so people with liver problems need to take it carefully. In patients with severe liver disease, the medicine may stay in the body longer, which can increase the risk of side effects. In such cases, your doctor may reduce the dose and monitor you more closely. Anyone with liver disease should inform their doctor before starting treatment.

faq.question: Can MEtrogyl 400 Tablet lead to antibiotic resistance?
faq.answer: Yes, like all antibiotics, MEtrogyl 400 Tablet can contribute to antibiotic resistance if used improperly. Taking it when it is not needed, using it for the wrong condition, or not completing the full prescribed course can allow bacteria to survive and become harder to treat in the future. It should always be taken after consulting your doctor.

faq.question: How should MEtrogyl 400 Tablet be consumed relative to meals?
faq.answer: MEtrogyl 400 Tablet can be taken with or after food. Taking it with food may help reduce stomach upset or nausea. The tablets should be swallowed with water, and you should follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment.

faq.question: How long does MEtrogyl 400 Tablet take to work?
faq.answer: MEtrogyl 400 Tablet usually begins working within about one hour after you take it, as the medicine is absorbed into the bloodstream. However, you may not feel better immediately. In most infections, noticeable improvement in symptoms may take 2–3 days. It is important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed. If your symptoms do not improve or worsen, you should consult your doctor.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while using MEtrogyl 400 Tablet?

faq.question: Can using MEtrogyl 400 Tablet cause a metallic taste?
faq.answer: Yes, a temporary metallic taste in the mouth is a known side effect. This is usually harmless and resolves after treatment is completed. Staying well hydrated, brushing your teeth after meals, and chewing sugar-free gum or mints may help reduce this sensation.

faq.question: Can I stop taking MEtrogyl 400 Tablet when I feel better?
faq.answer: No, you should complete the full prescribed course, even if you start feeling better. Symptoms may improve before the infection is fully cleared. faq.question: What if there is no improvement after using MEtrogyl 400 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you do not feel better after completing the full course, or if your symptoms worsen during treatment, inform your doctor. Further evaluation or a change in treatment may be needed.

faq.question: What is ZOCon 400 Tablet used for?
faq.answer: ZOCon 400 Tablet is an antifungal medicine. It is used for the treatment of many fungal infections like Cryptococcal meningitis (fungal infection in the brain) and Coccidioidomycosis (a disease of the lungs). Additionally, it is helpful in the treatment of infections caused by Candida found in the bloodstream, body organs (e.g., heart, lungs) or urinary tract, mucosal thrush (infection affecting the lining of the mouth, throat, and denture sore mouth), and genital thrush (infection of the vagina or penis). It can also be used to treat skin infections like athlete's foot, ringworm, jock itch, nail infection.

faq.question: Can ZOCon 400 Tablet be taken with oral contraceptives (OCPs) or birth control pills?
faq.answer: ZOCon 400 Tablet has been reported to have a minor interaction when taken with estradiol (a component of oral contraceptives). It can increase the level or effect of estradiol when given along with it. Before starting the treatment with ZOCon 400 Tablet inform your doctor if you are taking birth control pills.

faq.question: Can ZOCon 400 Tablet cause hair loss?
faq.answer: ZOCon 400 Tablet may cause hair loss as a rare side effect. If during the treatment you experience hair loss, inform your doctor.

faq.question: Is ZOCon 400 Tablet effective?
faq.answer: Yes, ZOCon 400 Tablet is effective when used in the dose and duration advised by your doctor. Do not stop taking it even if you see improvement in your condition. If you stop using ZOCon 400 Tablet too early, the symptoms may return or worsen.

faq.question: Is ZOCon 400 Tablet fungistatic or fungicidal?
faq.answer: ZOCon 400 Tablet is primarily fungistatic which means it controls the growth of fungus). However, it may also act as a fungicidal (kills fungus) medicine against certain organisms, specifically Cryptococcus in a dose-dependent manner, specifically Cryptococcus.

faq.question: Does ZOCon 400 Tablet treat urinary tract infection (UTI)?
faq.answer: ZOCon 400 Tablet is used to treat urinary tract infections (UTI) caused mainly by Candida. However, bacteria growth can also cause UTI in some cases. If you are suffering from UTI, please consult your doctor as the cause of infection (fungal or bacterial, or other) needs to be identified before the start of any treatment.

faq.question: What if I forget to take a dose of ZOCon 400 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you have missed a dose of ZOCon 400 Tablet, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next scheduled dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one as this may increase the chances of developing side effects.

faq.question: Can I take ZOCon 400 Tablet for yeast infection?
faq.answer: Yes, ZOCon 400 Tablet can be used for the treatment of yeast (candidal) infection. However, if you think you are suffering from a yeast infection, consult your doctor. This is because proper diagnosis is required before starting any therapy.

faq.question: Is ZOCon 400 Tablet a steroid?
faq.answer: No, ZOCon 400 Tablet is not a steroid. ZOCon 400 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called antifungals.

faq.question: Does ZOCon 400 Tablet treat bacterial vaginosis?
faq.answer: No, ZOCon 400 Tablet does not treat bacterial vaginosis as it is not active against any bacteria. ZOCon 400 Tablet is used to treat infection of the vagina caused by Candida (a fungal infection). If you think you are suffering from bacterial vaginosis, consult your doctor. This is because the diagnosis of your infection (whether it is fungal or bacterial) is required to start your treatment.

faq.question: Does ZOCon 400 Tablet make you feel tired?
faq.answer: Yes, ZOCon 400 Tablet can make you feel tired. If you experience excessive tiredness during the treatment with this medicine, consult your doctor. The reason for tiredness could be a sign of an underlying liver problem as ZOCon 400 Tablet can affect your liver.

faq.question: Is ZOCon 400 Tablet over the counter (OTC)?
faq.answer: No, ZOCon 400 Tablet is not an over-the-counter (OTC) product. It is available only when prescribed by your doctor.

faq.question: Is ZOCon 400 Tablet safe to be used in pregnancy?
faq.answer: No, ZOCon 400 Tablet is not safe to be used in pregnancy. Studies suggest that the use of ZOCon 400 Tablet during pregnancy is harmful to the development of the baby. Therefore, ZOCon 400 Tablet is prescribed in pregnant women only if the benefits of the medicine outweigh the risks involved. However, if a woman gets pregnant during the treatment with ZOCon 400 Tablet, she must be well informed about the potential harm to the baby. If you are planning to conceive, are pregnant, or breastfeeding, inform your doctor before taking ZOCon 400 Tablet.

faq.question: I feel better now, can I stop taking ZOCon 400 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking ZOCon 400 Tablet suddenly without consulting your doctor. This is because suddenly stopping the medication may worsen your condition and your infection may return. Continue your medication even if you feel better as your symptoms may improve before the infection is completely cleared. Stopping the medication too early could allow the fungus to continue to grow and hence, prevent complete healing.

faq.question: When can I drink water after taking BUDEtrol 400 Capsule?

faq.question: What should I discuss with my doctor before starting treatment with BUDEtrol 400 Capsule?

faq.question: When should I stop using the BUDEtrol 400 Capsule?
