Cutisoft Cream is meant only for external use and should be used as advised by your doctor.
You should normally clean and dry the affected area before applying a thin layer of the medicine evenly on the affected skin.
You should not apply it to open wounds or damaged skin.
Use it regularly to get the maximum benefit from it.It is usually well tolerated with little or no side effects.
However, it may cause application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness in some people.
These side effects are temporary and usually go away with time.
However, if they persist or worsen, let your doctor know.Pregnant and breastfeeding mothers need to consult their doctors before using this medicine.
Avoid any contact with your eyes, nose, or mouth.
Rinse it off with plenty of water in case of accidental contact.
Avoid covering the treated area with airtight dressings such as bandages unless directed by a doctor.Cutisoft Cream is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to the medicine or any of its constituent ingredients.
Patients with tuberculosis or fungal infections and/or herpes infections of the eyes, lips, or genitals should also avoid the use of Cutisoft Cream or consult a doctor.Cutisoft Cream should not be used under waterproof dressings unless advised to do so by a physician.
Cutisoft Cream should not be used to treat acne.
Cutisoft Cream should not be used for external feminine itching if a vaginal discharge is present.
It is not to be used for external anal itching if bleeding is present.

faq.question: Can Cutisoft Cream be used on the face?
faq.answer: No, Cutisoft Cream should not be used on the face. In addition to this, Cutisoft Cream should not be used on the axillae (armpits), groin, and if there is atrophy (wasting away of tissues) at the treatment site. In some cases, doctors may decide to use it if they believe it's necessary. It should be used only after consultation with your physician, and if possible, the application on the face should be limited to a maximum of 5 days.

faq.question: Can we use Cutisoft Cream in infections?
faq.answer: Cutisoft Cream is not an antimicrobial or antifungal agent. It is a steroid medication. It should not be used in infections. Bacterial infections are prone to worsen if the infection is covered with a dressing after using Cutisoft Cream. In case the inflammatory lesions get infected or there is any spread of infection, consult your doctor immediately. The doctor will withdraw the use of Cutisoft Cream and provide appropriate antimicrobial therapy.

faq.question: How to use Cutisoft Cream?
faq.answer: Before using the Cutisoft Cream, clean and dry the affected area. Gently and thoroughly massage the medication into the skin. Be careful not to get the medication in your eyes or mouth. If Cutisoft Cream accidentally gets in your eyes, wash them with plenty of water and call your doctor if your eyes are irritated.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Cutisoft Cream when my symptoms are relieved?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking Cutisoft Cream and finish the full course of treatment even if you feel better. Your symptoms may improve before your treatment is complete. Stopping Cutisoft Cream before your treatment is completed can bring back your skin symptoms.

faq.question: What are the precautions that are needed to be taken while using Cutisoft Cream?
faq.answer: Cutisoft Cream should not be used on the face. Do not use the medication for longer periods than you have been advised. Do not apply a bandage or dressing to the area being treated, as this will increase absorption of the preparation and increase the risk of side effects. This medicine should only be used when advised by the doctor and never given to other people, even if their condition appears to be the same as yours.

faq.question: Who should not use Cutisoft Cream?
faq.answer: Cutisoft Cream should not be used in people who are allergic to Cutisoft Cream or any of its ingredients. faq.question: What should I do if I forget to use Cutisoft Cream?
faq.answer: If you forget to use the Cutisoft Cream, do not worry; take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and follow your regular schedule. Do not double the dose. However, if you are not sure and have any other doubts, please consult your doctor.

faq.question: How does Cutisoft 1% cream work?
faq.answer: Cutisoft 1% cream contains hydrocortisone, which works by blocking or reducing the action of some natural substances in the skin that cause swelling, redness and allergies.

faq.question: How to use Cutisoft 1% cream?
faq.answer: Use Cutisoft 1% cream as directed by your doctor. Read the instructions on the label or leaflet before use. Clean and dry the affected area well. Apply it on healthy skin surface free from cuts and wounds.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Cyblex 30 XR Tablet?

faq.question: Is Cyblex 30 XR Tablet the same as metformin?

faq.question: Can you take metformin and Cyblex 30 XR Tablet at the same time?

faq.question: Is Cyblex 30 XR Tablet bad for kidneys?

faq.question: What is Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet?

Metformin works by lowering the glucose production in the liver and improving insulin sensitivity. This combination is not indicated for the treatment of Type 1 DM.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet is associated with common side effects. These side effects may include hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level), altered taste, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhea, headache and upper respiratory tract infection. Its use can also lead to serious but rare side effects like lactic acidosis. On long-term use, it can also lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Can the use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet cause hypoglycemia?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet can cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level). Symptoms of hypoglycemia include nausea, headache, irritability, hunger, sweating, dizziness, fast heart rate and feeling anxious or shaky. It happens more often if you miss or delay your food, drink alcohol, over-exercise or take other antidiabetic medicine along with it. So, regular monitoring of blood sugar level is important. Always keep glucose tablets, honey or fruit juice with you.

faq.question: Can the use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet cause lactic acidosis?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet can lead to lactic acidosis. It is a medical emergency which is caused by increased levels of lactic acid in the blood. It is also known as MALA (Metformin associated lactic acidosis). It is a rare side effect associated with the use of metformin. It is avoided in patients with underlying kidney disease, old age patients or who take large amounts of alcohol. Symptoms of lactic acidosis may include muscle pain or weakness, dizziness, tiredness, feeling of cold in arms and legs, difficulty in breathing, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain or slow heart rate. If you have these symptoms, stop taking Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet and immediately consult your doctor.

faq.question: Can the use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet lead to Vitamin B12 deficiency?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet can cause vitamin B12 deficiency on long-term use. The deficiency occurs as the medicine interferes with absorption of vitamin B12 in the stomach. If untreated, it may cause anemia and nerve problems and the patient can have tingling sensation and numbness in hands and feet, weakness, urinary problems, change in mental status and difficulty in maintaining balance (ataxia). To avoid such problems, some researchers suggest an intake of vitamin B12 from outside sources at least once every year.

faq.question: Are there any specific conditions in which Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet should not to be taken?
faq.answer: The use of Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet should be avoided in patients with known allergy to any of the component or excipients of this medicine. It is also avoided in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease or with underlying metabolic acidosis including diabetic ketoacidosis.

faq.question: Is it safe to take alcohol while I am also taking Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is not safe to take alcohol along with Cyblex M 30 XR Tablet. It may lower your low blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia) and can increase the chances of lactic acidosis.

Cyra-D Capsule should be taken on an empty stomach in the dose and duration advised by your doctor.
The exact dose will depend on your condition and response to treatment.
Continue taking it for as long as prescribed, even if your symptoms improve, as stopping early may cause them to return or worsen.

faq.question: What is Cyra-D Capsule?
faq.answer: Cyra-D Capsule is a combination of two medicines: Domperidone and Rabeprazole. faq.question: What are the contraindications of Cyra-D Capsule?

faq.question: Can the use of Cyra-D Capsule cause dry mouth?

faq.question: Can the use of Cyra-D Capsule cause diarrhea?

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for Cyra-D Capsule?

faq.question: Is it safe to use Cyra-D Capsule?

faq.question: What is the best time to take Cyra-D Capsule?
faq.answer: It is best to take Cyra-D Capsule before the first meal of the day or on an empty stomach.

faq.question: Can the use of Cyra-D Capsule cause abnormal heartbeat?

description:
Cytolog Tablet is a medicine used for medical abortion (terminating a pregnancy).
It is also used for preventing excessive bleeding after delivery.
This medicine acts on the uterus and increases its contraction.
Cytolog Tablet is given alone or in combination with some other medicine to attain the maximum benefit.
It should be taken with food or as your doctor's advice.
It should be taken orally, by swallow the tablets whole with a drink of water.
If you experience vomiting within 30 minutes of tablet intake, inform your doctor or take another tablet.
The medicine may take 24 hours to show its action and you experience bleeding.Common side effects of this medicine include infection following abortion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, uterine contractions or cramping, uterine bleeding, heavy bleeding, and fetal malformations.
If these bother you or appear serious, let your doctor know.
There may be ways of reducing or preventing them.
Usually, vaginal bleeding may last for 12 days, inform your doctor if it lasts for more than 12 days or you notice severe abdominal pain.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had an ectopic pregnancy, or you are breastfeeding or using an intrauterine device.
Your doctor should also know about all other medicines you are taking as many of these may make this medicine less effective or change the way it works.
You must avoid strenuous activity like heavy exercise, running, and driving while abortion as it can affect the bleeding.
Your doctor may perform an ultrasound or pelvic examination to check for abortion completion.

faq.question: What is Cytolog Tablet and what is used for?
faq.answer: Cytolog Tablet contains a medicine called Misoprostol. It helps in medical termination of the pregnancy. It is prescribed along with another medicine called Mifepristone. It is only used to terminate a pregnancy which should not be more than 63 days old, counting from the first day of the last menstrual period. It works by increasing the contractions of the uterus. It may also be used in the prevention or treatment of post-delivery bleeding and for cervical ripening.

faq.question: How and in what dose should I take Cytolog Tablet?
faq.answer: This medicine is administered only in a clinic or healthcare facility under the supervision of a gynaecologist.

faq.question: What should I expect after taking Cytolog Tablet?
faq.answer: For medical termination of pregnancy: You may experience abdominal cramping, diarrhea, stomach pain, and nausea immediately after taking Cytolog Tablet. You may also have vaginal bleeding within 4 hours of taking Cytolog Tablet. You may also be asked to stay at the clinic or healthcare center for at least 3 hours after taking this medicine. After 14 days of taking Mifepristone (pill you took before Cytolog Tablet) your gynaecologist may run some blood tests or perform ultrasonography to confirm whether pregnancy has been terminated or not.

faq.question: Can Cytolog Tablet affect my future chances of getting pregnant?
faq.answer: No, studies have shown that this medicine does not impair the fertility of the women. Your future chances of getting pregnant are as equal as of those who have not taken this medicine.

faq.question: What are the common side effects of taking Cytolog Tablet?
faq.answer: The common side effects of using Cytolog Tablet are abdominal pain, abdominal cramping, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, uterine contractions, pelvic pain, and shivering. If you experience a very heavy vaginal bleeding or if any of these side effects bother you please consult with your gynaecologist.

description:
D-Shine Shot Oral Solution is used in the treatment of vitamin D deficiency and osteoporosis.
It helps the body to absorb calcium.
Calcium is essential for maintaining strong and healthy bones.
It is used when your diet does not provide enough calcium.
D-Shine Shot Oral Solution should be taken as directed by your doctor.
It is best taken with or after food, as this helps your body absorb it, and you should take it regularly to get the most benefits.
If you are using it to treat osteoporosis, you will also be prescribed other medicines.
This medicine may be only part of a complete treatment program that includes making changes to your diet and taking calcium and vitamin supplements.
Learn about the foods you should eat to ensure you get enough calcium and vitamin D.D-Shine Shot Oral Solution has few side effects, and none are common.
If you take too much, you may feel weakness, muscle pain, or a metallic taste in your mouth.
If you experience any such side effects, speak with your doctor.
They may be able to help you reduce or treat the symptoms.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have high calcium levels in your blood or if you have any heart, kidney, or liver disease.
Some other medicines can decrease the absorption of vitamin D3, so let your doctor know about all the other medicines you are taking to make sure you are safe.
This medicine may help during pregnancy when your body needs more vitamin D, but too much could harm your baby.
Discuss it with your doctor.

faq.question: Is it better to take D-Shine Shot Oral Solution at night or in the morning?
faq.answer: You can take D-Shine Shot Oral Solution at any time, morning or night. However, limited information is available about the best time to take it. Take it strictly as advised by your doctor.

faq.question: What are the benefits of taking D-Shine Shot Oral Solution?
faq.answer: D-Shine Shot Oral Solution is vital for maintaining bone health and supporting the health of the immune system, brain, and nervous system. It regulates insulin levels and is important for a healthy heart and blood vessels.

faq.question: How should D-Shine Shot Oral Solution be taken?
faq.answer: D-Shine Shot Oral Solution should be swallowed whole with water and not crushed or chewed. It is advised to take it with the main meal of the day to increase its absorption.

faq.question: Who should not take D-Shine Shot Oral Solution?
faq.answer: D-Shine Shot Oral Solution should not be taken by patients allergic to cholecalciferol, patients with increased calcium levels in the blood, or patients with calcium in the urine. Patients with kidney stones or severe kidney problems should also avoid its use.

faq.question: What happens if I take too much D-Shine Shot Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Taking too much D-Shine Shot Oral Solution for an extended period may increase calcium levels in the blood (hypercalcemia). This may cause weakness, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, sluggishness, kidney stones, increased blood pressure, and growth retardation in children.

faq.question: How much vitamin D should I take daily?
faq.answer: The daily requirement of vitamin D is 4000 IU/day. Since your diet may not meet this requirement, you may need 1000 - 3000 IU/day of vitamin D supplements. D-Shine Shot Oral Solution is a form of vitamin D used as a supplement in patients with vitamin D deficiency.

faq.question: What happens if vitamin D is low?
faq.answer: Low vitamin D levels may cause rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults. Vitamin D deficiency may also increase the risk of diabetes mellitus type 1, high blood pressure, depression, some cancers, and osteoporosis.

description:
Dacia MT Tablet ER is a medicine used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension).
It works by relaxing the blood vessels allowing the blood to flow more easily.
It also slows down the heart rate and reduces cardiac workload.
By lowering the blood pressure, it helps in preventing future heart attack and stroke.
Dacia MT Tablet ER may be taken with or without food.
Take it regularly and at a fixed time each day to maintain consistent levels of medicine in the blood.
Keep taking it for as long as advised by your doctor.
Do not stop taking the medicine on your own even if you feel better, as high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Staying active with regular exercise, reducing your weight and eating a healthy diet will also help control your blood pressure.
Follow your doctor’s advice while taking this medicine.Some common side effects of this medicine include tiredness, dizziness, slow heart rate, low blood pressure, diarrhea, rash, or upset stomach.
If it causes dizziness, avoid driving and rise slowly from the sitting position.
You may be asked for regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar level, kidney functioning, urea, or electrolytes level during the treatment.Before taking it, let your doctor know if you have any liver or kidney problems.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
You also need to tell your doctor what other medicines you are taking, especially those used to treat high blood pressure or heart conditions.

description:
Dailyglim 1mg Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called sulfonylureas and is used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus in adults.
It helps control blood sugar levels in people with diabetes thereby preventing serious complications of diabetes such as kidney damage and blindness.
Dailyglim 1mg Tablet may be used alone or along with other medicines.
It should be taken just before or with the first meal of the day.
Take it regularly at the same time each day to get the maximum benefit.
Your doctor will decide what dose is best for you and this may change from time to time according to your blood sugar levels.Keep taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet, even if you feel well or your blood sugar levels are controlled.
If you stop it without consulting your doctor, your blood sugar levels could rise to put you at risk of diabetes complications such as kidney damage, blindness, nerve problems, and loss of limbs.
Remember that it is only part of a treatment program that should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.
Your lifestyle plays a big part in controlling diabetes.The most common side effects of taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet include low blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia).
It is important to have regular meals and always carry a fast-acting source of glucose such as sugary food or fruit juice with you.
Drinking alcohol can also increase your risk of low blood sugar levels and hence should be avoided.
Some people may experience an increase in weight with this medicine.You should not take Dailyglim 1mg Tablet if you have type 1 diabetes mellitus, diabetic ketoacidosis (high levels of acid in your blood), or if you have severe kidney or liver disease.
Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had heart disease, thyroid disease, or some hormonal conditions, as it may not be suitable.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Your blood sugar levels should be checked regularly and your doctor may also advise blood tests to monitor your blood cell counts and liver function.

faq.question: Does Dailyglim 1mg Tablet make you sleepy?
faq.answer: Dailyglim 1mg Tablet itself does not cause sleepiness. However, it may cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar) when used with other anti-diabetes medicine. Because of this you may feel sleepy or have problems in sleeping.

faq.question: Is Dailyglim 1mg Tablet safe for kidneys?
faq.answer: Dailyglim 1mg Tablet does not affect kidneys in patients with normal kidney function. However, its use should be avoided in patients with severe kidney disease since Dailyglim 1mg Tablet is principally eliminated by the kidneys.

faq.question: Does Dailyglim 1mg Tablet cause memory loss?
faq.answer: No, it is not known that Dailyglim 1mg Tablet causes memory loss. However, the use of Dailyglim 1mg Tablet may cause low blood sugar which may cause problems with concentration and reduced alertness.

faq.question: Who should not take Dailyglim 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: Dailyglim 1mg Tablet should be avoided by patients who are allergic to it, have severe kidney or liver disease, have G6PD-deficiency (an inherited condition affecting red blood cells) or are due to have surgery. Additionally, patients who are trying to get pregnant, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have insulin-dependent diabetes (type 1 diabetes mellitus) should avoid taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet.

faq.question: How long does it take for Dailyglim 1mg Tablet to start working?
faq.answer: Dailyglim 1mg Tablet takes about 2 to 3 hours to reduce blood sugar levels. You may not feel any difference, but this does not mean the medicine is not working. Continue taking the medication as directed by your doctor and if you have any concerns, discuss it with your doctor.

faq.question: How long do I need to take Dailyglim 1mg Tablet? Can I stop the medication?
faq.answer: Usually, the treatment for diabetes is suggested for a long term. You may have to continue the treatment life long. Dailyglim 1mg Tablet only controls the sugar levels but does not cure it. Do not stop taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet without talking to your doctor. If you stop taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet suddenly your diabetes may get worse.

faq.question: What can happen if I take more than the recommended dose of Dailyglim 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: Dailyglim 1mg Tablet should be taken strictly as advised by the doctor. Overdose of Dailyglim 1mg Tablet may significantly decrease your blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia). If you think you have taken an excess dose and experience a dip in your sugar level, consume enough sugar (e.g., a small bar of sugar cubes, sweet juice or sweetened tea) and inform a doctor immediately. Severe cases of hypoglycemia accompanied by loss of consciousness and coma require immediate medical treatment and admission into hospital.

faq.question: Can you take Dailyglim 1mg Tablet on an empty stomach?
faq.answer: No. Taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet on an empty stomach can cause your blood sugar levels to become too low. Low blood sugar can cause dizziness, shaking, anxiety, irritability, a fast heartbeat, and confusion. Therefore, you should always take the medicine with breakfast or the first meal of the day. If you are skipping your meal, then you should also avoid taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet.

faq.question: Can Dailyglim 1mg Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, Dailyglim 1mg Tablet can cause dizziness as a side effect. If this happens to you, sit or lie down until the symptoms pass. Always carry some sugary food or fruit juice with you in case you experience dizziness while travelling.

faq.question: What should you not eat while taking Dailyglim 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: It is advisable to avoid foods that are high in saturated and trans fats, instead consume fats from fish and nuts. Control your carbohydrate intake as this directly affects your blood sugar.

faq.question: Is Dailyglim 1mg Tablet safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, Dailyglim 1mg Tablet tablet is safe when used as directed by the doctor. However, it may show some side effects. For best results, it should be used in the correct dose and at the same time each day.

faq.question: Can people with diabetes have proteins?
faq.answer: Yes, people with diabetes must include proteins along with other essential nutrients in their daily diet. Proteins are one of the major energy providers among all essential nutrients. Besides, being the building blocks of the human body, proteins break down into glucose to release energy. Unlike carbohydrates, the metabolism of proteins into glucose is much slower. Therefore, the release of energy usually takes a few hours after consumption. Thus, the spike in blood sugar levels might occur after a few hours when you are on a high-protein diet.

faq.question: Are artificial sweeteners good for people with diabetes?
faq.answer: No, artificial sweeteners are not good for people with diabetes. They are composed of chemicals that can cause mild to severe side effects. Thus, it is better to limit or avoid their use as much as you can.

faq.question: Can diabetes cause kidney failure?
faq.answer: Yes, uncontrolled diabetes can cause kidney failure. In the long run, diabetes can affect the kidneys leading to a condition called diabetic nephropathy. Diabetic nephropathy is a condition that is a major cause of kidney failure in patients with diabetes. The best way to prevent damage to kidneys is by keeping diabetes in check, making dietary changes, monitoring sugar levels regularly, getting routine blood tests done, and taking prescribed medications on time.

faq.question: Can diabetes be cured?
faq.answer: Diabetes is a condition that causes changes in your blood glucose levels, which if left uncontrolled, can lead to serious health complications affecting the heart, brain, kidneys, and eyes. However, with simple lifestyle changes, diet, and medications, one can manage their condition and lead a healthy life.

faq.question: What is Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR?

Glimepiride lowers the blood glucose levels by increasing the release of insulin from the pancreas. Metformin works by lowering glucose production in the liver and improving insulin sensitivity. This combination is not indicated for the treatment of type 1 DM.

faq.question: Can the use of Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR lead to lactic acidosis?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR can lead to lactic acidosis. It is a medical emergency that is caused by increased levels of lactic acid in the blood. It is also known as MALA (metformin-associated lactic acidosis). It is a rare side effect associated with the use of metformin, and therefore, it is considered to be harmful for patients with underlying kidney disease, older patients, or those who take large amounts of alcohol. Symptoms of lactic acidosis may include muscle pain or weakness, dizziness, tiredness, a feeling of cold in arms and legs, difficulty in breathing, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, or a slow heart rate. If you have these symptoms, stop taking Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR and consult your doctor immediately.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR?

faq.question: Can the use of Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR lead to Vitamin B12 deficiency?

It happens more often if you miss or delay your food, drink alcohol, over-exercise, or take other antidiabetic medicines along with it. So, regular monitoring of the blood sugar level is important. Always keep a quick source of sugar, like glucose tablets, honey, or fruit juice, with you.

faq.question: Is it safe to take alcohol while I am also taking Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR?
faq.answer: No, it is not safe to take Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR along with alcohol, as it may lower your blood sugar levels and lead to hypoglycemia. It can also increase the chances of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: What are the recommended storage conditions for Dailyglim M2 Tablet PR?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, or other people.

faq.question: Is Dapacose 10 Tablet safe to use?

faq.question: What are the side effects of Dapacose 10 Tablet?

faq.question: Can I stop taking Dapacose 10 Tablet when I feel better?

faq.question: Who should not take Dapacose 10 Tablet?

faq.question: Can I take Dapacose 10 Tablet before surgery?

This is done because there is a risk of developing diabetic ketoacidosis (a serious condition that may develop if high blood sugar is not treated).

faq.question: Why did my doctor prescribe Dapacose 10 Tablet along with metformin?

So, maybe your doctor prescribed the combined use of metformin with Dapacose 10 Tablet to provide the extra help you need.

faq.question: Can Dapaford-LN 5 Tablet cause low blood sugar?

faq.question: What serious side effects of Dapaford-LN 5 Tablet should I watch for?

faq.question: What should I tell my doctor before starting Dapaford-LN 5 Tablet?

faq.question: Can dehydration or low blood pressure happen with this medicine?

faq.question: Is this medicine suitable for people with heart or kidney disease?

faq.question: What should I do if I develop skin blisters or a severe rash?
faq.answer: Stop Dapaford-LN 5 Tablet, and contact your doctor right away. A condition called bullous pemphigoid, which causes large fluid-filled blisters, has been reported with linagliptin use. Early treatment is important.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Dapaford 10 Tablet when I feel better?

faq.question: Who should not take Dapaford 10 Tablet?

faq.question: Can I take Dapaford 10 Tablet before surgery?

faq.question: Why did my doctor prescribe Dapaford 10 Tablet along with metformin?

description:
Telmikind Beta 50 Tablet ER is a medicine used for treating high blood pressure.
By lowering blood pressure, it helps in preventing future heart attacks and strokes.
Early treatment with this medicine also improves the chances of survival in patients with heart attacks.
It is advised to take Telmikind Beta 50 Tablet ER with food at a fixed time each day to maintain consistent levels of medicine in the blood.
Keep taking it for as long as advised by your doctor.
Even if you feel well, do not stop this medicine on your own because high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Keeping active with regular exercise, reducing your weight and eating a healthy diet will also help control your blood pressure.
Follow your doctor’s advice while taking this medicine.Some common side effects of this medicine include headache, weakness, dizziness, decreased blood pressure, increased potassium level in blood, orthostatic hypotension (occasionally with syncope), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue.
It is advised to avoid potassium rich food and supplements while taking this medicine.
It may cause dizziness, avoid driving or rise slowly from the sitting position.
You may be asked for regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar level, kidney functioning, urea, or electrolytes level during the treatment.Before taking it, let your doctor know if you have any liver or kidney problems.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
You also need to tell your doctor what other medicines you are taking especially those used to treat high blood pressure or heart conditions.

faq.question: What is Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER used for?
faq.answer: Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER helps lower blood sugar levels in adults with type 2 diabetes. It combines three drugs that work in different ways to improve blood sugar control and may also help with weight loss and protect the heart and kidneys in some people.

faq.question: Can anyone with diabetes take Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER?
faq.answer: No. Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER is only for adults with type 2 diabetes. It should not be used in people with type 1 diabetes, or those who have severe kidney problems, metabolic acidosis, or diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA)—a serious condition caused by very high blood sugar.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER I need to watch for?
faq.answer: During Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER treatment, contact a doctor if serious side effects appear. These may include signs of lactic acidosis (such as weakness, breathing difficulty, or stomach pain), symptoms of ketoacidosis (like nausea, vomiting, confusion, or fruity breath), painful or persistent genital or urinary infections, signs of pancreatitis (severe stomach pain or nausea), or allergic reactions (rash, swelling, or breathing problems). These effects are rare but require prompt medical attention.

faq.question: Can Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER affect my kidneys or liver?
faq.answer: Yes, people with kidney or liver problems need to be monitored closely or may need a different medication. Your doctor will do regular blood tests to check your kidney and liver function during Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER treatment.

faq.question: Can I take Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER if I am pregnant or breastfeeding?
faq.answer: Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Some of the ingredients may harm the baby or affect milk production. Let your doctor know if you're planning a pregnancy.

faq.question: Will Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER make my blood sugar too low?
faq.answer: Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER does not usually cause low blood sugar on its own, but it can happen if you take it with insulin or certain diabetes pills. Always carry something sweet (like glucose tablets or candy) in case of symptoms like shakiness, sweating, or dizziness.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER?
faq.answer: During Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER treatment, you should avoid drinking alcohol heavily as it increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Also, be cautious with dehydration and drink enough fluids, especially in hot weather or when you're sick.

faq.question: Can I take other medicines with Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Some medicines, including diuretics (water pills), blood pressure drugs, and steroids, may interact with Dapanorm Trio Tablet ER. Always tell your doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines or supplements you’re using.

faq.question: What if I vomit after taking Lanol ER Tablet?
faq.answer: If you vomit in less than 30 minutes after having a dose of Lanol ER Tablet tablets or syrup, retake the same dose again. If you vomit after 30 minutes of a dose, you do not need to take another one until the next standard dose.

faq.question: When will I feel better after taking the Lanol ER Tablet?
faq.answer: Usually, you will start feeling better after about half an hour of taking a Lanol ER Tablet.

faq.question: How often can I take the Lanol ER Tablet?
faq.answer: You should only take four doses of Lanol ER Tablet in 24 hours. There should be a gap of at least 4 hours between two doses. Do not take Lanol ER Tablet for more than 3 days without consulting a doctor first.

faq.question: Is Lanol ER Tablet an antibiotic?
faq.answer: No, Lanol ER Tablet is not an antibiotic. It works as a painkiller and fever-reducing medicine.

faq.question: Can I take Lanol ER Tablet and ibuprofen together?
faq.answer: Ibuprofen and Lanol ER Tablet are safe medicines, but both should not be used together. Consult your doctor if you are not sure.

faq.question: How long does a Lanol ER Tablet take to work?
faq.answer: Lanol ER Tablet takes around 30-45 min to start working and show its effects. It is advised to take this medicine for the duration suggested by the doctor. Consult your doctor if you experience any bothersome side effects.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of taking an excess of the Lanol ER Tablet?
faq.answer: Overdose of Lanol ER Tablete may cause severe life-threatening liver injury. Taking more than the prescribed dose may also cause kidney injury, decreased platelet count, and even coma. Early symptoms of an overdose include nausea, vomiting, and general tiredness. Immediately consult a doctor or reach an emergency in case of a suspected overdose.

faq.question: Can Lanol ER Tablet cause nausea and vomiting?
faq.answer: Yes, Lanol ER Tablet may cause nausea and vomiting. Taking it with milk, food or antacids can prevent nausea. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. In case of vomiting, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small frequent sips. Talk to your doctor if vomiting persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like dark colored and strong-smelling urine or a low frequency of urination. Do not take any other medicines without speaking to your doctor.

faq.question: Is Lanol ER Tablet helpful in relieving stomach pain due to indigestion?
faq.answer: No, Lanol ER Tablet should not be taken for stomach pain without consulting a doctor. This drug can increase stomach acid secretion which may aggravate an unknown underlying condition.

faq.question: Can I take Lanol ER Tablet with an antibiotic?
faq.answer: Yes, taking Lanol ER Tablet and antibiotics at the same time should not cause any problems. Antibiotics are used to help clear infections but often don't do anything to relieve pain. Therefore you can generally take Lanol ER Tablet alongside your antibiotics. However, always consult your doctor before taking any medications.

faq.question: Does Lanol ER Tablet make babies sleepy?
faq.answer: No, Lanol ER Tablet does not make babies sleepy. It is a pain-relieving medicine that is also used to control high fever.

faq.question: Is Lanol ER Tablet safe for children?
faq.answer: Lanol ER Tablet is considered safe for children only when used as directed by the doctor.

faq.question: What happens if I take Lanol ER Tablet tablet even if I don't have a fever?
faq.answer: If you take Lanol ER Tablet tablet when you don’t have a fever, then any minor pain or ache you might be experiencing in your body will be relieved. If you don’t have any pain, you will not notice any difference. At low doses, Lanol ER Tablet is harmless.

faq.question: How long does Flagyl ER Tablet take to work?
faq.answer: Usually, Flagyl ER Tablet starts working within 1 hour of its ingestion. However, it may take around 2-3 days to make you feel better while taking Flagyl ER Tablet. If you do not experience any significant reduction in your symptoms, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while using Flagyl ER Tablet?
faq.answer: No, avoid drinking alcohol while taking Flagyl ER Tablet. Moreover, you should avoid alcohol even after 3 days of finishing the complete course. Drinking alcohol can cause an unpleasant reaction (disulfiram like reaction) with symptoms such as stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, headache, flushing or redness of the face.

faq.question: Can the use of Flagyl ER Tablet cause metallic taste?
faq.answer: Yes, Flagyl ER Tablet may cause a temporary metallic taste. This metallic taste can be reduced by staying hydrated, brushing teeth after the meals and chewing sugar-free gum or mints.

faq.question: What if I take more than the recommended dose of Flagyl ER Tablet?
faq.answer: If you have taken Flagyl ER Tablet in excess (more than the recommended dose), immediately contact your doctor or report to the nearest hospital. Overdose of Flagyl ER Tablet may cause loss of appetite, metallic taste, headache, dizziness, insomnia or drowsiness.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Flagyl ER Tablet when I feel better?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking Flagyl ER Tablet and complete the full course of treatment even if you feel better. Your symptoms may improve before the infection is completely cured. Hence, if you stop taking the medicine before completing the course, your infection may come back. Consult your doctor before you stop taking Flagyl ER Tablet and follow their advice.

faq.question: What if there is no improvement after using Flagyl ER Tablet?
faq.answer: Inform your doctor if you did not feel better after completing the full course of treatment. Also, inform him/her if your symptoms are getting worse during the treatment.

faq.question: Can the use of MEtrogyl ER Tablet cause metallic taste?

faq.question: What if I take more than the recommended dose of MEtrogyl ER Tablet?

faq.question: Can I stop taking MEtrogyl ER Tablet when I feel better?

faq.question: Who should not take Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER should not be taken by people allergic to metoprolol, ramipril, or any other ingredients present in it, or to beta-blocker or ACE inhibitor medicines. It must not be used in patients with a history of angioedema, severe asthma, very low blood pressure, certain heart rhythm problems, cardiogenic shock, or untreated pheochromocytoma.

faq.question: Can Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER cause serious allergic reactions?
faq.answer: Yes. Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER can sometimes cause angioedema, which is swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat. This can be life-threatening and requires immediate medical help.

faq.question: Can Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER affect breathing?
faq.answer: Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER may cause breathing problems in people with asthma or chronic obstructive lung disease. It should not be used in patients with severe lung conditions.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Serious side effects of Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER may include severe dizziness or fainting from low blood pressure, swelling of the face or throat, chest pain, irregular heartbeat, severe diarrhea, signs of kidney problems, or yellowing of the skin and eyes. If you notice these, seek urgent medical attention.

faq.question: Can Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER affect my kidneys or liver?
faq.answer: Yes. Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER can affect kidney function, especially in patients with narrowed kidney blood vessels or pre-existing kidney disease. faq.question: Can Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER cause blood sugar or electrolyte problems?
faq.answer: Yes. Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER can mask signs of low blood sugar in diabetic patients. Cardace Meto 5 Tablet ER may also increase potassium levels, which can be dangerous if not monitored. Your doctor will check your blood sugar, potassium, and sodium levels regularly.

faq.question: What is Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER used for?
faq.answer: Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER helps lower blood sugar levels in adults with type 2 diabetes. It combines three drugs that work in different ways to improve blood sugar control and may also help with weight loss and protect the heart and kidneys in some people.

faq.question: Can anyone with diabetes take Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER?
faq.answer: No. Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER is only for adults with type 2 diabetes. It should not be used in people with type 1 diabetes, or those who have severe kidney problems, metabolic acidosis, or diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA)—a serious condition caused by very high blood sugar.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER I need to watch for?
faq.answer: During Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER treatment, contact a doctor if serious side effects appear. These may include signs of lactic acidosis (such as weakness, breathing difficulty, or stomach pain), symptoms of ketoacidosis (like nausea, vomiting, confusion, or fruity breath), painful or persistent genital or urinary infections, signs of pancreatitis (severe stomach pain or nausea), or allergic reactions (rash, swelling, or breathing problems). These effects are rare but require prompt medical attention.

faq.question: Can Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER affect my kidneys or liver?
faq.answer: Yes, people with kidney or liver problems need to be monitored closely or may need a different medication. Your doctor will do regular blood tests to check your kidney and liver function during Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER treatment.

faq.question: Can I take Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER if I am pregnant or breastfeeding?
faq.answer: Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Some of the ingredients may harm the baby or affect milk production. Let your doctor know if you're planning a pregnancy.

faq.question: Will Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER make my blood sugar too low?
faq.answer: Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER does not usually cause low blood sugar on its own, but it can happen if you take it with insulin or certain diabetes pills. Always carry something sweet (like glucose tablets or candy) in case of symptoms like shakiness, sweating, or dizziness.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER?
faq.answer: During Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER treatment, you should avoid drinking alcohol heavily as it increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Also, be cautious with dehydration and drink enough fluids, especially in hot weather or when you're sick.

faq.question: Can I take other medicines with Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Some medicines, including diuretics (water pills), blood pressure drugs, and steroids, may interact with Dapanorm Trio Forte Tablet ER. Always tell your doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines or supplements you’re using.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Tribet 2 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: No, it is not safe to drink alcohol while using Tribet 2 Tablet ER. Drinking alcohol may lower your blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia). Also, it can increase the chances of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: What should I inform the doctor before taking Tribet 2 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Before taking Tribet 2 Tablet ER inform your doctor if you have congestive heart failure, kidney problems, liver problems, swelling of the back of the eye. Inform the doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or a premenopausal woman. Let the doctor know if you are taking any prescription and non-prescription medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements.

faq.question: Can the use of Tribet 2 Tablet ER lead to Vitamin B12 deficiency?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Tribet 2 Tablet ER can cause vitamin B12 deficiency as it contains metformin in it. On long-term use, it interferes with absorption of vitamin B12 in the stomach.

faq.question: Can the use of Tribet 2 Tablet ER cause hypoglycemia?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Tribet 2 Tablet ER can cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level). Symptoms of hypoglycemia include nausea, headache, irritability, hunger, sweating, dizziness, fast heart rate and feeling anxious or shaky. It happens more often if you miss or delay your meal, drink alcohol, over-exercise or take other antidiabetic medicine along with it. So, regular monitoring of blood sugar level is important. Always carry some sugary item like a candy or chocolate with you.

faq.question: What are the instructions for the storage and disposal of Tribet 2 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.answer: No, you should not consume alcohol after taking Olmezest Beta 50 Tablet ER. Alcohol may increase the blood-pressure-lowering effects of this medicine and lead to low blood pressure.

faq.question: I am experiencing a headache, is it due to Olmezest Beta 50 Tablet ER?

faq.question: Does Olmezest Beta 50 Tablet ER cause constipation?

faq.answer: Nausea and vomiting are some of the common side effects of this medicine. Eat smaller, more frequent meals to reduce the feeling of nausea. Avoid food that is salty, spicy, fried, or fatty.

faq.answer: No, Septapress 5 Tablet ER does not get you high. It does not have any abuse potential or any dependence. The common psychiatric side effects of Septapress 5 Tablet ER include nervousness and depression.

faq.question: How should Septapress 5 Tablet ER be taken?
faq.answer: Always take this medicine exactly as advised by your doctor. Septapress 5 Tablet ER should be taken by mouth and can be taken before or after meals and drinks. Usually, it is advised to take the dose two or three times a day at evenly spaced intervals.

faq.question: What precaution should be followed while taking Septapress 5 Tablet ER?

Septapress 5 Tablet ER is usually started at the lowest possible dose and gradually increased, depending on how you respond to treatment. faq.answer: Your doctor will decide the duration of treatment based on the condition you are being treated for. For instance, if you are being treated for high blood pressure, then you may have to take it for life.

Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly while taking this medicine.

faq.question: What is DApanorm 10 Tablet used for?
faq.answer: DApanorm 10 Tablet is used to lower blood glucose levels in type 2 diabetes. In type 2 diabetes, the body is not able to use the produced insulin properly. This leads to an increase in the levels of sugar in your blood. DApanorm 10 Tablet works by removing excess sugar from your body via your urine. In addition to that, it can also help prevent heart disease.

faq.question: Is DApanorm 10 Tablet safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, DApanorm 10 Tablet is safe when used as directed by the doctor. However, it may show some side effects. For best results, it should be used in the correct dose and at the same time each day.

faq.question: Does DApanorm 10 Tablet cause weight loss?
faq.answer: Yes, DApanorm 10 Tablet may cause weight loss in some patients. However, it is an uncommon side effect. If you experience sudden weight gain or have any concerns regarding your weight, discuss it with your doctor.

faq.question: What are the side effects of DApanorm 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of DApanorm 10 Tablet may cause symptoms such as stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, vaginal yeast infections, and yeast infections of the penis. In addition to that, one may experience frequent urination throughout the day or at night, and changes in the quantity of urine.

faq.question: Can I stop taking DApanorm 10 Tablet when I feel better?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking DApanorm 10 Tablet without talking to your doctor first. Sudden discontinuation of medicine may make your diabetes worse. Inform your doctor if your symptoms bother you or if there is no considerable improvement in your condition. The doctor may suggest some other medicine that could be more effective in treating your diabetes.

faq.question: Who should not take DApanorm 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Patients allergic to DApanorm 10 Tablet should avoid using this medicine. Also, it is highly recommended that patients who are on dialysis or have severe kidney problems should not use DApanorm 10 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I take DApanorm 10 Tablet before surgery?
faq.answer: Inform your doctor that you are taking DApanorm 10 Tablet before going for the surgery. The doctor may ask you to stop taking your DApanorm 10 Tablet tablets before your operation. This is done because there is a risk of developing diabetic ketoacidosis (a serious condition that may develop if high blood sugar is not treated).

faq.question: Why did my doctor prescribe DApanorm 10 Tablet along with metformin?
faq.answer: For some people, taking metformin alone can effectively lower blood sugar levels. But, evidence suggests that adding DApanorm 10 Tablet to metformin therapy may provide better control over the increased blood sugar levels in some people. So, maybe your doctor prescribed the combined use of metformin with DApanorm 10 Tablet to provide the extra help you need.

Its symptoms include tiredness, weakness, muscle pain, sleepiness, abdominal pain, and breathing problems. Seek immediate medical advice in case you notice any such symptoms.

faq.question: Can Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet can lower your blood sugar level and make you feel dizzy if taken with other antidiabetic medicines. If this happens to you, sit or lie down until the symptoms pass. Always carry some sugary food or fruit juice with you in case you experience dizziness while traveling. Also, monitor your blood sugar level at regular intervals.

faq.question: Can this medicine be used to treat type 1 diabetes?
faq.answer: This medication does not treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis (increased ketones in the blood or urine).

faq.question: Can Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet cause pancreatitis?
faq.answer: There have been reports of acute pancreatitis due to Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet. Patients are prompted to discontinue this medicine and contact their doctor if there is persistent severe abdominal pain, sometimes radiating to the back.

faq.question: What should you not eat while taking Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet?
faq.answer: It is advisable to avoid foods that are high in saturated and trans fats, instead consume fats from fish and nuts. Control your carbohydrate intake as this directly affects your blood sugar levels.

faq.question: Is Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet tablet safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet tablet is safe when used as directed by the doctor; however, it may show some side effects. For best results, this medicine should be used in the correct dose and at the same time each day.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Daparyl-VM 500 Tablet tablet?

faq.question: Can people with diabetes have proteins?
faq.answer: Yes, people with diabetes must include protein along with other essential nutrients in their daily diet. Proteins are one of the major energy providers among all essential nutrients. Besides, being the building blocks of the human body, proteins break down into glucose to release energy. Unlike carbohydrates, the metabolism of proteins into glucose is much slower. Therefore, the release of energy usually takes a few hours after consumption. Thus, the spike in blood sugar levels might occur after a few hours when you are on a high-protein diet. It is often recommended to consume about 2-3 teaspoons of proteins in the evening snacks to avert the chances of hypoglycemia.

faq.question: Are artificial sweeteners good for people with diabetes?
faq.answer: No, artificial sweeteners are not good for people with diabetes. They are composed of chemicals that can cause mild to severe side effects. Thus, it is better to limit or avoid their use as much as you can.

faq.question: Can diabetes cause kidney failure?
faq.answer: Yes, uncontrolled diabetes can cause kidney failure. In the long run, diabetes can affect the kidneys leading to a condition called diabetic nephropathy, as this condition is a major cause of kidney failure in patients with diabetes. The best way to prevent damage to the kidneys is by keeping diabetes in check, making dietary changes, monitoring sugar levels regularly, getting routine blood tests done, and taking prescribed medications on time.

faq.question: Can diabetes be cured?
faq.answer: Diabetes is a condition that causes changes in your blood glucose levels, which if left uncontrolled, can lead to serious health complications affecting the heart, brain, kidneys, and eyes. Although it cannot be cured permanently, with simple lifestyle changes, diet, and medications, one can manage their condition and lead a healthy life.

description:
Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet is a combination medicine that helps control blood sugar levels.
This medicine is used together with diet and exercise to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
It helps in the proper utilization of insulin, thereby lowering the blood sugar level.
Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet can be taken with or without food at any time of day, but try to take it at the same time every day.
The dose will be decided by your doctor, and don’t stop taking it without consulting them.
If you do, your blood sugar levels may increase and put you at risk of serious complications like kidney damage and blindness.
This medicine is only a part of the treatment program that should include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.The most common side effects of Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet include urinary tract infection, nasal congestion, sore throat, and upper respiratory tract infection.
Drinking plenty of fluids while using it will help prevent dehydration.
Some people may develop fungal infections in the genital area.
Maintaining good hygiene can help prevent this.Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver problems, a urinary tract infection, or if you are on water pills (diuretics).
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Avoid excessive alcohol intake while taking this drug, as this may increase the risk of some side effects.
Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly while taking this medicine.

faq.question: What is Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet is used for adults with type 2 diabetes when sugar control is not good enough with a single medicine alone. It helps lower high blood sugar, along with diet and exercise.

faq.question: Is Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet for type 1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No. Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet should not be used in type 1 diabetes (the body makes no insulin), and it is not for treating diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA).

faq.question: What serious warnings should I know upfront during Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet treatment?
faq.answer: You should reach out to a doctor immediately if you get signs of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA), like fast, deep breathing, stomach pain, vomiting, extreme thirst, unusual sleepiness, confusion, rapid weight loss, or a sweet smell on breath, urine, or sweat. This can happen even if blood sugar is not very high.

faq.question: Can Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet increase the risk of infections?
faq.answer: Yes. Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet can raise the chance of urinary tract infection (UTI) and genital yeast infection (thrush). Get help for fever, chills, burning when passing urine, back/side pain, or genital itching, discharge, or odor.

faq.question: What is Fournier’s gangrene, and why is it related to Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet use?
faq.answer: Fournier’s gangrene can occur during Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet use. It is a rare but serious infection of the area between the genitals and the anus. Get urgent care for pain, redness, swelling in that area with fever, or feeling unwell, because it needs immediate treatment.

faq.question: Can Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet cause pancreatitis (inflamed pancreas)?
faq.answer: Yes. Pancreatitis has been reported with Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet. Seek help for severe, persistent stomach pain that may extend to the back, with nausea, or vomiting.

faq.question: Can Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)?
faq.answer: Dapefy-S 10/100 Tablet can cause low blood sugar when taken with other sugar‑lowering medicines like sulfonylureas or insulin. Symptoms of low blood sugar include shaking, sweating, hunger, fast heartbeat, headache, vision changes, mood change, or confusion. Your doctor may lower the dose of the other medicines to reduce this risk.

Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet belongs to a category of medicines known as anti-diabetic drugs.
It is a combination of two medicines used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus in adults.
It helps control blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.
Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet should be taken with food.
Take it regularly at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
Your doctor will decide what dose is best for you and this may change from time to time according to how it is working according to your blood sugar levels.Keep taking this medicine, even if you feel well or your blood sugar levels are controlled.
If you stop it without consulting your doctor, your blood sugar levels could rise and put you at risk of kidney damage, blindness, nerve problems and loss of limbs.
Remember that it is only part of a treatment program that should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.
Your lifestyle plays a big part in controlling diabetes.The most common side effect of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet are low blood glucose levels (hypoglycemia), constipation, and vomiting.
Make sure you recognize the signs of having low blood glucose levels, such as sweating, dizziness, headache, and shaking and know how to deal with it.
To prevent this, it's important to have regular meals and always carry a fast-acting source of glucose such as sugary food or fruit juice with you.
Drinking alcohol can also increase your risk of low blood sugar levels and should be avoided.
Other side effects that may be seen on taking this medicine include taste changes, nausea, diarrhea, stomach pain, headache, and upper respiratory tract infection.
Some people may find that they put on weight with this medicine.You should not take it if you have type 1 diabetes mellitus, if you have diabetic ketoacidosis (high levels of acid in your blood), or if you have severe kidney or liver disease.
Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had heart disease.
It may not be suitable.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Your blood sugar levels should be checked regularly and your doctor may also advise blood tests to monitor your blood cell counts and liver function.

faq.question: What is Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet?
faq.answer: Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet is a combination of two medicines: Gliclazide and Metformin. This medicine is used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM). It improves blood glucose levels in adults when taken along with proper diet and regular exercise. Gliclazide lowers the blood glucose levels by increasing the release of insulin from the pancreas. Metformin works by lowering the glucose production in the liver and improving insulin sensitivity. This combination is not indicated for the treatment of Type 1 DM.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet is associated with common side effects. These side effects may include hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level), altered taste, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhea, headache and upper respiratory tract infection. Its use can also lead to serious but rare side effects like lactic acidosis. On long-term use, it can also lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Can the use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet cause hypoglycemia?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet can cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level). Symptoms of hypoglycemia include nausea, headache, irritability, hunger, sweating, dizziness, fast heart rate and feeling anxious or shaky. It happens more often if you miss or delay your food, drink alcohol, over-exercise or take other antidiabetic medicine along with it. So, regular monitoring of blood sugar level is important. Always keep glucose tablets, honey or fruit juice with you.

faq.question: Can the use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet cause lactic acidosis?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet can lead to lactic acidosis. It is a medical emergency which is caused by increased levels of lactic acid in the blood. It is also known as MALA (Metformin associated lactic acidosis). It is a rare side effect associated with the use of metformin. It is avoided in patients with underlying kidney disease, old age patients or who take large amounts of alcohol. Symptoms of lactic acidosis may include muscle pain or weakness, dizziness, tiredness, feeling of cold in arms and legs, difficulty in breathing, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain or slow heart rate. If you have these symptoms, stop taking Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet and immediately consult your doctor.

faq.question: Can the use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet lead to Vitamin B12 deficiency?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet can cause vitamin B12 deficiency on long-term use. The deficiency occurs as the medicine interferes with absorption of vitamin B12 in the stomach. If untreated, it may cause anemia and nerve problems and the patient can have tingling sensation and numbness in hands and feet, weakness, urinary problems, change in mental status and difficulty in maintaining balance (ataxia). To avoid such problems, some researchers suggest an intake of vitamin B12 from outside sources at least once every year.

faq.question: Are there any specific conditions in which Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet should not to be taken?
faq.answer: The use of Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet should be avoided in patients with known allergy to any of the component or excipients of this medicine. It is also avoided in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease or with underlying metabolic acidosis including diabetic ketoacidosis.

faq.question: Is it safe to take alcohol while I am also taking Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is not safe to take alcohol along with Dayclazide-XR Mex 60 Tablet. It may lower your low blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia) and can increase the chances of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: What makes Debistal 1000 SR Tablet different from other diabetes medicines?

Debistal 1mg Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called sulfonylureas and is used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus in adults.

It should be taken just before or with the first meal of the day.
Take it regularly at the same time each day to get the maximum benefit.
Your doctor will decide what dose is best for you and this may change from time to time according to your blood sugar levels.Keep taking Debistal 1mg Tablet, even if you feel well or your blood sugar levels are controlled.
If you stop it without consulting your doctor, your blood sugar levels could rise to put you at risk of diabetes complications such as kidney damage, blindness, nerve problems, and loss of limbs.
Remember that it is only part of a treatment program that should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.
Your lifestyle plays a big part in controlling diabetes.The most common side effects of taking Debistal 1mg Tablet include low blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia).
It is important to have regular meals and always carry a fast-acting source of glucose such as sugary food or fruit juice with you.
Drinking alcohol can also increase your risk of low blood sugar levels and hence should be avoided.

Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

faq.question: Does Debistal 1mg Tablet make you sleepy?

faq.question: Is Debistal 1mg Tablet safe for kidneys?
faq.answer: Debistal 1mg Tablet does not affect kidneys in patients with normal kidney function. However, its use should be avoided in patients with severe kidney disease since Debistal 1mg Tablet is principally eliminated by the kidneys.

faq.question: Does Debistal 1mg Tablet cause memory loss?
faq.answer: No, it is not known that Debistal 1mg Tablet causes memory loss. However, the use of Debistal 1mg Tablet may cause low blood sugar which may cause problems with concentration and reduced alertness.

faq.question: Who should not take Debistal 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: Debistal 1mg Tablet should be avoided by patients who are allergic to it, have severe kidney or liver disease, have G6PD-deficiency (an inherited condition affecting red blood cells) or are due to have surgery. faq.question: How long does it take for Debistal 1mg Tablet to start working?
faq.answer: Debistal 1mg Tablet takes about 2 to 3 hours to reduce blood sugar levels. You may not feel any difference, but this does not mean the medicine is not working. Continue taking the medication as directed by your doctor and if you have any concerns, discuss it with your doctor.

faq.question: How long do I need to take Debistal 1mg Tablet? Can I stop the medication?
faq.answer: Usually, the treatment for diabetes is suggested for a long term. You may have to continue the treatment life long. If you stop taking Debistal 1mg Tablet suddenly your diabetes may get worse.

faq.question: What can happen if I take more than the recommended dose of Debistal 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: Debistal 1mg Tablet should be taken strictly as advised by the doctor. Overdose of Debistal 1mg Tablet may significantly decrease your blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia). If you think you have taken an excess dose and experience a dip in your sugar level, consume enough sugar (e.g., a small bar of sugar cubes, sweet juice or sweetened tea) and inform a doctor immediately. Severe cases of hypoglycemia accompanied by loss of consciousness and coma require immediate medical treatment and admission into hospital.

faq.question: Can you take Debistal 1mg Tablet on an empty stomach?
faq.answer: No. Taking Debistal 1mg Tablet on an empty stomach can cause your blood sugar levels to become too low. Low blood sugar can cause dizziness, shaking, anxiety, irritability, a fast heartbeat, and confusion. Therefore, you should always take the medicine with breakfast or the first meal of the day. If you are skipping your meal, then you should also avoid taking Debistal 1mg Tablet.

faq.question: Can Debistal 1mg Tablet cause dizziness?

faq.question: What should you not eat while taking Debistal 1mg Tablet?
faq.answer: It is advisable to avoid foods that are high in saturated and trans fats, instead consume fats from fish and nuts. Control your carbohydrate intake as this directly affects your blood sugar.

faq.question: Is Debistal 1mg Tablet safe to use?

faq.question: Can people with diabetes have proteins?
faq.answer: Yes, people with diabetes must include proteins along with other essential nutrients in their daily diet. Proteins are one of the major energy providers among all essential nutrients. Besides, being the building blocks of the human body, proteins break down into glucose to release energy. Unlike carbohydrates, the metabolism of proteins into glucose is much slower. Therefore, the release of energy usually takes a few hours after consumption. Thus, the spike in blood sugar levels might occur after a few hours when you are on a high-protein diet.

faq.question: Are artificial sweeteners good for people with diabetes?
faq.answer: No, artificial sweeteners are not good for people with diabetes. They are composed of chemicals that can cause mild to severe side effects. Thus, it is better to limit or avoid their use as much as you can.

faq.question: Can diabetes cause kidney failure?
faq.answer: Yes, uncontrolled diabetes can cause kidney failure. In the long run, diabetes can affect the kidneys leading to a condition called diabetic nephropathy. Diabetic nephropathy is a condition that is a major cause of kidney failure in patients with diabetes. The best way to prevent damage to kidneys is by keeping diabetes in check, making dietary changes, monitoring sugar levels regularly, getting routine blood tests done, and taking prescribed medications on time.

faq.question: Can diabetes be cured?
faq.answer: Diabetes is a condition that causes changes in your blood glucose levels, which if left uncontrolled, can lead to serious health complications affecting the heart, brain, kidneys, and eyes. However, with simple lifestyle changes, diet, and medications, one can manage their condition and lead a healthy life.

faq.question: What is Debistal M2 Forte Tablet?
faq.answer: Debistal M2 Forte Tablet is a combination of two medicines: glimepiride and metformin. This medicine is used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM). It improves blood glucose levels in adults when taken along with a proper diet and regular exercise. Glimepiride lowers the blood glucose levels by increasing the release of insulin from the pancreas. Metformin works by lowering glucose production in the liver and improving insulin sensitivity. This combination is not indicated for the treatment of type 1 DM.

faq.question: Can the use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet lead to lactic acidosis?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet can lead to lactic acidosis. It is a medical emergency that is caused by increased levels of lactic acid in the blood. It is also known as MALA (metformin-associated lactic acidosis). It is a rare side effect associated with the use of metformin, and therefore, it is considered to be harmful for patients with underlying kidney disease, older patients, or those who take large amounts of alcohol. Symptoms of lactic acidosis may include muscle pain or weakness, dizziness, tiredness, a feeling of cold in arms and legs, difficulty in breathing, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, or a slow heart rate. If you have these symptoms, stop taking Debistal M2 Forte Tablet and consult your doctor immediately.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet is associated with common side effects like hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level), altered taste, nausea, stomach pain, diarrhea, and headache. Its use can also lead to serious but rare side effects like lactic acidosis. On long-term use, it can also lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Can the use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet lead to Vitamin B12 deficiency?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet can cause Vitamin B12 deficiency on long-term use. It interferes with the absorption of Vitamin B12 in the stomach. If untreated, it may cause anemia and nerve problems and the patient can experience tingling sensation and numbness in hands and feet, weakness, urinary problems, change in mental status and difficulty in maintaining balance (ataxia). To avoid such problems, some researchers suggest an intake of Vitamin B12 from outside sources at least once every year.

faq.question: Can the use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet cause hypoglycemia?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Debistal M2 Forte Tablet can cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar level). Symptoms of hypoglycemia include nausea, headache, irritability, hunger, sweating, dizziness, fast heart rate, and feeling anxious or shaky. It happens more often if you miss or delay your food, drink alcohol, over-exercise, or take other antidiabetic medicines along with it. So, regular monitoring of the blood sugar level is important. Always keep a quick source of sugar, like glucose tablets, honey, or fruit juice, with you.

faq.question: Is it safe to take alcohol while I am also taking Debistal M2 Forte Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is not safe to take Debistal M2 Forte Tablet along with alcohol, as it may lower your blood sugar levels and lead to hypoglycemia. It can also increase the chances of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: What are the recommended storage conditions for Debistal M2 Forte Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, or other people.

faq.question: Is Decakem Injection a steroid?

faq.question: What is Decakem Injection used for?
faq.answer: Decakem Injection has anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressant properties. faq.question: How is Decakem Injection administered?

The dose will be decided by your doctor based on the condition you are being treated for as well as your body weight. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully to get maximum benefit from Decakem Injection.

faq.question: How does Decakem Injection work?

faq.question: Is Decakem Injection better than Prednisone?
