description:
Dilup Tablet is used to treat resistant hypertension, chronic cardiac failure, and hepatic cirrhosis.
It is commonly used when fluid buildup (edema) or high blood pressure cannot be controlled by a single medicine.
It helps remove excess salt and water from the body, reducing swelling and fluid overload.
Take Dilup Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor, preferably with breakfast and/or lunch along with a full glass of water.
Avoid taking it in the evening to prevent nighttime urination.
For the best results, take the medicine at the same time every day and do not stop on your own, even if you start feeling better.Continue to follow your doctor’s advice about dietary salt and fluid intake.
In conditions like hypertension or heart failure, your doctor may recommend limiting salt, avoiding alcohol, and maintaining a healthy weight.
Regular follow-up visits are important, as your doctor may monitor blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels (especially potassium and sodium).The most common side effects of Dilup Tablet include electrolyte disturbances, hyponatremia (low sodium level in blood), dehydration, and hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).
Because this medicine increases urine output, you may feel thirsty or need to urinate more often.
To reduce side effects, drink adequate water, avoid excessive sweating or dehydration, and do not use salt substitutes containing potassium unless your doctor advises it.Do not take Dilup Tablet if you have kidney failure, severe liver disease (hepatic encephalopathy), high potassium levels, or low sodium levels, or if you are dehydrated.
It is also contraindicated in pregnancy and breastfeeding due to potential harm to the baby.
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that may lower blood pressure or increase potassium levels, such as ACE inhibitors, potassium supplements, or certain painkillers (NSAIDs).
Be cautious while driving or operating machinery, as dizziness or drowsiness may occur, especially at the start of treatment.

faq.question: What are the recommended storage conditions for Dilup Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: What are the contraindications associated with the use of Dilup Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Dilup Tablet should be avoided in patients with hypersensitivity to furosemide, sulfonylureas or spironolactone or any other ingredient of the product. The use of this medicine should also be avoided in patients with anuria, acute renal insufficiency, hepatic coma and pre-coma, low blood pressure (hypotension), cardiac arrhythmias, patients taking aminoglycosides or cephalosporins, kidney dysfunction due to drugs which cause renal damage, patients with high potassium levels (hyperkalemia), Addison's disease and in children with moderate to severe renal impairment.

faq.question: What is Dilup Tablet?
faq.answer: Dilup Tablet is a fixed-dose combination of furosemide (a loop diuretic) and spironolactone (an antagonist of aldosterone). Both are diuretics and they help to remove excess fluid from the body. The use of this combination is advised in patients with resistant hypertension, congestive heart failure (heart failure leading to fluid accumulation in the lung and rest of the body), and liver cirrhosis with fluid retention (edema).

faq.question: Is it safe to use Dilup Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, Dilup Tablet is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients it may cause common side effects like dizziness, dehydration, decreased sodium level in blood, breast enlargement in males, decreased magnesium level in blood, decreased calcium level in blood, increased blood uric acid. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Dilup Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dilup Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better. Do not drive or use any machines.

faq.question: Can the use of Dilup Tablet cause gout?
faq.answer: Yes, Dilup Tablet can cause gout. Dilup Tablet contains furosemide which can increase the blood uric acid levels by increasing its absorption from the kidneys. Increased uric acid levels can cause a gout attack. Inform your doctor if you have hyperuricemia (excess of uric acid in blood) or a history of gout before taking this medicine. Use of Dilup Tablet should be avoided in patients with gout.

It is widely used to treat high blood pressure and heart failure and may be prescribed after a heart attack.
It also lowers the chances of having a heart attack or stroke.
Dilvas 10 Tablet can be prescribed either alone or in combination with other medicines.
It should be taken on an empty stomach.
This medicine should be taken at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
It is important to continue taking it regularly even if you feel well or even if your blood pressure is controlled.
Most people with high blood pressure do not feel ill, but if you stop taking this medicine, your condition could get worse.
This is a widely used medicine and is considered safe for long-term use.Making some changes in your lifestyle will also help lower your blood pressure.
These may include regular exercise, losing weight, smoking cessation, reducing alcohol intake, and reducing the amount of salt in your diet, as advised by your doctor.
The most common side effects of this medicine include decreased blood pressure, fatigue, and dizziness.
Most of these are temporary and resolve with time.
Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects bother you or do not go away.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor know if you have any kidney or liver problems.
Pregnant or breastfeeding mothers should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and potassium levels in your blood at regular intervals while you are taking this medicine.

faq.question: What is Dilvas 5 Tablet? What is it used for?
faq.answer: Dilvas 5 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. It relaxes and widens the blood vessels, making it easier for the blood to pass through the vessels. As a result of this, the heart does not have to work more to push the blood. Since the workload on the heart is reduced, it helps to lower the blood pressure and thus reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke. It is also used for the treatment and prevention of congestive heart failure.

faq.question: Does Dilvas 5 Tablet cause excessive urination? Can it cause kidney damage?
faq.answer: No, Dilvas 5 Tablet does not cause excessive urination (loss of water through urine). The use of Dilvas 5 Tablet may not affect normally functioning kidneys. However, damage to the kidneys may occur when Dilvas 5 Tablet is given with a diuretic (water pill, a medicine that increases the urine output). In such a case, either the diuretic should be discontinued or its dose should be reduced. If you have severe heart failure or your kidneys are already affected then there is a risk of kidney failure. However, timely and appropriate treatment can reverse the damage caused to kidneys.

faq.question: Can use of Dilvas 5 Tablet affect my liver?
faq.answer: In rare cases, Dilvas 5 Tablet may cause yellowing of skin and eyes, loss of appetite and an increase in liver enzymes. It can also cause considerable damage to the liver and even death. Therefore, if you experience any such symptoms, call your doctor immediately.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Dilvas 5 Tablet along with hydrochlorthiazide?

faq.answer: If you have been taking Pantodac IV Injection for a long time, stopping it abruptly may lead to increased acid production, thereby worsening your symptoms. Therefore, you must discuss with your doctor about any dose changes or if you wish to come off Pantodac IV Injection.

faq.question: Does Pantodac IV Injection cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Although rare but long-term treatment with Pantodac IV Injection may cause weight gain. The reason could be the relief from reflux symptoms which could make you eat more. Consult your doctor for any weight-related concern.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with Pantodac IV Injection?
faq.answer: No, alcohol intake is not advised with Pantodac IV Injection. Alcohol itself does not affect the working of Pantodac IV Injection, but it can increase the acid production. This may further cause worsening of your symptoms.

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with Pantodac IV Injection?
faq.answer: Yes, you can take antacids along with Pantodac IV Injection. Take it 2 hours before or after you take Pantodac IV Injection.

faq.question: What dietary changes should I make to get relief from acidity?
faq.answer: Pantodac IV Injection is best taken 1 hour before a meal. You should avoid spicy and fatty foods while taking this medicine. You must refrain from caffeinated drinks such as tea, coffee and cola. Alcohol intake should also be avoided as it may worsen your symptoms.

faq.question: Are painkillers safe to take along with Pantodac IV Injection?
faq.answer: Yes, it is safe to take painkillers along with Pantodac IV Injection. Pantodac IV Injection prevents acidity and stomach ulcers associated with the intake of painkillers. Pantodac IV Injection is taken 1 hour before a meal. On the other hand, painkillers are usually taken with, or after a meal to avoid stomach upset.

faq.question: Will I get cured after taking Acivir IV Injection for shingles?
faq.answer: Acivir IV Injection is an antiviral medicine effective against herpes simplex and varicella zoster viruses. It does not cure infections caused by these viruses but helps to minimize the symptoms and shorten the duration of infection. It does not remove the viruses from the body but prevents the viruses from dividing and spreading.

faq.question: How is Acivir IV Injection administered?
faq.answer: Acivir IV Injection should be administered under the supervision of a trained healthcare professional or a doctor only and should not be self-administered. It is given by slow intravenous (I.V) infusion over a one hour period to avoid damage to kidneys. The dose will depend on the condition you are being treated for and will be decided by your doctor. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully to get maximum benefit from Acivir IV Injection.

faq.question: Does Acivir IV Injection prevent transmission of infection to others?
faq.answer: No, you can infect other people, even while you are being treated with Acivir IV Injection. Herpes infections are contagious, so avoid letting infected areas come into contact with other people. Avoid touching your eyes after touching an infected area. Wash your hands frequently to prevent transmitting the infection to others. You should practice safe sex by using condoms. You should not have sex if you have genital sores or blisters.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Acivir IV Injection?
faq.answer: Serious side effects are rare, but if you experience them, you should seek medical advice right away. These rare side effects include hives, blistering or peeling rash, yellow skin or eyes, unusual bruising or bleeding, loss of consciousness, fits, difficulty in breathing, hallucinations and swelling of the face, tongue, lips or throat.

faq.question: Do elderly patients need to be more careful while taking Acivir IV Injection?
faq.answer: Older adults (over age 65 years) tend to experience more side effects when taking Acivir IV Injection. The reason being, their kidneys do not flush the drug out of their system as quickly as a younger person’s kidneys would do. Elderly patients should drink plenty of water while taking Acivir IV Injection, and their kidney function should be monitored. These patients should be given a lower dose and should be monitored for neurological problems.

faq.question: What can happen if somebody takes more than the recommended dose of Acivir IV Injection accidentally?
faq.answer: Accidental, repeated overdoses of oral Acivir IV Injection over several days have resulted in nausea, vomiting, confusion and headache. Consult your doctor in case of overdose.

faq.question: Can I get resistant to Acivir IV Injection treatment?
faq.answer: Patients with advanced HIV disease or patients with an impaired immunity have reported resistance to Acivir IV Injection. If you are not responding to Acivir IV Injection, the possibility of drug resistance should be checked.

faq.question: Is hair loss caused due to Acivir IV Injection permanent?
faq.answer: Hair loss is an uncommon side effect of Acivir IV Injection. It stops when the medicine is discontinued.

description:
Diosartan Tablet is used to treat high blood pressure and heart failure.
Lowering blood pressure helps to prevent future heart attacks and stroke.
This medicine is also effective in preserving kidney function in patients with diabetes.
Diosartan Tablet can be prescribed either alone or in combination with other medicines.
It may be taken with or without food during the day or at night.
However, try to take it at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
It is important to continue taking it regularly even if you feel well or if your blood pressure is controlled.
Most people with high blood pressure do not feel ill, but if you stop taking this medicine, your condition could get worse.
This is a widely used medicine and is considered safe for long-term use.Making some changes in your lifestyle will also help lower your blood pressure.
These may include regular exercise, losing weight, smoking cessation, reducing alcohol intake, and reducing the amount of salt in your diet as advised by your doctor.
This medicine is tolerated well by most patients and has few side effects.
Dizziness, particularly after the first dose, is known to occur in some people.
This may be associated with low blood pressure, orthostatic hypotension, and rash.
Let your doctor know if these side effects bother you or do not go away.
No weight gain has been seen with the regular use of this medicine.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor know if you have any kidney or liver problems.
Pregnant or breastfeeding mothers should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure and potassium levels in your blood at regular intervals while you are taking this medicine.

faq.question: How long does it take for Diosartan Tablet to start working?
faq.answer: A substantial decrease in blood pressure can be experienced within 2 weeks of starting Diosartan Tablet. The medicine may take up to 4 weeks to show its complete effects.

faq.question: Which medicine is considered safe for treating high blood pressure?
faq.answer: There are many blood pressure-lowering medicines which can be considered safe. Use of these medicines varies from person to person and can be based on various factors such as age, gender, other co-existing diseases, etc. For instance, a person below 55 years of age having no other coexisting disease may be prescribed angiotensin II receptor antagonists (ARAs) (e.g., Diosartan Tablet, losartan, olmesartan) or Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors (e.g., ramipril, captopril, or enalapril) by the doctor.

faq.question: Is Diosartan Tablet bad for kidneys?
faq.answer: Diosartan Tablet does not generally affect the working of a proper functioning kidney. However, it should be cautiously used in patients who have existing severe kidney impairment (creatinine clearance <10 ml/min) and are on dialysis as there is limited data to support the safety of these patients.

faq.question: What class of medicine is Diosartan Tablet?
faq.answer: Diosartan Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called angiotensin II receptor antagonists (ARAs). Angiotensin II is a substance in the body that causes vessels to tighten which leads to increase in blood pressure. Diosartan Tablet works by blocking the effect of angiotensin II. As a result, blood vessels relax and blood pressure is lowered.

faq.question: Does Diosartan Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: No, Diosartan Tablet does not cause weight gain as a side effect. However, if your kidney function deteriorates, then your body may swell due to accumulation of water (fluid retention) because of which you may gain weight. Inform your doctor if you experience any unexplained weight gain or swelling in your feet, ankles, or hands.

faq.question: How long do I need to take Diosartan Tablet?
faq.answer: Continue taking Diosartan Tablet as long as your doctor has prescribed. Do not stop taking it even if you start feeling better. You may even have to take it life long, since Diosartan Tablet does not cure high blood pressure or heart failure but controls them.

faq.question: What is the most important information I should know about Diosartan Tablet?
faq.answer: Taking Diosartan Tablet during the last months of pregnancy can cause serious harm or even death of the unborn baby. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. Do not take Diosartan Tablet if you are pregnant. If you become pregnant while taking Diosartan Tablet, stop taking Diosartan Tablet and call your doctor immediately.

faq.question: Can I switch in between the brands of Diosartan Tablet, since currently the brand I am using is not available?
faq.answer: No, do not switch to a different Diosartan Tablet product unless your doctor says that you should. Since you have to take it daily, keep a stock of it. Each Diosartan Tablet product releases the medication differently in your body and cannot be used interchangeably.

faq.question: What is the use of Diovan 160 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Diovan 160 Tablet is used to treat hypertension (high blood pressure). Additionally, it is used to treat heart failure and prevent heart attack.

faq.question: How does Diovan 160 Tablet work?
faq.answer: Diovan 160 Tablet contains ‘valsartan’, which works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood to all body parts. Thereby, Diovan 160 Tablet helps in lowering blood pressure to normal levels.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Diovan 160 Tablet on my own?
faq.answer: Please do not stop taking Diovan 160 Tablet without consulting your doctor on your own, as it may lead to a rise in blood pressure. Continue taking Diovan 160 Tablet for as long as your doctor has prescribed it to you. Do not be reluctant to speak with your doctor if you experience any difficulty while taking Diovan 160 Tablet .

faq.question: Does Diovan 160 Tablet cause orthostatic hypotension (sudden lowering in blood pressure leading to dizziness on standing)?
faq.answer: Orthostatic hypotension could be a side-effect of Diovan 160 Tablet . Orthostatic hypotension is a sudden lowering in blood pressure leading to dizziness on standing. If you experience this, do not try to stand up suddenly or start walking, instead, lie down and get up slowly only when you feel better. People taking Diovan 160 Tablet are advised to regularly monitor their blood pressure levels to avoid such unpleasant events.

faq.question: What happens when the blood pressure is high?
faq.answer: High blood pressure increases the workload on the arteries and heart. If untreated, it could damage the heart, brain, and kidneys' blood vessels, resulting in a stroke, heart failure or kidney failure. Hypertension increases the risk of heart attacks. Therefore, anti-hypertensives such as Diovan 160 Tablet are used to lower the blood pressure to normal, which reduces the risk of developing these disorders.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Diovan 160 Tablet with NSAID's (pain killers)?
faq.answer: Avoid taking NSAIDs with Diovan 160 Tablet unless prescribed by the doctor, as it could lead to an increased risk of kidney impairment and loss of anti-hypertensive effect.

faq.question: Can I take potassium supplements with Diovan 160 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Talk to your doctor before taking potassium supplements, potassium-sparing diuretics or salt substitutes along with Diovan 160 Tablet , as it might cause an increase in serum potassium and serum creatinine levels.

faq.question: Should Diovan 160 Tablet be taken in the morning or at night?
faq.answer: It would be preferable to take the first dose at night as it might cause dizziness. The next doses can be taken at time of the day.

faq.question: How long does it take for Diovan 160 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: Diovan 160 Tablet starts working within 2 hours to lower the blood pressure. However, it might take 2-4 weeks to notice the full benefits.

faq.question: If I have some kidney problem, can I take Diovan 160 Tablet ? Can it further deteriorate my kidney function?
faq.answer: Diovan 160 Tablet may worsen kidney problems in people who already have kidney disease/problems. Inform the doctor if you have kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems if prescribed by the doctor.

faq.question: I am overweight and the doctor has prescribed me Diovan 160 Tablet for blood pressure control. I am bothered that Diovan 160 Tablet can increase my weight. Is it true?
faq.answer: Diovan 160 Tablet is not known to cause weight gain. Maintain proper weight by eating healthy food and exercising regularly.

faq.question: Does Diovan 160 Tablet affect blood glucose levels in diabetics?
faq.answer: Diovan 160 Tablet may affect blood glucose levels. Therefore, inform the doctor if you have diabetes. Regular monitoring of blood sugar levels is advised.

faq.question: Can the use of Diovan 160 Tablet cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium level in blood)?
faq.answer: Yes, Diovan 160 Tablet may cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium level in blood). Consult the doctor if you notice symptoms of hyperkalemia such as tiredness, weakness, nausea, vomiting, chest pain, trouble breathing or irregular heartbeat.

faq.question: Does Diovan 160 Tablet work by causing excessive urination?
faq.answer: No, Diovan 160 Tablet does not work by causing excessive urination. It works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the blood flow.

faq.question: Can I take ibuprofen and Diovan 160 Tablet together?

faq.question: What is the use of Diovan Tablet?

faq.question: What is Diprobate S Plus Ointment used for?
faq.answer: Diprobate S Plus Ointment is used to treat eczema and psoriasis. It provides relief from redness, itching, and swelling. It removes the dead skin cells, and helps in softening the skin.

faq.question: Can I use Diprobate S Plus Ointment on broken or irritated skin?

faq.question: Who should avoid using Diprobate S Plus Ointment?

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Diprobate S Plus Ointment?
faq.answer: Although they are rare, serious side effects of Diprobate S Plus Ointment may include severe rash, blistering, swelling, redness, or difficulty breathing. Stop using Diprobate S Plus Ointment, and seek medical attention if you notice any of these symptoms.

faq.question: Can children use Diprobate S Plus Ointment?
faq.answer: Diprobate S Plus Ointment is generally not recommended for children under 12 years of age, and if prescribed, usage duration should be short to avoid side effects.

faq.question: What is MOMate S Ointment used for, and what skin problem does it treat?
faq.answer: MOMate S Ointment is for the initial treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (a scaly, itchy, red skin condition). It combines a potent steroid (mometasone) and a keratolytic (salicylic acid) to help manage this skin condition.

faq.question: Who should not use MOMate S Ointment?

faq.question: Are there age limits to use MOMate S Ointment, and can children use it?

faq.question: Could MOMate S Ointment cause serious side effects?

faq.question: Will MOMate S Ointment make a skin infection worse or hide an infection?
faq.answer: Yes, MOMate S Ointment can mask or worsen infections by suppressing local immune responses. If the skin becomes more infected or the rash changes in an unexpected way, you should stop the medicine and see a doctor, since an antibacterial or antifungal treatment may be needed.

faq.question: Can MOMate S Ointment be used on the face, groin, or near the eyes?
faq.answer: No, MOMate S Ointment is not recommended for use on the face, groin, genitals, or other skin folds (intertriginous areas), and should not be used near the eyes, as it is very risky. Take care to avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes.

faq.question: During MOMate S Ointment treatment, is there anything special to know if I am having phototherapy or sun treatment?
faq.answer: Yes. Salicylic acid present in MOMate S Ointment can act as a photoprotective/photoreactive agent. If you are about to receive UV therapy, remove and clean off the medicine before treatment to avoid uneven burning of nearby skin. You can reapply after the UV session.

faq.question: If the rash does not get better or gets worse, what then?
faq.answer: If there is no improvement, or the rash worsens (more redness, pain, pus, spreading, or signs of infection), stop MOMate S Ointment and see your doctor. They may need to treat a secondary infection or change therapy. This medicine is not recommended for pustular psoriasis or guttate psoriasis.

faq.question: What is Broncofree S Syrup used for?
faq.answer: Broncofree S Syrup is used to treat a productive cough. It helps loosen mucus, makes it easier to cough out, and relaxes the airways.

faq.question: Who should not take Broncofree S Syrup?
faq.answer: Broncofree S Syrup should not be taken by individuals who are allergic to any of its ingredients, have serious heart problems, an overactive thyroid, or a rare condition called acute porphyria. It is also not recommended for very young children under 2 years old.

faq.question: Can Broncofree S Syrup be harmful for people with heart disease?
faq.answer: Yes, Broncofree S Syrup contains salbutamol, which can increase heart rate and may worsen conditions like high blood pressure, irregular heartbeat, or other cardiovascular diseases. Patients with heart issues should use it only under strict medical supervision.

faq.question: What precautions should I take before using Broncofree S Syrup?
faq.answer: Before using Broncofree S Syrup, tell your doctor if you have thyroid problems, diabetes, liver or kidney disease, or if you have a persistent cough possibly related to smoking or emphysema. A persistent cough may be a sign of a serious underlying illness.

faq.question: Can Broncofree S Syrup cause serious side effects?
faq.answer: Although they are uncommon, serious side effects of Broncofree S Syrup include rapid heartbeat, severe tremors, chest pain, shortness of breath, extreme restlessness, or allergic reactions like swelling and rash. Seek immediate medical attention if these occur.

faq.question: Is Broncofree S Syrup safe for children?
faq.answer: Broncofree S Syrup should not be given to children under 2 years. For children above 2 years, the dosage must be strictly followed as advised by a doctor.

faq.question: Can I take Broncofree S Syrup if I have asthma?
faq.answer: Yes, doctors often prescribe Broncofree S Syrup for asthma-related mucus cough. However, it requires medical supervision because it may occasionally cause bronchospasm, which makes breathing harder.

faq.question: What should I do if my cough does not improve with Broncofree S Syrup?
faq.answer: If your cough does not improve or gets worse after using Broncofree S Syrup, consult your doctor. A persistent cough may indicate a serious lung condition that requires further evaluation.

description:
Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR is a combination medicine used to reduce excess fluid levels in your body.
It is used to treat edema (fluid overload).
It treats fluid overload associated with heart, liver, kidney, or lung disease.
Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR will make you lose excess water through urine while maintaining potassium balance in the body.
It is best to take this medicine in the morning along with food to avoid frequent urination at night time.
You should take it regularly at evenly spaced intervals as per the schedule prescribed by your doctor.
Taking it at the same time every day will help you remember to take it.
The dose and duration of treatment will depend on what you are being treated for.
Do not stop taking it until you have finished the complete course, even when you feel better.Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and stomach pain are some common side effects of this medicine.
Regular monitoring of kidney function and electrolytes is important while using this medicine.
It is advised to drink plenty of fluids to avoid dehydration while taking this medicine.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have kidney, heart problems, high blood pressure or high blood potassium level.
You should also let your healthcare team know all other medicines you are taking as they may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
Pregnant and breastfeeding mothers should consult their doctor before using it.

faq.question: What is Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR used for?
faq.answer: Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR is used to treat fluid retention (edema) and mild to moderate high blood pressure. They help the body get rid of extra water while replacing potassium that is lost due to the diuretic effect of furosemide.

faq.question: Who should not take Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR?
faq.answer: Individuals should not take Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR if they have high potassium levels, Addison’s disease, severe liver disease with coma risk, or are allergic to furosemide, potassium chloride, or any ingredient in the medicine. This medicine is also not recommended for children.

faq.question: Can Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR cause dangerous changes in electrolytes?
faq.answer: Yes, Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR can cause an imbalance of electrolytes, leading to problems like too much or too little potassium, sodium, or fluid loss. Regular blood tests are important to check your electrolyte levels.

faq.question: Can Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR cause stomach or bowel problems?
faq.answer: Rarely, but potassium chloride in Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR can cause ulcers in the esophagus or small intestine, especially with long-term use, or in patients with heart disease or gut problems.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR?
faq.answer: Serious side effects of Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR include severe stomach pain, blood in stools, unusual tiredness, muscle weakness, fainting, hearing changes, severe rash, or yellowing of the skin or eyes. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience any of these symptoms.

faq.question: Can Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR affect blood sugar or gout?
faq.answer: Yes, Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR may raise blood sugar in people with diabetes, and may increase uric acid levels, which can trigger gout attacks.

faq.question: Can Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR affect hearing?
faq.answer: Rarely, but Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR can cause ototoxicity, leading to hearing loss or ringing in the ears, especially when combined with certain antibiotics.

faq.question: Are elderly patients at higher risk with Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR?
faq.answer: Yes, older adults may be more sensitive to dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, kidney problems, or urinary obstruction, so extra monitoring is needed while on Diucontin-K 40 Tablet CR treatment.

description:
Diuton Tablet is used to treat resistant hypertension, chronic cardiac failure, and hepatic cirrhosis.
It is commonly used when fluid buildup (edema) or high blood pressure cannot be controlled by a single medicine.
It helps remove excess salt and water from the body, reducing swelling and fluid overload.
Take Diuton Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor, preferably with breakfast and/or lunch along with a full glass of water.
Avoid taking it in the evening to prevent nighttime urination.
For the best results, take the medicine at the same time every day and do not stop on your own, even if you start feeling better.Continue to follow your doctor’s advice about dietary salt and fluid intake.
In conditions like hypertension or heart failure, your doctor may recommend limiting salt, avoiding alcohol, and maintaining a healthy weight.
Regular follow-up visits are important, as your doctor may monitor blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels (especially potassium and sodium).The most common side effects of Diuton Tablet include electrolyte disturbances, hyponatremia (low sodium level in blood), dehydration, and hypovolemia (decreased blood volume).
Because this medicine increases urine output, you may feel thirsty or need to urinate more often.
To reduce side effects, drink adequate water, avoid excessive sweating or dehydration, and do not use salt substitutes containing potassium unless your doctor advises it.Do not take Diuton Tablet if you have kidney failure, severe liver disease (hepatic encephalopathy), high potassium levels, or low sodium levels, or if you are dehydrated.
It is also contraindicated in pregnancy and breastfeeding due to potential harm to the baby.
Avoid alcohol and other medicines that may lower blood pressure or increase potassium levels, such as ACE inhibitors, potassium supplements, or certain painkillers (NSAIDs).
Be cautious while driving or operating machinery, as dizziness or drowsiness may occur, especially at the start of treatment.

faq.question: What are the recommended storage conditions for Diuton Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: What are the contraindications associated with the use of Diuton Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Diuton Tablet should be avoided in patients with hypersensitivity to furosemide, sulfonylureas or spironolactone or any other ingredient of the product. The use of this medicine should also be avoided in patients with anuria, acute renal insufficiency, hepatic coma and pre-coma, low blood pressure (hypotension), cardiac arrhythmias, patients taking aminoglycosides or cephalosporins, kidney dysfunction due to drugs which cause renal damage, patients with high potassium levels (hyperkalemia), Addison's disease and in children with moderate to severe renal impairment.

faq.question: What is Diuton Tablet?
faq.answer: Diuton Tablet is a fixed-dose combination of furosemide (a loop diuretic) and spironolactone (an antagonist of aldosterone). Both are diuretics and they help to remove excess fluid from the body. The use of this combination is advised in patients with resistant hypertension, congestive heart failure (heart failure leading to fluid accumulation in the lung and rest of the body), and liver cirrhosis with fluid retention (edema).

faq.question: Is it safe to use Diuton Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, Diuton Tablet is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients it may cause common side effects like dizziness, dehydration, decreased sodium level in blood, breast enlargement in males, decreased magnesium level in blood, decreased calcium level in blood, increased blood uric acid. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Diuton Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Diuton Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better. Do not drive or use any machines.

faq.question: Can the use of Diuton Tablet cause gout?
faq.answer: Yes, Diuton Tablet can cause gout. Diuton Tablet contains furosemide which can increase the blood uric acid levels by increasing its absorption from the kidneys. Increased uric acid levels can cause a gout attack. Inform your doctor if you have hyperuricemia (excess of uric acid in blood) or a history of gout before taking this medicine. Use of Diuton Tablet should be avoided in patients with gout.

description:
Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER is a medication used to treat epilepsy, seizures, bipolar disorder, mania, trigeminal neuralgia, and migraines.
It works by stabilizing brain activity.
Always use it under medical supervision for safe and effective treatment.
Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER may be used alone or in combination with other medicines.
Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and frequency to effectively control your symptoms.
You can take this medicine with or without food, but for the best results, take it at the same time each day.
It usually takes a couple of weeks to work.
It is important to take this medicine regularly and for as long as you are advised, even if you feel well.
Missing doses may trigger seizures, and if you stop, your condition may get worse.
It should never be stopped suddenly.The most common side effects of Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER include headache, constipation, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, weight gain, rash, back pain, and abdominal pain.
Most of these are not serious.
Continue taking the medicine, but

faq.question: What happens if I stop taking Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: You should not stop taking Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER without consulting your doctor. The dose of Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER should be reduced gradually and eventually can be stopped under the supervision of a doctor or specialist. Suddenly stopping the medication may trigger seizures or lead to the recurrence of symptoms.

faq.question: Is Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER a mood stabilizer?
faq.answer: Yes, Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER can sometimes be used as a mood stabilizer. It is given in patients who experience rapid changes in their mood. It works by calming the hyperactivity of the brain during mood changes.

faq.question: Can Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Yes, Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER may cause weight gain. The gain in weight could be due to an increase in hunger. Keep a check on your diet and exercise regularly to prevent any weight gain. If you are have concerns related to weight gain, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Does Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER make you sleepy?
faq.answer: Yes, Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER may make you feel sleepy. Avoid driving or other work that requires mental focus until you know how it affects you.

faq.question: Does Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER cause hair loss?
faq.answer: Yes, Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER may cause hair loss. However, it is only for a short time and is usually dose-related. Consult your doctor if the hair loss bothers you or persists for a longer duration.

faq.question: Can Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER damage my liver?
faq.answer: Yes, Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER can cause damage to the liver. The risk is more likely to occur during the first 6 months of starting the treatment with Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER. Symptoms of liver damage may include nausea or vomiting, loss of appetite, stomach pain, dark-colored urine, facial swelling, yellowing of the skin, or white eyes. Therefore, it is important to have liver function tests done before starting the medicine. Tests should be done periodically during the first 6 months of therapy, especially in those who are likely to be at risk and those with a prior history of liver disease.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol while I am taking Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: Avoid alcohol consumption while you are on treatment with Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER. Taking alcohol with this medicine may make you feel more drowsy, light headed or dizzy.

faq.question: What are the laboratory tests recommended before taking Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: The doctor may suggest blood tests before starting the treatment with Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER. The tests may include blood cell count, including platelet count, bleeding time, and coagulation tests. These tests are also advised to avoid any spontaneous bruising or bleeding. In addition to this, liver function tests are advised before therapy. It is recommended to periodically monitor liver function during the first 6 months of therapy, primarily in those who seem most at risk and those with a prior history of liver disease.

faq.question: What should be done if I start experiencing abdominal pain, nausea and anorexia?
faq.answer: If you experience acute, severe abdominal pain along with nausea and vomiting, it may be due to pancreatitis. Immediately consult your doctor in case you experience these symptoms. Your doctor may get your levels of serum amylase checked. In case the test shows positive results for pancreatitis, the medication should be stopped immediately.

faq.question: How to check for overdose of Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER?
faq.answer: An overdose of Divaa -OD 500 Tablet ER may cause headaches, blurred eyesight due to the pupils of the eyes becoming smaller, lack of reflexes, confusion, and tiredness. You may also experience weak or “floppy” muscles, fits (seizures), loss of consciousness, behavioral changes, and breathing difficulties such as fast breathing, shortness of breath, or chest pain. Immediate medical assistance is required in case of overdose.

description:
DIXIn Paed Oral Solution is a medicine used to treat heart failure in combination with other medicines.
It helps to provide symptomatic relief by making the heart pump blood more efficiently.
This medicine is also used to treat abnormal heart rhythms (arrhythmia).
DIXIn Paed Oral Solution restores and maintains a normal and steady heartbeat.
It should be taken regularly as advised by the doctor.
You may take it with or without food, but it is better to take this medicine at a fixed time.
This medicine should not be stopped abruptly without consulting the doctor, as this can worsen your condition.
Regular follow-up with your doctor is advised while using this medicine.Common side effects of this medicine include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dizziness, and visual disturbances.

faq.question: What is DIXIn Paed Oral Solution used for?
faq.answer: DIXIn Paed Oral Solution is a medication used to treat heart conditions like heart failure and irregular heartbeats (arrhythmias or atrial fibrillation). It helps the heart beat more strongly and regularly, improving blood flow.

faq.question: Can taking too much DIXIn Paed Oral Solution be dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes, taking too much DIXIn Paed Oral Solution can be harmful. It may accumulate in the body and lead to toxicity, especially if the dose is too high, or if you are older, underweight, have kidney problems, or low electrolyte levels. Signs of toxicity include nausea, vomiting, confusion, vision changes, or an irregular heartbeat. To stay safe, your doctor will regularly monitor your blood levels and adjust your dose if needed.

faq.question: Does DIXIn Paed Oral Solution affect potassium levels?
faq.answer: Yes, DIXIn Paed Oral Solution can decrease blood potassium levels. Low potassium levels (hypokalemia) can increase the risk of DIXIn Paed Oral Solution toxicity. Your doctor may recommend eating potassium-rich foods (like bananas or oranges) or taking potassium supplements if needed. Also, DIXIn Paed Oral Solution should be used cautiously with medications that lower potassium, such as diuretics.

faq.question: How long does it take for DIXIn Paed Oral Solution to work?
faq.answer: The exact time DIXIn Paed Oral Solution takes to show results is not known. However, some people may notice improvement in symptoms like shortness of breath or irregular heartbeat within a few hours to days. It might take several days to a few weeks to feel the full effect. Keep taking it exactly as prescribed, even if you start to feel better.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking DIXIn Paed Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Avoid activities that require alertness, such as driving or operating machinery, until you know how DIXIn Paed Oral Solution affects you. Also, try not to eat large amounts of high-fiber foods (like bran) or take antacids without checking with your doctor, as they may affect how well the DIXIn Paed Oral Solution works.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of DIXIn Paed Oral Solution?
faq.answer: The serious side effects of DIXIn Paed Oral Solution include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, blurred or yellow-green vision, irregular heartbeat, and fainting. If you experience these, seek medical help immediately, as they may indicate digoxin toxicity.

faq.question: When should I avoid taking DIXIn Paed Oral Solution?
faq.answer: You should avoid taking DIXIn Paed Oral Solution if you have a heart condition such as ventricular fibrillation (a dangerous heart rhythm) and Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome. Also, you should also avoid taking DIXIn Paed Oral Solution if you are allergic to digoxin or similar drugs. Always let your doctor know about your full medical history.

faq.question: Do I need regular checkups while taking DIXIn Paed Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Yes, regular monitoring is important. Your doctor will check your heart rate and kidney function. They will also check digoxin levels in your blood. Too much can be toxic, and too little might not work. Following your doctor’s instructions and attending all follow-ups helps keep treatment safe and effective.

description:
Dizy 10 Tablet is used to treat angina (heart-related chest pain), high blood pressure, and some types of irregular heartbeats (arrhythmia).
It is known as a calcium channel blocker.
It works by relaxing blood vessels to lower blood pressure.
This helps to reduce the workload of the heart.
Dizy 10 Tablet may be taken with or without food, but it is better to take it regularly at a fixed time each day as advised by your doctor.
Keep using this medicine even if you feel well.
If you stop taking it suddenly, your condition may worsen.
This medicine is only part of a treatment program that should include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.Common side effects seen with this medicine include headache, constipation, dizziness, fatigue, nausea, flushing, and rash.
These are usually mild and disappear after a short time.

faq.question: Is Dizy 10 Tablet a blood thinner?
faq.answer: No, Dizy 10 Tablet is not a blood thinner. It belongs to the calcium channel blocker class of medicines. It is used to treat hypertension, arrhythmias and angina (chest pain caused by a reduction of oxygen to the heart muscle).

faq.question: Does Dizy 10 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Yes, Dizy 10 Tablet may cause weight gain but not in everybody. However, if you are gaining weight while taking Dizy 10 Tablet then consult your doctor or a nutritionist.

faq.question: Is it better to take Dizy 10 Tablet in the morning or at night?
faq.answer: It is recommended to take Dizy 10 Tablet at night and before meals. The dose will be decided by your doctor and should be taken exactly as prescribed by the doctor.

faq.question: Does Dizy 10 Tablet affect sleep?
faq.answer: Dizy 10 Tablet may cause sleeplessness which does not affect everyone. If this persists and worries you talk to your doctor.

faq.question: Who should not take Dizy 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should not take Dizy 10 Tablet if you are allergic to it, have an irregular or slow heartbeat, heart failure, and low blood pressure. It should not be given to children and women who are pregnant or planning to get pregnant.

faq.question: What are the symptoms of overdose of Dizy 10 Tablet?

faq.question: Who should not receive Dobumin Injection?
faq.answer: Individuals should not receive Dobumin Injection if they have a heart condition called idiopathic hypertrophic subaortic stenosis (a heart condition characterized by thickening of the heart muscle, particularly in the left ventricle, which can obstruct blood flow out of the heart) , or if they are allergic to dobutamine or any ingredient in the drug.

faq.question: Can Dobumin Injection increase heart rate or blood pressure?

faq.question: Is Dobumin Injection safe for people with irregular heartbeats?

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Dobumin Injection?

faq.question: Can Dobumin Injection cause low potassium levels?

faq.question: How quickly does Dobumin Injection start working?

description:
Crocin Pain Relief Tablet is a combination of two medicines used in the treatment of headache.
It helps relieve headache by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that causes headache.
Your doctor will advise how much Crocin Pain Relief Tablet you need to take.
It can be taken with or without food.
You should take the medicine regularly while you do need it and try not to miss doses as it will become less effective.
It should be used with caution in people who have any problems with their heart, kidneys, or liver.Using this medicine may cause sleep problems (insomnia), nervousness, irritation, or restlessness.
If you experience any of such side effects that do not go away or worsen, you should let your doctor know.
Your doctor may be able to suggest ways of preventing or reducing the symptoms.
In general, you should try to use the smallest amount necessary to control your symptoms.Before using the medicine, you should tell your doctor if you have any other illnesses or disorders.
It may also affect, or be affected by, some other medicines you are using so let your doctor know all the other medicines you are taking.
Do not consume alcohol when on treatment with this medicine as it may cause excessive sleepiness.
Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors first before using the medicine.

faq.question: What is Dolo Pain Relief Spray used for?
faq.answer: Dolo Pain Relief Spray is used to relieve joint and muscle pain, reduce swelling, and ease inflammation. It is commonly used for backache, sprains, strains, tendon injuries, and conditions like arthritis or tennis elbow.

faq.question: What precautions should I take while using Dolo Pain Relief Spray?
faq.answer: Avoid applying Dolo Pain Relief Spray to open wounds, eyes, mouth, or mucous membranes. Wash your hands thoroughly after application, and do not cover the area with tight bandages or apply heat unless advised by a doctor.

faq.question: Who should not use Dolo Pain Relief Spray?
faq.answer: People should not use Dolo Pain Relief Spray if they are allergic to diclofenac, aspirin, or other NSAIDs. It is also not suitable for individuals who experience asthma attacks or skin reactions after using pain-relief medicines.

faq.question: How should I apply Dolo Pain Relief Spray?
faq.answer: Apply Dolo Pain Relief Spray gently to the affected area three to four times a day. The amount depends on the size of the painful area. Do not apply it to open wounds or broken skin.

faq.question: Is Dolo Pain Relief Spray safe for children?
faq.answer: Dolo Pain Relief Spray should not be used in children under 14 years of age. It is recommended only for adults and adolescents aged 14 and older.

faq.question: What is the rationale behind using caffeine with paracetamol?
faq.answer: Caffeine is often combined with paracetamol because it increases the effectiveness of paracetamol.

faq.question: What if I overdose on Crocin Pain Relief Tablet?
faq.answer: Contact your doctor immediately even if you feel well. An overdose of Crocin Pain Relief Tablet can cause serious liver damage. Symptoms of liver damage are fever, rash, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, stomach pain, dark urine, and yellow skin or eyes.

faq.question: What is the recommended dose of Crocin Pain Relief Tablet?
faq.answer: The recommended doses for adults and children are different. Adults should take 1-2 tablets every 4 hours. Do not take more than 8 tablets a day. Whereas, children should be given 1 tablet every 4 hours. Do not give more than 4 tablets a day.

faq.question: Can I take Crocin Pain Relief Tablet for headache everyday?
faq.answer: Avoid using Crocin Pain Relief Tablet for more than 2-3 days per week for headache. Its overuse can instead lead to the occurrence of a medicine-overuse headache.

faq.question: What are the instructions for the storage and disposal of Crocin Pain Relief Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the packet or the container it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: Can the use of Crocin Pain Relief Tablet cause damage to the liver?
faq.answer: Crocin Pain Relief Tablet contains paracetamol. This medicine is known to cause harm to the liver in high doses. Also, avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may further increase your risk of liver damage. Use of this medicine should preferably be avoided in patients with the underlying liver disease. Contact your doctor immediately if you notice any early signs and symptoms of liver damage. These symptoms may include fever, rash, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, stomach pain, dark urine, yellow skin or eyes and abnormal liver enzymes.

faq.question: What is Naxdom 250 Tablet and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Naxdom 250 Tablet is used to treat migraine headaches, especially when they are associated with nausea or vomiting. The medicine works by blocking certain chemical signals in the body that cause pain and inflammation, while also helping control nausea associated with migraines. It should be taken only as prescribed by a doctor and not used regularly for other types of headaches without medical advice.

faq.question: How should I take Naxdom 250 Tablet?
faq.answer: Take Naxdom 250 Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not crush or chew it. Do not change the dose or schedule on your own. Consult your doctor if you miss doses often or if symptoms persist.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Naxdom 250 Tablet?
faq.answer: Common side effects of Naxdom 250 Tablet may include headache, dizziness, tiredness, ringing in the ears, skin rash, or mild vision changes. Some people may also experience stomach discomfort or nausea. These effects are usually mild and may improve as the body adjusts to the medicine. However, consult your doctor if side effects persist, worsen, or become bothersome. Consult your doctor immediately if you have black stools, vomit blood, or severe stomach pain.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Naxdom 250 Tablet?
faq.answer: It is not recommended to drink alcohol while taking Naxdom 250 Tablet. Alcohol may increase dizziness and the risk of stomach irritation or bleeding. It may also make it harder to notice unwanted reactions from the medicine. Since the body is already dealing with migraine symptoms, alcohol may worsen discomfort or dehydration. For safety, avoid alcohol during treatment and consult your doctor if you have concerns.

faq.question: How should I take Responday 250 Tablet?

faq.question: What are the side effects of Responday 250 Tablet?

faq.question: What is Flutrol 250 Capsule?
faq.answer: Flutrol 250 Capsule is an inhalation medication that helps in reducing symptoms associated with obstructive airway diseases like asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

faq.question: How does Flutrol 250 Capsule work?
faq.answer: Flutrol 250 Capsule contains salmeterol, a long-acting beta-2-adrenergic agonist and fluticasone, a corticosteroid. Salmeterol relaxes bronchial smooth muscles causing bronchodilation and fluticasone reduces inflammation.

faq.question: Is Flutrol 250 Capsule a controller or a reliever medication?
faq.answer: Flutrol 250 Capsule is a controller medication to be used on a regular basis as prescribed by the doctor. It does not help to relive the sudden worsening of respiratory symptoms.

faq.question: Does Flutrol 250 Capsule contain steroids?
faq.answer: Yes, it contains steroids that are effective in improving breathing difficulty due to COPD and asthma. Inhaled corticosteroids have a lower side effect profile as compared to steroid injections and tablets.

faq.question: Does Flutrol 250 Capsule increase heart rate?
faq.answer: Some individuals taking Flutrol 250 Capsule may experience an increase in heart rate. If this occurs, one should contact his/her doctor immediately.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Flutrol 250 Capsule?
faq.answer: The most common side effects of Flutrol 250 Capsule are upper respiratory infection, headache, throat irritation, hoarseness and voice changes, dizziness, nausea, and vomiting.

faq.question: Is Flutrol 250 Capsule addictive?
faq.answer: Flutrol 250 Capsule is not at all addictive. It is a very effective and useful medicine for people suffering from breathing difficulties due to asthma and COPD.

faq.question: Will Flutrol 250 Capsule be more effective if taken more frequently?
faq.answer: No, you should not take Flutrol 250 Capsule more frequently than recommended by your doctor. It will increase the risk of side effects rather than providing additional therapeutic benefits. However, if you feel the symptoms are not relieved by the given doses, consult the doctor for reevaluation.

faq.question: What happens if I miss the dose of Flutrol 250 Capsule?

faq.question: Is there a particular breathing technique to be followed while using Flutrol 250 Capsule?

faq.question: Can I use Flutrol 250 Capsule if I am diabetic?
faq.answer: Flutrol 250 Capsule may cause an increase in blood sugar levels, hence the blood sugar levels should be cautiously monitored. Consult your doctor for further information.

faq.question: What precautions should one take while using Flutrol 250 Capsule?
faq.answer: Always use the Flutrol 250 Capsule in the right way. If any worsening of symptoms or side effects occurs, inform your doctor about it. Rinse your mouth with water after using the inhaler every time. Maintain good oral hygiene.

faq.question: What are the instructions for storage of Flutrol 250 Capsule?
faq.answer: Flutrol 250 Capsule should be stored at room temperature, away from heat and direct light. It should be kept away from the reach of children and pets.

faq.question: How much Dolo Drops should I give to my child?
faq.answer: Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding how much of the medicine to give and how often to give it. This depends on the strength of the medicine and the age of your child. You may also check the label or the leaflet inside the packaging for directions before use.

faq.answer: You can give this medicine if your child has a temperature of 38.3°C (101°F) or higher. But, you must always try to speak to your child’s doctor first.

faq.question: When will my child’s condition improve after taking Dolo Drops?
faq.answer: Dolo Drops usually starts working within 30 to 60 minutes of intake and shows its peak effect within 3 to 4 hours. Your child may start to feel better after a few doses. In case the pain or fever persists longer, consult your child’s doctor immediately.

faq.question: My child’s fever is persistent even after taking Dolo Drops. What should I do?
faq.answer: If the fever doesn't come down after the initial few doses, the cause might be an infection (virus or bacteria). It is advised to consult your child’s doctor for specific treatment.

faq.question: How much of Dolo Drops is considered as an overdose?
faq.answer: You should only take four doses of Dolo Drops in 24 hours. There should be a gap of at least 4-6 hours between two doses. Do not take it for more than 3 days without first talking to your doctor.

faq.question: Is there any special diet my child needs to follow while taking this medicine?
faq.answer: Unless instructed by your doctor, your child should take a normal, balanced diet while continuing this medicine, as a lack of nutrition can put your child at risk of developing medication toxicity.

faq.question: Where should I store this medicine?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine at room temperature in a dry place beyond the reach of children.

faq.question: In what conditions Dolo Drops must be given with caution?
faq.answer: It is advised to use the Dolo Drops with caution if the child has malnutrition, G6PD deficiency, liver disease, or any medical allergy. So, do not hesitate to share your child’s complete medical history with the doctor, as that will help the doctor decide whether the medicine is safe for your child or not.

faq.question: Can I give Dolo Drops on a routine basis when my child is taking a vaccine?
faq.answer: It is generally not recommended to give Dolo Drops routinely with vaccines that may cause fever. Studies suggest that doing so might reduce the effectiveness of the vaccine.

Domi UP Oral Spray is a medicine given to children to help treat nausea and vomiting.
It is mainly given to treat nausea and vomiting associated with surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and stomach/intestinal infection.
It also helps treat vomiting that is caused as a side effect of medicines like painkillers.
Domi UP Oral Spray may be given before or after meals.
To control vomiting caused due to chemotherapy, give this medicine to your child 30 minutes before the procedure.
Give it 1 to 2 hours before a radiotherapy session and 1 hour before surgery to prevent your child from vomiting post these procedures.
If your child expels out the medicine within 30 minutes of the intake, help your child calm down and repeat the dose.
Do not double the dose if it is already time for the next dose.Domi UP Oral Spray may cause some temporary side effects such as headache, constipation, diarrhea, and fatigue.
These side effects usually subside once your child’s body adapts to the medicine.
In case these side effects persist or become bothersome, do reach out to the doctor on a priority basis.Let the doctor know about all the medicines your child is taking, including painkillers, antibiotics, or medicines taken to treat depression.
Also, inform the doctor if your child has a history of liver problems, kidney malfunction, blockage in the gastrointestinal tract, heart problems, or allergies to any medicine, its ingredients, or a food product.
This information is very important for dose alterations and for planning your child’s overall treatment.

faq.question: What if my child takes too much Domi UP Oral Spray?
faq.answer: Domi UP Oral Spray is unlikely to cause harm if you give an extra dose by mistake. However, you must still speak to your child’s doctor immediately. Sometimes, excessive intake of Domi UP Oral Spray can cause some serious side effects like excess sleepiness, agitation, rapid heartbeat, hypertension, flushing, dilated pupils, sweating, involuntary muscle jerk, uncontrolled eye movements, overactive reflexes, and seizures. These symptoms are collectively known as serotonin syndrome. If any of these appear, consult the doctor without any delay.

faq.question: How should Domi UP Oral Spray be stored?
faq.answer: Domi UP Oral Spray should be stored at room temperature, in a dry place, away from direct heat and light. Also, keep all the medicines out of the reach and sight of children to avoid any accidental intake.

faq.question: What all medicines should my child avoid while taking Domi UP Oral Spray?
faq.answer: Usually, it is advised not to give Domi UP Oral Spray along with antidepressant medicines, apomorphine, anti-migraine medicines, painkillers, heart medicines, and antibiotics like linezolid. But, it is ideal to speak to your child’s doctor before coming to any conclusion. So, narrate your child’s complete medical history to your child’s doctor and follow their advice strictly.

faq.question: In what conditions do I need to call my child’s doctor right away?
faq.answer: Call your child’s doctor immediately if your child develops symptoms of serotonin syndrome like irregular heartbeat, green-colored vomiting, inability to pass wind, pale skin and eyes, dark-colored urine, restlessness, and insomnia.

faq.question: My child is having a migraine and is on medication. Can I give Domi UP Oral Spray along with it?
faq.answer: Avoid combining Domi UP Oral Spray with such medicines because concomitant use of Domi UP Oral Spray with medicines meant to treat depression or migraine results in serotonin syndrome. Consult your child’s doctor before giving any medicine to your child.

Domirox Tablet is a medicine used in the prevention of migraines.
It inhibits the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain, inflammation, and fever.
It also blocks the signals in the brain that cause nausea and vomiting associated with migraines.
Domirox Tablet may be prescribed alone or in combination with another medicine.
It can be taken with or without food.
The dose and duration will depend on the severity of your condition and how well it helps your symptoms.
Use it regularly and do not discontinue it until the doctor tells you it is right to stop.Using Domirox Tablet may cause common side effects such as headaches, ringing in the ears, dizziness, tiredness, rashes, and vision changes.
If you experience such side effects that do not go away or get worse, you should let your doctor know.
Your doctor may be able to suggest ways of preventing or reducing the symptoms.In general, you should try to use the smallest amount necessary to control your symptoms.
Before using the medicine, you should tell your doctor if you have any other illnesses or disorders.
It may also affect, or be affected by, some other medicines you are using, so let your doctor know all the other medicines you are taking.
Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors first before using the medicine.

faq.question: What is Domirox Tablet and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Domirox Tablet is used to treat migraine headaches, especially when they are associated with nausea or vomiting. It helps reduce migraine symptoms such as head pain, nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light or sound. The medicine works by blocking certain chemical signals in the body that cause pain and inflammation, while also helping control nausea associated with migraines. It should be taken only as prescribed by a doctor and not used regularly for other types of headaches without medical advice.

faq.question: How should I take Domirox Tablet?
faq.answer: Take Domirox Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet whole with water and do not crush or chew it. It may be taken with or without food, but taking it at the same time each day helps maintain consistent effects. If it causes stomach discomfort, taking it after food may help. Do not change the dose or schedule on your own. Consult your doctor if you miss doses often or if symptoms persist.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Domirox Tablet?
faq.answer: Common side effects of Domirox Tablet may include headache, dizziness, tiredness, ringing in the ears, skin rash, or mild vision changes. Some people may also experience stomach discomfort or nausea. These effects are usually mild and may improve as the body adjusts to the medicine. However, consult your doctor if side effects persist, worsen, or become bothersome. Consult your doctor immediately if you have black stools, vomit blood, or severe stomach pain.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Domirox Tablet?
faq.answer: It is not recommended to drink alcohol while taking Domirox Tablet. Alcohol may increase dizziness and the risk of stomach irritation or bleeding. It may also make it harder to notice unwanted reactions from the medicine. Since the body is already dealing with migraine symptoms, alcohol may worsen discomfort or dehydration. For safety, avoid alcohol during treatment and consult your doctor if you have concerns.

faq.question: Who should avoid taking Domirox Tablet?
faq.answer: Domirox Tablet should be used with caution and only under a doctor’s advice in people who are pregnant, have kidney or liver disease, heart problems, or high blood pressure. It may not be suitable during pregnancy unless clearly prescribed. Breastfeeding mothers should also consult a doctor before using it. Extra care is needed if you take other medicines or have ongoing health conditions. Always share your full medical history with your doctor before starting Domirox Tablet.

faq.question: Can Domirox Tablet affect driving ability?
faq.answer: Domirox Tablet may cause dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, or vision problems in some people. These effects can reduce alertness and may affect your ability to drive or operate machinery safely. If you feel dizzy, unusually tired, or notice vision changes after taking the medicine, avoid driving or using heavy machines until you feel normal again. Consult your doctor if these symptoms persist.

faq.question: Can I take Domirox Tablet every day?
faq.answer: Domirox Tablet should only be used in the dose and duration recommended by your doctor. It is generally taken when migraine symptoms occur or as directed for prevention, and should not be used more frequently or in higher doses than prescribed. If your headaches become frequent or severe, consult your doctor rather than increasing the dose yourself. Repeated or excessive use may worsen headaches over time. Seek urgent medical care if symptoms such as severe weakness, fainting, chest pain, breathing difficulty, seizures, confusion, black stools, or severe dehydration occur.

faq.question: How many times a day can Domirox Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: The number of times you should take Domirox Tablet depends on your doctor’s instructions and your medical condition. Always follow the dosing schedule provided by your doctor and do not increase the frequency on your own. Taking more than recommended may increase the risk of side effects. If the medicine upsets your stomach, your doctor may advise taking it after food and maintaining good hydration.

description:
Dompan SR Tablet is a medicine that is used to treat conditions like gastroesophageal acid reflux disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis, gastritis, gastric and duodenal ulcers, and indigestion with symptoms like heartburn, bloating, and regurgitation.
Take Dompan SR Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily before breakfast.
Swallow it whole with water; do not crush or chew.
To get the best results, maintain a healthy diet, avoid late-night meals, caffeine, spicy or oily foods, and stop smoking or alcohol use.
Do not skip doses or stop early, even if you feel better, as that may lead to a return of the symptoms.The most common side effect of Dompan SR Tablet is dry mouth.
It may also cause headache, dizziness, diarrhea, nausea, or mild stomach discomfort in some people.
These are usually temporary.
If you experience persistent vomiting, irregular heartbeat, rash, or severe diarrhea, contact your doctor immediately.
Staying hydrated and taking the medicine before meals may help reduce stomach-related side effects.Inform your doctor about any liver, kidney, or heart problems before starting Dompan SR Tablet.
Avoid taking it with other drugs that may affect heart rhythm or interact with domperidone or pantoprazole.
Do not use it if you have a history of gastrointestinal bleeding or obstruction, or if you are allergic to any of the ingredients in the medicine.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use.

faq.question: What is Dompan Tablet and how does it help?
faq.answer: Dompan Tablet is a combination of two medicines used to treat acidity, heartburn, and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) — a condition in which stomach acid flows back into the food pipe (esophagus). It works by improving the movement of the stomach and intestines, helping food pass more easily through the digestive tract. It also reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach, providing relief from acid-related indigestion and heartburn.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Dompan Tablet?
faq.answer: Dompan Tablet is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients, it may cause common side effects like diarrhea, stomach pain, flatulence, dryness in the mouth, dizziness, headache, and other uncommon and rare side effects. If you experience any persistent problem while taking this medication, inform your doctor.

faq.question: Are there any specific contraindications associated with the use of Dompan Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Dompan Tablet is considered to be harmful for patients with a known hypersensitivity to pantoprazole or domperidone, or any other inactive ingredients of the medicine. Caution is advised in patients with underlying kidney or liver disease. This medicine should not be used if you have a history of gastrointestinal bleeding or obstruction.

faq.question: Can the use of Dompan Tablet cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dompan Tablet can cause dry mouth. If you experience dry mouth, drink plenty of water. Take regular sips of water during the day and keep some water on your bedside at night. Cut down the intake of alcohol and avoid smoking. If you have a dry mouth, try to use alcohol-free mouthwash as its use can increase the risk of tooth decay.

faq.question: Can the use of Dompan Tablet cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dompan Tablet can cause diarrhea. In case you experience diarrhea, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small, frequent sips. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. Talk to your doctor if diarrhea persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like less urination with dark colored and strong-smelling urine.

faq.question: While taking Dompan Tablet, which foods should be avoided?
faq.answer: You should preferably avoid foods that cause acidity and heartburn as they will only worsen your condition, for example, fried or spicy food, butter, oil, and juices, caffeinated drinks like cola or tea, drinks from citrus fruits like lemon water or orange juice, and alcohol.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Dompan Tablet if I feel better?
faq.answer: If you have been taking Dompan Tablet for a long time, stopping it abruptly may lead to increased acid production, thereby worsening your symptoms. Therefore, you must discuss any dose changes with your doctor.

faq.question: What are the instructions for storage and disposal of Dompan Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, and other people.

description:
Domstal 5 DT Tablet helps treat indigestion, gastroesophageal reflux disease, nausea, and vomiting in children.
It increases the movement of food through the stomach and intestines, thereby relieving bloating, fullness, and gastric discomfort.
Domstal 5 DT Tablet is best given half an hour before each meal.
If given after meals, it will still work but the absorption of the medicine may get affected.
For young babies, the doctor may prescribe giving it four times each day.
Wait for at least 4 hours between doses and give each dose just before a milk feed.
The doses usually vary depending upon your child’s condition, body weight, and age.
Never exceed the prescribed duration without consulting the doctor.
If your child vomits within 30 minutes of the intake, repeat the same dose once your child calms down, but do not double dose if it is time for the next dose.This medicine may cause some minor and temporary side effects such as dry mouth, headache, drowsiness, stomach cramps, and diarrhea.
Usually, these episodes subside once your child’s body adapts to the medicine.
However, if these side effects persist or become bothersome for your child, report to the doctor without any delay.Your child’s doctor should be aware if your child has had any previous episodes of allergy, heart problem, a blood disorder, birth defects, airway obstruction, lung anomaly, gastrointestinal problem, skin disorder, liver impairment, and kidney malfunction.
Being aware of your child’s entire medical history will help the doctor make critical dose alterations and plan your child’s overall treatment.

faq.question: What is the maximum dose of Domstal 5 DT Tablet I can give to my child daily?
faq.answer: The maximum daily safe dose of Domstal 5 DT Tablet is 30mg/day. Giving more than this amount can cause heart-related problems in your child.

faq.question: What if my child takes too much Domstal 5 DT Tablet?
faq.answer: Domstal 5 DT Tablet is unlikely to cause harm if you give an extra dose by mistake. However, you must still speak to your child’s doctor immediately. Sometimes, excessive intake of Domstal 5 DT Tablet can cause some serious side effects like irregular heartbeats, heart block, agitation, and confusion. If any of these appear, consult the doctor without any delay.

faq.question: How should Domstal 5 DT Tablet be stored?
faq.answer: Store Domstal 5 DT Tablet at room temperature, in a dry place, away from direct heat and light. Also, keep all the medicines out of the reach and sight of children to avoid any accidental intake.

faq.question: Can other medicines be given at the same time as Domstal 5 DT Tablet?
faq.answer: Domstal 5 DT Tablet can sometimes interact with other medicines or substances. Tell your doctor about any other medicines your child is taking before starting Domstal 5 DT Tablet. Also, check with your child’s doctor before giving any medicine to your child.

It increases the movement of food through the stomach and intestines, thereby relieving bloating, fullness, and gastric discomfort.

If given after meals, it will still work but the absorption of the medicine may get affected.
For young babies, the doctor may prescribe giving it four times each day.
Wait for at least 4 hours between doses and give each dose just before a milk feed.
The doses usually vary depending upon your child’s condition, body weight, and age.

If your child vomits within 30 minutes of the intake, repeat the same dose once your child calms down, but do not double dose if it is time for the next dose.This medicine may cause some minor and temporary side effects such as dry mouth, headache, drowsiness, stomach cramps, and diarrhea.
