description:
Dosyer Injection is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections in your body.
It is effective in some infections of the lungs, urinary tract, eyes, and others.
It kills bacteria, which helps to improve your symptoms and cure the infection.
Dosyer Injection is also used to treat many sexually transmitted diseases.
It helps to improve your symptoms and cure the underlying infection.
It is given as a drip (intravenous infusion) into a vein by a doctor or a nurse.
You should get the injection regularly at evenly spaced intervals for maximum benefits.
Do not skip any doses and finish the full course of treatment even if you feel better.
Stopping the medicine too early may lead to the infection returning or worsening.The most common side effects of this medicine include skin reaction on exposure to sunlight (photosensitivity), vomiting, nausea, and diarrhea.
Avoid excessive sun exposure and use sunscreen and protective clothing when outdoors.
Some people may develop temporary redness or pain at the site of injection.
These side effects are usually mild but let your doctor know if they bother you or last more than a few days.Before using it, you should tell your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics.
You should also let your doctor know all other medicines you are taking as they may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
Pregnant and breastfeeding mothers should consult their doctor before using it.
It may blur your vision or make you feel sleepy and dizzy.
Do not drive if these symptoms occur.

faq.question: How long does Dosyer Injection takes to work?
faq.answer: Usually, Dosyer Injection starts working soon after taking it. However, it may take some days to kill all the harmful bacteria and make you feel better.

faq.question: Can the use of Dosyer Injection cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dosyer Injection can cause diarrhea. It is an antibiotic which kills the harmful bacteria. However, it also affects the helpful bacteria in your stomach or intestine and causes diarrhea. If diarrhea persists, talk to your doctor about it.

faq.question: What is Douxclav 625 Tablet, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Douxclav 625 Tablet is an oral antibacterial combination of amoxicillin and clavulanic acid. It is used to treat a wide range of bacterial infections. It is commonly prescribed to treat infections such as ear infections (otitis media), sinus infections (bacterial rhinosinusitis), respiratory infections (pneumonia, bronchitis), and skin and soft tissue infections (cellulitis, abscesses).

faq.question: Is Douxclav 625 Tablet safe for patients with a history of penicillin allergy?
faq.answer: Since Douxclav 625 Tablet is a penicillin-type antibiotic, individuals with a known penicillin allergy may be at higher risk of an allergic reaction. Patients who are allergic to penicillin or who have had a previous allergic reaction to Douxclav 625 Tablet should not use it.

faq.question: Can I take Douxclav 625 Tablet if I have a known liver condition or a history of jaundice?
faq.answer: Douxclav 625 Tablet should be used with caution in patients with liver disease or a history of jaundice. Dose adjustment may be needed. Your doctor will decide whether to prescribe this medicine after evaluating your condition, often with liver function tests. Always take it only after consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Does Douxclav 625 Tablet affect the efficacy of oral contraceptive (birth control) pills?
faq.answer: As per the most recent evidence, Douxclav 625 Tablet does not interfere with hormonal birth control. However, talk to your doctor if you have any concerns. They can help you feel confident and protected. Antibiotics such as Douxclav 625 Tablet can cause nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. If you vomit within two hours of taking the birth control pills, or if you have had diarrhea for 24 hours or more, your birth control pills may be ineffective. You may need to use an additional barrier method (such as condoms) in such cases.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Douxclav 625 Tablet early if my symptoms disappear?
faq.answer: No. It is very important to complete the full course of treatment, even if you start feeling better before finishing it. Feeling better does not necessarily mean that all the bacteria causing your infection have been eliminated. Stopping antibiotic treatment early may cause the symptoms to recur or make the bacteria resistant to the antibiotic.

faq.question: Does Douxclav 625 Tablet cause loose motions or diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, diarrhea or loose motions is amongst the most commonly reported side effects of Douxclav 625 Tablet. In most cases, this is mild and resolves once the antibiotic course is complete. If you develop severe diarrhea, bloody stools, or abdominal cramping, or if symptoms persist or worsen, inform your doctor immediately.

faq.question: Is Douxclav 625 Tablet effective against viral infections, such as the common cold or flu?
faq.answer: No. Douxclav 625 Tablet is an antibiotic and works only against bacterial infections. Viruses cause the common cold and influenza (flu). Antibiotics are not effective against them. If you have a cold or flu, supportive care such as rest, staying hydrated, and using home remedies like saline gargles or steam inhalation may help with recovery.

faq.question: How long does Douxclav 625 Tablet take to work, and how do I know if it is working?
faq.answer: Douxclav 625 Tablet begins to work against bacterial infections within hours of taking it. However, it may take 24 to 48 hours to notice improvement in your symptoms. If you do not notice any improvement, or if your symptoms worsen at any point, contact your doctor. This may indicate that the bacteria causing the infection are resistant to this antibiotic or that a different treatment is needed.

faq.question: Is Douxclav 625 Tablet safe for elderly patients with reduced kidney function?
faq.answer: Special care is needed when Douxclav 625 Tablet is given to older adults, particularly those with reduced kidney function (renal impairment). The kidneys primarily clear Douxclav 625 Tablet from the body, so if they are not functioning well, the drug can build up in the body and increase the risk of side effects. Dose adjustment may be required based on kidney function.

faq.question: How do I properly store the dry syrup of Amoxycillin + Clavulanic Acid?
faq.answer: Amoxycillin + Clavulanic Acid is available as a dry powder (dry syrup) that needs to be mixed with water before use. Proper preparation and storage are essential to ensure the medicine works correctly. Always refrigerate the reconstituted suspension (2°C–8°C). Shake well before each use, and discard it within 7–10 days after reconstitution.

faq.question: What kind of infection does Douxclav 625 Tablet fight?
faq.answer: Douxclav 625 Tablet fights infections caused by bacteria, specifically those that produce enzymes called beta-lactamases. These enzymes are a common mechanism by which bacteria defend themselves against antibiotics. Clavulanic acid blocks these enzymes, allowing amoxicillin to kill the bacteria effectively. This medicine is active against a broad range of bacteria, including both gram-positive and gram-negative types. Common bacteria it targets include Streptococcus pneumoniae (a cause of pneumonia and ear infections), Haemophilus influenzae (associated with respiratory and ear infections), and Moraxella catarrhalis (common in sinus and chest infections).

faq.question: How does Doxiflo 650 Tablet SR work?

Doxiflo 650 Tablet SR relieves the breathlessness and cough thereby providing symptomatic relief.

description:
Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet is a medicine used in dogs for treating bacterial infections, including those affecting the respiratory tract, such as rhinitis, tonsillitis, and bronchopneumonia.
It kills and stops the bacteria from multiplying.
This helps clear the infections and speeds up recovery.
Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet should be given exactly as prescribed by the veterinarian.
The dose and duration of the treatment may depend on body weight, type, or severity of the infection.
Always follow your veterinarian’s dosage instructions.
Do not skip doses or stop treatment early, even if your pet seems better, as this may allow the infection to return.There is limited data on the common side effects of Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet.
Some dogs may develop skin sensitivity to sunlight (photodermatitis) after exposure to strong sunlight during treatment.
Vomiting and swelling, irritation, or inflammation of the esophagus may also occur in some animals.
Giving the medicine with food and ensuring adequate water intake can help minimize these effects.Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet is not recommended for use in pregnant or lactating animals and should not be used in pets known to be hypersensitive to doxycycline or other tetracyclines.
Use with caution in young animals, as this medicine may cause tooth discoloration if given during tooth development.Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet should not be used with other antibiotics.
Additionally, avoid giving the medicine along with iron supplements, antacids, or oral absorbents, as they can interfere with absorption.
Exposure to intense sunlight or ultraviolet light should be minimized during treatment, as this medicine may cause skin sensitivity (photodermatitis).

faq.question: What is Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet used for in dogs?
faq.answer: Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet is used for the treatment of bacterial infections in dogs, including respiratory tract infections such as rhinitis, tonsillitis, and bronchopneumonia. faq.question: How does Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet work?
faq.answer: Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet contains doxycycline, an antibiotic that stops bacterial growth by blocking the production of proteins essential for bacterial survival. It also includes Lactobacillus, which helps maintain healthy gut flora during antibiotic therapy.

faq.question: How should I give Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet to my pet?
faq.answer: Give it in the exact dose and duration directed by your veterinarian. It is best given during feeding time to improve tolerance and reduce the risk of stomach irritation.

faq.question: Can I stop giving Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet once my dog looks better?
faq.answer: No. It is important to complete the full course prescribed by your veterinarian. Stopping early may not fully clear the infection and can contribute to antibiotic resistance.

faq.question: Can Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet be given to pregnant or nursing dogs?
faq.answer: No. Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet should not be used in pregnant or lactating animals, as tetracyclines can affect tooth and bone development in puppies.

faq.question: Can Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet be used with other antibiotics or supplements?
faq.answer: Doxypet 100 Doxycycline Pet Tablet should not be used at the same time as other bactericidal antibiotics such as β-lactams, or with iron, calcium, or antacid supplements, as these can interfere with absorption or effectiveness.

faq.question: What is Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet used for in dogs?

faq.question: How does Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet work?
faq.answer: Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet contains doxycycline, an antibiotic that stops bacterial growth by blocking the production of proteins essential for bacterial survival. It also includes Lactobacillus, which helps maintain healthy gut flora during antibiotic therapy.

faq.question: How should I give Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet to my pet?
faq.answer: Give it in the exact dose and duration directed by your veterinarian. It is best given during feeding time to improve tolerance and reduce the risk of stomach irritation.

faq.question: Can I stop giving Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet once my dog looks better?

faq.question: Can Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet be given to pregnant or nursing dogs?

faq.question: Can Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet be used with other antibiotics or supplements?
faq.answer: Doxypet 300 (Doxycycline) Pet Tablet should not be used at the same time as other bactericidal antibiotics such as β-lactams, or with iron, calcium, or antacid supplements, as these can interfere with absorption or effectiveness.

description:
DP Gesic Tablet is a pain-relieving medicine.
It is used to reduce pain and inflammation in conditions like rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and osteoarthritis.
It may also be used to relieve muscle pain, back pain, toothache, or pain in the ear and throat.
DP Gesic Tablet should be taken with food.
This will prevent you from getting an upset stomach.
You should take it regularly as advised by your doctor.
Do not take more or use it for a longer duration than recommended by your doctor.There is limited data on the side effects of DP Gesic Tablet.
Let your doctor know if you experience any symptoms while taking DP Gesic Tablet.
They may be able to suggest ways to treat or manage the side effects.Before you start DP Gesic Tablet, tell your doctor if you have any medical conditions.
Let your doctor also know about all the medications you are taking, as some medicines may interact with DP Gesic Tablet.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before taking DP Gesic Tablet to ensure safety.

faq.question: What is DP Gesic Tablet?
faq.answer: DP Gesic Tablet is a combination of two medicines: Diclofenac and Paracetamol. This medication helps in relieving pain and inflammation. It works by lowering the levels of chemical substances in the body that cause pain and inflammation. Paracetamol / Acetaminophen has an early onset of action which means that it takes very less time to start its action and it helps in relieving the symptoms till diclofenac starts working.

faq.question: Is it safe to use DP Gesic Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, DP Gesic Tablet is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients it may cause some unwanted common side effects like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, heartburn, diarrhea and other uncommon and rare side effects. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem while taking this medication.

faq.question: Can I stop taking DP Gesic Tablet when my pain is relieved?
faq.answer: DP Gesic Tablet, when used for long-term pain relief, should be continued for as long as advised by your physician. It can be discontinued if you are using it for short-term pain relief.

faq.question: Can the use of DP Gesic Tablet cause nausea and vomiting?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of DP Gesic Tablet can cause nausea and vomiting. Taking it with milk, food or with antacids can prevent nausea. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. In case of vomiting, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small frequent sips. Talk to your doctor if vomiting persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like dark colored and strong-smelling urine and a low frequency of urination. Do not take any other medicine without speaking to your doctor.

faq.question: Can the use of DP Gesic Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of DP Gesic Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: Can the use of DP Gesic Tablet cause damage to kidneys?
faq.answer: Yes, the long-term use of DP Gesic Tablet can cause damage to the kidneys. Normal kidneys produce a chemical called prostaglandins that protect them from damage. Use of painkillers lowers the levels of prostaglandins in the body leading to kidney damage on long-term use. Use of painkillers is not recommended in patients with underlying kidney disease.

faq.question: Are there any specific contraindications associated with the use of DP Gesic Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of DP Gesic Tablet is considered to be harmful in patients with known allergy to painkillers (NSAIDs) or any of the components or excipients of this medicine. The use of this medicine should preferably be avoided in patients with a history of stomach ulcers or in patients with active, recurrent stomach ulcer/bleeding. It should also be avoided in patients with the history of heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease.

faq.question: Can DP Gesic Tablet be taken with Vitamin B-complex?
faq.answer: Yes, DP Gesic Tablet can be taken with Vitamin B-complex preparations. While DP Gesic Tablet helps to relieve pain, Vitamin B-complex can help to correct the vitamin deficiency that might be causing the underlying painful condition.

faq.question: Is it safe to take a higher than the recommended dose of DP Gesic Tablet?
faq.answer: No, taking a higher than the recommended dose of DP Gesic Tablet can lead to increased chances of side effects like nausea, vomiting, heartburn, indigestion, diarrhea and can also damage your kidneys on long-term use. If you are experiencing increased severity of pain or the pain is not relieved by the recommended doses of this medicine, please consult your doctor for re-evaluation.

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for DP Gesic Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: What is Duet 625 Tablet, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Duet 625 Tablet is an oral antibacterial combination of amoxicillin and clavulanic acid. It is used to treat a wide range of bacterial infections. It is commonly prescribed to treat infections such as ear infections (otitis media), sinus infections (bacterial rhinosinusitis), respiratory infections (pneumonia, bronchitis), and skin and soft tissue infections (cellulitis, abscesses).

faq.question: Is Duet 625 Tablet safe for patients with a history of penicillin allergy?
faq.answer: Since Duet 625 Tablet is a penicillin-type antibiotic, individuals with a known penicillin allergy may be at higher risk of an allergic reaction. Patients who are allergic to penicillin or who have had a previous allergic reaction to Duet 625 Tablet should not use it.

faq.question: Can I take Duet 625 Tablet if I have a known liver condition or a history of jaundice?
faq.answer: Duet 625 Tablet should be used with caution in patients with liver disease or a history of jaundice. Dose adjustment may be needed. Your doctor will decide whether to prescribe this medicine after evaluating your condition, often with liver function tests. Always take it only after consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Does Duet 625 Tablet affect the efficacy of oral contraceptive (birth control) pills?
faq.answer: As per the most recent evidence, Duet 625 Tablet does not interfere with hormonal birth control. However, talk to your doctor if you have any concerns. They can help you feel confident and protected. Antibiotics such as Duet 625 Tablet can cause nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. If you vomit within two hours of taking the birth control pills, or if you have had diarrhea for 24 hours or more, your birth control pills may be ineffective. You may need to use an additional barrier method (such as condoms) in such cases.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Duet 625 Tablet early if my symptoms disappear?
faq.answer: No. It is very important to complete the full course of treatment, even if you start feeling better before finishing it. Feeling better does not necessarily mean that all the bacteria causing your infection have been eliminated. Stopping antibiotic treatment early may cause the symptoms to recur or make the bacteria resistant to the antibiotic.

faq.question: Does Duet 625 Tablet cause loose motions or diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, diarrhea or loose motions is amongst the most commonly reported side effects of Duet 625 Tablet. In most cases, this is mild and resolves once the antibiotic course is complete. If you develop severe diarrhea, bloody stools, or abdominal cramping, or if symptoms persist or worsen, inform your doctor immediately.

faq.question: Is Duet 625 Tablet effective against viral infections, such as the common cold or flu?
faq.answer: No. Duet 625 Tablet is an antibiotic and works only against bacterial infections. Viruses cause the common cold and influenza (flu). Antibiotics are not effective against them. If you have a cold or flu, supportive care such as rest, staying hydrated, and using home remedies like saline gargles or steam inhalation may help with recovery.

faq.question: How long does Duet 625 Tablet take to work, and how do I know if it is working?
faq.answer: Duet 625 Tablet begins to work against bacterial infections within hours of taking it. However, it may take 24 to 48 hours to notice improvement in your symptoms. If you do not notice any improvement, or if your symptoms worsen at any point, contact your doctor. This may indicate that the bacteria causing the infection are resistant to this antibiotic or that a different treatment is needed.

faq.question: Is Duet 625 Tablet safe for elderly patients with reduced kidney function?
faq.answer: Special care is needed when Duet 625 Tablet is given to older adults, particularly those with reduced kidney function (renal impairment). The kidneys primarily clear Duet 625 Tablet from the body, so if they are not functioning well, the drug can build up in the body and increase the risk of side effects. Dose adjustment may be required based on kidney function.

faq.question: How do I properly store the dry syrup of Amoxycillin + Clavulanic Acid?
faq.answer: Amoxycillin + Clavulanic Acid is available as a dry powder (dry syrup) that needs to be mixed with water before use. Proper preparation and storage are essential to ensure the medicine works correctly. Always refrigerate the reconstituted suspension (2°C–8°C). Shake well before each use, and discard it within 7–10 days after reconstitution.

faq.question: What kind of infection does Duet 625 Tablet fight?
faq.answer: Duet 625 Tablet fights infections caused by bacteria, specifically those that produce enzymes called beta-lactamases. These enzymes are a common mechanism by which bacteria defend themselves against antibiotics. Clavulanic acid blocks these enzymes, allowing amoxicillin to kill the bacteria effectively. This medicine is active against a broad range of bacteria, including both gram-positive and gram-negative types. Common bacteria it targets include Streptococcus pneumoniae (a cause of pneumonia and ear infections), Haemophilus influenzae (associated with respiratory and ear infections), and Moraxella catarrhalis (common in sinus and chest infections).

Dulax Tablet is best taken at night when it is used to treat constipation.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Dulax Tablet?

faq.question: Is Dulax Tablet a stimulant laxative?

faq.question: Is Dulax Tablet habit forming?

faq.question: Is Dulax Tablet effective?

faq.question: Can I take Dulax Tablet for constipation?
faq.answer: Dulax Tablet is used for the treatment of recent or long-term constipation. Dulax Tablet can also be used to clear the bowels before surgery, labor or radiological investigation. description:
Duoclear Respules is used for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (a lung disorder in which the flow of air to the lungs is blocked).
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages and making it easier to breathe.
It relieves coughing, wheezing, and feeling short of breath.
Your doctor will instruct you on how often to use your inhaler.
The effects of Duoclear Respules may be noticeable after a few days but usually reach their maximum after a few weeks.
Use it regularly for the best results.
Continue using it even if you do not have any symptoms, for as long as it is prescribed.
This medicine should not be used to relieve sudden shortness of breath.
If sudden shortness of breath occurs, use your rescue inhaler instead.The most common side effects include dry mouth, cough, tremor, headache, palpitations, muscle cramps, and sometimes shortness of breath.
You can help prevent some of these effects by rinsing your mouth and throat with water or brushing your teeth after using your inhaler.
Other, rarer side effects may be serious.
Talk to your doctor if you are worried about them.Before using Duoclear Respules, tell your doctor if you have any problems with your kidneys or liver, so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
Also, tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding to make sure it is safe for you.

faq.question: Can Duoclear Respules interact with other medicines?
faq.answer: Yes, Duoclear Respules can interact with certain medicines, so you should inform your doctor about all medicines, inhalers, and supplements you are using. It may interact with other anticholinergic medicines, other inhalers or heart medicines, diuretics (water tablets), digoxin, MAO inhibitors, and some antidepressants. These combinations may increase the risk of heart rhythm problems, low potassium levels, or stronger side effects. Always consult your doctor before starting or combining Duoclear Respules with any other medicine.

faq.question: What is Duoclear Respules used for and how does it work?
faq.answer: Duoclear Respules is used to help relieve breathing problems such as wheezing, shortness of breath, and chest tightness in conditions like asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It contains ipratropium bromide and levosalbutamol, which work together to relax and widen the airways in the lungs, making it easier to breathe. The medicine is usually given through a nebulizer so it can act directly in the lungs for faster symptom relief. It should be used only as prescribed by a doctor.

faq.question: Can I take more than the recommended dose of Duoclear Respules frequently?
faq.answer: No, taking more than the recommended dose of Duoclear Respules will not make it work better and may increase the risk of side effects such as fast heartbeat, tremors, or dizziness. Always use it exactly as prescribed by your doctor. If breathing symptoms are not relieved or continue to worsen, do not repeat doses too frequently on your own and seek medical advice promptly.

faq.question: What side effects should I watch for while using Duoclear Respules?
faq.answer: Duoclear Respules may cause dizziness, stomach upset, throat irritation, tremors, or a fast heartbeat in some people. These effects are usually mild and improve with time. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how the medicine affects you. Seek medical help immediately if you develop severe breathing difficulty, rash, swelling of the face, fainting, or persistent worsening symptoms.

faq.question: Can Duoclear Respules cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, Duoclear Respules may cause dryness of the mouth in some people. If this occurs, drink plenty of water and take small sips frequently during the day. Keeping water nearby at night may also help reduce discomfort.

faq.question: How should Duoclear Respules be stored and disposed of?
faq.answer: Keep Duoclear Respules in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions on the package label, usually in a cool and dry place. Dispose of any unused medicine safely and keep it out of reach of children and pets.

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Duoclear Respules?
faq.answer: If you miss a dose of Duoclear Respules, take it as soon as you remember unless it is almost time for your next scheduled dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the next dose to make up for the missed one. If you frequently miss doses, consult your doctor for guidance.

faq.question: Can Duoclear Respules be taken with food?
faq.answer: Duoclear Respules is used by inhalation through a nebulizer, so food does not significantly affect how it works. However, maintaining good hydration and avoiding foods that worsen breathing discomfort or acidity may help overall comfort. Always follow your doctor’s instructions for use.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while using Duoclear Respules?
faq.answer: It is generally better to avoid alcohol while using Duoclear Respules unless your doctor advises otherwise. Alcohol may increase dizziness, palpitations, or discomfort in some people. It is best to limit or avoid it. If you feel very dizzy, unusually sleepy, or unwell after mixing alcohol with this medicine, contact your doctor.

faq.question: Who should avoid Duoclear Respules?
faq.answer: Duoclear Respules should be used only if prescribed by a doctor, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use with caution in people with glaucoma, prostate problems, or heart rhythm disorders. Always inform your doctor about your medical history and other medicines before using it. Seek medical advice if you develop chest pain, severe dizziness, swelling, or unusual weakness while using this medicine.

faq.question: Can Duoclear Respules be used for sudden breathlessness?
faq.answer: No, Duoclear Respules is not meant for sudden breathing attacks. Use your rescue inhaler for quick relief and seek medical help if symptoms are severe.

Use this medicine regularly to get the maximum benefit and try to take it at the same time(s) each day.
Your dose may go up or down depending on how well it is working.
Do not take more than you are advised to and, if you miss a dose, do not take an extra one to make up for it.

faq.question: How should Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution be taken?

faq.question: How long does it take for Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution to work?

faq.question: What is Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution used for?
faq.answer: Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution is used to treat constipation which is presented as infrequent bowel movements, hard and dry stools. It is also used in patients with hepatic encephalopathy which is a serious liver problem causing confusion, tremors and decreased level of consciousness.

faq.question: Is Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution a laxative?
faq.answer: Yes, Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution is a laxative which softens the stools by pulling in water from the body to the large intestine. It is also used to reduce the amount of ammonia in the blood of patients with liver disease.

faq.question: What are the side effects of taking Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution very commonly causes diarrhea, flatulence, nausea, vomiting and abdominal pain. Diarrhea and abdominal pain occur due to a high dose. In such cases, the dose should be reduced. Flatulence may occur during the first few days of treatment and may disappear after sometime. This medicine may also cause electrolyte imbalance. However, this is an uncommon side effect.

faq.question: Is it okay to take Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution every day?
faq.answer: You should take Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution for as long as advised by your doctor. You may also take it for as long as constipation lasts, which may be up to a week. For hepatic encephalopathy, the treatment may be longer, even several months.

faq.question: Who should not be given Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution should not be given to patients who are allergic to it or are intolerant to lactose (cannot process lactose). It should also be avoided in patients having galactosemia, a rare health problem where the body cannot process galactose.

faq.question: Can I take other laxatives along with Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Usually, one laxative is sufficient to relieve constipation. In case you need more, your doctor may advise you to take one more laxative along with Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution. The risk of side effects is more with two laxatives.

faq.question: What if I take more than the recommended dose of Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution?
faq.answer: Taking more than the recommended dose of Duphalac Fiber Oral Solution may cause abdominal pain, electrolyte imbalance and diarrhea, which may last for a couple of days.

faq.question: How should Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon be taken?

faq.question: How long does it take for Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon to work?

faq.question: Is it okay to take Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon every day?

faq.question: Can I take other laxatives along with Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon?

Using multiple laxatives at the same time may increase the risk of diarrhea, dehydration, or electrolyte imbalance. If constipation persists, consult your doctor before adding any other medicine.

faq.question: What if I take more than the recommended dose of Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon?
faq.answer: Taking more than the recommended dose of Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon may cause diarrhea, stomach cramps, or dehydration. In some cases, it may also disturb your body’s electrolyte balance. If you have taken too much and feel unwell, contact your doctor for advice. Drink enough fluids if diarrhea occurs.

faq.question: What is Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon is a laxative. It is commonly used to treat constipation by helping soften the stool and making it easier to pass. In some cases, it may also be prescribed for certain liver-related conditions where reducing blood ammonia levels is required. Your doctor will decide the appropriate use based on your condition.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon if I have diabetes?
faq.answer: Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon contains small amounts of sugars such as lactose and galactose. These sugars are absorbed in small amounts, but they may affect blood glucose levels if taken in high doses or for a long time. If you have diabetes, inform your doctor before starting this medicine. Your blood sugar may need to be monitored during treatment.

faq.question: Does Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon cause gas or abdominal bloating?
faq.answer: Gas, bloating, and mild stomach cramps are common, especially during the first few days of treatment. These effects occur because gut bacteria break down the sugars in the medicine, which can produce gas. These symptoms often improve with continued use. Consult your doctor if the discomfort becomes severe or persistent.

faq.question: Is Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon safe for patients with lactose intolerance?
faq.answer: Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon contains small amounts of lactose. People with lactose intolerance may experience gas, bloating, or stomach cramps after taking it. If you are sensitive to dairy products, inform your doctor before starting this medicine. They can decide whether this option is suitable for you.

faq.question: Does Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon help with acidity or gas?
faq.answer: No, Duphalac Oral Solution Lemon is not an antacid. It is used to relieve constipation by promoting bowel movements. It may actually increase gas during the initial days of use. If you have symptoms such as heartburn or reflux, talk to your doctor about appropriate treatment options.

description:
Durabec Breath Inhaler is a combination medicine used to treat asthma.
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages, thus widening it and making it easier to breathe.
Durabec Breath Inhaler is taken with or without food in a dose and duration as advised by the doctor.
The dose you are given will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
You should keep taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early your symptoms may come back and your condition may worsen.
Let your healthcare team know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, headache,and cough.
Most of these are temporary and usually resolve with time.
Contact your doctor straight away if you are at all concerned about any of these side effects.
It may cause sleepiness and dizziness, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine as it can worsen your sleepiness.Before taking this medicine, you should tell your doctor if you have any kidney or liver diseases so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
You should also tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

faq.question: When should I take Durabec Breath Inhaler?
faq.answer: Use one inhalation of Durabec Breath Inhaler once daily, either morning or evening, but at the same time each day. This will help to keep you free of symptoms throughout the day and night. Do not take more than 1 inhalation per day. After inhalation, rinse your mouth with water without swallowing.

faq.question: Do I still need to take Durabec Breath Inhaler even when I am feeling better?
faq.answer: Yes, it is advisable to use this medicine for as long as your doctor prescribes. It will only be effective as long as you are using it. Do not stop using it unless your doctor advises you to, even if you feel better, as your symptoms may get worse.

faq.question: What should I tell my doctor before using Durabec Breath Inhaler?
faq.answer: Before using Durabec Breath Inhaler, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions, including if you have heart problems, high blood pressure, thyroid, liver and kidney problems, diabetes, and eye problems like glaucoma, or if you are allergic to any food or medicines or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

faq.question: Is Durabec Breath Inhaler safe to be used in children?
faq.answer: No, this inhaler should not be used in children younger than 18 years of age as the safety and efficacy of Durabec Breath Inhaler have not been established in pediatric patients.

faq.question: Can Durabec Breath Inhaler cause a fungal infection inside the mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, you may get a fungal infection or thrush inside your mouth with the use of this inhaler. Rinse your mouth with water without swallowing after using Durabec Breath Inhaler to help reduce your chance of getting thrush.

faq.question: Can I smoke if I have been prescribed Durabec Breath Inhaler?
faq.answer: No, you should not smoke while taking Durabec Breath Inhaler. Smoking irritates the lungs and will make your condition worse. Take advice from your doctor if you are finding it hard to avoid smoking.

faq.question: I have started using Durabec Breath Inhaler and I am experiencing headaches. Is this because of Durabec Breath Inhaler and will these go away?
faq.answer: Yes, it could be due to Durabec Breath Inhaler. For any kind of pain after using Durabec Breath Inhaler, it is advisable to take sufficient rest, have a good diet, and avoid alcohol. Usually, headaches go away after a week. If they persist for a long time, contact your doctor.

description:
Durabolin 25 Injection is a medicine used in the treatment of osteoporosis in post-menopausal women, a certain type of anemia, and breast cancer.
It works by helping build and strengthen body tissues, including bones and muscles, and supports red blood cell production, which makes it beneficial in these conditions.
Durabolin 25 Injection is generally given by a healthcare professional.
You should not self-administer this medicine at home.
Your doctor will decide the dose and how often you should take them.
You should take it regularly to get the most benefit from it.
Do not stop using the medicine even if you feel better unless the doctor tells you so.Using this medicine may cause a few common side effects such as pain at the injection site, hypertension, acne, itching, nausea, abnormal liver function & increased or decreased sexual desire.
Let your doctor know if any of these side effects bother you.Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems.
You should also tell your doctor all the other medicines you are taking.
Pregnant and breastfeeding mothers should consult with their doctors before using the medicine.

faq.question: What is Durabolin 25 Injection used for?
faq.answer: Durabolin 25 Injection belongs to the group of medicines called anabolic steroids. It is used to treat osteoporosis in postmenopausal women, certain types of anemia, and breast cancer (in women). It can also be used to treat patients on long-term steroid therapy.

faq.question: Who should not take Durabolin 25 Injection?
faq.answer: Individuals should not use Durabolin 25 Injection if they have prostate cancer, male breast cancer, breast cancer in women with high calcium levels, certain kidney diseases, or if they are pregnant.

faq.question: What are the major warnings for Durabolin 25 Injection?
faq.answer: Durabolin 25 Injection can cause serious liver problems such as blood-filled cysts or liver tumors, changes in cholesterol that increase heart disease risk, swelling due to fluid retention, and high calcium levels in women with certain cancers.

faq.question: What precautions should I take while using Durabolin 25 Injection?
faq.answer: While using Durabolin 25 Injection, your doctor will monitor your liver, heart, and kidney health, blood calcium, cholesterol levels, and bone growth in children. Women should watch for signs of masculinization, such as a deep voice or facial hair.

faq.question: Can Durabolin 25 Injection be used to improve sports performance?
faq.answer: No, Durabolin 25 Injection is not approved or safe for enhancing athletic performance. Misuse can cause serious health risks and is banned in competitive sports.

Duralyn Pead Syrup is used to treat and prevent symptoms of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (a lung disorder in which flow of air to the lung is blocked).
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages, thus widening it and making it easier to breathe.
Duralyn Pead Syrup can be taken with the food in the evening.
Take it at the same time every day to get the most benefit.
The dose and how often you take it depends on what you are taking it for.
Your doctor will decide how much you need to improve your symptoms.
Take it for as long as it is prescribed for you.
Do not miss even a single dose, if in any case, you missed a dose, take it as soon as you remember it.
It does not work immediately or prevent the already started breathing trouble, hence always carry your medical inhaler with you for an emergency.The most common side effects of this medicine include vomiting, headache, nausea, stomach upset, and insomnia.
If these bother you or appear serious, let your doctor know.
There may be ways of reducing or preventing them.
Generally, it is advised not to consume alcohol or do not smoke while on treatment.
You must avoid high caffeinated products like coffee, tea, and dark chocolates as it enhances drug side effects.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease or if you have heart-related problems.
Your doctor should also know about all other medicines you are taking as many of these may make this medicine less effective or change the way it works.
Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before starting the treatment.

faq.question: How quickly does Duralyn Pead Syrup work?
faq.answer: Duralyn Pead Syrup starts acting quickly and you may notice improvement in symptoms within about half an hour of taking it. However, the medicine may take a little longer about 4-8 hours to show full effect. Consult your doctor if there is no considerable improvement in your symptoms.

faq.question: What foods to avoid while taking Duralyn Pead Syrup?
faq.answer: While on Duralyn Pead Syrup you should avoid foods rich in caffeine like tea, cocoa, coffee, and chocolate. These foods can increase side effects associated with Duralyn Pead Syrup. In addition to that, you should avoid alcohol and tobacco while on Duralyn Pead Syrup. Discuss with your doctor if you are not sure or have any concerns regarding food restriction.

faq.question: How should Duralyn Pead Syrup be taken?
faq.answer: Take the medicine exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Usually, it is prescribed to be taken twice a day. Do not crush or chew the tablets. The capsules can be taken whole or opened and the contents mixed with soft food and swallowed without chewing.

description:
Durite Plus 10 Tablet is used to treat edema (swelling) caused by conditions such as heart failure, liver disease, kidney disease, or pulmonary edema.
It helps the body eliminate excess fluid.
It is also used to treat high blood pressure, helping to lower strain on the heart and improve overall circulation.
Durite Plus 10 Tablet is best taken in the morning along with food to avoid frequent urination at night.
For better results, it is suggested that you take it at the same time every day.
The dose and frequency of administration depend on the condition being treated.
Your doctor will decide how much you need to improve your symptoms.
You should take this medicine for as long as it is prescribed for you.Common side effects of Durite Plus 10 Tablet include dizziness, frequent urination, headache, diarrhea, and period pain.
If any of these side effects persist or worsen, let your doctor know.
They may be able to suggest ways to manage or treat them.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have any liver or kidney disease.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
You should also let your doctor know all other medicines you are taking, as they may affect, or be affected by, this medicine.

faq.question: What is Durite Plus 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Durite Plus 10 Tablet is a fixed-dose combination of torasemide (a loop diuretic) and spironolactone (an antagonist of aldosterone). Both are diuretics, and they help to remove excess fluid from the body. This medicine is prescribed for individuals with edema.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Durite Plus 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, Durite Plus 10 Tablet is safe to use in most patients. However, in some patients, it may cause common side effects like dizziness, frequent urge to urinate, and headache. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problems while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady, or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: Can the use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet cause dehydration (excessive loss of fluid)?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet can cause dehydration (excessive loss of fluid). Inform your doctor if you experience persistent problems while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium levels)?
faq.answer: Yes, Durite Plus 10 Tablet can cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium levels). This occurs more commonly in patients with underlying kidney disease or patients taking excessive potassium in their diet. High potassium levels can cause fatal heart problems. It is very important to get electrolytes and kidney function tests done regularly while you are taking this medicine.

faq.question: What are the contraindications to the use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Durite Plus 10 Tablet should be avoided in patients with hypersensitivity to torasemide, sulfonylureas, spironolactone, or any other ingredient of the product. The use of this medicine should also be avoided in patients with anuria, acute renal insufficiency, hepatic coma and pre-coma, low blood pressure (hypotension), cardiac arrhythmias, patients taking aminoglycosides or cephalosporins, kidney dysfunction due to drugs that cause renal damage, patients with high potassium levels (hyperkalemia), Addison's disease, and in children with moderate to severe renal impairment.

faq.question: What is the storage condition for the Durite Plus 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, and other people.

description:
Dutaresp Respules is used for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (a lung disorder in which the flow of air to the lungs is blocked).
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages and making it easier to breathe.
It relieves coughing, wheezing, and feeling short of breath.
Your doctor will instruct you on how often to use your inhaler.
The effects of Dutaresp Respules may be noticeable after a few days but usually reach their maximum after a few weeks.
Use it regularly for the best results.
Continue using it even if you do not have any symptoms, for as long as it is prescribed.
This medicine should not be used to relieve sudden shortness of breath.
If sudden shortness of breath occurs, use your rescue inhaler instead.The most common side effects include dry mouth, cough, tremor, headache, palpitations, muscle cramps, and sometimes shortness of breath.
You can help prevent some of these effects by rinsing your mouth and throat with water or brushing your teeth after using your inhaler.
Other, rarer side effects may be serious.
Talk to your doctor if you are worried about them.Before using Dutaresp Respules, tell your doctor if you have any problems with your kidneys or liver, so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
Also, tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding to make sure it is safe for you.

faq.question: Can Dutaresp Respules interact with other medicines?
faq.answer: Yes, Dutaresp Respules can interact with certain medicines, so you should inform your doctor about all medicines, inhalers, and supplements you are using. It may interact with other anticholinergic medicines, other inhalers or heart medicines, diuretics (water tablets), digoxin, MAO inhibitors, and some antidepressants. These combinations may increase the risk of heart rhythm problems, low potassium levels, or stronger side effects. Always consult your doctor before starting or combining Dutaresp Respules with any other medicine.

faq.question: What is Dutaresp Respules used for and how does it work?
faq.answer: Dutaresp Respules is used to help relieve breathing problems such as wheezing, shortness of breath, and chest tightness in conditions like asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It contains ipratropium bromide and levosalbutamol, which work together to relax and widen the airways in the lungs, making it easier to breathe. The medicine is usually given through a nebulizer so it can act directly in the lungs for faster symptom relief. It should be used only as prescribed by a doctor.

faq.question: Can I take more than the recommended dose of Dutaresp Respules frequently?
faq.answer: No, taking more than the recommended dose of Dutaresp Respules will not make it work better and may increase the risk of side effects such as fast heartbeat, tremors, or dizziness. Always use it exactly as prescribed by your doctor. If breathing symptoms are not relieved or continue to worsen, do not repeat doses too frequently on your own and seek medical advice promptly.

faq.question: What side effects should I watch for while using Dutaresp Respules?
faq.answer: Dutaresp Respules may cause dizziness, stomach upset, throat irritation, tremors, or a fast heartbeat in some people. These effects are usually mild and improve with time. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how the medicine affects you. Seek medical help immediately if you develop severe breathing difficulty, rash, swelling of the face, fainting, or persistent worsening symptoms.

faq.question: Can Dutaresp Respules cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, Dutaresp Respules may cause dryness of the mouth in some people. If this occurs, drink plenty of water and take small sips frequently during the day. Keeping water nearby at night may also help reduce discomfort.

faq.question: How should Dutaresp Respules be stored and disposed of?
faq.answer: Keep Dutaresp Respules in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions on the package label, usually in a cool and dry place. Dispose of any unused medicine safely and keep it out of reach of children and pets.

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Dutaresp Respules?
faq.answer: If you miss a dose of Dutaresp Respules, take it as soon as you remember unless it is almost time for your next scheduled dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the next dose to make up for the missed one. If you frequently miss doses, consult your doctor for guidance.

faq.question: Can Dutaresp Respules be taken with food?
faq.answer: Dutaresp Respules is used by inhalation through a nebulizer, so food does not significantly affect how it works. However, maintaining good hydration and avoiding foods that worsen breathing discomfort or acidity may help overall comfort. Always follow your doctor’s instructions for use.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while using Dutaresp Respules?
faq.answer: It is generally better to avoid alcohol while using Dutaresp Respules unless your doctor advises otherwise. Alcohol may increase dizziness, palpitations, or discomfort in some people. It is best to limit or avoid it. If you feel very dizzy, unusually sleepy, or unwell after mixing alcohol with this medicine, contact your doctor.

faq.question: Who should avoid Dutaresp Respules?
faq.answer: Dutaresp Respules should be used only if prescribed by a doctor, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use with caution in people with glaucoma, prostate problems, or heart rhythm disorders. Always inform your doctor about your medical history and other medicines before using it. Seek medical advice if you develop chest pain, severe dizziness, swelling, or unusual weakness while using this medicine.

faq.question: Can Dutaresp Respules be used for sudden breathlessness?
faq.answer: No, Dutaresp Respules is not meant for sudden breathing attacks. Use your rescue inhaler for quick relief and seek medical help if symptoms are severe.

description:
Duvent-PD Syrup is used for the treatment of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (a lung disorder in which the flow of air to the lungs is blocked).
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages and making it easier to breathe.
It relieves coughing, wheezing and feeling short of breath.
Duvent-PD Syrup is taken without food in a dose and duration as advised by the doctor.
It is better to take it with food to avoid stomach upset.
The dose you are given will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
You should keep taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early your symptoms may come back and your condition may worsen.
Let your healthcare team know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, tremor, headache, palpitations, muscle cramps, restlessness, and increased heart rate.
Most of these are temporary and usually resolve with time.
Contact your doctor straight away if you are at all concerned about any of these side effects.
This medicine may also cause dizziness and sleepiness, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine as it can worsen your sleepiness.Before taking it, you should tell your doctor if you have any kidney or liver diseases so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
You should also tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

description:
Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet is used to treat edema (swelling) caused by conditions such as heart failure, liver disease, kidney disease, or pulmonary edema.
It helps the body eliminate excess fluid.
It is also used to treat high blood pressure, helping to lower strain on the heart and improve overall circulation.
Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet is best taken in the morning along with food to avoid frequent urination at night.
For better results, it is suggested that you take it at the same time every day.
The dose and frequency of administration depend on the condition being treated.
Your doctor will decide how much you need to improve your symptoms.
You should take this medicine for as long as it is prescribed for you.Common side effects of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet include dizziness, frequent urination, headache, diarrhea, and period pain.
If any of these side effects persist or worsen, let your doctor know.
They may be able to suggest ways to manage or treat them.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have any liver or kidney disease.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
You should also let your doctor know all other medicines you are taking, as they may affect, or be affected by, this medicine.

faq.question: What is Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet is a fixed-dose combination of torasemide (a loop diuretic) and spironolactone (an antagonist of aldosterone). Both are diuretics, and they help to remove excess fluid from the body. This medicine is prescribed for individuals with edema.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet is safe to use in most patients. However, in some patients, it may cause common side effects like dizziness, frequent urge to urinate, and headache. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problems while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady, or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: Can the use of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet cause dehydration (excessive loss of fluid)?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet can cause dehydration (excessive loss of fluid). Inform your doctor if you experience persistent problems while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium levels)?
faq.answer: Yes, Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet can cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium levels). This occurs more commonly in patients with underlying kidney disease or patients taking excessive potassium in their diet. High potassium levels can cause fatal heart problems. It is very important to get electrolytes and kidney function tests done regularly while you are taking this medicine.

faq.question: What are the contraindications to the use of Dyloop Plus 10 Tablet?

description:
DynaDuo 25 Tablet is a combination medicine that helps control blood sugar levels.
This medicine is used with diet and exercise to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
It helps properly utilize insulin, thereby lowering the blood sugar level.
DynaDuo 25 Tablet can be taken with or without food at any time of day, but you should try to take it at the same time every day.
Your doctor will decide the dose.
Don't stop taking it without asking your doctor.
If you do, your blood sugar levels may increase, putting you at risk of serious complications like kidney damage and blindness.
This medicine is only part of a treatment program that should include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction, as your doctor advises.This medicine's most common side effects are urinary tract infections, nasopharyngitis, and upper respiratory tract infections.
Drinking plenty of fluids while using it will help prevent dehydration.
Some people may develop fungal infections in the genital area.
Maintaining good hygiene can help prevent this.Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver problems, a urinary tract infection, or are taking water pills (diuretics).
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Avoid excessive alcohol intake while taking it, as this may increase the risk of developing some side effects.
Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly while taking this medicine.

faq.question: What is DynaDuo 25 Tablet, and how does it work?
faq.answer: DynaDuo 25 Tablet combines two medications, empagliflozin and linagliptin, used to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes. Empagliflozin helps the kidneys remove excess glucose through urine, while linagliptin increases insulin secretion and lowers glucose production by inhibiting the DPP-4 enzyme.

faq.question: Who is DynaDuo 25 Tablet prescribed for?
faq.answer: DynaDuo 25 Tablet is prescribed for adults with type 2 diabetes to improve blood sugar levels when diet and exercise alone are not enough. It may also be used in people with type 2 diabetes who have cardiovascular disease to reduce the risk of heart-related complications.

faq.question: How should I take DynaDuo 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: DynaDuo 25 Tablet is taken once daily, with or without food, as directed by your doctor. It is important to follow your prescribed dosage and schedule. Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Can DynaDuo 25 Tablet be used for type 1 diabetes?
faq.answer: No, DynaDuo 25 Tablet is not recommended for individuals with type 1 diabetes or those with diabetic ketoacidosis. It is specifically for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: Can DynaDuo 25 Tablet cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)?
faq.answer: DynaDuo 25 Tablet alone is unlikely to cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), but the risk may increase when taken with other diabetes medications such as insulin or sulfonylureas. Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly and follow your healthcare provider's recommendations to prevent hypoglycemia.

faq.question: Can DynaDuo 25 Tablet be taken during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
faq.answer: DynaDuo 25 Tablet is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss alternative diabetes treatments with your doctor.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking DynaDuo 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: While taking DynaDuo 25 Tablet, avoid alcohol as it can increase the risk of low blood sugar or dehydration. Also, make sure to stay hydrated, especially if you're engaging in activities that may cause fluid loss, such as exercise or hot weather.

faq.question: Can DynaDuo 25 Tablet help with weight loss?
faq.answer: Empagliflozin, one of the components of DynaDuo 25 Tablet, may promote mild weight loss by helping your body excrete excess glucose through urine. However, DynaDuo 25 Tablet is not specifically prescribed for weight loss and should be used only as directed for managing type 2 diabetes.

faq.question: How should DynaDuo 25 Tablet be stored?
faq.answer: Store DynaDuo 25 Tablet at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light. Keep it out of reach of children and pets, and do not use the medication after its expiration date.

faq.question: What should I do in case of an overdose?
faq.answer: If you suspect an overdose, seek emergency medical attention immediately. Symptoms of an overdose may include severe dizziness, fainting, or signs of low blood sugar, such as confusion, sweating, and rapid heartbeat.

faq.question: Can DynaDuo 25 Tablet be used with other diabetes medications?
faq.answer: Yes, DynaDuo 25 Tablet can be used with other diabetes medications if prescribed by your doctor. However, it is important to monitor your blood sugar levels carefully, as combining multiple medications can increase the risk of hypoglycemia or other side effects.

faq.question: What should I know before taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet?
faq.answer: Before taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet, you should tell your doctor if you are allergic to Ecosprin 325 Tablet or any of its ingredients to avoid any allergic reactions. faq.question: How does Ecosprin 325 Tablet work?
faq.answer: Ecosprin 325 Tablet works by stopping the production of prostaglandin, the chemical responsible for sending pain signals to the brain and also causes swelling and fever. faq.question: How long does it take Ecosprin 325 Tablet to start working?
faq.answer: Ecosprin 325 Tablet starts working within 20 to 30 minutes after taking it. However, if you do not notice any significant improvement in your condition, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Ecosprin 325 Tablet for a long time?
faq.answer: Ecosprin 325 Tablet may be taken safely for a long time provided that you take it as prescribed by the doctor. This will reduce the chances of developing unwanted side effects and you can get the maximum benefit from the medicine.

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, you may drink alcohol while taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet. However, drinking too much alcohol while taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet may irritate your stomach. Consult your doctor if you have any stomach -related problems while taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet.

faq.question: How long should I take Ecosprin 325 Tablet for?
faq.answer: You will need to take Ecosprin 325 Tablet for the rest of your life unless stopped by your doctor.

faq.question: When will I feel better after taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet?
faq.answer: Ecosprin 325 Tablet is known to reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke. You may not feel any difference after taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet. Keep taking it as prescribed by your doctor to keep getting the benefits.

faq.question: How long does Ecosprin 325 Tablet take to clear from the body?
faq.answer: It takes around 10 days for Ecosprin 325 Tablet to get cleared from the body after completely stopping this medicine.

faq.question: Why is Ecosprin 325 Tablet given in pregnancy?
faq.answer: Ecosprin 325 Tablet is generally not recommended in pregnancy. However, Ecosprin 325 Tablet may be given in lower doses in certain medical conditions like pre-eclampsia or other clotting disorders.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Ecosprin 325 Tablet?
faq.answer: Take Ecosprin 325 Tablet as prescribed by your doctor. According to a recent study, taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet at nighttime, before you go to sleep, is more effective in reducing the risk of heart attack and stroke.

faq.question: Will I need to stop Ecosprin 325 Tablet before surgery or dental procedure?
faq.answer: Ecosprin 325 Tablet may increase the risk of bleeding during a surgery or dental procedure. Therefore, you may be asked by your doctor to stop taking Ecosprin 325 Tablet. But, never stop taking it on your own.

Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule is a combination of two medicines used to prevent heart attack and stroke.

Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule should be taken with food to avoid stomach upset.
You should take it regularly at evenly spaced intervals as per the schedule prescribed by your doctor.

You should also let your healthcare team know all other medicines you are taking, as they may affect or be affected by this medicine.

faq.question: Can Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule affect the liver?
faq.answer: Yes, Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule may cause liver damage and should be used with caution in patients who consume substantial quantities of alcohol or have a past history of liver disease.

faq.question: What are the recommended storage conditions for Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, and other people.

faq.question: Can the Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule cause muscle pain?
faq.answer: Yes, Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule may cause muscle pain due to muscle injury. However, this side effect does not occur in everybody. Talk to your doctor as soon as possible if you are experiencing symptoms such as muscle pain or weakness.

faq.question: Will I need to stop Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule before surgery or a dental procedure?
faq.answer: Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule may increase the risk of bleeding during a surgery or dental procedure. Therefore, you may be asked by your doctor to stop taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule. You should not stop taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule on your own.

faq.question: What are the lifestyle changes one should adopt while taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule?
faq.answer: Making lifestyle changes can boost your health while taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule. Avoid smoking, as smoking increases your risk of having a heart attack and stroke. If you are overweight or obese, try to lose weight. You should maintain a healthy diet by including fruits and vegetables in your meals. Regular exercise can make your heart strong and decrease your risk of a heart attack.

faq.question: Which painkiller is safe while taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule?
faq.answer: Paracetamol is safe to use while taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule for reducing pain. Avoid the use of other painkillers while taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule, as they may increase the risk of bleeding.

faq.question: Which medicines should I avoid while taking Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule?
faq.answer: Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule can interact with several medicines and can cause serious problems. Talk to your doctor and inform them about using Ecosprin AV 150/20 Capsule before taking any prescription or nonprescription medicine.

This helps prevent serious complications of diabetes.
Glicazide 40 Tablet may be prescribed alone or along with other medicines.
It should be taken with food.
Take it regularly at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
Your doctor will decide what dose is best for you, which may change from time to time according to how it works.
Continue using this medicine as prescribed, even if you feel fine or your blood sugar levels are stable.
If you stop it without consulting your doctor, your blood sugar levels could rise and put you at risk of kidney damage, blindness, and nerve problems.Keep in mind that this medicine is just one part of your treatment plan.
It should be combined with a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight management as recommended by your doctor.
Your lifestyle plays a crucial role in managing diabetes.The most common side effects of taking this medicine include diarrhea and headaches.
It can also cause low blood glucose levels (hypoglycemia).
Make sure you recognize the signs of having low blood glucose levels, such as sweating, dizziness, headache, and shaking.
You must know how to deal with it.To prevent hypoglycemic conditions, have regular meals and always carry a fast-acting source of glucose, such as sugary food or fruit juice, with you.
Consuming alcohol can raise the risk of low blood sugar and should be avoided.
Additionally, some individuals may experience weight gain while taking this medicine.
You should not take Glicazide 40 Tablet if you have type 1 diabetes mellitus, diabetic ketoacidosis (high levels of acid in your blood), or severe kidney or liver disease.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had heart disease, thyroid disease, or some hormonal conditions.
It may not be suitable.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Regularly monitor your blood sugar levels, and your doctor may recommend blood tests to check your blood cell counts and liver function.

faq.question: What is Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule?
faq.answer: Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule is a combination of three medicines: aspirin/acetylsalicylic acid, atorvastatin, and clopidogrel. Aspirin and clopidogrel are antiplatelet medicines. They work by preventing the platelets from sticking together and decreasing the formation of harmful blood clots. On the other hand, atorvastatin is a lipid-lowering medicine that blocks an enzyme that makes cholesterol in the body. It lowers the "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides and raises the "good" cholesterol (HDL).

faq.question: Can the use of Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady, or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: Can the use of Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule cause nausea and vomiting?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule can cause nausea and vomiting. Taking it with milk, food, or antacids can prevent nausea. Avoid eating fatty or fried foods along with this medication. In case of vomiting, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small, frequent sips. Consult your doctor if vomiting continues and you experience dehydration symptoms, such as dark, strong-smelling urine or infrequent urination. Do not take any other medicine without speaking to a doctor.

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for the Ecosprin Gold 40 Capsule?
faq.answer: Store this medicine in its original container or packaging, ensuring it is tightly sealed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, and other people.

faq.question: What should I know about high cholesterol?
faq.answer: Cholesterol is a type of fat present in your blood. Total cholesterol is determined by the total amount of LDL and HDL cholesterol in the body. LDL cholesterol is called “bad” cholesterol. Bad cholesterol can build up in the wall of your blood vessels and slow or obstruct blood flow to your heart, brain, and other organs. This can cause heart disease and stroke. HDL cholesterol is called “good” cholesterol as it prevents the bad cholesterol from building up in the blood vessels. High levels of triglycerides are also harmful to you.

faq.question: Can LipVAS 40 Tablet cause muscle problems or muscle injury?
faq.answer: Yes, taking LipVAS 40 Tablet can cause muscle problems or muscle injury. This is because of the reduced oxygen supply to the muscle cells which leads to fatigue, muscle pain, tenderness, or muscle weakness. The soreness may be significant enough to interfere with your daily activities. Do not take it lightly and consult your doctor to know about ways to prevent this and to avoid making it worse.

faq.question: Is LipVAS 40 Tablet used for lowering cholesterol?
faq.answer: LipVAS 40 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as statins, which lowers the level of lipids or fats. LipVAS 40 Tablet is used to lower lipids known as cholesterol and triglycerides in the blood when a low-fat diet and lifestyle changes fail to lower the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides. If you are at an increased risk of heart disease, LipVAS 40 Tablet can also be used to reduce such risk even if your cholesterol levels are normal. You should maintain a standard cholesterol-lowering diet during treatment.

faq.question: Can LipVAS 40 Tablet be prescribed to children?
faq.answer: LipVAS 40 Tablet is for adults and children aged 10 years or more whose cholesterol levels do not come down enough with exercise and a low-fat diet. It is not approved for use in patients younger than 10 years old.

faq.question: Is LipVAS 40 Tablet a blood thinner?
faq.answer: No, LipVAS 40 Tablet is not a blood thinner. It is a cholesterol-lowering medicine. It works by slowing down the production of cholesterol in the body. This further decreases the amount of cholesterol that may build up on the walls of the arteries and block blood flow to the part of the body. By lowering the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides it prevents the chances of stroke and heart attack.

faq.question: Will taking LipVAS 40 Tablet lead to an increase in my risk of diabetes?
faq.answer: If you are at high risk of developing type 2 diabetes, taking LipVAS 40 Tablet may increase this risk slightly. This is because LipVAS 40 Tablet can raise your blood sugar a little. If you already have type 2 diabetes, your doctor may advise monitoring your blood sugar levels more closely for the first few months. faq.question: How long does it take for Telma 40 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: You may see an improvement within a few days. But, the maximum benefit can be seen within 4-8 weeks of starting treatment.

faq.question: My blood pressure is now controlled. Can I stop taking Telma 40 Tablet now?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking Telma 40 Tablet without consulting your doctor even if your blood pressure is controlled. faq.question: Can the use of Telma 40 Tablet cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium level in blood)?
faq.answer: Yes, Telma 40 Tablet can cause hyperkalemia (increased potassium level in blood). A regular monitoring of blood potassium levels may be advised by your doctor while taking this medicine.

faq.question: If I have some kidney problem, can I take Telma 40 Tablet? Can it further deteriorate my kidney function?
faq.answer: You can take Telma 40 Tablet if it has been advised by your doctor. Your doctor may ask you to get regular tests done (potassium and creatinine levels) in order to monitor your kidney function. Telma 40 Tablet may cause worsening of kidney function, therefore you should contact your doctor in case you notice swelling in your feet, ankles, or hands or unexplained weight gain.

faq.question: I am overweight and the doctor has prescribed me Telma 40 Tablet for blood pressure control. I am bothered that Telma 40 Tablet can increase my weight. Is it true?
faq.answer: No, do not worry since Telma 40 Tablet is not known to cause weight gain. In fact in animal studies Telma 40 Tablet has been found to decrease fat tissue.

faq.question: Does Telma 40 Tablet affect blood glucose levels in diabetics?
faq.answer: Telma 40 Tablet may lower blood glucose levels in patients with diabetes. Therefore, it is essential to keep a regular track of your blood glucose levels. Talk to your doctor if you are a diabetic because the dose of insulin or antidiabetic medicines may need adjustment.

faq.question: Do I need to follow any precautions if I take ibuprofen and Telma 40 Tablet together?
faq.answer: If you are taking ibuprofen and Telma 40 Tablet together, you should continuously keep a check on your blood pressure and kidney function. Telma 40 Tablet may enhance the side effects of ibuprofen which may further cause water retention, especially in patients taking Telma 40 Tablet for heart failure. Ibuprofen may interfere with the working of Telma 40 Tablet and decrease its efficiency at lowering blood pressure.

faq.question: Does Telma 40 Tablet work by causing excessive urination?
faq.answer: No, Telma 40 Tablet does not cause excessive urination and does not belong to the diuretic class of medicines. Telma 40 Tablet works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking the effect of a substance known as angiotensin II. This substance is responsible for increasing the blood pressure by narrowing down the blood vessels.

faq.question: What is ATOrva gold 40 Capsule?
