faq.answer: Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet may cause hair loss but not in everyone. It has been seen that on discontinuing Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet or replacing Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet with another medicine, there is improvement, and hair loss reverses.

faq.question: Who should not take Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should not take Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet if you have serious liver disorder or serious blood disorder. You should also avoid taking this medicine if you are pregnant or are allergic to Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet or any of the ingredients present in it Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet.

faq.question: My sister is taking Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet for overactive thyroid gland. She frequently gets sore throat and stops and restarts the treatment again and again. Is there any risk if she continues to take Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet when she has sore throat?
faq.answer: Very rarely, Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet interferes with the bone marrow and causes a drastic drop in white blood cells. These white blood cells are a part of the body's defense against bacterial infections, such as sore throats. So, a sore throat can sometimes be the first clue that Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet is affecting the bone marrow. Your sister should contact her doctor and get a blood test. If a blood test shows her white blood cell count to be normal, then she can continue Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet. If not, she should stop the treatment after consulting the doctor.

faq.question: How does Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet affect children?
faq.answer: The effectiveness and side effects of Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet in children are more or less the same as in adults. Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet should not be used in children less than 2 years of age.

faq.question: I have been taking warfarin, so will it have any effect on Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet therapy?
faq.answer: If you have started taking Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet, the dose of warfarin may need adjustment. You should consult your doctor and get your bleeding time checked so that the dose can be adjusted according to the results of the investigations.

faq.question: Even if my liver is normal, can Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet cause any liver problems?
faq.answer: Yes, Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet may cause liver problems, though not in everyone. A very common side effect of Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet can be the yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice). It may also cause abnormal liver function tests, hepatitis, etc. If you notice jaundice, you should discontinue Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet and seek immediate medical advice.

faq.question: If I am planning my pregnancy, can I continue taking Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is advisable not to take Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet during pregnancy as it may cause abnormalities in your baby. You should consult your doctor because if your thyroid hormone levels are not controlled, the chances of birth defects in your baby are much more. In case Neo-Mercazole 20 Tablet is the only option for you, your doctor will prescribe the lowest possible dose, which will be regulated according to your condition. You can stop it 3-4 weeks before delivery to reduce the chances of complications in your baby.

name: neo-mercazole

description:
Neobet Tablet is a steroid.
It is used in the treatment of inflammation, severe allergies, and flare-ups of ongoing illnesses.
It is also used to treat many other medical problems that require either reduction of inflammation or suppression of the immune system.
Neobet Tablet may be taken with or without food.
It should be taken exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Your doctor will decide the dose and how often you should take them.
You should take this medicine regularly to get the most benefit from it.
Do not stop taking the medicine even if you feel better unless the doctor tells you so.Using the medicine may cause few common side effects such as a reduction in bone density and an upset stomach.
Let your doctor know if any of these side effects bother you.
If this medicine is used for a long time, you may have to get regular tests to check your bone density.Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic to any medicine or have liver problems.
This medicine is not recommended during pregnancy.
Pregnant and breastfeeding mothers should consult with their doctors before using the medicine.

faq.question: How does Neobet Tablet work?
faq.answer: Neobet Tablet works by decreasing the inflammation caused by allergies. It reduces inflammation by blocking the release of certain natural substances that cause allergic symptoms such as swelling, redness, and pain.

faq.question: Is Neobet Tablet safe to use?
faq.answer: Neobet Tablet is safe to use when used for an indication in a dose as advised by your doctor. You should not take this medicine if you are allergic to Neobet Tablet or any of the other ingredients of this medicine. Furthermore, you should not take Neobet Tablet if you have an infection and have not yet started medicine (e.g. antibiotics) to treat it.

faq.question: Does Neobet Tablet cause hair loss?
faq.answer: No, Neobet Tablet is not known to cause hair loss. In fact, it may cause an increase in body hair growth (especially in females) when used for a long-term duration. Talk to your doctor if you get excessive hair growth on your body while taking Neobet Tablet.

faq.question: Does Neobet Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Yes, Neobet Tablet may cause weight gain, especially when taken at high doses and used for a long time or repeated short courses. Please consult your doctor if you experience weight gain after taking Neobet Tablet.

faq.question: Is Neobet Tablet over the counter medicine?
faq.answer: No, Neobet Tablet is not an over-the-counter (OTC) medicine. It is available only when prescribed by a doctor.

faq.question: Is Neobet Tablet a steroid?
faq.answer: Yes, Neobet Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called steroids also known as corticosteroids. Corticosteroids occur naturally in the body and help to maintain health and well-being. Neobet Tablet increases the levels of corticosteroids in the body which helps in treating various illnesses involving inflammation (redness, tenderness, heat, and swelling). Many different conditions such as asthma, severe allergic reactions, rheumatoid arthritis, autoimmune diseases, etc can be improved by the use of Neobet Tablet, as they reduce inflammation in the body.

faq.question: What if I forget to take a dose of Neobet Tablet?
faq.answer: If you forget a dose of Neobet Tablet, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next scheduled dose at the prescribed time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one as this may increase the chances of developing side effects.

name: neobet tablet

Neoglyate Injection is given by your doctor or nurse.
The dose you are given will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
Let your healthcare team know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.The most common side effect is allergic reaction.
This is temporary and usually resolves with time.
Contact your doctor straight away if you are at all concerned about these side effects.
It may also cause dizziness and sleepiness, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine as it can worsen your dizziness.Before taking this medicine, you should tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

It helps to provide symptomatic relief by making the heart pump blood more efficiently.
It helps in arrhythmia by restoring a steady and normal heartbeat.
Neogoxin Injection is administered under the supervision of a doctor.
Your doctor will decide the dose and duration of the medicine for you.
Doctor may closely monitor your blood pressure, heart rate and ECG till you became stable.
You should continue all your other medicines that are advised by the doctor for your long-term treatment even after this injection.Common side effects of this medicine include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dizziness, and visual disturbances.

description:
Neomiz Tablet is a medicine used for medical abortion (terminating a pregnancy).
It is also used for preventing excessive bleeding after delivery.
This medicine acts on the uterus and increases its contraction.
Neomiz Tablet is given alone or in combination with some other medicine to attain the maximum benefit.
It should be taken with food or as your doctor's advice.
It should be taken orally, by swallow the tablets whole with a drink of water.
If you experience vomiting within 30 minutes of tablet intake, inform your doctor or take another tablet.
The medicine may take 24 hours to show its action and you experience bleeding.Common side effects of this medicine include infection following abortion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, uterine contractions or cramping, uterine bleeding, heavy bleeding, and fetal malformations.
If these bother you or appear serious, let your doctor know.
There may be ways of reducing or preventing them.
Usually, vaginal bleeding may last for 12 days, inform your doctor if it lasts for more than 12 days or you notice severe abdominal pain.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had an ectopic pregnancy, or you are breastfeeding or using an intrauterine device.
Your doctor should also know about all other medicines you are taking as many of these may make this medicine less effective or change the way it works.
You must avoid strenuous activity like heavy exercise, running, and driving while abortion as it can affect the bleeding.
Your doctor may perform an ultrasound or pelvic examination to check for abortion completion.

faq.question: What is Neomiz Tablet and what is used for?
faq.answer: Neomiz Tablet contains a medicine called Misoprostol. It helps in medical termination of the pregnancy. It is prescribed along with another medicine called Mifepristone. It is only used to terminate a pregnancy which should not be more than 63 days old, counting from the first day of the last menstrual period. It works by increasing the contractions of the uterus. It may also be used in the prevention or treatment of post-delivery bleeding and for cervical ripening.

faq.question: How and in what dose should I take Neomiz Tablet?
faq.answer: This medicine is administered only in a clinic or healthcare facility under the supervision of a gynaecologist.

faq.question: What should I expect after taking Neomiz Tablet?
faq.answer: For medical termination of pregnancy: You may experience abdominal cramping, diarrhea, stomach pain, and nausea immediately after taking Neomiz Tablet. You may also have vaginal bleeding within 4 hours of taking Neomiz Tablet. You may also be asked to stay at the clinic or healthcare center for at least 3 hours after taking this medicine. After 14 days of taking Mifepristone (pill you took before Neomiz Tablet) your gynaecologist may run some blood tests or perform ultrasonography to confirm whether pregnancy has been terminated or not.

faq.question: Can Neomiz Tablet affect my future chances of getting pregnant?
faq.answer: No, studies have shown that this medicine does not impair the fertility of the women. Your future chances of getting pregnant are as equal as of those who have not taken this medicine.

faq.question: What are the common side effects of taking Neomiz Tablet?
faq.answer: The common side effects of using Neomiz Tablet are abdominal pain, abdominal cramping, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, uterine contractions, pelvic pain, and shivering. If you experience a very heavy vaginal bleeding or if any of these side effects bother you please consult with your gynaecologist.

name: neomiz tablet

description:
Neopin 1mg Injection is used to treat bradycardia (slow heart rate).
It helps to restore normal heartbeat in cardiac arrest cases.
This injection is also given before general anesthesia to reduce saliva secretions.
It even works as an antidote to some insecticide poisoning.
Neopin 1mg Injection may be used in combination with other medicines to reverse the effect of muscle relaxants during surgery.
It is given by your doctor or nurse, who will make sure you get the right amount.
Let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.Common side effects of this medicine include blurred vision and fast heart rate.
Dry mouth may also occur while using this medicine so, try to do frequent mouth rinses, maintain good oral hygiene and increase water intake.Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking this medicine.
It is better to avoid this medication if you are suffering from any severe heart disease or urinary retention.

faq.question: What is Neopin 1mg Injection used for in an emergency?
faq.answer: Neopin 1mg Injection is used in emergency situations when the heart beats too slowly, as an antidote to insecticide or mushroom poisoning. It can be used as part of the premedication before general anesthesia. It is also used in combination with other drugs to reverse the effect of muscle relaxants used during surgery.

faq.question: Who should not take Neopin 1mg Injection?
faq.answer: Inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, lung disease, stomach ulcers, liver problems, and thyroid disorders before taking this medicine.

faq.question: Where is Neopin 1mg Injection injected?
faq.answer: This medicine is injected into a muscle, under the skin, or as an infusion into a vein. A healthcare provider will give you this injection in a hospital setting only.

faq.question: What happens if you are given Neopin 1mg Injection in excess?
faq.answer: Some of the signs of overdose are dilation of the pupils, difficulty in swallowing, hot dry skin, flushing, inability to pass urine, rapid breathing, increased heart rate, and hyperactivity. However, this rarely happens as Neopin 1mg Injection is administered under the care of a highly trained doctor. If you suspect you have been given this medicine in excess, you should tell the doctor immediately.

faq.question: What should I avoid while receiving Neopin 1mg Injection?
faq.answer: Avoid becoming overheated or dehydrated during exercise and in hot weather. Neopin 1mg Injection can decrease sweating and you may be more prone to heatstroke. Drink lots of fluids to stop fluid loss.

faq.question: Can Neopin 1mg Injection be given to pregnant women?
faq.answer: No, Neopin 1mg Injection should not be given during pregnancy since the medicine may cross the placental barrier and may cause tachycardia (rapid heartbeat) in the fetus.

faq.question: Does Neopin 1mg Injection cause dryness in the mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, dry mouth is a common side-effect of this medicine. Frequent mouth rinses, good oral hygiene, increased water intake and sucking sugarless candy may help.

faq.question: Does Neopin 1mg Injection make you sleepy?
faq.answer: This medicine may cause drowsiness and blurred vision. Do not drive or do anything else that could be dangerous until you know how this medicine affects you. Do not drive until your pupils are no longer dilated.

name: neopin 1mg injection

description:
Neopress HS Tablet is a combination of two medicines.
It helps to control high blood pressure in different ways.
If high blood pressure is not treated it can lead to heart attacks, strokes and kidney failure.
You can take Neopress HS Tablet with or without food.
The dose will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
Try to take it at the same time each day.
It is important to keep taking this medicine until your doctor tells you not to.
It contains a diuretic (water pill) and will make you urinate more so, it is best to avoid taking this medicine within four hours of going to bed.
Use this medicine regularly to get the most benefit from it even if you feel well.
High blood pressure does not usually have symptoms and if you stop taking it your risk of heart attack or stroke may increase.The most common side effect is dizziness.
Other side effects include feeling tired, nausea, diarrhea, headache, and decreased blood pressure.
Frequent urination is not a side effect of this medicine.
It is the purpose of hydrochlorothiazide and helps control your blood pressure.
You may experience other possible side effects, but most are rare.
Make sure you read the leaflet that comes with your medicines and tell your doctor if you are bothered by side effects or they do not go away.
It may be possible to adjust your dose or try a different medicine.This medicine is not recommended during pregnancy and you should ask your doctor before taking it if you have kidney or liver disease, heart trouble or diabetes.
Drinking alcohol can further lower your blood pressure and may cause side effects.

faq.question: Are there any special instructions regarding storage and disposal of this medicine?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: Can I feel dizzy after taking Neopress HS Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Neopress HS Tablet can make you feel dizzy. This may occur when you suddenly rise up from lying or sitting position. To lower the chance of feeling dizzy or passing out, rise slowly if you have been sitting or lying down.

faq.question: Can I use Neopress HS Tablet in pregnancy?
faq.answer: No, Neopress HS Tablet should be avoided in pregnancy. Its use can cause injury and death to the baby. If you conceive while using Neopress HS Tablet, stop using it and contact your doctor immediately. Your doctor will recommend you other ways to lower the blood pressure.

faq.question: What are some lifestyle changes to make while using Neopress HS Tablet?
faq.answer: Making lifestyle changes can boost your health while taking Neopress HS Tablet. Avoid smoking, as smoking increases your risk of having heart attack and stroke. If you are overweight or obese, try to lose weight. You should maintain a healthy diet by including fruits and vegetables in your meals. Regular exercise can make your heart strong and reduce the risk of heart attack.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Neopress HS Tablet if I feel well?
faq.answer: No, keep using Neopress HS Tablet as advised by your doctor, even if you feel well. Stopping Neopress HS Tablet suddenly may lead to serious complications such as heart attack and stroke.

name: neopress hs tablet

description: Neosporin H Ear Drop is an ear medication used to treat bacterial ear infections. It helps kill infection-causing bacteria and reduces inflammation, swelling, and discomfort in the ear. Use Neosporin H Ear Drop exactly for the duration prescribed by your doctor and complete the full course even if symptoms improve earlier. Avoid prolonged or unnecessary use.

faq.question: What should I do if my symptoms do not improve?
faq.answer: If there is no improvement within about a week, or if symptoms worsen, consult your doctor. Further evaluation or a change in treatment may be needed to confirm the cause of infection or identify resistant organisms.

faq.question: Can this medicine be used for all types of ear infections?
faq.answer: No. This medicine is intended for bacterial infections of the outer ear only. It is not effective for viral or fungal infections, and it should not be used unless the infection is confirmed or suspected to be bacterial.

faq.question: Why is long-term or repeated use not recommended?
faq.answer: Prolonged use may increase the risk of allergic reactions, overgrowth of fungi, or other ear-related side effects. Treatment duration should be limited to the period advised by your doctor.

faq.question: When should I stop using the medicine and seek medical help?
faq.answer: Stop use and consult your doctor if you develop increased irritation, a rash, persistent itching, worsening pain, hearing changes, or any new or unusual symptoms during treatment.

faq.question: Who should avoid using this medicine?
faq.answer: It should not be used in people who are allergic to any of its components, those with certain viral ear infections, or patients with a perforated eardrum unless specifically advised by a doctor.

name: neosporin h ear drop

description:
Newtel-H 40 Tablet contains two medicines, both of which help to control high blood pressure.
It is generally used when one medicine alone is not controlling the blood pressure effectively.
Lowering blood pressure helps to reduce your risk of having a heart attack or a stroke in the future.
You can take Newtel-H 40 Tablet with or without food.
The dose will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
Try to take it at the same time each day.
It’s important to keep taking this medicine until your doctor tells you not to.
It contains a diuretic (water pill) and will make you urinate more, so it is best to avoid taking this medicine within four hours of going to bed.
Use this medicine regularly even if you feel better to get the most from it.
High blood pressure does not usually have symptoms and if you stop taking it your risk of heart attack or stroke may increase.The most common side effect is dizziness.
Other side effects include feeling tired, nausea, shortness of breath, and changes to your heartbeat.
Frequent urination is not a side effect of this medicine.
It is the purpose of this medicine as frequent urination helps control your blood pressure.
You may experience other possible side effects, but most are rare.
Make sure you read the leaflet that comes with your medicines and tell your doctor if you are bothered by side effects or they do not go away.
It may be possible to adjust your dose or try a different medicine.Do not use potassium supplements or salt substitutes unless your doctor has told you to.
This medicine is not recommended during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
You should ask your doctor before taking it if you have kidney or liver disease, heart trouble or diabetes.
Drinking alcohol can further lower your blood pressure and may cause side effects.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes, unless advised by your doctor. Also, avoid alcohol consumption as doing so can further lower your blood pressure and may cause some side effects. In addition to that, avoid getting dehydrated, drink enough fluids during exercise and in hot weather. The medicine may make you dizzy so avoid driving, using machinery or doing anything that needs concentration unless you know how this medicine affects you. If you feel dizzy, lie down so you do not faint. Then sit for a few moments before standing to prevent feeling dizzy again.

faq.question: What happens if I take too much of Newtel-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you accidentally take too much of Newtel-H 40 Tablet, you may experience symptoms such as low blood pressure, dizziness, lightheadedness, weakness, vomiting and rapid heartbeat. However, in some cases slow heartbeat, reduced kidney function including kidney failure (e.g., reduced urine output) have also been reported. If you experience any such symptoms, contact your doctor immediately and seek medical help.

faq.question: Can I come off Newtel-H 40 Tablet when my blood pressure is under control or normal?
faq.answer: Remember, Newtel-H 40 Tablet does not cure your hypertension (high blood pressure) but helps normalize it. You should continue taking this medicine even if your blood pressure is controlled. If you stop taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet, your blood pressure could rise back up again. Generally, blood pressure-lowering medicines are to be taken for the rest of your life. It is important to know that by keeping your blood pressure controlled you are reducing your risk of having a heart attack or a stroke.

faq.question: What happens if I forget to take Newtel-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed one and take the next scheduled dose. Do not take a double dose to make up for the one you missed. If you often forget doses, it may help to set an alarm to remind you. If not sure, consult your doctor for other ways to help you remember.

faq.question: What will happen if I stop taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should not stop taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet without talking to your doctor first. If you do stop taking it, your blood pressure may rise and you may put yourself at greater risk of having a heart attack or a stroke. If you experience side effects, such as dizziness, nausea, diarrhea etc., talk to your doctor.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Newtel-H 40 Tablet for a long time?
faq.answer: Newtel-H 40 Tablet is generally safe to take for a long time. Remember to follow your doctor's advice/instructions.

faq.question: How long will I be taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet for?
faq.answer: You may have to take Newtel-H 40 Tablet for a long-term or even lifelong. The medicine only keeps your blood pressure under control for as long as you are taking it. Therefore, it is advised to continue your medication and follow your doctor's advice.

faq.question: What if Newtel-H 40 Tablet doesn’t make me feel any better?
faq.answer: High blood pressure does not usually have any symptoms, so you may not feel ill if there is any change in the blood pressure. Therefore, this medicine may not make you feel “better”. This does not mean that you can stop the medicine as they are working in the background to reduce your risk of serious illness.

faq.question: Can Newtel-H 40 Tablet affect my fertility or sex life?
faq.answer: Newtel-H 40 Tablet may very rarely lead to erectile dysfunction (inability to gain or maintain an erection). Consult your doctor if you are worried or notice some changes. However, untreated hypertension (high blood pressure) itself can lead to erectile dysfunction, therefore it is important that you take your medicine regularly and keep a track of your blood pressure.

faq.question: What other lifestyle changes should I make while taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Lifestyle changes play a major role in keeping you healthy if you are taking Newtel-H 40 Tablet. Avoid taking excess salt in your diet and find ways to reduce or manage stress in your life. Practice yoga or meditation or take up a hobby. Ensure that you have a sound sleep every night as this also helps to reduce stress levels and helps to keep your blood pressure normal. Stop smoking and alcohol consumption as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and take a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Newtel-H 40 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: How long does it take for Olmetime-H 40 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: You may notice a decrease in your blood pressure effectively within 2 weeks of starting Olmetime-H 40 Tablet. However, it may take about 8 weeks to see the full benefits of this medicine.

faq.question: At what time of the day should you take Olmetime-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Your doctor may suggest to take your first dose before bedtime, considering that this medicine can make you feel dizzy. After the very first dose you can take Olmetime-H 40 Tablet at any time of the day. It is important to take this medicine at the same time every day.

faq.question: Can I feel dizzy after taking Olmetime-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Olmetime-H 40 Tablet can make you feel dizzy. This may occur when you suddenly get up from a lying or sitting position. To lower the chance of feeling dizzy or passing out, rise slowly if you have been sitting or lying down.

faq.question: What are the other lifestyle changes I should make while using Olmetime-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Lifestyle changes play a major role in keeping you healthy if you are taking Olmetime-H 40 Tablet. Avoid taking excess salt in your diet and find ways to reduce or manage stress in your life. Practice yoga or meditation or take up a hobby. Ensure that you have a sound sleep every night as this also helps to reduce stress levels and helps to keep your blood pressure normal. Stop smoking and alcohol consumption as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and take a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Olmetime-H 40 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: Can Olmetime-H 40 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: No, Olmetime-H 40 Tablet does not cause weight gain. However, in very rare cases, chronic diarrhea with substantial weight loss may occur. If a patient develops diarrhea while taking Olmetime-H 40 Tablet and no other cause of diarrhea can be deduced, then the doctor may advise the patient to discontinue it immediately and recommend another medicine.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Olmetime-H 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: The serious side effects of Olmetime-H 40 Tablet include skin rash or itchiness, painful joints, fast heart beat, shortness of breath or tightness in the chest. Serious side effects may also include aching, tender or weak muscles not caused by exercise and swelling of the hands, feet or ankles. Olmetime-H 40 Tablet may also cause symptoms that may indicate high potassium levels in the blood, such as nausea, diarrhea, muscle weakness and change in heart rhythm. If you experience any of these symptoms, call your doctor immediately.

faq.question: Can Olmetime-H 40 Tablet affect my fertility or sex life?
faq.answer: Some blood pressure medicines (including water pills like hydrochlorothiazide) may affect a man’s ability to gain or maintain an erection (erectile dysfunction). However, it is thought that other blood pressure medicines can actually improve erectile dysfunction. If you are worried or notice some changes, talk to your doctor. There is no firm evidence which suggests any effect on the fertility of either men or women with the use of Olmetime-H 40 Tablet.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take Olmetime-H 40 Tablet? Is it safe to take long term?
faq.answer: You may have to take Olmetime-H 40 Tablet life long. Olmetime-H 40 Tablet controls high blood pressure but does not cure it. Do not stop taking it even if your blood pressure is well controlled. Olmetime-H 40 Tablet is generally considered safe to be taken for long term. In some cases, long-term use may adversely affect the kidneys and the kidneys may not function as they should. Therefore, your doctor may prescribe regular blood tests to check urea, creatinine and potassium levels to keep a track of how well your kidneys are working.

faq.question: Can I take Olmetime-H 40 Tablet before surgery?
faq.answer: Your doctor may advise you to stop taking Olmetime-H 40 Tablet 24 hours before surgery. This is because Olmetime-H 40 Tablet can further reduce your blood pressure when used with anesthetics. So, inform your doctor that you are taking Olmetime-H 40 Tablet if you will be given general anesthetics (medicines that put you to sleep) or are scheduled to have any surgery.

name: newtel-h 40 tablet

description:
NexEMPA 10 Tablet is used to treat type 2 diabetes, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease (CKD).
It helps lower blood sugar levels in people with diabetes when used with diet and exercise.
In heart failure and CKD, it helps reduce hospitalizations and slow disease progression.
NexEMPA 10 Tablet can be taken with or without food, in the dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
For best results, continue to follow your doctor’s advice on diet and exercise.
Stay well-hydrated, especially during hot weather or physical activity, and attend regular check-ups to monitor your blood sugar, kidney function, and overall health.The most common side effects of NexEMPA 10 Tablet are urinary tract infections and female genital yeast infections (vaginal mycosis).
Maintain good personal hygiene, drink plenty of fluids, and contact your doctor if these symptoms persist or worsen.
Some people, especially those taking insulin or sulfonylureas, may experience low blood sugar (hypoglycemia).
If this happens, consume something sugary and inform your doctor if it occurs frequently.Do not use NexEMPA 10 Tablet if you are allergic to empagliflozin or any of its ingredients.
This medicine is not recommended for people with type 1 diabetes.
Use it with caution if you have kidney or liver problems, are elderly, take diuretics (water pills), or have low blood pressure, as it may cause dehydration or dizziness.
Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding should not use NexEMPA 10 Tablet, as it may harm the baby.

faq.question: What is the recommended method of taking NexEMPA 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Take the recommended dose advised by the doctor. NexEMPA 10 Tablet may be taken with or without food. It should be swallowed whole with water, preferably at the same time each day. For best results, it is important to stay on a diet and exercise program as directed by your doctor.

faq.question: Can I stop taking NexEMPA 10 Tablet when I feel better?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking NexEMPA 10 Tablet without consulting your doctor. Doing so can lead to a sudden increase in your blood glucose levels. Use the medicine strictly according to the dose and duration the doctor advises. Never stop taking any medicine without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: Can NexEMPA 10 Tablet be used with other diabetes medicines?
faq.answer: Yes, NexEMPA 10 Tablet can be used alone or with other diabetes medicines. However, a proper diet and exercise should be followed along with medicines.

faq.question: Can the use of NexEMPA 10 Tablet cause hypoglycemia (very low blood sugar levels)?
faq.answer: NexEMPA 10 Tablet does not cause very low blood sugar on its own. However, watch out for hypoglycemia if it is taken along with other diabetes medicines such as insulin, sulfonylurea, or meglitinides.

faq.question: I am taking furosemide for high blood pressure. Can I take NexEMPA 10 Tablet with it?
faq.answer: NexEMPA 10 Tablet may cause excessive fluid loss, or you may urinate more, resulting in dehydration. Since furosemide also causes fluid loss, taking it with NexEMPA 10 Tablet may cause unusual thirst, lightheadedness, or dizziness upon standing, fainting, or loss of consciousness. Inform your doctor about furosemide before starting NexEMPA 10 Tablet.

Nexopil -DSR Capsule is best taken on an empty stomach.
Take it in the dose and duration advised by the doctor.
Continue taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early, your symptoms may come back, and your condition may worsen.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Nexopil -DSR Capsule?

faq.question: What is the best time to take Nexopil -DSR Capsule?

faq.question: What are the contraindications associated with the use of Nexopil -DSR Capsule?

faq.question: Can the use of Nexopil -DSR Capsule cause dry mouth?

faq.question: Can the use of Nexopil -DSR Capsule cause diarrhea?

Talk to your doctor if diarrhea persists and if you notice signs of dehydration, like less frequent urination and dark-colored and strong-smelling urine. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods with this medication. Also, do not take any medicines without consulting the doctor.

faq.question: What are the storage conditions for Nexopil -DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, and other people.

description:
Nexovas O 40 Tablet contains two medicines, both of which help to control high blood pressure.
It lowers the blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and making it easier for your heart to pump blood around your body.
This will reduce your risk of having a heart attack or a stroke.
Nexovas O 40 Tablet may be taken on an empty stomach or along with food.
However, it is better to take it regularly at a fixed time each day, as prescribed by your doctor.
The dose will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
It’s important to keep taking this medicine even if you feel well.
By lowering your blood pressure, it is reducing your risk of heart attack or stroke so do not stop taking it unless your doctor tells you to.
You can help this medication work better by making a few changes to your lifestyle such as keeping active, stopping smoking, and eating a low salt and low-fat diet.The most common side effects of this medicine include swelling in your ankles or feet (edema), headache, sleepiness, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, and upset stomach.
Since it may cause sleepiness and dizziness, do not drive or do anything requiring concentration until you know how it affects you.
Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects bother you or will not go away.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor know if you have any kidney or liver problems or severe dehydration.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
While using this medicine, your blood pressure will need to be checked often and your kidney function may also need to be tested.

faq.question: How long does it take for Nexovas O 40 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: You may notice a decrease in your blood pressure effectively within 2 weeks of starting Nexovas O 40 Tablet. However, it may take about 8 weeks to see the full benefits of this medicine.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Nexovas O 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Your doctor may suggest to take your first dose before bedtime, considering that this medicine can make you feel dizzy. After the very first dose you can take Nexovas O 40 Tablet at any time of the day. It is important to take this medicine at the same time every day.

faq.question: Can I feel dizzy after taking Nexovas O 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Nexovas O 40 Tablet can make you feel dizzy. This may occur when you suddenly get up from a lying or sitting position. To lower the chance of feeling dizzy or passing out, rise slowly if you have been sitting or lying down.

faq.question: What are the other lifestyle changes I should make while using Nexovas O 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Lifestyle changes play a major role in keeping you healthy if you are taking Nexovas O 40 Tablet. Avoid taking excess salt in your diet and find ways to reduce or manage stress in your life. Practice yoga or meditation or take up a hobby. Ensure that you have a sound sleep every night as this also helps to reduce stress levels and helps to keep your blood pressure normal. Stop smoking and alcohol consumption as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and take a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Nexovas O 40 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: Can Nexovas O 40 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: No, Nexovas O 40 Tablet does not cause weight gain. However, in very rare cases, chronic diarrhea with substantial weight loss may occur. If a patient develops diarrhea while taking Nexovas O 40 Tablet and no other cause of diarrhea can be deduced, the doctor may suggest discontinuation of the medicine and recommend another medicine.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Nexovas O 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: The serious side effects of Nexovas O 40 Tablet include skin rash or itchiness, painful joints, fast heartbeat, shortness of breath or tightness in the chest. Serious side effects may also include aching, tender or weak muscles (not caused by exercise) and swelling of the hands, feet or ankles. Nexovas O 40 Tablet may also cause symptoms that may indicate high potassium levels in the blood, such as nausea, diarrhea, muscle weakness and change in heart rhythm. If you experience any of these symptoms, call your doctor immediately.

faq.question: Can Nexovas O 40 Tablet affect my fertility or sex life?
faq.answer: Some blood pressure medicines (including water pills like hydrochlorothiazide) may affect a man’s ability to gain or maintain an erection (erectile dysfunction). However, it is thought that other blood pressure medicines can actually improve erectile dysfunction. If you are worried or notice some changes, talk to your doctor. There is no firm evidence which suggests any effect on the fertility of either men or women with the use of Nexovas O 40 Tablet.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take Nexovas O 40 Tablet? Is it safe to take long term?
faq.answer: You may have to take Nexovas O 40 Tablet life long. Nexovas O 40 Tablet controls high blood pressure but does not cure it. Do not stop taking it even if your blood pressure is well controlled. Nexovas O 40 Tablet is generally considered safe to be taken for a long term. In some cases, long-term use may adversely affect the kidneys and the kidneys may not function as they should. Therefore, your doctor may prescribe regular blood tests to check urea, creatinine and potassium levels to keep a track of how well your kidneys are working.

faq.question: What if I give excess Nor Metrogyl O Syrup by mistake?
faq.answer: Although an extra dose of Nor Metrogyl O Syrup will not have any side effects, you must always be vigilant. If you think you have given too much Nor Metrogyl O Syrup to your child, immediately speak to a doctor. Overdose increases the risk of unwanted side effects such as seizures, tremors, severe headache, sudden weakness, blood cell abnormalities, and rapid and irregular heartbeat. Rush to your child’s doctor on an immediate basis if you notice any of these symptoms.

faq.question: What should I do if my child shows no improvement even after taking Nor Metrogyl O Syrup for the prescribed duration?
faq.answer: Ineffective treatment with Nor Metrogyl O Syrup could mean that the medicine is not able to act against the infection-causing bacteria. In such a case, visit your child’s doctor who may prescribe some other antibiotic, having more specific action toward the infection-causing bacteria.

faq.question: Can other medicines be given at the same time as Nor Metrogyl O Syrup?
faq.answer: Nor Metrogyl O Syrup can sometimes interact with other medicines or substances. Tell your doctor about any other medicines your child is taking before starting Nor Metrogyl O Syrup. Also, check with your child’s doctor before giving any medicine to your child.

faq.question: Can I get my child vaccinated while on treatment with Nor Metrogyl O Syrup?
faq.answer: Antibiotics usually do not interfere with the ingredients in vaccines or cause a bad reaction in a child who has just been vaccinated. However, children taking antibiotics should not get vaccinated until they recover from the illness. As soon as your child feels better, the vaccine can be given.

faq.question: What should I tell the doctor before giving Nor Metrogyl O Syrup to my child?
faq.answer: Inform the doctor if your child is suffering from heart disease, genetic disorders involving blood vessels, seizures, psychiatric disorders, diabetes, photoallergy (allergy from sunlight), neuromuscular disorders, or rheumatoid arthritis. This is because there is a possibility that Nor Metrogyl O Syrup may aggravate these conditions and result in complications.

faq.question: My child has been passing red-brown urine ever since he started taking Nor Metrogyl O Syrup. Is it normal?
faq.answer: Yes, it is normal. Nor Metrogyl O Syrup contains an active ingredient called metronidazole which can cause red-brown urine. It is a harmless side effect. It will subside once the medicine is stopped after the completion of the treatment.

faq.question: My child is having a common cold. Is it safe to give Nor Metrogyl O Syrup along with cough & cold medicines?
faq.answer: No, do not give Nor Metrogyl O Syrup with cough and cold medicines as it can interfere with their working.

description:
NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet is used to treat conditions related to excessive stomach acid production, such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach and provides relief from symptoms and promotes healing.
NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet can also be used to prevent stomach ulcers caused by certain medications, such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).
Take it in the exact dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
It is usually taken on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning or at least 1 hour before a meal.
Continue taking the medicine even if your symptoms disappear until the doctor says it is okay to stop.
If you are taking this medicine for a long time, your doctor may carry out regular tests to check your levels of magnesium, which can fall with this medicine.Common side effects include headache, constipation or diarrhea, stomach pain, and nausea.
These tend to be mild, but talk to your doctor if they bother you or do not go away.
The risk of side effects may increase the longer you take this medicine.
You may be more likely to have a broken bone if you take it for a long time.
It is best to avoid foods that seem to make your symptoms worse, such as rich, spicy, and fatty foods.
Cutting down on caffeinated drinks, such as tea, coffee, and cola, as well as alcohol, may also help.NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet may not be suitable for some people.
Before taking this medicine, you need to tell your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have had an allergic reaction to similar medicines in the past, or have osteoporosis.
Alcohol does not interfere with the way NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet works; however, drinking alcohol makes your stomach produce more acid than normal.
This medicine can make you feel dizzy, sleepy, or affect your vision.
If this happens, do not drive, cycle, or use machinery or tools until you feel better.
This medicine is not usually recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

faq.question: What is the best time to take NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Usually, NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet is taken once a day, first thing in the morning. If you take NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet twice a day, take 1 dose in the morning and 1 dose in the evening. The tablets should be swallowed whole (remember not be chewed or crushed) and taken at least 1 hour before a meal with some water.

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, you can take antacids along with NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet. Take it 2 hours before or after you take NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I take NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet for a long term?
faq.answer: NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet is usually prescribed for short-term use only. However, if need arises, such as for treating peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (ZES), NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet may be prescribed for a long-term duration as well. Long-term use may carry an increased risk for side effects and must be discussed with the doctor. Please use NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet as advised by your doctor and under their supervision.

faq.question: Can I stop taking NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet if I feel better?
faq.answer: If you have been taking NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet for a long time, stopping it abruptly may lead to increased acid production, thereby worsening your symptoms. Therefore, you must discuss any dose changes or if you wish to come off NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet.

faq.question: What are the long term side effects of NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: If NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet is used for more than 3 months, certain long-term side effects may be seen. The most important of these is low magnesium levels in your blood, which may make you feel tired, confused, dizzy, or shaky. You may also have muscle twitches or an irregular heartbeat. If the use is further prolonged for more than a year, you may have an increased risk of bone fractures, stomach infections, and vitamin B12 deficiency. Vitamin B12 deficiency can make you anemic, as a result of which you may feel more tired, weak, or pale. Additionally, you may have palpitations, shortness of breath, lightheadedness, indigestion, loss of appetite, flatulence (gas), or nerve problems such as numbness, tingling, and problem in walking.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, alcohol intake is not advised with NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet. Alcohol itself does not affect the working of NexPRO Fast 40 Tablet, but it can increase the acid production. This may further cause worsening of your symptoms.

faq.question: What is the use of Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet is used to treat Hyperacidity, Heartburn, Stomach ulcer, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

faq.question: How does Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet work?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI), which is a type of medication. Proton pumps are enzymes found in the stomach lining that aid in the production of acid needed for digestion. Esomeprazole impairs the function of proton pumps. This decreases the quantity of acid produced by the stomach.

faq.question: Does Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet treats gastric bleeding?
faq.answer: No. Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet prevents excess production of stomach acid causing acid reflux and heartburn. If blood is coming in your stool or mucous immediately contact the doctor.

faq.question: Does Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet interfere or affect laboratory test reports?
faq.answer: Yes. Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet can alter certain medical tests like neuroendocrine tumours (secretin stimulation test), and urine screening tests for tetrahydrocannabinol (THC). So before undergoing such diagnostics test contact your doctor.

faq.question: What if I take too much Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: It is very unlikely that taking one or two extra doses by accident will cause any problems. However, you should check with your doctor if you have taken too much and have are feeling sweaty, have a fast heartbeat, are feeling sleepy.

faq.question: Will Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet affect my fertility?
faq.answer: There's no firm evidence to suggest that taking Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet will reduce fertility in either men or women. However, speak to your doctor if you're trying to get pregnant and do as advised.

faq.question: Is there any food or drink I need to avoid while taking Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: You can eat and drink normally while taking Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet . However, you should avoid foods that seem to make your indigestion worse, such as rich, spicy and fatty foods. You should also cut down on caffeinated drinks, such as tea, coffee and cola, as well as alcohol.

faq.question: Are gas and acidity same thing?
faq.answer: No. Gas and acidity are two different common discomforts. Acidity is caused when improper functioning of the valve (sphincter) is located at the junction of the stomach and food pipe. As a result stomach acid backflows and enters the upper part of the food pipe causing heartburn. On the other hand, gas is the result of the digestion of the food and drinks eliminating gases like carbon dioxide, hydrogen, nitrogen, methane, etc. from the body.

faq.question: What are the long term effects of Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Prolonged intake of Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet may lead to atrophic gastritis (inflammation of stomach cells), Vitamin B12 deficiency and weakening of bones or osteoporosis (loss of calcium, magnesium and vitamin D). Your doctor may prescribe calcium, vitamin D or haemoglobin enhancing medications to cope with long term side effects.

faq.question: Can Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet be used in children?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet should be used in children only if prescribed by the doctor. Please consult the doctor before giving Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet to children.

faq.question: Can I take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet after having food?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet should be taken an hour before meals.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet is usually taken on an empty stomach, first thing in the morning. If you take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet twice a day, take 1 dose in the morning and 1 dose in the evening.

faq.question: Can I take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet with domperidone?
faq.answer: Yes, Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet can be taken with domperidone if prescribed by the doctor.

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Antacids can be taken along with Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet if prescribed by the doctor. However, it is advised to maintain a gap of 2 hours between Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet and antacid medicines.

faq.question: Can I take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet for a long term?
faq.answer: It is advised to take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet for the duration prescribed by the doctor. Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet is usually prescribed for a short term. However, it may be indicated for a long term use in cases like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and ulcer disease.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet if I feel better?
faq.answer: Do not discontinue Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet without consulting your doctor. To treat your condition effectively, take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet for the duration prescribed by the physician.

faq.question: Can Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet may cause weight gain in rare cases. Maintain a proper weight by eating healthy food and exercising regularly.

faq.question: Is Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet is safe to use if prescribed by the doctor.

faq.question: Can I take Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet with ranitidine?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet can be taken with ranitidine if prescribed by the doctor. No interactions were found between both the medicines.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Drinking alcohol with Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet may cause dehydration and elevate the level of stomach acid thereby decreasing its efficiency. So, try to avoid/limit alcohol consumption with Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet .

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: If you miss a dose of Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet take it as soon as you remember, However, if it is almost time for the scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the scheduled time.

faq.question: Are there any side effects of taking Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet might cause side effects like headache, diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain, and vomiting. Consult the doctor if the side effects persist or worsen.

faq.question: Can I take other medicines while using Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet ?
faq.answer: Consult the doctor before taking other medicines while using Nexpro Fast 40 Tablet to prevent interactions. Let the doctor know if you are taking blood thinners, antifungal agents, anti-HIV drugs, anti-viral drugs, iron supplements, antibiotics, cardiac medicines and anti-cancer drugs.

faq.question: Can I take Nexpro Fast after food??
faq.answer: Nexpro Fast Tablets can be taken with food or on an empty stomach. However, it is best if you take it on an empty stomach one hour before taking food for better acidity control.

faq.question: Does Nexpro Fast Tablet help in reducing gas?
faq.answer: No, Nexpro Fast Tablet does not reduce gas. However, it helps to relieve heartburn and pain due to increased acidity.

faq.question: Is Nexpro Fast an antibiotic medicine?
faq.answer: No, it is not an antibiotic. It is an acidity medicine containing esomeprazole used for the treatment of ulcers, acid reflux disease, acidity, etc.

description:
Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR is a medicine used for the treatment of hypertension (high blood pressure).
It works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels, which improves blood flow and reduces the workload on the heart.
It promotes better heart function and overall cardiovascular health.
Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR may be prescribed alone or along with other medicines.
Your doctor will decide the dose and duration of the treatment.
Your doctor may adjust the dose depending on how you respond to this medicine and your blood pressure levels.
You can take it at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day.Keep taking it for as long as advised by your doctor.
Even if you feel well, do not stop this medicine on your own because high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Maintaining an active lifestyle through regular exercise, managing your weight, and consuming a healthy diet will also help regulate your blood pressure.
Follow your doctor’s advice while taking this medicine.The most common side effects include fatigue, edema (swelling), dizziness, unusual heartbeat (palpitations), flushing, constipation, and headache.

faq.question: Is Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR a diuretic?
faq.answer: No, Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR is not a diuretic medication. However, some evidence indicates that Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR has a partial diuretic property which may result in increased sodium loss through urine. It is a medication which relaxes the blood vessels by directly acting on them. This helps to decrease the blood pressure of the individual. As a result, blood flows more easily and lowers blood pressure, which helps to reduce the strain or pressure on your heart.

faq.question: Is Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR bad for kidneys?
faq.answer: No, Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR is not bad for kidneys. In few research studies, taking Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR in recommended doses has in fact been shown to be beneficial for the kidneys. It is not advised to use this medicine without consulting the doctor. It should be used exactly as prescribed.

faq.question: Can Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR cause liver damage?
faq.answer: Yes,Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR can cause liver damage in some cases, but this is very rare. However, some people may develop a rise in liver enzymes after taking Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR. Let your doctor know if you notice any such changes in your recent lab tests. Do not start this medication without consulting your doctor and do inform him if you have any history of liver disease or liver damage. This is because, in case of liver damage, dose adjustment may be required.

faq.question: Does Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR affect blood sugar?
faq.answer: No, Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR does not cause any change in blood sugar levels. It has been observed that Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR has no effect on the release of insulin or change in blood sugar levels. However, before starting the medicine, inform the doctor if you are diabetic. This is done because the medicine for blood pressure is suggested accordingly when a patient is diabetic.

faq.question: Can Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR be used in pregnancy and nursing mothers?
faq.answer: It is advised that you should consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant or breastfeeding. It should be used only if prescribed by the doctor in case of pregnancy. Studies have shown significant risks to the developing baby and it is given only if the benefits are clearly more than the risks involved.

faq.question: Does Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR cause palpitations?
faq.answer: Yes. Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR can cause palpitations as a side effect. However, this is usually not bothersome and resolves as you continue with the treatment. If the symptom persists for long, consult the doctor who will suggest the ways to prevent it.

faq.question: Do I need to change my diet while taking Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR?
faq.answer: Yes, making small changes to your diet can help your medicine work better. You must take a low sodium and low-fat diet, and adhere to the lifestyle changes as advised by your doctor. You should also avoid eating grapefruit (chakotra) or drinking grapefruit juice while taking Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR.

faq.question: My blood pressure is now controlled. Can I stop taking Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR now?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking it on your own as it may worsen your condition. You should take Nicardia CD Retard 30 Tablet SR in the dose and duration advised by your doctor. Consult your doctor for any query or dose modification.

description:
Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet is used to treat common cold symptoms such as sneezing, a runny or blocked nose, sore throat, cough, body ache, and mild fever.
It works by reducing pain and fever, relieving allergy-related symptoms, and shrinking blood vessels in the nose to ease congestion.
Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet can be taken with or without food in a dose and duration as advised by the doctor.
Consider taking it with food if you experience an upset stomach.
Let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking, as some may affect or be affected by this medicine.The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, insomnia, restlessness, impaired coordination, and headache.
Most of these are temporary and usually resolve with time.
Contact your doctor if you are at all concerned about any of these side effects.
It can also cause dizziness and sleepiness, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.Before taking it, you should tell your doctor if you have any kidney or liver diseases so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
Also, tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine, as it can make dizziness worse.

faq.question: What is Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet is a medicine used to relieve symptoms of the common cold. It helps reduce fever, headache, body aches, sneezing, a runny or blocked nose, watery eyes, a sore throat, and a mild cough. It provides temporary relief so you can feel more comfortable while your body fights the infection. However, Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet does not cure the virus that causes the cold. If your symptoms last longer than a few days or get worse, consult your doctor.

faq.question: What foods should I avoid while taking Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet?
faq.answer: While taking Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet, avoid foods and drinks that contain caffeine, such as coffee, tea, cola, and chocolate. Too much caffeine may increase side effects like restlessness, nervousness, or a racing heartbeat. Alcohol should also be avoided because it can increase drowsiness and put extra strain on your body while you are sick. Eating light meals and drinking warm fluids may help you recover more comfortably.

faq.question: Can Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet cause drowsiness?
faq.answer: Yes, Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet may cause drowsiness or make you feel less alert in some cases. You might feel unusually sleepy or tired after taking it. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks that require full attention until you know how the medicine affects you.

faq.question: What serious side effects can Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet cause?
faq.answer: Serious side effects with Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet are uncommon but require immediate medical attention. Seek help if you develop a severe allergic reaction, such as rash, swelling of the face or throat, or difficulty breathing. Other warning signs include skin peeling, persistent high fever, unusual bleeding, vision problems, or a fast or irregular heartbeat. In some people, Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet may raise blood pressure. Stop taking the medicine and contact your doctor right away if you notice any severe or unusual symptoms.

faq.question: Is Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet safe during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
faq.answer: Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet should only be used during pregnancy if your doctor specifically recommends it, as some ingredients may affect blood pressure or cause other unwanted effects. Self-medicating during pregnancy is not advised. It is also generally not recommended while breastfeeding because certain ingredients can pass into breast milk and may affect the baby. Always inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet.

faq.question: Can I take an extra dose of Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet for faster relief?
faq.answer: No, taking more than the recommended dose of Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet will not make it work faster and may increase the risk of serious side effects. Overuse can harm the liver, affect blood pressure, or cause other complications. Always follow your doctor’s dosing instructions and do not increase the dose or frequency on your own. Rest, staying hydrated, and supportive care are also important for recovery.

faq.question: Who should not take Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet?
faq.answer: Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet should be avoided in people with uncontrolled high blood pressure, serious heart disease, an overactive thyroid, stomach ulcers, or significant liver disease unless advised by a doctor. It should not be taken with certain antidepressants, especially monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAO inhibitors) or some tricyclic antidepressants. Taking more than the recommended dose or combining it with other medicines that contain acetaminophen (paracetamol) can increase the risk of liver damage. Always consult your doctor before starting Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet.

faq.question: Is Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet an antibiotic, and can it cause resistance?
faq.answer: No, Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet is not an antibiotic and does not cause antibiotic resistance. It is used to relieve symptoms such as fever, headache, body aches, and nasal congestion associated with the common cold. Antibiotic resistance occurs when antibiotics are overused or misused for bacterial infections. Since Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet does not contain an antibiotic and does not treat bacterial infections, it does not contribute to resistance.

faq.question: Can elderly people take Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet?
faq.answer: Older adults should take Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet only after consulting a doctor. Some ingredients may cause increased drowsiness, confusion, or changes in blood pressure in elderly patients. Medical supervision helps ensure safe and appropriate use.

faq.question: When should I stop taking Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet?
faq.answer: You should stop taking Nicip Cold & Flu Tablet once your symptoms improve or as advised by your doctor. Do not continue using it longer than necessary, as prolonged use may increase the risk of side effects. If your symptoms last more than a few days or worsen, consult your doctor for further evaluation.

faq.question: Can vitamin C help recover faster from a cold?
faq.answer: Vitamin C may slightly reduce the duration of a cold in some people, but it does not prevent colds completely. Eating a balanced diet, including fruits rich in vitamin C, and staying well hydrated can support your immune system. Consult your doctor before starting vitamin supplements.

faq.question: How can I tell if my cold is viral or bacterial?
faq.answer: Viruses cause most common colds and usually include symptoms such as a runny nose, mild fever, sneezing, and sore throat that improve within a few days. A bacterial infection may be suspected if symptoms are severe, include a high fever, or last longer than expected. Only a doctor can accurately determine the cause. Avoid self-diagnosing.

faq.question: Can antibiotics help with a cold?
faq.answer: Antibiotics do not work for viral colds, which are the most common type of cold. Using antibiotics unnecessarily can contribute to antibiotic resistance and may cause side effects. If you have persistent fever or worsening symptoms, consult your doctor to determine whether further evaluation or treatment is needed.

description:
Nicip Plus Tablet is a combination medicine that helps in relieving pain.
It is used to relieve pain and inflammation in conditions like rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and osteoarthritis.
It is also used to relieve muscle pain, back pain, toothache, or pain in the ear and throat.
Nicip Plus Tablet should be taken with food.
This will prevent you from getting an upset stomach.
The dose will depend on what you are taking it for and how well it helps your symptoms.
You should take it as advised by your doctor.
Do not take more or use it for a longer duration than recommended by the doctor.The most common side effects of this medicine include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and increased liver enzymes.
If any of these side effects bother you or get worse, you should speak to your doctor.
Your doctor may be able to suggest ways of preventing or reducing the side effects.Before taking it, you should let your doctor know if you have a history of ulcers or bleeding in your stomach, high blood pressure, or any trouble with your heart, kidneys, or liver.
Let your doctor also know about all the other medicines you are taking because they may affect, or be affected by, this medicine.Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before starting treatment.
You should also avoid drinking alcohol while you are taking this medicine, as alcohol can cause excessive drowsiness.

faq.question: What is Nicip Plus Tablet, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet is a medicine used for short-term relief of pain, fever, and inflammation. Your doctor may prescribe it for conditions such as a toothache, body pain, joint pain, muscle pain, or pain related to injuries. It works by reducing pain signals and inflammation in the body, which helps relieve discomfort. However, Nicip Plus Tablet only helps control symptoms and does not treat the underlying cause of pain. Because it contains strong pain-relieving ingredients, it should be taken only under a doctor’s supervision and not used for long periods without medical advice.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Nicip Plus Tablet when my pain is relieved?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet is usually prescribed for short-term pain relief. If your pain improves, you may be able to stop taking it. However, if your doctor has advised you to take it for a specific period or for a particular condition, you should continue it as directed. Always follow your doctor’s instructions before stopping the medicine.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Nicip Plus Tablet?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet may cause side effects such as nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, dizziness, or tiredness in some people. Taking the medicine with food or milk may help reduce stomach upset. Most people do not feel sleepy while taking it, but some may feel light-headed or weak. Drinking enough fluids may help if you feel unwell. Consult your doctor if these symptoms persist or if you experience severe vomiting, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

faq.question: Who should not take Nicip Plus Tablet?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet should not be taken by people who are allergic to this medicine or to other similar pain relievers known as NSAIDs. It is also not recommended for individuals with stomach ulcers or bleeding, severe liver disease, kidney problems, heart failure, or uncontrolled high blood pressure unless advised by a doctor. The medicine may carry a risk of liver injury, especially with repeated use or when combined with alcohol. Always inform your doctor about your medical history before taking Nicip Plus Tablet.

faq.question: Can I take Nicip Plus Tablet with vitamin B-complex?
faq.answer: Yes, Nicip Plus Tablet can usually be taken with vitamin B-complex supplements. While Nicip Plus Tablet helps relieve pain, vitamin B-complex may help correct vitamin deficiencies that sometimes contribute to symptoms such as nerve pain or fatigue. However, it is always best to consult your doctor before combining medicines or supplements.

faq.question: Does Nicip Plus Tablet help relieve stomach pain?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet should not be taken for stomach pain without consulting a doctor. The medicine may increase the risk of stomach irritation and could worsen certain underlying stomach conditions, such as gastritis or ulcers. If you have persistent stomach pain, seek medical advice rather than self-medicating.

faq.question: Can Nicip Plus Tablet damage the liver?
faq.answer: Yes, Nicip Plus Tablet may affect the liver if it is taken in higher-than-recommended doses or used for a long time. The risk increases if you drink alcohol, already have liver disease, or take other medicines that contain similar ingredients. Stop taking the medicine and seek medical help if you notice symptoms such as yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine, severe tiredness, or unusual weakness.

faq.question: Can Nicip Plus Tablet be used during pregnancy?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet should generally be avoided during pregnancy unless a doctor specifically advises it. Certain anti-inflammatory pain medicines can affect pregnancy and the baby, particularly during the later stages. If you experience pain during pregnancy, consult your doctor so that a safer treatment option can be recommended.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Nicip Plus Tablet?
faq.answer: While taking Nicip Plus Tablet, avoid drinking alcohol because it increases the risk of liver damage. Do not take other medicines that contain paracetamol or similar pain-relieving ingredients at the same time unless advised by your doctor. If you are prone to acidity, avoid taking the medicine on an empty stomach and try to eat light meals while using it. Staying well hydrated may also help reduce discomfort.

faq.question: Can I take Nicip Plus Tablet for many days for chronic pain?
faq.answer: Nicip Plus Tablet is not intended for long-term or daily use for chronic pain unless your doctor closely supervises the treatment. Repeated or prolonged use can increase the risk of liver problems and may hide the underlying cause of the pain. Chronic pain conditions often require proper evaluation and a long-term treatment plan. Consult your doctor for safer options rather than using Nicip Plus Tablet regularly for extended periods.

description:
Nicoduce 5 Tablet is a medicine used to prevent and treat heart-related chest pain (angina).
It is usually prescribed when other heart medicines are either not suitable or have not worked.
It reduces the risk of an angina attack by widening blood vessels and improving blood flow to the heart.
Nicoduce 5 Tablet may be taken with or without food.
It should be swallowed whole with water.
Take this medicine regularly and at about the same time(s) each day.
Your doctor will decide the dose and how often you should take it.
This may change from time to time depending on how well it is working.
Do not stop taking it without talking to our doctor as sudden withdrawal may cause your chest pain to come back.
You can improve the health of your heart by making some lifestyle changes such as quitting smoking, cutting down on alcohol, eating well, exercising regularly, and managing stress.The most common side effect of this medicine is headache, especially during the first few days of treatment.
This usually improves within a week.
However, drinking plenty of fluids and avoiding alcohol may help.
Other common side effects include dizziness or weakness, nausea, and flushing (sense of warmth in the face, ears, neck, and trunk).
Talk to your doctor if these bother you or do not go away.Nicoduce 5 Tablet may not be suitable for some people.
Inform your doctor if you have a history of low blood pressure or heart failure.
Also let your doctor know about all other medications that you are using as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
You should not take any medicines for erectile dysfunction with this medicine.
Nicoduce 5 Tablet is not usually recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

faq.question: What class of drug is Nicoduce 5 Tablet and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Nicoduce 5 Tablet belongs to a class of medicines known as “potassium channel openers”. It causes widening of the arteries. This decreases the workload of the heart to pump the blood. It also improves the blood and oxygen supply to your heart muscle. It is prescribed to patients with stable angina (heart-related chest pain) who cannot take other medicines (beta-blockers, calcium channel antagonist) meant for angina.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Nicoduce 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking Nicoduce 5 Tablet without speaking to your doctor first. If you stop Nicoduce 5 Tablet suddenly, your anginal pain may recur. Talk to your doctor if you are experiencing any side effects.

faq.question: For how long do I need to continue Nicoduce 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: Continue taking your medicine for as long as your doctor tells you. Nicoduce 5 Tablet is generally prescribed for a long term. You may even need to take it for the rest of your life.

faq.question: What if somebody accidentally takes excess of Nicoduce 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: He or she should be taken to the hospital immediately. The person may experience signs of low blood pressure, which include feeling weak or dizzy. He or she may also experience irregular or fast heart beat.

faq.question: Can I take Nicoduce 5 Tablet if I am taking aspirin?
faq.answer: You should avoid taking Nicoduce 5 Tablet and aspirin together. Taking the two medicines together increases the risk of ulcer or bleeding in the mouth, stomach or intestine. Immediately consult your doctor, If you notice blood in your stool or vomit while using Nicoduce 5 Tablet.

faq.question: Who should not use Nicoduce 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: People who are allergic to Nicoduce 5 Tablet or any of its ingredients should avoid using this medicine. Also, patients who have heart problems such as cardiogenic shock or left ventricular failure with low filling pressure or cardiac decompensation or have a build-up of fluid in the lungs (pulmonary edema) should not use Nicoduce 5 Tablet. Additionally, patients taking medicines to treat erectile dysfunction (e.g., sildenafil, tadalafil, and vardenafil) or medicines to treat pulmonary hypertension (e.g., riociguat) should not use the medication. Your blood pressure may be affected if these medicines are taken with Nicoduce 5 Tablet or if you have low blood volume.

faq.question: Can Nicoduce 5 Tablet affect my sex life?
faq.answer: No, Nicoduce 5 Tablet does not affect your sex life. However, it is not recommended to take medicines used to treat erectile dysfunction (e.g., sildenafil or tadalafil) or premature ejaculation (e.g., vardenafil or dapoxetine) while taking Nicoduce 5 Tablet. Taking them together can lead to a serious drop in your blood pressure.
