description:
Prominad Tablet is used alone or in combination with other medicines to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus.
It helps control the high blood sugar levels seen in diabetes.
This reduces the chances of serious complications of diabetes and also helps prevent heart disease.
Prominad Tablet can be taken before a meal, but you should try to take it at the same time every day.
The dose will be decided by your doctor.
Do not stop taking it without asking your doctor.
If you do, your blood sugar levels may increase and put you at risk of serious complications like kidney damage and blindness.
This medicine is only part of a treatment program that should include a healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight reduction as advised by your doctor.The most common side effects of this medicine include fungal infection of the vagina, urinary tract infection, and frequent urge to urinate.
It may cause the body to lose too much water.
Drink plenty of fluids to prevent dehydration.
Maintaining good hygiene can help prevent fungal infections in the genital area.Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver problems or a urinary tract infection or if you are on water pills (diuretics).
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Avoid excessive alcohol intake while taking it as this may increase the risk of developing some side effects.
Monitor your blood sugar levels regularly while taking this medicine.

faq.question: What is Prominad Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Prominad Tablet is used in adults with type 2 diabetes to lower blood sugar levels. It works best when used along with diet and exercise. It is also used in adults having diabetes and cardiovascular disease together. Its use in such patients helps reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke or death due to these cardiovascular events.

faq.question: Is Prominad Tablet the same as metformin?
faq.answer: No, Prominad Tablet is not the same as metformin. Prominad Tablet is a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor whereas metformin is a biguanide. Prominad Tablet lowers blood sugar by causing the kidneys to get rid of more glucose in the urine. On the other hand, metformin works by reducing the amount of sugar which your liver releases into your blood.

faq.question: How do you take Prominad Tablet?
faq.answer: Take Prominad Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. You should swallow the tablet whole with water. You can take your tablet with or without food. It is best to take it before the first meal of the day, preferably at the same time each day. This will help you remember to take it.

faq.question: How do I know that Prominad Tablet is working?
faq.answer: Keep a record of your blood sugar levels, daily or at regular intervals. You can show this record to your doctor on your next visit. Your doctor will analyze these reports and tell you whether the medicine is working or not.

faq.question: What types of patients are more prone to amputation?
faq.answer: Patients having a history of amputation are more prone to lower limb amputation. The risk is also high in patients with foot ulcers or sores or who have or had heart disease. Also, patients who have or have suffered from peripheral vascular disease (narrowing of blood vessels in feet, legs, or arms causing numbness, pain, or coldness) and neuropathy (nerve damage that causes tingling, numbness, and pain, usually in your hands and feet) also have a high risk of lower limb amputation.

faq.question: Can Prominad Tablet cause weight loss?
faq.answer: Prominad Tablet usually causes loss of fat mass which further leads to weight loss. However, this may vary from person to person depending upon the doses and whether it is being used alone or with other diabetes medications.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Prominad Tablet?
faq.answer: The serious side effects of Prominad Tablet include ketoacidosis (increased ketones in your blood or urine), some allergic reaction, sudden kidney impairment, serious urinary tract infections and low blood sugar (hypoglycemia). Prominad Tablet may also cause a serious bacterial infection that may damage the tissue under the skin in the area between and around the anus and genitals (perineum), although it is rare. It works by slowing the heart rate and relaxing blood vessels, helping to reduce strain on the heart and improve blood flow.
Take Pronate 20 Tablet in the dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
It will depend on what you are being treated for and how you respond to the medicine.
You should always take it as prescribed by the doctor.
It can be taken with or without food.
You should keep taking it even if you feel well, as you are still getting the benefits.
If you stop taking it suddenly, your condition may worsen.The most common side effects of Pronate 20 Tablet include tiredness, dizziness, weakness, cold fingers or toes, and stomach pain.
You may also experience nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.
Talk to your doctor if the side effects bother you or do not go away.
Most side effects are short-lived and improve as your body gets used to the medicine.You should not use Pronate 20 Tablet if you have asthma, very slow or uneven heartbeats, or a serious heart condition, including heart failure.

faq.question: My doctor has prescribed Pronate 20 Tablet even though my blood pressure is within normal limits. Is it because of the chest pain that I complained of?
faq.answer: Yes, it is possible that your doctor prescribed Pronate 20 Tablet for chest pain (angina). Pronate 20 Tablet is a beta-blocker that is used to lower high blood pressure, prevent angina, treat or prevent heart attacks, or reduce your risk of heart problems following a heart attack.

faq.question: Can Pronate 20 Tablet be used in asthmatics?
faq.answer: No, Pronate 20 Tablet cannot be used in asthmatics. This is because using Pronate 20 Tablet in asthma patients can cause breathing problems, which may trigger an asthma attack. Always inform your doctor if you have or ever had asthma or any episodes of difficulty breathing, before starting treatment with Pronate 20 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Pronate 20 Tablet as my chest pain is under control?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking Pronate 20 Tablet suddenly because that may worsen your angina or may cause a heart attack. Tell your doctor, and if there is a need to stop Pronate 20 Tablet, your doctor will reduce your dose gradually over a few weeks.

faq.question: Does Pronate 20 Tablet relieve anxiety?
faq.answer: Yes, Pronate 20 Tablet helps relieve the symptoms of anxiety such as irritability, restlessness, excessive worry, lack of concentration, racing or unwanted thoughts, fatigue, insomnia (lack of sleep), palpitations (irregular heart rate), or trembling. The dose and duration of taking Pronate 20 Tablet will be suggested by your doctor, depending on whether your symptoms are a recurring problem or occur only in stressful conditions. However, Pronate 20 Tablet is usually given for the short-term treatment of anxiety. If you have any doubts, consult your doctor.

faq.question: What other lifestyle changes should I make while taking Pronate 20 Tablet?
faq.answer:
Lifestyle changes play a major role in keeping you healthy if you are taking Pronate 20 Tablet. Avoid taking excess salt in your diet and find ways to reduce or manage stress in your life. Practice yoga or meditation, or take up a hobby. Ensure that you have a sound sleep every night, as this also helps reduce stress levels and helps keep your blood pressure normal.
Stop smoking and alcohol consumption, as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and eat a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables, and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Pronate 20 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: I have been on Indomethacin for several months. Will it be a problem if I start taking Pronate 20 Tablet along with it?

description:
Prost 200 Tablet is a medicine used for medical abortion (terminating a pregnancy).
It is also used for preventing excessive bleeding after delivery.
This medicine acts on the uterus and increases its contraction.
Prost 200 Tablet is given alone or in combination with some other medicine to attain the maximum benefit.
It should be taken with food or as your doctor's advice.
It should be taken orally, by swallow the tablets whole with a drink of water.
If you experience vomiting within 30 minutes of tablet intake, inform your doctor or take another tablet.
The medicine may take 24 hours to show its action and you experience bleeding.Common side effects of this medicine include infection following abortion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, uterine contractions or cramping, uterine bleeding, heavy bleeding, and fetal malformations.
If these bother you or appear serious, let your doctor know.
There may be ways of reducing or preventing them.
Usually, vaginal bleeding may last for 12 days, inform your doctor if it lasts for more than 12 days or you notice severe abdominal pain.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had an ectopic pregnancy, or you are breastfeeding or using an intrauterine device.
Your doctor should also know about all other medicines you are taking as many of these may make this medicine less effective or change the way it works.
You must avoid strenuous activity like heavy exercise, running, and driving while abortion as it can affect the bleeding.
Your doctor may perform an ultrasound or pelvic examination to check for abortion completion.

faq.question: What is Prost 200 Tablet and what is used for?
faq.answer: Prost 200 Tablet contains a medicine called Misoprostol. It helps in medical termination of the pregnancy. It is prescribed along with another medicine called Mifepristone. It is only used to terminate a pregnancy which should not be more than 63 days old, counting from the first day of the last menstrual period. It works by increasing the contractions of the uterus. It may also be used in the prevention or treatment of post-delivery bleeding and for cervical ripening.

faq.question: How and in what dose should I take Prost 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: This medicine is administered only in a clinic or healthcare facility under the supervision of a gynaecologist.

faq.question: What should I expect after taking Prost 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: For medical termination of pregnancy: You may experience abdominal cramping, diarrhea, stomach pain, and nausea immediately after taking Prost 200 Tablet. You may also have vaginal bleeding within 4 hours of taking Prost 200 Tablet. You may also be asked to stay at the clinic or healthcare center for at least 3 hours after taking this medicine. After 14 days of taking Mifepristone (pill you took before Prost 200 Tablet) your gynaecologist may run some blood tests or perform ultrasonography to confirm whether pregnancy has been terminated or not.

faq.question: Can Prost 200 Tablet affect my future chances of getting pregnant?
faq.answer: No, studies have shown that this medicine does not impair the fertility of the women. Your future chances of getting pregnant are as equal as of those who have not taken this medicine.

faq.question: What are the common side effects of taking Prost 200 Tablet?
faq.answer: The common side effects of using Prost 200 Tablet are abdominal pain, abdominal cramping, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, uterine contractions, pelvic pain, and shivering. If you experience a very heavy vaginal bleeding or if any of these side effects bother you please consult with your gynaecologist.

name: prost 200 tablet

description:
Protera D Capsule is a medicine that is used to treat conditions like gastroesophageal acid reflux disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis, gastritis, gastric and duodenal ulcers, and indigestion with symptoms like heartburn, bloating, and regurgitation.
Take Protera D Capsule exactly as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily before breakfast.
Swallow it whole with water; do not crush or chew.
To get the best results, maintain a healthy diet, avoid late-night meals, caffeine, spicy or oily foods, and stop smoking or alcohol use.
Do not skip doses or stop early, even if you feel better, as that may lead to a return of the symptoms.The most common side effect of Protera D Capsule is dry mouth.
It may also cause headache, dizziness, diarrhea, nausea, or mild stomach discomfort in some people.
These are usually temporary.
If you experience persistent vomiting, irregular heartbeat, rash, or severe diarrhea, contact your doctor immediately.
Staying hydrated and taking the medicine before meals may help reduce stomach-related side effects.Inform your doctor about any liver, kidney, or heart problems before starting Protera D Capsule.
Avoid taking it with other drugs that may affect heart rhythm or interact with domperidone or pantoprazole.
Do not use it if you have a history of gastrointestinal bleeding or obstruction, or if you are allergic to any of the ingredients in the medicine.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use.

faq.question: What is Protera D Capsule and how does it help?
faq.answer: Protera D Capsule is a combination of two medicines used to treat acidity, heartburn, and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) — a condition in which stomach acid flows back into the food pipe (esophagus). It works by improving the movement of the stomach and intestines, helping food pass more easily through the digestive tract. It also reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach, providing relief from acid-related indigestion and heartburn.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Protera D Capsule?
faq.answer: Protera D Capsule is safe for most of the patients. However, in some patients, it may cause common side effects like diarrhea, stomach pain, flatulence, dryness in the mouth, dizziness, headache, and other uncommon and rare side effects. If you experience any persistent problem while taking this medication, inform your doctor.

faq.question: Are there any specific contraindications associated with the use of Protera D Capsule?
faq.answer: The use of Protera D Capsule is considered to be harmful for patients with a known hypersensitivity to pantoprazole or domperidone, or any other inactive ingredients of the medicine. Caution is advised in patients with underlying kidney or liver disease. This medicine should not be used if you have a history of gastrointestinal bleeding or obstruction.

faq.question: Can the use of Protera D Capsule cause dry mouth?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Protera D Capsule can cause dry mouth. If you experience dry mouth, drink plenty of water. Take regular sips of water during the day and keep some water on your bedside at night. Cut down the intake of alcohol and avoid smoking. If you have a dry mouth, try to use alcohol-free mouthwash as its use can increase the risk of tooth decay.

faq.question: Can the use of Protera D Capsule cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Protera D Capsule can cause diarrhea. In case you experience diarrhea, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small, frequent sips. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. Talk to your doctor if diarrhea persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like less urination with dark colored and strong-smelling urine.

faq.question: While taking Protera D Capsule, which foods should be avoided?
faq.answer: You should preferably avoid foods that cause acidity and heartburn as they will only worsen your condition, for example, fried or spicy food, butter, oil, and juices, caffeinated drinks like cola or tea, drinks from citrus fruits like lemon water or orange juice, and alcohol.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Protera D Capsule if I feel better?
faq.answer: If you have been taking Protera D Capsule for a long time, stopping it abruptly may lead to increased acid production, thereby worsening your symptoms. Therefore, you must discuss any dose changes with your doctor.

faq.question: What are the instructions for storage and disposal of Protera D Capsule?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children, and other people.

description:
Prozoten 1 mg Tablet is used to treat hypertension (high blood pressure).
It may also be used to treat mild prostate gland enlargement in men (known as Benign Prostate Hyperplasia), painful cold fingers (Raynaud’s Disease) and heart failure.Prozoten 1 mg Tablet contains Prazosin, an alpha-blocker, which works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow.
In patients with an enlarged prostate, it relaxes the muscles around the bladder and prostate so that urine is passed more easily.The common side effects of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet are drowsiness, headache, weakness, dizziness, nausea, and dry mouth.
Most of these side effects do not require medical attention and gradually resolve over time.
However, if the side effects are persistent, reach out to your doctor.Do not take Prozoten 1 mg Tablet if you are allergic to any of its components.
Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Let your doctor know about your health conditions and medications to prevent any potential interactions.

faq.question: What is Prozoten 1 mg Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension), Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia, and Cold Finger Syndrome (Raynaud's disease).

faq.question: How does Prozoten 1 mg Tablet work?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet contains Prazosin, an alpha-blocker that acts by relaxing and widening the constricted blood vessels. This reduces the heart's workload and makes the heart more efficient at pumping blood throughout the body. Thus, it reduces high blood pressure and reduces the chances of a future heart attack or stroke.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Prozoten 1 mg Tablet when my blood pressure is under control?
faq.answer: No, do not discontinue Prozoten 1 mg Tablet on your own. To treat your condition effectively, keep taking Prozoten 1 mg Tablet for the prescribed duration.

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: In case, you have missed a dose of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet , you are advised to take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is time for you to take your next dose, then do not take both doses together. Take only one dose; taking a double dose of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet will lead to low blood pressure.

faq.question: How long can Prozoten 1 mg Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet can be safely taken as long as your doctor has prescribed it to you. Conditions such as high blood pressure are lifelong, and one should not abruptly discontinue it without discussing it with a doctor.

faq.question: Can use of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, Prozoten 1 mg Tablet may cause dizziness. It is advised to avoid driving or operate any heavy machinery while taking Prozoten 1 mg Tablet . In case you feel dizzy or light-headed, it is advised to rest for some time until you feel better.

faq.question: Can Prozoten 1 mg Tablet cause priapism (prolonged penile erection)?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet may cause priapism (prolonged erections) sometimes. If you have an erection that lasts more than four hours, inform your doctor and seek emergency medical help, as if not treated, it can lead to tissue scarring or erectile dysfunction.

faq.question: Can Prozoten 1 mg Tablet cause nasal congestion?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet can cause nasal congestion due to dilation of vessels in the nasal mucosa.

faq.question: Is Prozoten 1 mg Tablet a sleeping pill?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet is not a sleeping pill. It is used to lower blood pressure in patients with hypertension.

faq.question: Can Prozoten 1 mg Tablet get you high?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet cannot get you high as it doesn’t have the potential of abuse or dependence.

faq.question: Is Prozoten 1 mg Tablet used for anxiety?
faq.answer: Though prazosin may help with anxiety, especially related to chronic PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder), it is not used for anxiety.

faq.question: How should Prozoten 1 mg Tablet be taken?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet should be swallowed as a whole with water. It can be taken before or after food and drinks.

faq.question: What precautions should be followed while taking Prozoten 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet might cause dizziness or light-headedness, which may be caused by low blood pressure upon sitting or standing up quickly. To prevent this, avoid standing or sitting up quickly. Lie down and try getting up slowly after you feel better.

faq.question: What class of drug is Prozoten 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Prozoten 1 mg Tablet belongs to the class of drugs called alpha-blockers. It relaxes the blood vessels and helps treat high blood pressure.

faq.question: What are the side effects of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet ?
faq.answer: Side effects of Prozoten 1 mg Tablet are drowsiness, headache, weakness, dizziness, nausea, and feeling exhausted. If the side effects are persistent, reach out to your doctor.

description:
Pryor Tablet is a medication used in the treatment of prostate cancer.
It works by blocking the effects of testosterone on prostate cancer cells, which help slow down the growth and spread of prostate cancer.
It is often used in combination with other therapies to treat prostate cancer.
Pryor Tablet may be taken with or without food.
However, always take it in the dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
Also, continue taking this medicine for as long as your doctor prescribes it, as missing a dose or stopping the treatment prematurely can reduce its effectiveness and may impact overall treatment outcomes.Some common side effects of this medicine include fatigue, skin rash, hypertension, hot flush, arthralgia, diarrhea, falls, and weight loss.
These side effects mostly occur at the initial stage of the treatment and usually disappear within a few days with continued treatment.
However, let your doctor know if any of these side effects get worse or bother you.
The doctor may also monitor you regularly to check the effectiveness of the medicine.Pryor Tablet is not suitable for everyone.
To make sure it is safe for you, let your doctor know if you have a known history of allergic reactions to any of the ingredients of this medicine or have any other pre-existing medical conditions.
Also, inform the doctor if you are taking, have recently taken, or might take any other medicines.
This medicine is also contraindicated in pregnant or breastfeeding women, as it can cause harm to the developing fetus or nursing baby.

faq.question: What is Pryor Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Pryor Tablet is used to treat certain types of prostate cancer that are still growing even when testosterone levels are low (called castration-resistant prostate cancer), or that have spread to other parts of the body but are still sensitive to testosterone (called metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer). It helps slow down cancer growth and lowers the risk of it spreading further.

faq.question: Can Pryor Tablet be used alone for prostate cancer treatment?
faq.answer: Your doctor may prescribe Pryor Tablet along with another treatment that lowers testosterone, such as surgery to remove the testicles, or medicines that block testosterone production. Testosterone fuels prostate cancer growth, so this product works best when testosterone levels are kept low.

faq.question: Who should not take Pryor Tablet?
faq.answer: Individuals should not take Pryor Tablet if they are allergic to it or any of its ingredients. People with a history of severe allergic reactions, seizures, or certain heart problems should inform their doctor before starting the treatment. This product is for men only and should not be used by women or children.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Pryor Tablet I should watch out for?
faq.answer: Some serious side effects of Pryor Tablet may include seizures, fainting, falls, fractures, severe skin rash, or allergic reactions such as swelling and trouble breathing. If you experience any of these symptoms, get medical help right away.

faq.question: Can Pryor Tablet cause skin reactions or rashes?
faq.answer: Yes, some people may develop skin rashes or allergic reactions while taking Pryor Tablet. Severe skin rashes may include redness, blisters, or peeling. Contact your doctor immediately if you notice these symptoms.

faq.question: Does Pryor Tablet affect bone strength or increase fracture risk?
faq.answer: Yes, Pryor Tablet can make bones weaker, especially when used with testosterone-lowering treatments. This may increase the risk of falls or bone fractures. Your doctor may recommend supplements or lifestyle changes to protect your bone health.

faq.question: Can women or children take Pryor Tablet?
faq.answer: No, Pryor Tablet is meant for adult men only. It should not be used by women or children. Women who are pregnant or may become pregnant should not handle crushed or broken product, as it may harm the unborn baby.

faq.question: How does Pryor Tablet help improve survival in prostate cancer?
faq.answer: Pryor Tablet helps by blocking signals that drive prostate cancer cells to grow and spread. Clinical studies indicate that it may delay cancer progression and support survival in men with advanced prostate cancer when used as prescribed along with hormone therapy.

faq.question: What regular monitoring is needed during Pryor Tablet?
faq.answer: Your doctor will monitor your blood pressure, liver function, thyroid levels, and bone health during Pryor Tablet treatment. Regular medical visits help ensure that the product is working effectively and that any side effects are managed early.

description:
Psoriax 7.5 Tablet is a medicine used for the treatment of cancer in various parts of the body.
It is also used to treat rheumatoid arthritis, severe and uncontrolled psoriasis, and Crohn’s disease.
It works by slowing the growth of abnormal cells and reducing immune system activity in autoimmune conditions.
Psoriax 7.5 Tablet may be used alone or in combination with other medicines.
You should take it exactly as your doctor has advised.
Taking too much of it can cause serious side effects.
It may take several weeks or months for you to see or feel the benefits, but do not stop taking it unless your doctor tells you to.The most common side effects of this medicine are ulcerative stomatitis, hair loss, low blood cell count, increased liver enzymes, nausea, and abdominal distress.
Your doctor may advise you to take folic acid to reduce some of these.
If they do not go away or get worse, tell your doctor.
There may be ways of preventing or reducing these effects.Psoriax 7.5 Tablet may lower your ability to fight infections and lead to problems with your blood, liver, or kidneys.
Your doctor may perform several tests, such as blood tests, X-rays, and physical examinations, both before and during the treatment with this medicine to check for these problems.Before taking it, tell your doctor if you have problems related to the stomach, liver, or kidneys, or are taking any medicines to treat infections.
Many other medicines can affect or be affected by this medicine, so let your doctor know about all your medications.
This medicine is not recommended during pregnancy or while breastfeeding, as it may harm the baby.
You should avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may increase your risk of liver damage.

faq.question: Can Psoriax 7.5 Tablet cause mouth ulcers?
faq.answer: Yes, Psoriax 7.5 Tablet can cause a sore mouth and mouth ulcers as side effects in some cases. Taking folic acid along with Psoriax 7.5 Tablet may help in reducing the ulcers. Ask your doctor if the dose can be reduced, as dose reduction may further help in reducing the ulcers.

faq.question: Why do I have to take folic acid with Psoriax 7.5 Tablet?
faq.answer: Folic acid is required to make new cells in the body, and Psoriax 7.5 Tablet decreases the folic acid levels in the body. Folic acid can help reduce some of the side effects of Psoriax 7.5 Tablet, such as mouth ulcers, hair loss, nausea, heartburn, abdominal pain, fatigue, anemia, and liver problems.

faq.question: Why do I need to take regular blood tests while taking Psoriax 7.5 Tablet?
faq.answer: Regular blood tests will help your doctor to check your response to Psoriax 7.5 Tablet and monitor you for side effects. You will need to regularly check your liver function and your blood counts (white blood cells, red blood cells, and platelets). Your doctor may also order additional tests depending on the results.

faq.question: Can Psoriax 7.5 Tablet use make me more prone to infections?
faq.answer: Psoriax 7.5 Tablet may decrease the activity of your immune system. As a result, you may develop serious infections. There have been rare reports that suggest the occurrence of serious lung infections with the use of Psoriax 7.5 Tablet. If you have an active infection, Psoriax 7.5 Tablet should be used with extreme caution.

faq.question: Can Psoriax 7.5 Tablet affect fertility?
faq.answer: Yes, Psoriax 7.5 Tablet may affect fertility in both males and females. It may cause a decrease in sperm count in males and menstrual disturbances in females. No need to worry; these effects are reversible and disappear once the therapy is discontinued.

faq.question: What to do if I am planning to become pregnant and my husband is taking Psoriax 7.5 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should avoid pregnancy if your husband is taking Psoriax 7.5 Tablet. Also, it is advised that pregnancy should be further avoided for a minimum of 3 months after the therapy, as it can lead to serious fetal abnormalities.

description:
Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps is a combination of two medicines in one inhaler.
It relieves the long-term symptoms of asthma and COPD, making breathing easier.
It works by inhibiting the release of certain chemical messengers that cause inflammation (swelling) and relaxes the muscles in the airways.
Your doctor will tell you how often you need to use your inhaler.
The effect of this medicine may be noticeable after a few days but will only reach its maximum after a few weeks.
This medicine must be used regularly to be effective, so go on taking it even if you don't have any symptoms.
That means it’s doing its job.
If you stop taking it your symptoms may get worse.
This medicine should not be used to relieve sudden shortness of breath.
If sudden shortness of breath occurs, use your rescue inhaler.
To get the benefit from this medicine you need to make sure you get your inhaler technique right, otherwise, it does not work as well.The most common side effects include headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, and respiratory tract infection.
If you get there, don’t stop taking it but do talk to your doctor.
You can prevent some of these symptoms by rinsing your mouth and throat with water or brushing your teeth after using your inhaler.
There are other, rarer side effects which can be serious.
Talk to your doctor if you're worried about them.Before taking it, you should tell your doctor if you have any kidney or liver diseases so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
You should also tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

faq.question: What is Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps prescribed for?
faq.answer: Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps is prescribed to treat symptoms of obstructive airways diseases like asthma and chronic pulmonary obstructive disease. The usual symptoms of obstructive airways diseases like asthma and COPD are wheezing, shortness of breath, breathlessness and chest tightness.

faq.question: Does Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps contain steroids?
faq.answer: Budesonide, which is a component of foracort, is a corticosteroid. Corticosteroids are anti-inflammatory medicines used to treat a range of conditions like asthma. They’re different from anabolic steroids which are used illegally to gain muscle mass.

faq.question: Will Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps be more effective if taken in more than recommended dose?
faq.answer: No, taking more of this medicine will not make it more effective, rather it can lead to increased side effects. If the symptoms are not getting relieved by the recommended doses, please consult the doctor for re-evaluation.

faq.question: When can I drink water after taking Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps?
faq.answer: There are no restrictions on drinking water after taking Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps. However, it is better to rinse your mouth before drinking water to avoid ingestion of this medicine.

faq.question: What should I discuss with my doctor before starting treatment with Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps?
faq.answer: Inform the doctor about your detailed medical and surgical history. Inform your doctor if you have heart, liver or kidney disease. Inform your doctor about other medications you may be taking.

faq.question: When should I stop using the Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps?
faq.answer: You should consult a doctor before stopping the treatment with Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps. Do not abruptly discontinue unless advised by your doctor, otherwise it may lead to an asthma attack. Therefore, using Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps as recommended by your doctor is important.

faq.question: Is Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps safe during pregnancy?
faq.answer: Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps rotacaps is considered safe for use during pregnancy. However, your doctor may give you Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps only if it is needed and the advantage of taking it outweighs the risk. You should always consult a doctor before making any changes to your medication during pregnancy.

faq.question: Can I take antifungal medicine along with Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps?
faq.answer: Always consult your doctor for any concomitant medications that you may be taking. The doctor’s recommendations must be followed for medication advice.

faq.question: What are the common side effects of Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps?
faq.answer: Some commonly reported side effects of Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps are headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort and dizziness. However, these symptoms are usually mild and resolve on their own.

faq.question: What are the instructions for storage and disposal of Pulmosmart 200 Pulmicaps?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

It helps control blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.
Glycigon-M Tablet should be taken with food.
Take it regularly at the same time each day to get the most benefit.
Your doctor will decide what dose is best for you and this may change from time to time according to how it is working according to your blood sugar levels.Keep taking this medicine, even if you feel well or your blood sugar levels are controlled.
If you stop it without consulting your doctor, your blood sugar levels could rise and put you at risk of kidney damage, blindness, nerve problems and loss of limbs.

description:
Pyrilot 650 Tablet helps relieve pain and fever by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that trigger these symptoms.
It is used to treat headaches, migraines, toothaches, period pains, arthritis, and muscle aches, and to reduce fever associated with infections such as the common cold and flu.
Pyrilot 650 Tablet may be prescribed alone or in combination with another medicine.
You should take it regularly as advised by your doctor.
It is best taken with food to prevent an upset stomach.
Do not take more or for longer than the recommended duration.Side effects are rare when taken in the correct dose.
However, it may cause upset stomach, nausea, or vomiting in some people.

faq.question: What if I vomit after taking Pyrilot 650 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you vomit shortly after taking Pyrilot 650 Tablet, the amount of medicine absorbed into your body will depend on how quickly you vomited after taking it. If you vomit within 15 to 30 minutes of taking the dose, the dose may be repeated.

faq.question: What is Pyrilot 650 Tablet, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Pyrilot 650 Tablet is a widely used pain reliever and fever reducer. It works by blocking certain chemical signals in the brain that cause pain and raise body temperature. It is used for fever and mild to moderate pain such as headaches, toothaches, muscle aches, and body pain.

faq.question: How long will it take Pyrilot 650 Tablet to reduce my fever, and when will I start feeling better?
faq.answer: Pyrilot 650 Tablet generally begins to reduce fever and relieve pain within 30 to 60 minutes of an oral dose. The effect usually peaks at 1 to 2 hours and typically lasts 4 to 6 hours, after which another dose may be taken if needed.

faq.question: Can I take Pyrilot 650 Tablet and ibuprofen together?
faq.answer: Yes, in most adults, paracetamol and ibuprofen can be taken together safely. They belong to different classes of medicines and work in different ways, so combining them does not increase the risk of side effects. However, people with stomach ulcers or inflammatory bowel disease, kidney problems, or pregnant women should consult their doctor before taking them together.

faq.question: Is Pyrilot 650 Tablet safe for children, and can it be given to kids under 12?
faq.answer: Yes, Pyrilot 650 Tablet is widely considered safe for children, including infants. Do not give adult-strength tablets to young children. Always consult a doctor before giving it to your child.

faq.question: How much Pyrilot 650 Tablet can I take in a day, and how long should I wait between doses?
faq.answer: For most adults, do not exceed 4 g (4000 mg) in 24 hours. The medicine's effect typically lasts up to 4 to 6 hours, after which another dose may be taken if needed. Paracetamol may be present in many other medicines for cold, flu, and pain relief. Taking Pyrilot 650 Tablet with them may increase the total dose in your body, increasing the risk of liver damage.

faq.question: What happens if I take Pyrilot 650 Tablet even if I do not have a fever?
faq.answer: If taken at the recommended dose without fever, Pyrilot 650 Tablet will simply relieve pain without causing any abnormal drop in body temperature. If you regularly take it for ongoing pain without a clear reason, or if your symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor for proper assessment.

faq.question: Can I take Pyrilot 650 Tablet if I have a known liver condition?
faq.answer: The liver primarily processes (metabolizes) paracetamol, and taking too much can cause serious liver damage. If you have a known liver condition, discuss your situation with your doctor, as you may require dose adjustment and monitoring.

faq.question: What should I do if I accidentally take a double dose of Pyrilot 650 Tablet?
faq.answer: Taking one extra dose of paracetamol is usually not harmful for a healthy adult. It is slightly above the usual single dose but well below dangerous levels. In such a case, skip the next dose for 8–10 hours. Avoid alcohol, and do not take any other medicines containing paracetamol. Stay hydrated and eat light. However, if you have liver disease, drink alcohol regularly, take repeated high doses, or notice symptoms such as vomiting, abdominal pain (right side), yellowing of skin/eyes, unusual fatigue, or dark urine, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Can I take Pyrilot 650 Tablet along with my daily blood pressure medication?
faq.answer: Always inform your doctor that you are on blood pressure medication before regularly using any painkiller, including paracetamol. In general, paracetamol is considered one of the safer pain-relief options for people taking blood pressure (antihypertensive) medication, particularly when compared to other anti-inflammatory medicines.

description:
Pyrolate Injection is an anticholinergic medication.
It is used before or even during an operation to reduce secretions and it even reverses the unwanted effects of certain medicines used during surgery (muscle relaxants).
It also helps to treat peptic ulcers when oral medication is not tolerated.
Pyrolate Injection is given by your doctor or nurse.
Let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
You should keep taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early your symptoms may come back and your condition may worsen.The most common side effects of this medicine include dry mouth, urinary retention, blurred vision, photophobia, dilation of the pupil, cycloplegia, increased heart rate, increased eye pressure, tachycardia, bradycardia, palpitation, and reduced sweating.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine as it can worsen your sleepiness.Inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, myasthenia gravis, heart failure, and high blood pressure.

faq.question: Is Pyrolate Injection a narcotic?
faq.answer: No, Pyrolate Injection is not a narcotic.

faq.question: Does Pyrolate Injection cause tachycardia?
faq.answer: Yes, Pyrolate Injection has its action on the heart which increases the heart rate (tachycardia). This property of the medication is utilized during surgery to prevent the fall of heart rate due to various other supplemental anesthetic medications.

faq.question: Can Pyrolate Injection cause constipation?
faq.answer: Yes, Pyrolate Injection can cause constipation because of its action on the intestine. It decreases the intestinal secretions and also decreases the gut motility which can result in constipation.

faq.question: Does Pyrolate Injection increase blood pressure?
faq.answer: Yes, Pyrolate Injection can sometimes lead to an increase in blood pressure. There are evidences where it has led to increased blood pressure. Therefore, when injected into a patient during a surgery, the heart rate and blood pressure are continuously monitored.

faq.question: I am on antidepressants currently. Can I take Pyrolate Injection?
faq.answer: Some classes of antidepressant medicines can worsen the side effects of Pyrolate Injection and cause uneasiness for the patient. These antidepressant medicines may include tricyclic antidepressants (amitriptyline or imipramine), phenelzine, tranylcypromine, clozapine, etc. Therefore, do inform your doctor about your previous illness and the medicines you are taking before you take this medication. Your doctor may make the necessary adjustments.

It is used for treating acid-related diseases of the stomach and intestine, such as acid reflux, peptic ulcer disease, and some other stomach conditions associated with excessive acid production.
PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry is also used to prevent stomach ulcers and acidity.
This medicine should be taken one hour before a meal.
The dose and duration of the treatment will depend on your underlying condition and how you respond to the medicine.
You should keep on taking it as prescribed, even if your symptoms disappear quickly.
You can increase the efficiency of the treatment by eating smaller meals more often and avoiding caffeinated drinks (like tea and coffee) and spicy or fatty foods.The most common side effects of this medicine include nausea, abdominal pain, constipation, and diarrhea.

faq.question: What is PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry? What is it used for?
faq.answer: PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry belongs to a class of medicines known as proton pump inhibitors. PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry is used for the treatment of acidity, peptic ulcer disease (gastric and duodenal ulcers), reflux esophagitis, or gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). It works by reducing the amount of acid made by your stomach.

faq.question: Should PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry be taken empty stomach or with food?
faq.answer: PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry is taken on an empty stomach. It should be swallowed whole (remember not to chew or crush it) and taken at least 1 hour before a meal with some water.

faq.question: While taking PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry, which foods should be avoided?
faq.answer: It's best to avoid foods that trigger acidity and heartburn, as they can worsen your condition. These include fried or spicy foods, butter, oil, and caffeinated drinks like cola or tea.

faq.question: Is PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry used for children?
faq.answer: Yes, PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry is used in the management of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and erosive gastritis in children. However, the safety and effectiveness of PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry are established only in children between 1 and 17 years of age.

faq.question: What are the long term side effects of PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry?
faq.answer: If PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry is used for more than 3 months, certain long term side effects may be seen. The most important of these is low magnesium levels in your blood which may make you feel tired, confused, dizzy, shaky or dizzy. You may also have muscle twitches or irregular heartbeat. If the use is further prolonged for more than a year, you may have an increased risk of bone fractures (due to decreased calcium levels in the blood), especially hip, wrist or spine, stomach infections and vitamin B12 deficiency. Vitamin B12 deficiency can make you anemic, as a result of which you may feel more tired, weak, or pale. Additionally you may also have palpitations, shortness of breath, lightheadedness, indigestion, loss of appetite, flatulence (gas) or nerve problems such as numbness, tingling and problem in walking.

faq.question: How is PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry given through the nasogastric tube?
faq.answer: Your doctor or nurse will show you the correct way of giving PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry through the nasogastric (NG) tube. Open the PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry capsule and empty the granules into a syringe. Mix the contents with apple juice in the syringe and attach it to the NG tube and give directly into the stomach. Once given, flush the NG tube with more apple juice to clear the tube.

faq.question: Can PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry may cause diarrhea as a side effect in some people. This is usually not bothersome, but if you experience persistent watery stools that do not go away, along with stomach cramps and fever, get medical help immediately. These symptoms are most likely because of the overgrowth of harmful bacteria called C. difficile and the diarrhea is known as Clostridium difficile–associated diarrhea (CDAD). Use of PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry lowers the natural stomach acid which normally helps to kill bacteria and this can cause uncontrollable diarrhea associated with stomach cramps and fever.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry?
faq.answer: No, alcohol intake is not advised with PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry. Alcohol itself does not affect the working of PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry, but it can increase the acid production. This may further cause worsening of your symptoms.

faq.question: Is PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry is relatively safe to use. Most of the people who take PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry do not get a side effect. It is advised to be taken as directed by the doctor for maximum benefit.

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry?
faq.answer: Yes, you can take antacids along with PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry. Take it 2 hours before or after you take PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry.

faq.question: Can I stop taking PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry if I feel better?
faq.answer: If you have been taking PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry for a long time, stopping it abruptly may lead to increased acid production, thereby worsening your symptoms. Therefore, you must discuss any dose changes or if you wish to come off PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry.

faq.question: Can PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry cause weight gain?
faq.answer: Weight gain is reported in less than 1% of the patients taking PZ-Lan Tablet MD Strawberry but the exact cause is unknown. One possible explanation is higher food intake once the reflux symptoms are relieved. Lifestyle modifications such as proper diet and exercise can help to prevent weight gain.

Q-Sone Cream should be used only on the skin and exactly as prescribed.
Avoid any contact with your eyes, nose, or mouth.
Rinse it off with plenty of water in case of accidental contact.
Avoid covering the treated area with airtight dressings such as bandages unless directed by a doctor.Use of the medicine may cause itching or burning sensations, irritation, redness, and swelling at the site of application.
These side effects are temporary and usually go away with time.

faq.question: What is Q-Sone Cream? What is it used for?
faq.answer: Q-Sone Cream belongs to a group of medicines called steroids, also known as corticosteroids. Q-Sone Cream is used to treat various allergic skin conditions such as eczema and atopic dermatitis. Q-Sone Cream effectively reduces symptoms associated with such conditions, such as swelling, itching, and redness.

faq.question: Is Q-Sone Cream good for burns?
faq.answer: No, Q-Sone Cream should never be applied in those areas of the skin that have burns, cuts, or scrapes. If Q-Sone Cream accidentally gets onto such areas, rinse the area thoroughly with water. faq.question: Can I use Q-Sone Cream on my face, groin, or underarms?
faq.answer: No. Q-Sone Cream should not be used on the face, groin, or underarms unless your doctor specifically tells you to do so. These areas absorb corticosteroids more easily, which increases the risk of skin thinning, irritation, and other side effects.

faq.question: Is Q-Sone Cream safe for children?
faq.answer: No. This medicine is not recommended for use in children. Children absorb more steroids through the skin than adults, which puts them at a higher risk of growth problems, hormone suppression, and other serious side effects.

faq.question: Why is covering or wrapping the treated skin not allowed?

faq.question: When should I stop using the Quikhale FB 200 Capsule?

faq.question: What is Rabalkem-DSR Capsule?

faq.question: What are the contraindications of Rabalkem-DSR Capsule?

faq.question: Can the use of Rabalkem-DSR Capsule cause dry mouth?

faq.question: Can the use of Rabalkem-DSR Capsule cause diarrhea?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Rabalkem-DSR Capsule can cause diarrhea. In case you experience diarrhea, drink plenty of water or other fluids. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medication. Talk to your doctor if diarrhea persists and if you notice any signs of dehydration, like less urination with dark colored and strong-smelling urine.

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for Rabalkem-DSR Capsule?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Rabalkem-DSR Capsule?

faq.question: What is the best time to take Rabalkem-DSR Capsule?

faq.question: Can the use of Rabalkem-DSR Capsule cause abnormal heartbeat?

Rabekind 40 Tablet is a medicine that reduces the amount of acid produced in your stomach.
It is used in the treatment of acid-related diseases of the stomach and intestine such as acid reflux, peptic ulcer disease, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
It provides relief from symptoms and promotes healing.
Rabekind 40 Tablet medicine should be taken one hour before a meal, preferably in the morning.
The dose will depend on your underlying condition and how you respond to the medicine.
Try to take it regularly at the same time each day as advised by your doctor.
You should keep on taking it as prescribed even if your symptoms disappear quickly.
You may be able to help improve your symptoms by eating smaller meals more often and avoiding caffeinated drinks like tea and coffee, and spicy or fatty foods.This medicine's most common side effects include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, and stomach pain.
These tend to be mild but talk to your doctor if they bother you or do not go away.
The risk of side effects may increase the longer you take this medicine.
Long-term use (more than 1 year) may increase your risk for bone fractures, especially with higher doses.
Talk to your doctor about ways to prevent bone loss (osteoporosis), like taking calcium and vitamin D supplements.Low blood magnesium levels (hypomagnesemia) have been seen in some people taking this medicine for 3 months or more.
This may lead to tiredness, confusion, dizziness, muscle twitches, and an irregular heartbeat.
Your doctor may monitor your magnesium levels to prevent this.Rabekind 40 Tablet is not suitable for some people.
Before taking this medicine, you need to tell your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have ever had an allergic reaction to similar medicines in the past, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis).
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Avoid drinking alcohol as it makes your stomach produce excessive acid and can worsen your symptoms.
Do not drive or use machinery or tools, if this medicine makes you feel dizzy or sleepy.

faq.question: What is Rabekind 40 Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Rabekind 40 Tablet is used for the treatment of stomach and intestinal ulcers (gastric and duodenal ulcers), reflux esophagitis, or gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). It works by reducing the amount of acid made by your stomach and thus relieves your symptoms. Rabekind 40 Tablet also prevents acidity associated with the use of painkillers and stress ulcers in critically ill people. It is also used to treat a disease associated with excessive acid production in the stomach known as Zollinger Ellison syndrome (ZES).

faq.question: How long does it take for Rabekind 40 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: Rabekind 40 Tablet starts working within an hour of taking it and shows maximum benefit within two to four hours. You should start feeling better within 2 to 3 days but it may take up to 4 weeks to relieve your symptoms significantly.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Rabekind 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: It is best to take Rabekind 40 Tablet before your breakfast. If you are taking two doses, take it in the morning and evening. Rabekind 40 Tablet is more effective when it is taken an hour before your food.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Rabekind 40 Tablet for a long period of time?
faq.answer: Rabekind 40 Tablet should be used for as long as it has been prescribed by your doctor. Rabekind 40 Tablet is usually considered to be safe when taken in the recommended dose and duration. If Rabekind 40 Tablet is used for more than 3 months, certain long-term side effects may be seen. The most important of these is low magnesium levels in your blood, making you feel tired, confused, dizzy, shaky, or dizzy. You may also have muscle twitches or irregular heartbeat. If the use is further prolonged for more than a year, you may have an increased risk of bone fractures, stomach infections, subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, osteoporosis, and vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Does Rabekind 40 Tablet cause bone problems?
faq.answer: Yes, long-term use of Rabekind 40 Tablet can cause thinning of bones, which is called osteoporosis. Rabekind 40 Tablet decreases the calcium absorption leading to calcium deficiency and increases the risk of bone fractures of the hip, wrist, or spine. Take an adequate amount of calcium in your diet or take the supplements as advised by your doctor to avoid any bone problems.

faq.question: Can I take Rabekind 40 Tablet with vitamin D?
faq.answer: Yes, vitamin D can be taken along with Rabekind 40 Tablet. Vitamin D is generally advised to be taken as a supplement with Rabekind 40 Tablet as the long-term use of Rabekind 40 Tablet decreases the absorption of calcium and may lead to calcium deficiency. This can lead to osteoporosis (thinning of bones) and increase the risk of bone fractures like hip, wrist, and spine fractures. Please consult your doctor to know about ways to prevent this.

faq.question: How is Rabekind 40 Tablet useful in the treatment of H. pylori infection?
faq.answer: Rabekind 40 Tablet is used along with antibiotics for the treatment of H.Pylori infection. It works by decreasing stomach acid volume and decreasing breakdown and washout of antibiotics leading to an increased antibiotic concentration and tissue penetration. It also helps in symptomatic relief by decreasing associated acidity, reflux, and heartburn.

faq.question: Can long term use of Rabekind 40 Tablet cause magnesium deficiency?
faq.answer: Long-term use of Rabekind 40 Tablet can lower magnesium levels in patients taking multiple daily doses for 3 months or longer. Get your magnesium levels checked at regular intervals. Tell your doctor if you experience seizures (fits), dizziness, abnormal or fast heartbeat, jitteriness, jerking movements or shaking (tremors), muscle weakness, spasms of the hands and feet, cramps, muscle aches.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Rabekind 40 Tablet if I feel better?
faq.answer: No, do not stop taking Rabekind 40 Tablet before completing the full course of treatment. You will start to feel better before your treatment is complete.

faq.question: What dietary changes should I make to get relief from acidity?
faq.answer: Rabekind 40 Tablet is best taken 1 hour before a meal. You should avoid spicy and fatty foods while taking this medicine. It also helps to cut down on caffeinated drinks such as tea, coffee, and cola. Alcohol intake should also be avoided as it may worsen your symptoms.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with Rabekind 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, alcohol intake is not advised with Rabekind 40 Tablet. Alcohol itself does not affect the working of Rabekind 40 Tablet, but it can increase acid production. This may further cause worsening of your symptoms.

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with Rabekind 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, you can take antacids along with Rabekind 40 Tablet. Take it 2 hours before or after you take Rabekind 40 Tablet.

faq.question: What other lifestyle changes should I make to get maximum benefit of Rabekind 40 Tablet?
faq.answer: You make see better results if you make certain dietary and lifestyle changes while taking Rabekind 40 Tablet. Exercise regularly and eat healthily. You can consult your dietician to get a diet chart that suits you best. Eat at least 3 hours before sleeping to reduce the chances of aggravation of your symptoms at night. You should avoid spicy and fatty foods while taking this medicine. Refrain from caffeinated drinks such as tea, coffee, and cola. Alcohol intake and smoking should also be avoided as they may worsen your symptoms.

It is used in the treatment of acid-related diseases of the stomach and intestine such as acid reflux, peptic ulcer disease, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
It provides relief from symptoms and promotes healing.
Rabium 20 Tablet medicine should be taken one hour before a meal, preferably in the morning.
The dose will depend on your underlying condition and how you respond to the medicine.
Try to take it regularly at the same time each day as advised by your doctor.
You should keep on taking it as prescribed even if your symptoms disappear quickly.
You may be able to help improve your symptoms by eating smaller meals more often and avoiding caffeinated drinks like tea and coffee, and spicy or fatty foods.This medicine's most common side effects include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, and stomach pain.

The risk of side effects may increase the longer you take this medicine.

Talk to your doctor about ways to prevent bone loss (osteoporosis), like taking calcium and vitamin D supplements.Low blood magnesium levels (hypomagnesemia) have been seen in some people taking this medicine for 3 months or more.
This may lead to tiredness, confusion, dizziness, muscle twitches, and an irregular heartbeat.
Your doctor may monitor your magnesium levels to prevent this.Rabium 20 Tablet is not suitable for some people.
Before taking this medicine, you need to tell your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have ever had an allergic reaction to similar medicines in the past, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis).

Avoid drinking alcohol as it makes your stomach produce excessive acid and can worsen your symptoms.
Do not drive or use machinery or tools, if this medicine makes you feel dizzy or sleepy.

faq.question: What is Rabium 20 Tablet used for?
faq.answer: Rabium 20 Tablet is used for the treatment of stomach and intestinal ulcers (gastric and duodenal ulcers), reflux esophagitis, or gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). Rabium 20 Tablet also prevents acidity associated with the use of painkillers and stress ulcers in critically ill people. It is also used to treat a disease associated with excessive acid production in the stomach known as Zollinger Ellison syndrome (ZES).

faq.question: How long does it take for Rabium 20 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: Rabium 20 Tablet starts working within an hour of taking it and shows maximum benefit within two to four hours. You should start feeling better within 2 to 3 days but it may take up to 4 weeks to relieve your symptoms significantly.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Rabium 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: It is best to take Rabium 20 Tablet before your breakfast. If you are taking two doses, take it in the morning and evening. Rabium 20 Tablet is more effective when it is taken an hour before your food.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Rabium 20 Tablet for a long period of time?
faq.answer: Rabium 20 Tablet should be used for as long as it has been prescribed by your doctor. Rabium 20 Tablet is usually considered to be safe when taken in the recommended dose and duration. The most important of these is low magnesium levels in your blood, making you feel tired, confused, dizzy, shaky, or dizzy. You may also have muscle twitches or irregular heartbeat. If the use is further prolonged for more than a year, you may have an increased risk of bone fractures, stomach infections, subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, osteoporosis, and vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Does Rabium 20 Tablet cause bone problems?

Take an adequate amount of calcium in your diet or take the supplements as advised by your doctor to avoid any bone problems.

faq.question: Can I take Rabium 20 Tablet with vitamin D?
faq.answer: Yes, vitamin D can be taken along with Rabium 20 Tablet. faq.question: How is Rabium 20 Tablet useful in the treatment of H. pylori infection?

faq.question: How long does it take for Rabonik 20 Tablet to work?

faq.question: Is it safe to use Rabonik 20 Tablet for a long period of time?

faq.question: Does Rabonik 20 Tablet cause bone problems?

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with racipER 40 Tablet?

faq.question: Can I stop taking racipER 40 Tablet if I feel better?

faq.question: When can I expect my blood pressure to be normal after starting Ramcor 1.25 Capsule?

faq.question: Can Ramcor 1.25 Capsule increase potassium levels? If yes, what should be done?

faq.question: Ever since I started taking Ramcor 1.25 Capsule, I noticed that I have developed a dry cough which is very irritating and is not relieved by any medicine. Why is it?

faq.question: Can Ramcor 1.25 Capsule affect my fertility?
faq.answer: There is no evidence that Ramcor 1.25 Capsule has any effect on fertility in both men and women. However, if you are planning to get pregnant, talk to your doctor first because Ramcor 1.25 Capsule is not recommended in pregnancy.

faq.question: Will there be any problem if I am taking Ramcor 1.25 Capsule and I have surgery scheduled in a week?

It relaxes and widens the blood vessels, making it easier for the blood to pass through the vessels. As a result of this, the heart does not have to work more to push the blood. Since the workload on the heart is reduced, it is beneficial in heart failure. Additionally, it is also used to lower blood pressure and prevent stroke.

faq.question: When can I expect my blood pressure to be normal after starting Ramipres 1.25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Ramipres 1.25 Tablet takes a few hours to reduce high blood pressure but since there are no symptoms, you will not notice any difference. It takes a few weeks for the blood pressure to get fully controlled. Do not stop taking the medicine. Keep taking it even if you feel better or if your blood pressure is normalized.

faq.question: Can Ramipres 1.25 Tablet increase potassium levels? If yes, what should be done?
faq.answer: Ramipres 1.25 Tablet may increase potassium levels in the blood, especially if you have uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, kidney problems, and dehydration. Potassium levels may also increase in patients using potassium salts or medicines which increase potassium levels or are aged more than 70 years of age. If you have any of these conditions and are using Ramipres 1.25 Tablet, you need to be careful and get regular blood tests done to monitor potassium levels.

faq.question: Ever since I started taking Ramipres 1.25 Tablet, I noticed that I have developed a dry cough which is very irritating and is not relieved by any medicine. Why is it?
faq.answer: Ramipres 1.25 Tablet commonly is responsible for dry cough which can be persistent and is not relieved by any medicine. Talk to your doctor if it bothers you or you have trouble sleeping, as another medicine may be better. Even if you stop taking Ramipres 1.25 Tablet, the cough may take a few days to a month to go away.

faq.question: I accidentally took a 25 mg Ramipres 1.25 Tablet tablet instead of one 5 mg. Will it have any harmful effects?
faq.answer: Yes, you may feel lightheaded, dizzy, your pulse may become slow and you may even faint. You should take the help of a relative or friend for an emergency or seek immediate medical support.

faq.question: I have diabetes. Does Ramipres 1.25 Tablet have any effect on blood sugar levels?
faq.answer: Yes, Ramipres 1.25 Tablet may have some effect on antidiabetic medicines and insulin and may lower your blood sugar levels. Therefore, you need to check your blood sugar levels regularly.

faq.question: I have been using Ramipres 1.25 Tablet for blood pressure for some time, but now I have noticed that I often have a sore throat along with fever. I want to stop Ramipres 1.25 Tablet and see if this goes, can I stop Ramipres 1.25 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop Ramipres 1.25 Tablet suddenly as this may cause a sudden increase in your blood pressure which may be harmful to you. In addition to this, Ramipres 1.25 Tablet can very rarely decrease your white blood cell count which is important to fight infections in your body. Consult your doctor and get a blood test done. If your white cell count is decreased, it could be due to Ramipres 1.25 Tablet. Ask your doctor for alternative medicine for blood pressure. You can continue taking Ramipres 1.25 Tablet if your investigations are normal.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Ramipres 1.25 Tablet for a long time?
faq.answer: Yes, Ramipres 1.25 Tablet is safe and works best if taken for a long time. But, taking Ramipres 1.25 Tablet for a long time can sometimes affect the working of your kidneys. To keep track of this, your doctor will get regular blood tests done and check how well your kidneys are working.

faq.question: Can Ramipres 1.25 Tablet affect my fertility?
faq.answer: There is no evidence that Ramipres 1.25 Tablet has any effect on fertility in both men and women. However, if you are planning to get pregnant, talk to your doctor first because Ramipres 1.25 Tablet is not recommended in pregnancy.

faq.question: Will there be any problem if I am taking Ramipres 1.25 Tablet and I have surgery scheduled in a week?
faq.answer: Inform your doctor that you are taking Ramipres 1.25 Tablet. Ramipres 1.25 Tablet can reduce your blood pressure when it is used with a general anesthetic. Your doctor may advise you to stop taking it 24 hours before surgery.

It relaxes and widens the blood vessels, making it easier for the blood to pass through the vessels. As a result of this, the heart does not have to work more to push the blood. Since the workload on the heart is reduced, it is beneficial in heart failure. Additionally, it is also used to lower blood pressure and prevent stroke.

faq.question: When can I expect my blood pressure to be normal after starting RAMIstar 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: RAMIstar 5 Tablet takes a few hours to reduce high blood pressure but since there are no symptoms, you will not notice any difference. It takes a few weeks for the blood pressure to get fully controlled. Do not stop taking the medicine. Keep taking it even if you feel better or if your blood pressure is normalized.

faq.question: Can RAMIstar 5 Tablet increase potassium levels? If yes, what should be done?
faq.answer: RAMIstar 5 Tablet may increase potassium levels in the blood, especially if you have uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, kidney problems, and dehydration. Potassium levels may also increase in patients using potassium salts or medicines which increase potassium levels or are aged more than 70 years of age. If you have any of these conditions and are using RAMIstar 5 Tablet, you need to be careful and get regular blood tests done to monitor potassium levels.

faq.question: Ever since I started taking RAMIstar 5 Tablet, I noticed that I have developed a dry cough which is very irritating and is not relieved by any medicine. Why is it?
faq.answer: RAMIstar 5 Tablet commonly is responsible for dry cough which can be persistent and is not relieved by any medicine. Talk to your doctor if it bothers you or you have trouble sleeping, as another medicine may be better. Even if you stop taking RAMIstar 5 Tablet, the cough may take a few days to a month to go away.

faq.question: I accidentally took a 25 mg RAMIstar 5 Tablet tablet instead of one 5 mg. Will it have any harmful effects?
faq.answer: Yes, you may feel lightheaded, dizzy, your pulse may become slow and you may even faint. You should take the help of a relative or friend for an emergency or seek immediate medical support.

faq.question: I have diabetes. Does RAMIstar 5 Tablet have any effect on blood sugar levels?
faq.answer: Yes, RAMIstar 5 Tablet may have some effect on antidiabetic medicines and insulin and may lower your blood sugar levels. Therefore, you need to check your blood sugar levels regularly.

faq.question: I have been using RAMIstar 5 Tablet for blood pressure for some time, but now I have noticed that I often have a sore throat along with fever. I want to stop RAMIstar 5 Tablet and see if this goes, can I stop RAMIstar 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop RAMIstar 5 Tablet suddenly as this may cause a sudden increase in your blood pressure which may be harmful to you. In addition to this, RAMIstar 5 Tablet can very rarely decrease your white blood cell count which is important to fight infections in your body. Consult your doctor and get a blood test done. If your white cell count is decreased, it could be due to RAMIstar 5 Tablet. Ask your doctor for alternative medicine for blood pressure. You can continue taking RAMIstar 5 Tablet if your investigations are normal.

faq.question: Is it safe to take RAMIstar 5 Tablet for a long time?
faq.answer: Yes, RAMIstar 5 Tablet is safe and works best if taken for a long time. But, taking RAMIstar 5 Tablet for a long time can sometimes affect the working of your kidneys. To keep track of this, your doctor will get regular blood tests done and check how well your kidneys are working.

faq.question: Can RAMIstar 5 Tablet affect my fertility?
faq.answer: There is no evidence that RAMIstar 5 Tablet has any effect on fertility in both men and women. However, if you are planning to get pregnant, talk to your doctor first because RAMIstar 5 Tablet is not recommended in pregnancy.

faq.question: Will there be any problem if I am taking RAMIstar 5 Tablet and I have surgery scheduled in a week?
faq.answer: Inform your doctor that you are taking RAMIstar 5 Tablet. RAMIstar 5 Tablet can reduce your blood pressure when it is used with a general anesthetic. Your doctor may advise you to stop taking it 24 hours before surgery.

description:
Ramitorva Capsule is used to prevent heart attack and stroke.
It is a combination of medicines that help to control blood pressure, increased cholesterol levels and prevent clot formation.
Ramitorva Capsule should be taken with food regularly at a fixed time each day.
You should take it regularly at evenly spaced intervals as per the schedule prescribed by your doctor.
Taking it at the same time every day will help you remember to take it.
The dose and duration of treatment will depend on what you are being treated for.
Do not stop taking it until you have finished the complete course, even when you feel better.
Lifestyle changes like low-fat diet, exercise and not smoking may help this medicine to work better.Taste change, stomach pain, indigestion, and blurred vision are some common side effects of this medicine.
This medicine increases your risk of bleeding, so it is important to be careful while shaving, cutting nails, using sharp objects, or engaging in contact sports (e.g., football, wrestling).
Some patients may develop cough or throat irritation as a side effect of this medicine.
It may also produce dizziness initially, but this improves with time.
It is advisable to avoid the intake of potassium rich food or supplements while taking this medicine as this medicine may raise the level of potassium in the blood.Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease.
You must tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.
You should also let your healthcare team know all other medicines you are taking as they may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
You may be asked for regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar level and potassium level in the blood while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can Ramitorva Capsule cause muscle pain?
faq.answer: Yes, Ramitorva Capsule can cause muscle pain by injuring the muscles. Talk to your doctor as soon as possible if you experience muscle pain, weakness or muscle cramps. It can be a sign of any muscle injury caused due to Ramitorva Capsule.

faq.question: Will I need to stop Ramitorva Capsule before surgery or dental procedure?
faq.answer: Ramitorva Capsule may increase the risk of bleeding during a surgery or dental procedure. Therefore, you may be asked by your doctor to stop taking Ramitorva Capsule. You should not stop taking Ramitorva Capsule on your own.

faq.question: Can the use of Ramitorva Capsule increase the risk of bleeding?
faq.answer: Yes, Ramitorva Capsule increases the risk of bleeding. Always be careful while doing activities that may cause an injury or bleeding. Tell your doctor immediately if you notice any abnormal bruising or bleeding.

faq.question: Which painkiller is safe while taking Ramitorva Capsule?
faq.answer: Paracetamol is safe to use while taking Ramitorva Capsule for reducing pain. Avoid the use of other painkillers while taking Ramitorva Capsule, as they may increase the risk of bleeding.

faq.question: Can I use Ramitorva Capsule in pregnancy?
faq.answer: No, Ramitorva Capsule should be avoided in pregnancy. Its use can cause injury and death to the baby. If you conceive while taking Ramitorva Capsule, stop using the medicine and contact your doctor immediately.

faq.question: What medicines should I avoid while taking Ramitorva Capsule?
faq.answer: Ramitorva Capsule can interact with several medicines and can cause serious problems. Talk to your doctor and inform him about using Ramitorva Capsule before taking any prescription or non-prescription medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Ramitorva Capsule cause cough?
faq.answer: Yes, Ramitorva Capsule can cause cough because it has ramipril as one of the active ingredients. Unfortunately, even cough medicines are not helpful in treating cough caused by ramipril. Talk to your doctor about Ramitorva Capsule if you experience persistent cough.

faq.question: What are the instructions for the storage and disposal of Ramitorva Capsule?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the packet or the container it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.
