description:
Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free is used in the treatment of ulcers in the stomach and intestine.
It contains the active ingredient sucralfate which promotes the healing of ulcers by forming a coating over them which acts as a physical barrier.
Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free is taken one hour before meals preferably at bedtime in the dose and duration advised by the doctor.
You should keep taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early your symptoms may come back and your condition may worsen.The most common side effect of Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free are constipation and headache.
To prevent constipation, take plenty of fluids while on treatment with this medicine.
Dizziness and sleepiness may occasionally occur, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.Before taking Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free inform the doctor if you are suffering from any liver or kidney disease.
Let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
Do not take antacids within two hours of taking Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free.

faq.question: What should you avoid when taking Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free?
faq.answer: It is advisable to avoid taking antacids within 30 minutes of taking Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free since this medicine can decrease the absorption of some antacids if taken together.

faq.question: How long after taking Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free can I eat?
faq.answer: Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free must be taken on an empty stomach, at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after a meal.

faq.question: Does Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free work immediately?
faq.answer: No, it takes around one to two weeks for the medicine to heal an ulcer of the stomach or intestine. But continue taking Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free for the duration as prescribed by your doctor for complete healing.

faq.question: Does Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free cause constipation?
faq.answer: Yes, constipation is one of the common side effects of Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free. Include fiber in your diet (fruits and vegetables), drink 8-10 glasses of fluids a day, and keep active. A stool softener (with a doctor's prescription) once or twice a day may prevent constipation. If you do not have a bowel movement for 2-3 days, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free an antibiotic/sulfa drug/pain-killer/PPI?
faq.answer: Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free is not an antibiotic/sulfa drug/ PPI (proton-pump inhibitor) or a pain-killer. It is an ulcer protective medicine

faq.answer: No. Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free is a prescription drug. It is not available or sold over the counter

faq.question: Is Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free gluten free?
faq.answer: Yes. Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free is gluten free. However, please refer to package insert of the prescribed brand before use

faq.question: Is Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free is relatively safe if used as recommended. In case of any side-effects, consult your doctor

faq.question: Can I take Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free with Prilosec/Nexium/ Tylenol/Zantac/ibuprofen/Pepto?
faq.answer: Yes. Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free can be taken with Prilosec/Nexium/ Tylenol/Zantac/ibuprofen and Pepto if prescribed by your doctor

faq.answer: Sft Kid Suspension Sugar Free does not cause headaches/weight gain/insomnia or heartburn. If you experience any such symptoms, please consult your doctor

description:
SIAGLide 100 Tablet is a medicine used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus.
It is used together with a healthy diet and regular exercise to control blood sugar levels.
This helps reduce the risk of serious complications of diabetes like kidney damage and blindness.
SIAGLide 100 Tablet is normally prescribed when diet and exercise alone or other medicines do not prove sufficient to control your blood sugar level.
Your doctor may prescribe it alone or along with other diabetes medicines.
It may be taken on an empty stomach or with a meal.
The dose will depend on your condition and blood sugar levels.
Therefore, you should use it as advised by your doctor.You should take it regularly at the same time each day to get the most benefit, and you should not stop unless your doctor recommends it.
This medicine helps you to control your blood sugar levels and prevent serious complications in the future.
It is important to stay on the diet and exercise program recommended by your doctor while taking this medicine.
Your lifestyle plays a big part in controlling diabetes.The most common side effect of taking this medicine is a headache.
This is usually minor and improves with time.
Low blood sugar level (hypoglycemia) is a possible side effect if you are also taking other diabetes medicines like insulin or sulfonylurea, so you need to know how to recognize and deal with it.
It may also cause upper respiratory tract infections like a sore throat, cough, and cold.
Contact your doctor if the side effects worry you or if they do not go away.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor know if you have ever had kidney disease, heart or pancreas problems, or if you drink a lot of alcohol.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Some other medicines you are taking may interfere with this medicine.
So, make sure your doctor knows about all the other medicines you are using.
Limit your alcohol intake while taking this medicine because it can increase your risk of developing low blood sugar levels.
You may need regular tests, such as kidney function and blood glucose levels, to check that the medicine is working properly.

faq.question: Does SIAGLide 100 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: No, SIAGLide 100 Tablet is not known to cause weight gain by itself. However, keeping a healthy weight is an important part of managing diabetes. Consult your doctor if you experience weight gain while taking SIAGLide 100 Tablet.

faq.question: Is SIAGLide 100 Tablet bad for your kidneys?
faq.answer: No, SIAGLide 100 Tablet is not bad for your kidneys if your kidney function is normal. However, it is important to inform your doctor if you have, or ever had, any kidney problems. If you have kidney problems, you may need dose modification.

faq.question: Do I still have to manage my diet and exercise while on SIAGLide 100 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, it is important to manage your diet and exercise while taking SIAGLide 100 Tablet. In addition to the medicine, making healthy food choices and being physically active are also important to effectively manage blood sugar levels. You may consult a dietitian and follow a diet chart that suits you best. A well-balanced diet is one part of a healthy lifestyle for people with type 2 diabetes. Additionally, thirty minutes of exercise, such as a brisk walk, is recommended.

faq.question: Can my blood sugar levels go too low on SIAGLide 100 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, your blood sugar levels may become very low (hypoglycemia). The chances are higher if you are on any other antidiabetic medicine or insulin along with SIAGLide 100 Tablet. Additionally, blood sugar levels can take a huge dip if you skip meals, exercise more than usual, or take an overdose of SIAGLide 100 Tablet. If you experience a sudden fall in your sugar levels, inform your doctor. The doctor may suggest dose modification to prevent your blood sugar levels from decreasing significantly (hypoglycemia). Follow your doctor’s advice and monitor your blood sugar levels regularly.

faq.question: What will happen if I accidentally take more than the prescribed dose of SIAGLide 100 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you have accidentally taken more than the prescribed dose of SIAGLide 100 Tablet, your blood sugar levels may become too low (hypoglycemia). This hypoglycemia may be mild or severe. Monitor your blood sugar levels more frequently for the next 24 hours. Mild episodes of hypoglycemia (with symptoms like anxiety, sweating, weakness, tremors, and fast heartbeat) can usually be corrected with the help of sugary foods such as sugar or glucose candy, fruit juice, and glucose/Glucon-D. However, it is important to consult your doctor to decide on the further course of treatment. More severe episodes of hypoglycemia may even lead to a seizure (fit) or unconsciousness. This can be life-threatening, and immediate medical help may be required.

faq.question: What if I miss a dose of SIAGLide 100 Tablet?
faq.answer: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If, in case you do not remember until it is time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and go back to your regular schedule. Do not take two doses of SIAGLide 100 Tablet at the same time.

faq.question: Is SIAGLide 100 Tablet safe to be taken for a long-term?
faq.answer: Yes, it is safe to take SIAGLide 100 Tablet for a long time. Its long-term use, which can continue for months, years, or even a lifetime, has not shown any harmful effects. Keep taking SIAGLide 100 Tablet as long as your doctor recommends it. Remember, SIAGLide 100 Tablet only helps to keep your blood sugar levels under control, but it does not cure your diabetes.

faq.question: How long do I need to take SIAGLide 100 Tablet?
faq.answer: SIAGLide 100 Tablet only helps to manage your blood sugar levels, but does not cure your diabetes. Keep taking SIAGLide 100 Tablet as long as your doctor recommends it. You may have to take it lifelong. It is important to keep your blood sugar levels under control, as any fluctuations in your blood sugar levels may cause serious problems. Therefore, do not stop taking it without talking to your doctor.

faq.question: What is the most important information I should know about SIAGLide 100 Tablet?

faq.question: What is Signoflam Tablet used for and how does it work?

faq.question: Can I take Signoflam Tablet three times a day?

faq.question: Can I stop taking Signoflam Tablet when my pain is relieved?

faq.question: What are the common side effects of Signoflam Tablet?

faq.question: Can Signoflam Tablet be taken with vitamin B-complex?

faq.question: Who should avoid Signoflam Tablet?

faq.question: What should I do if I miss a dose of Signoflam Tablet?

faq.question: Can Signoflam Tablet be taken after food?

faq.question: Can I drink alcohol while taking Signoflam Tablet?
faq.answer: It is generally best to avoid alcohol while using Signoflam Tablet because alcohol may increase the risk of stomach irritation, drowsiness, dehydration, or liver stress.

faq.question: How long does Signoflam Tablet work?
faq.answer: The duration of relief from Signoflam Tablet can vary depending on the ingredients, the type of pain being treated, and individual response. It should always be used only for the duration advised by your doctor.

faq.question: Is Signoflam Tablet good for nerve pain?
faq.answer: Signoflam Tablet may help relieve certain types of pain associated with inflammation or tissue injury. However, nerve pain can have different causes, and the suitability of Signoflam Tablet depends on your specific condition. Always consult your doctor for appropriate treatment.

Sigral Suspension is used in the treatment of ulcers in the stomach and intestine.
It contains the active ingredient sucralfate which promotes the healing of ulcers by forming a coating over them which acts as a physical barrier.
Sigral Suspension is taken one hour before meals preferably at bedtime in the dose and duration advised by the doctor.
You should keep taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early your symptoms may come back and your condition may worsen.The most common side effect of Sigral Suspension are constipation and headache.
To prevent constipation, take plenty of fluids while on treatment with this medicine.
Dizziness and sleepiness may occasionally occur, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.Before taking Sigral Suspension inform the doctor if you are suffering from any liver or kidney disease.
Let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
Do not take antacids within two hours of taking Sigral Suspension.

faq.question: What should you avoid when taking Sigral Suspension?
faq.answer: It is advisable to avoid taking antacids within 30 minutes of taking Sigral Suspension since this medicine can decrease the absorption of some antacids if taken together.

faq.question: How long after taking Sigral Suspension can I eat?
faq.answer: Sigral Suspension must be taken on an empty stomach, at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after a meal.

faq.question: Does Sigral Suspension work immediately?
faq.answer: No, it takes around one to two weeks for the medicine to heal an ulcer of the stomach or intestine. But continue taking Sigral Suspension for the duration as prescribed by your doctor for complete healing.

faq.question: Does Sigral Suspension cause constipation?
faq.answer: Yes, constipation is one of the common side effects of Sigral Suspension. Include fiber in your diet (fruits and vegetables), drink 8-10 glasses of fluids a day, and keep active. A stool softener (with a doctor's prescription) once or twice a day may prevent constipation. If you do not have a bowel movement for 2-3 days, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Is Sigral Suspension an antibiotic/sulfa drug/pain-killer/PPI?
faq.answer: Sigral Suspension is not an antibiotic/sulfa drug/ PPI (proton-pump inhibitor) or a pain-killer. It is an ulcer protective medicine

faq.question: Is Sigral Suspension available or sold over the counter?
faq.answer: No. Sigral Suspension is a prescription drug. It is not available or sold over the counter

faq.question: Is Sigral Suspension gluten free?
faq.answer: Yes. Sigral Suspension is gluten free. However, please refer to package insert of the prescribed brand before use

faq.question: Is Sigral Suspension safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Sigral Suspension is relatively safe if used as recommended. In case of any side-effects, consult your doctor

faq.question: Can I take Sigral Suspension with Prilosec/Nexium/ Tylenol/Zantac/ibuprofen/Pepto?
faq.answer: Yes. Sigral Suspension can be taken with Prilosec/Nexium/ Tylenol/Zantac/ibuprofen and Pepto if prescribed by your doctor

faq.question: Does Sigral Suspension cause headaches/weight gain/insomnia/ heartburn?
faq.answer: Sigral Suspension does not cause headaches/weight gain/insomnia or heartburn. If you experience any such symptoms, please consult your doctor

faq.question: Is Sigral Suspension a narcotic drug?
faq.answer: No. Sigral Suspension is not a narcotic drug.

description:
Silectone 25 Tablet is a medicine known as a diuretic (water pill).
It is mainly used in the treatment of heart failure and high blood pressure.
It reduces the swelling (edema) caused by some other conditions.
This medicine is also used to treat low potassium levels in the body (hypokalemia).
Silectone 25 Tablet can be taken with or without food, but you should take it in the same way each time to get the most benefit.
Taking it with food can reduce some side effects and taking it early in the day can prevent you from having to get up at night to go to the toilet.
You should keep using this medicine as it has been prescribed, even if you feel well.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Follow your doctor's advice about the type and amount of liquids you should drink.
If you are being treated for high blood pressure, lifestyle changes such as taking regular exercise and changes to your diet may increase the effectiveness of this medicine.The common side effects include feeling or being sick, vomiting, dizziness and swelling or tenderness of your breasts (men and women).
If these bother you, or appear serious, let your doctor know.
There may be ways of reducing or preventing them.
Drinking alcohol can increase certain side effects.You should be careful about using Silectone 25 Tablet if you have kidney problems or are unable to urinate.
Before taking it, tell your doctor if you have ever had kidney, liver or heart disease or are pregnant.
Also let your healthcare team know about all other medications you are using as they may affect, or be affected by this medicine.
This medicine should only be used if it is clearly needed during pregnancy and while breastfeeding.
While using this medicine, you may be advised to limit your intake of salt or salt substitutes, and you should have your blood pressure checked frequently.
Some other tests will be done to monitor your progress.

faq.question: What is Silectone 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Silectone 25 Tablet is a medicine that belongs to the class of medicines known as potassium-sparing diuretics (water tablets). Silectone 25 Tablet being a diuretic helps lose excess fluid from your body. It is used to treat conditions such as high blood pressure, congestive heart failure, edema (swelling) or low potassium levels. Edema may be caused due to problems with your liver (cirrhosis or ascites) and kidney disorders (such as nephrotic syndrome).

faq.question: What is the best time to take Silectone 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Silectone 25 Tablet should be taken as directed by your doctor. Silectone 25 Tablet helps remove excess fluids from the body which can make you pass more urine. Therefore, it would be best to take Silectone 25 Tablet during the day so as to avoid the frequent urge to urinate during sleep.

faq.question: Does Silectone 25 Tablet treat hypertension?
faq.answer: Yes, Silectone 25 Tablet effectively treats hypertension (high blood pressure). However, it is used in combination with other medicines to get maximum benefit. Silectone 25 Tablet is a diuretic commonly known as a water tablet. It works by removing excess fluid from your body which helps in lowering your blood pressure. Silectone 25 Tablet should be taken only when prescribed by the doctor.

faq.question: What foods should I avoid while taking Silectone 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should avoid taking an excess amount of salt or salt substitutes while taking Silectone 25 Tablet. Try to avoid foods containing potassium or potassium substitutes such as bananas, coconut water, spinach, sweet potatoes and avocados. These foods may increase your potassium levels and this can be fatal. Consult your doctor to know more about other food choices to be avoided while taking Silectone 25 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I use Silectone 25 Tablet for weight control?
faq.answer: No, Aldactone should not be used for weight control. Silectone 25 Tablet is not helpful in weight management. If you have weight related concerns, please consult a doctor who will let you know the best therapy for weight control.

faq.question: What other lifestyle changes should I make while taking Silectone 25 Tablet?
faq.answer: Lifestyle changes play a major role in keeping you healthy if you are taking Silectone 25 Tablet. Avoid taking excess salt in your diet and find ways to reduce or manage stress in your life. Practice yoga or meditation or take up a hobby. Ensure that you have a sound sleep every night as this also helps to reduce stress levels and helps to keep your blood pressure normal. Stop smoking and alcohol consumption as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and take a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Silectone 25 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: Can I take Silectone 25 Tablet with birth control?
faq.answer: Silectone 25 Tablet can be taken with birth control pills (oral contraceptives) as there are no reports which suggest possible interactions or side effects while using these medicines together. However, in some cases, interactions may occur. Therefore, it would be best to first talk to your doctor before taking Silectone 25 Tablet with any birth control pills (oral contraceptives).

faq.question: Is Silectone 25 Tablet harmful to the kidneys?
faq.answer: Silectone 25 Tablet can lead to acute kidney failure particularly in those who already have impaired kidney function. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have kidney-related problems as you may need a different dose. In such cases, the doctor may suggest kidney function tests and closely monitor your condition.

Simpro 20 Tablet is a medicine used to prevent angina (chest pain) and migraine, and manage pheochromocytoma (a rare adrenal gland tumor).
It works by slowing the heart rate and relaxing blood vessels, helping to reduce strain on the heart and improve blood flow.
Take Simpro 20 Tablet in the dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
It will depend on what you are being treated for and how you respond to the medicine.
You should always take it as prescribed by the doctor.
It can be taken with or without food.
You should keep taking it even if you feel well, as you are still getting the benefits.
If you stop taking it suddenly, your condition may worsen.The most common side effects of Simpro 20 Tablet include tiredness, dizziness, weakness, cold fingers or toes, and stomach pain.
You may also experience nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.
Talk to your doctor if the side effects bother you or do not go away.
Most side effects are short-lived and improve as your body gets used to the medicine.You should not use Simpro 20 Tablet if you have asthma, very slow or uneven heartbeats, or a serious heart condition, including heart failure.
Talk to your doctor before taking it if you have kidney or liver problems or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
In terms of lifestyle, alcohol may affect the way this medicine works and should be avoided.
You should not drive if this medicine makes you feel dizzy.
Ask your doctor whether it is safe to take this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

faq.question: My doctor has prescribed Simpro 20 Tablet even though my blood pressure is within normal limits. Is it because of the chest pain that I complained of?
faq.answer: Yes, it is possible that your doctor prescribed Simpro 20 Tablet for chest pain (angina). Simpro 20 Tablet is a beta-blocker that is used to lower high blood pressure, prevent angina, treat or prevent heart attacks, or reduce your risk of heart problems following a heart attack.

faq.question: Can Simpro 20 Tablet be used in asthmatics?
faq.answer: No, Simpro 20 Tablet cannot be used in asthmatics. This is because using Simpro 20 Tablet in asthma patients can cause breathing problems, which may trigger an asthma attack. Always inform your doctor if you have or ever had asthma or any episodes of difficulty breathing, before starting treatment with Simpro 20 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Simpro 20 Tablet as my chest pain is under control?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking Simpro 20 Tablet suddenly because that may worsen your angina or may cause a heart attack. Tell your doctor, and if there is a need to stop Simpro 20 Tablet, your doctor will reduce your dose gradually over a few weeks.

faq.question: Does Simpro 20 Tablet relieve anxiety?
faq.answer: Yes, Simpro 20 Tablet helps relieve the symptoms of anxiety such as irritability, restlessness, excessive worry, lack of concentration, racing or unwanted thoughts, fatigue, insomnia (lack of sleep), palpitations (irregular heart rate), or trembling. The dose and duration of taking Simpro 20 Tablet will be suggested by your doctor, depending on whether your symptoms are a recurring problem or occur only in stressful conditions. However, Simpro 20 Tablet is usually given for the short-term treatment of anxiety. If you have any doubts, consult your doctor.

faq.question: What other lifestyle changes should I make while taking Simpro 20 Tablet?

Stop smoking and alcohol consumption, as this helps in lowering your blood pressure and preventing heart problems. Exercise regularly and eat a balanced diet that includes whole grains, fresh fruits, vegetables, and fat-free products. Consult your doctor if you need any further guidance to get the maximum benefit of Simpro 20 Tablet and to keep yourself healthy.

faq.question: I have been on Indomethacin for several months. Will it be a problem if I start taking Simpro 20 Tablet along with it?
faq.answer: Yes, indomethacin may interfere with the working of Simpro 20 Tablet and make it less effective. As a result, your blood pressure may increase. Speak to your doctor, who will prescribe you a different medicine to control blood pressure.

description:
Simvotin 10 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called statins.
It is used to lower cholesterol and triglycerides and reduce the risk of heart disease.
Cholesterol is a fatty substance that builds up in your blood vessels and causes narrowing, which may lead to a heart attack or stroke.
Simvotin 10 Tablet is usually taken in the evening, with or without food.
However, taking it with food may reduce the chances of nausea.
Take it regularly for maximum benefit.
Most people with high cholesterol and triglycerides do not feel ill, but stopping the medicine may increase cholesterol and triglyceride levels, making the condition worse and increasing the risk of heart disease and stroke.It is important to have your cholesterol levels checked regularly.
This medicine is only one part of the treatment program, which should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, smoking cessation, moderation of alcohol intake, and weight reduction.
You can eat normally while taking this medicine, but try to avoid foods that are high in fat.Common side effects of Simvotin 10 Tablet include upper respiratory infections, headache, abdominal pain, constipation, and nausea.
These are usually mild and temporary.

faq.question: What is Simvotin 10 Tablet used for? How does it work?
faq.answer: Cholesterol is a type of fat present in your blood. Total cholesterol is determined by the total amount of LDL and HDL cholesterol in the body. LDL cholesterol is called “bad” cholesterol. Bad cholesterol can build up in the walls of your blood vessels and slow or obstruct blood flow to your heart, brain, and other organs. This can cause heart disease and stroke. HDL cholesterol is called “good” cholesterol as it prevents the bad cholesterol from building up in the blood vessels. High levels of triglycerides are also harmful to you.

faq.question: Is Simvotin 10 Tablet safe to take?
faq.answer: Yes, Simvotin 10 Tablet is safe to use if used as prescribed by the doctor and if the doctor's instructions are followed. The side effects of this medicine are few and do not occur in everyone.

faq.question: What should I know about high cholesterol?
faq.answer: Simvotin 10 Tablet is a medicine that helps lower bad cholesterol and fats like triglycerides in your blood. It also helps raise good cholesterol. It is usually taken along with a healthy diet and regular exercise. It works by slowing down the amount of cholesterol made by your liver. This helps prevent cholesterol from building up in your blood vessels, which can lower your risk of heart problems like heart attacks and strokes.

faq.question: When should I take Simvotin 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Simvotin 10 Tablet is generally taken once a day, preferably in the evening after dinner. Try taking this medicine at the same time every day to help remember when to take it.

faq.question: For how long should I take Simvotin 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: You may need to take Simvotin 10 Tablet for life or for as long as directed by your doctor. The cholesterol levels will be maintained only till you are taking Simvotin 10 Tablet. Stopping Simvotin 10 Tablet without starting a different treatment may increase your cholesterol levels again. This medicine has only a few side effects and is usually considered safe if taken as directed by the doctor.

faq.question: What foods should be avoided when taking Simvotin 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: Simvotin 10 Tablet is used to decrease your blood cholesterol levels. Therefore, to seek the best results of this medicine, you should avoid foods which are high in calories like fried food and junk food. It is recommended to eat a low-fat and low-cholesterol diet. Be sure to follow all the exercise and dietary recommendations made by your doctor or dietician.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with Simvotin 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is not advised to take alcohol with Simvotin 10 Tablet. This is because the risk of developing liver problems increases if you drink alcohol while taking this medicine. Moreover, there is a significant increase in the triglyceride levels if Simvotin 10 Tablet is taken along with alcohol. This can further lead to liver damage and also worsen some of the side effects such as muscle pain, muscle weakness and tenderness. faq.question: What is Sit DC-M 500 Tablet?
faq.answer: Sit DC-M 500 Tablet is a combination of two medicines: sitagliptin and metformin. This medicine is used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus. It improves blood glucose levels in adults when taken along with a proper diet and regular exercise. Metformin lowers glucose production in the liver and improves insulin sensitivity. Sitagliptin inhibits the enzyme DPP4 and increases insulin release from the pancreas. This combination is not indicated for patients below 18 years of age.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Sit DC-M 500 Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Sit DC-M 500 Tablet is associated with common side effects like diarrhea, headache, and upper respiratory tract infection. Its use can also lead to serious but rare side effects like lactic acidosis. On long-term use, it can also lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Are there any specific conditions in which Sit DC-M 500 Tablet should not be taken?
faq.answer: The use of Sit DC-M 500 Tablet should be avoided in patients with known allergies to any of the components or excipients of this medicine. faq.answer: No, it is not safe to consume alcohol along with Sit DC-M 500 Tablet, as it can increase the chances of lactic acidosis.

faq.question: Can the use of Sit DC-M 500 Tablet lead to lactic acidosis?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Sit DC-M 500 Tablet can lead to lactic acidosis. It is a medical emergency caused by the increased levels of lactic acid in the blood. faq.question: Can the use of Sit DC-M 500 Tablet lead to vitamin B12 deficiency?

faq.question: What is Sitazee M 500 Tablet?
faq.answer: Sitazee M 500 Tablet is a combination of two medicines: sitagliptin and metformin. This medicine is used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus. It improves blood glucose levels in adults when taken along with a proper diet and regular exercise. Metformin lowers glucose production in the liver and improves insulin sensitivity. Sitagliptin inhibits the enzyme DPP4 and increases insulin release from the pancreas. This combination is not indicated for patients below 18 years of age.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Sitazee M 500 Tablet?

faq.question: Can the use of Sitazee M 500 Tablet lead to lactic acidosis?

description:
Sompraz 20 Tablet is used to treat conditions related to excessive stomach acid production, such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach and provides relief from symptoms and promotes healing.
Sompraz 20 Tablet can also be used to prevent stomach ulcers caused by certain medications, such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).
Take it in the exact dose and duration prescribed by your doctor.
It is usually taken on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning or at least 1 hour before a meal.
Continue taking the medicine even if your symptoms disappear until the doctor says it is okay to stop.
If you are taking this medicine for a long time, your doctor may carry out regular tests to check your levels of magnesium, which can fall with this medicine.Common side effects include headache, constipation or diarrhea, stomach pain, and nausea.
These tend to be mild, but talk to your doctor if they bother you or do not go away.
The risk of side effects may increase the longer you take this medicine.
You may be more likely to have a broken bone if you take it for a long time.
It is best to avoid foods that seem to make your symptoms worse, such as rich, spicy, and fatty foods.
Cutting down on caffeinated drinks, such as tea, coffee, and cola, as well as alcohol, may also help.Sompraz 20 Tablet may not be suitable for some people.
Before taking this medicine, you need to tell your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have had an allergic reaction to similar medicines in the past, or have osteoporosis.
Alcohol does not interfere with the way Sompraz 20 Tablet works; however, drinking alcohol makes your stomach produce more acid than normal.
This medicine can make you feel dizzy, sleepy, or affect your vision.
If this happens, do not drive, cycle, or use machinery or tools until you feel better.
This medicine is not usually recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

faq.question: What is the best time to take Sompraz 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: Usually, Sompraz 20 Tablet is taken once a day, first thing in the morning. If you take Sompraz 20 Tablet twice a day, take 1 dose in the morning and 1 dose in the evening. The tablets should be swallowed whole (remember not be chewed or crushed) and taken at least 1 hour before a meal with some water.

faq.question: Can I take antacids along with Sompraz 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, you can take antacids along with Sompraz 20 Tablet. Take it 2 hours before or after you take Sompraz 20 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I take Sompraz 20 Tablet for a long term?
faq.answer: Sompraz 20 Tablet is usually prescribed for short-term use only. However, if need arises, such as for treating peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (ZES), Sompraz 20 Tablet may be prescribed for a long-term duration as well. Long-term use may carry an increased risk for side effects and must be discussed with the doctor. Please use Sompraz 20 Tablet as advised by your doctor and under their supervision.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Sompraz 20 Tablet if I feel better?
faq.answer: If you have been taking Sompraz 20 Tablet for a long time, stopping it abruptly may lead to increased acid production, thereby worsening your symptoms. Therefore, you must discuss any dose changes or if you wish to come off Sompraz 20 Tablet.

faq.question: What are the long term side effects of Sompraz 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: If Sompraz 20 Tablet is used for more than 3 months, certain long-term side effects may be seen. The most important of these is low magnesium levels in your blood, which may make you feel tired, confused, dizzy, or shaky. You may also have muscle twitches or an irregular heartbeat. If the use is further prolonged for more than a year, you may have an increased risk of bone fractures, stomach infections, and vitamin B12 deficiency. Vitamin B12 deficiency can make you anemic, as a result of which you may feel more tired, weak, or pale. Additionally, you may have palpitations, shortness of breath, lightheadedness, indigestion, loss of appetite, flatulence (gas), or nerve problems such as numbness, tingling, and problem in walking.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with Sompraz 20 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, alcohol intake is not advised with Sompraz 20 Tablet. Alcohol itself does not affect the working of Sompraz 20 Tablet, but it can increase the acid production. This may further cause worsening of your symptoms.

faq.question: What is Sorbitrate 5 Tablet and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Sorbitrate 5 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as nitrates. It is used to prevent angina (heart-related chest pain). faq.question: How does Sorbitrate 5 Tablet work?
faq.answer: Sorbitrate 5 Tablet works by widening the blood vessels in your heart to allow an increased amount of blood flow to areas which need it.

faq.question: Does Sorbitrate 5 Tablet lower heart rate?
faq.answer: No, Sorbitrate 5 Tablet does not lower heart rate. However, in some cases, one may experience reflex tachycardia (fast heart rate) while using nitrates such as Sorbitrate 5 Tablet.

faq.question: Does Sorbitrate 5 Tablet lower blood pressure?
faq.answer: Yes, Sorbitrate 5 Tablet lowers blood pressure. This medicine widens the blood vessels and decreases the resistance in them, causing a fall in blood pressure. faq.question: What is Spirix 50 Tablet?

Spirix 50 Tablet being a diuretic helps lose excess fluid from your body. It is used to treat conditions such as high blood pressure, congestive heart failure, edema (swelling) or low potassium levels. Edema may be caused due to problems with your liver (cirrhosis or ascites) and kidney disorders (such as nephrotic syndrome).

faq.question: What is the best time to take Spirix 50 Tablet?

faq.question: Does Spirix 50 Tablet treat hypertension?

faq.question: What foods should I avoid while taking Spirix 50 Tablet?
faq.answer: You should avoid taking an excess amount of salt or salt substitutes while taking Spirix 50 Tablet. faq.question: What serious warnings should be known before starting Spiroflut A Nasal Spray?
faq.answer: Spiroflut A Nasal Spray can cause sleepiness, nosebleeds, nasal sores or ulcers, delayed wound healing in the nose, and rarely a hole in the nasal septum. Eye issues like glaucoma or cataracts can also occur, so report any vision changes promptly.

faq.question: Is drowsiness or impaired alertness a concern after using Spiroflut A Nasal Spray?

faq.question: What nasal problems should prompt stopping Spiroflut A Nasal Spray and calling a doctor?

faq.question: What eye-related symptoms require attention?

faq.question: What should be told to a doctor before starting Spiroflut A Nasal Spray?

faq.question: What are the contraindications associated with the use of Spiromide Tablet?

faq.question: What is Spiromide Tablet?

Both are diuretics and they help to remove excess fluid from the body. The use of this combination is advised in patients with resistant hypertension, congestive heart failure (heart failure leading to fluid accumulation in the lung and rest of the body), and liver cirrhosis with fluid retention (edema).

faq.question: Is it safe to use Spiromide Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, Spiromide Tablet is safe for most of the patients. Inform your doctor if you experience any persistent problem while taking this medicine.

faq.question: Can the use of Spiromide Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Spiromide Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better. Do not drive or use any machines.

faq.question: Can the use of Spiromide Tablet cause gout?
faq.answer: Yes, Spiromide Tablet can cause gout. Spiromide Tablet contains furosemide which can increase the blood uric acid levels by increasing its absorption from the kidneys. Use of Spiromide Tablet should be avoided in patients with gout.

faq.question: Are there any contraindications associated with use of Sreyas Tablet?

faq.question: What is SSN - DS Tablet DR, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: SSN - DS Tablet DR belongs to a group of medicines called anti-inflammatory agents. It is used to treat various inflammatory conditions such as Crohn’s disease, rheumatoid arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and psoriatic arthritis.

faq.question: Is SSN - DS Tablet DR a steroid or a painkiller?
faq.answer: SSN - DS Tablet DR is neither a steroid nor a painkiller. It is an anti-inflammatory medicine. It is used to treat and manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, in which the intestines become inflamed (swelling of intestines). It is also used to treat rheumatoid arthritis (painful joint disease).

faq.question: I have been prescribed SSN - DS Tablet DR for rheumatoid arthritis. When can I expect the pain in my joints to be better?
faq.answer: SSN - DS Tablet DR does not work right away. It takes about 6 to 12 weeks to deliver the full effect. Consumption of medicine should not be stopped without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take SSN - DS Tablet DR?
faq.answer: If you can tolerate SSN - DS Tablet DR, which means the side effects do not bother you, then you have to continue SSN - DS Tablet DR till the disease remains in remission. It is better to take SSN - DS Tablet DR for the prescribed period.

faq.question: Does the use of SSN - DS Tablet DR for the treatment of arthritis affect kidney function?
faq.answer: Though it is uncommon, SSN - DS Tablet DR may affect your kidney function. Therefore, your kidney function must remain normal before you start taking SSN - DS Tablet DR. If your kidney functions become abnormal during the treatment, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Do I need to get any blood tests done while on SSN - DS Tablet DR therapy?
faq.answer: Your doctor will advise blood tests to check your blood cell counts and your kidney function before starting your treatment and regularly during treatment. The tests should also be done to measure substances produced by your liver, known as enzymes (liver function tests), and urine for protein and blood before you start treatment and at regular intervals.

faq.question: Can SSN - DS Tablet DR affect my fertility?
faq.answer: Decreased sperm count and infertility have been reported in some males. These may disappear once the SSN - DS Tablet DR is discontinued.

faq.question: Can I take azathioprine along with SSN - DS Tablet DR?
faq.answer: You should avoid using SSN - DS Tablet DR with azathioprine since there are chances of a decrease in blood cell count, which can be a serious side effect.

faq.question: What is Stalix M 50+500 Tablet?
faq.answer: Stalix M 50+500 Tablet is a combination of two medicines: sitagliptin and metformin. This medicine is used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus. It improves blood glucose levels in adults when taken along with a proper diet and regular exercise. Metformin lowers glucose production in the liver and improves insulin sensitivity. Sitagliptin inhibits the enzyme DPP4 and increases insulin release from the pancreas. This combination is not indicated for patients below 18 years of age.

faq.question: What are the possible side effects of Stalix M 50+500 Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Stalix M 50+500 Tablet is associated with common side effects like diarrhea, headache, and upper respiratory tract infection. Its use can also lead to serious but rare side effects like lactic acidosis. On long-term use, it can also lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.

faq.question: Are there any specific conditions in which Stalix M 50+500 Tablet should not be taken?
faq.answer: The use of Stalix M 50+500 Tablet should be avoided in patients with known allergies to any of the components or excipients of this medicine. faq.question: Is it safe to take alcohol while I am taking Stalix M 50+500 Tablet?

faq.question: Can the use of Stalix M 50+500 Tablet lead to lactic acidosis?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Stalix M 50+500 Tablet can lead to lactic acidosis. It is a medical emergency caused by the increased levels of lactic acid in the blood. Therefore, it is avoided in patients with underlying kidney disease, elderly patients, or those who take large amounts of alcohol. Symptoms of lactic acidosis may include muscle pain or weakness, dizziness, tiredness, a feeling of cold in arms and legs, difficulty in breathing, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, or a slow heart rate. faq.question: Can my blood sugar levels go too low on STalix 100 Tablet?

If you experience a sudden fall in your sugar levels, inform your doctor. The doctor may suggest dose modification to prevent your blood sugar levels from decreasing significantly (hypoglycemia). faq.question: What will happen if I accidentally take more than the prescribed dose of STalix 100 Tablet?

faq.question: Is STalix 100 Tablet safe to be taken for a long-term?

faq.answer: Chymomerg D Tablet is a combination of four medicines: Trypsin, Bromelain, Rutoside and Diclofenac. This medication helps in relieving pain and swelling (inflammation). It works by lowering the levels of those chemical substances in the body which cause pain and swelling (inflammation).

faq.question: Can the use of Chymomerg D Tablet cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Chymomerg D Tablet can cause dizziness (feeling faint, weak, unsteady or lightheaded) in some patients. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, it is better to rest for some time and resume once you feel better.

faq.question: Are there any specific contraindications associated with the use of Chymomerg D Tablet?
faq.answer: The use of Chymomerg D Tablet is considered to be harmful for patients with known allergy to painkillers (NSAIDs) or any of the components or excipients of this medicine. The use of this medicine should preferably be avoided in patients with a history of stomach ulcers or in patients with active, recurrent stomach ulcer / bleeding. It should also be avoided in patients with history of heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease.

faq.question: Can I take a higher than the recommended dose of this medicine?
faq.answer: No, taking a higher than the recommended dose of Chymomerg D Tablet can increase the risk of side effects like nausea, vomiting, heartburn, indigestion, diarrhea and can also damage your kidneys on long-term use. If you are experiencing increased severity of pain and swelling which is not relieved by the recommended doses of this medicine, please consult your doctor for re-evaluation.

faq.question: What is the recommended storage condition for Chymomerg D Tablet?
faq.answer: Keep this medicine in the container or the pack it came in, tightly closed. Store it according to the instructions mentioned on the pack or label. Dispose of the unused medicine. Make sure it is not consumed by pets, children and other people.

faq.question: Can Chymomerg D Tablet be stopped when my pain and swelling (inflammation) are relieved?
faq.answer: Chymomerg D Tablet is usually used for short term and can be discontinued when pain and swelling are relieved. However, Chymomerg D Tablet should be continued if the doctor has advised you to do so.

faq.question: Can the use of Chymomerg D Tablet cause nausea and vomiting?
faq.answer: Yes, the use of Chymomerg D Tablet can cause nausea and vomiting. Taking it with milk, food or with antacids can prevent nausea. Avoid taking fatty or fried foods along with this medicine. In case of vomiting, drink plenty of water or other fluids by taking small frequent sips. Talk to your doctor if vomiting persists and you notice signs of dehydration, like dark colored and strong-smelling urine and a low frequency of urination. Do not take any other medicine without speaking to a doctor.

It is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) and prevent angina (heart-related chest pain).

Stamlo 5 Tablet may be prescribed alone or along with other medicines.
The dose depends on what you are taking it for and the severity of your condition.
You can take it at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is best to take it at about the same time each day.
You should take this medicine for as long as it is prescribed for you.
Even if you feel well, do not stop this medicine on your own because high blood pressure often has no symptoms.
If you stop taking it, your condition may get worse.
Keeping yourself active with regular exercise, managing your weight, and eating a healthy diet will also help control your blood pressure.The most common side effects include headache, edema, fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and somnolence.

faq.question: How long does it take for Stamlo 5 Tablet to work?
faq.answer: Stamlo 5 Tablet starts working on the day it is taken. However, it may take weeks to see the full effect. You should continue taking the medicine even if you feel better or if you do not notice any considerable difference. Consult your doctor if you have any concerns or you feel worse after taking the medicine.

faq.question: Does Stamlo 5 Tablet cause itching?
faq.answer: Stamlo 5 Tablet may cause itching in some patients, though it is an uncommon side effect. However, if you experience severe itching contact your doctor.

faq.question: Is Stamlo 5 Tablet bad for the kidneys?
faq.answer: No, there is no evidence that Stamlo 5 Tablet causes deterioration of kidney problems. Stamlo 5 Tablet can be used in normal doses in patients with kidney problems. In fact, its blood pressure-lowering effect, it helps to prevent injury to the kidneys due to hypertension.

faq.question: Should I take Stamlo 5 Tablet in the morning or at night?
faq.answer: Stamlo 5 Tablet can be taken anytime of the day. Usually, it is advised to be taken in the morning, but your doctor may advise to take it in the evening as well. faq.question: For how long do I need to take Stamlo 5 Tablet?

faq.question: Is Stamlo 5 Tablet a beta-blocker?
faq.answer: No, Stamlo 5 Tablet is not a beta-blocker. It belongs to a class of medicines known as calcium channel blockers. It lowers blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels so that blood can easily flow through the blood vessels.

faq.question: What are the serious side effects of Stamlo 5 Tablet?
faq.answer: Stamlo 5 Tablet may cause some serious side effects such as liver problems (yellowing of skin, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite), pancreatitis (severe stomach pain, nausea, and vomiting), and recurrent chest pain which may be indicative of a heart attack. Follow your doctor's advice.

faq.question: What should I avoid while taking Stamlo 5 Tablet?

faq.question: I have developed ankle edema and swelling over my feet after using a Stamlo 5 Tablet. What should I do?

description:
StatOR 10 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called statins.
It is used to lower cholesterol and triglycerides, and to reduce the risk of heart disease.
Cholesterol is a fatty substance that builds up in your blood vessels and causes narrowing, which may lead to a heart attack or stroke.
StatOR 10 Tablet is a widely prescribed medicine and is regarded as safe for long-term use when taken as per the doctor's advice.
It can be taken with a meal or on an empty stomach.
You can take it at any time of the day, but try to take it at about the same time each day.
Most people with high cholesterol do not feel ill, but stopping the medicine may increase cholesterol levels, thereby increasing the risk of heart disease and stroke.It is important to have your cholesterol levels checked regularly.
This medicine is only one part of the treatment program, which should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, smoking cessation, moderation of alcohol intake, and weight reduction.
You can eat normally while taking this medicine, but try to avoid foods that are high in fat.Common side effects of this medicine include nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, muscle pain (on long-term use), and joint pain.
These are usually mild and disappear after a short time.

faq.question: What should I know about high cholesterol?
faq.answer: Cholesterol is a type of fat present in your blood. Total cholesterol is determined by the total amount of LDL and HDL cholesterol in the body. LDL cholesterol is called “bad” cholesterol. Bad cholesterol can build up in the wall of your blood vessels and slow or obstruct blood flow to your heart, brain, and other organs. This can cause heart disease and stroke. HDL cholesterol is called “good” cholesterol as it prevents the bad cholesterol from building up in the blood vessels. High levels of triglycerides are also harmful to you.

faq.question: Can StatOR 10 Tablet cause muscle problems or muscle injury?
faq.answer: Yes, taking StatOR 10 Tablet can cause muscle problems or muscle injury. This is because of the reduced oxygen supply to the muscle cells which leads to fatigue, muscle pain, tenderness, or muscle weakness. The soreness may be significant enough to interfere with your daily activities. Do not take it lightly and consult your doctor to know about ways to prevent this and to avoid making it worse.

faq.question: Is StatOR 10 Tablet used for lowering cholesterol?
faq.answer: StatOR 10 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as statins, which lowers the level of lipids or fats. StatOR 10 Tablet is used to lower lipids known as cholesterol and triglycerides in the blood when a low-fat diet and lifestyle changes fail to lower the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides. If you are at an increased risk of heart disease, StatOR 10 Tablet can also be used to reduce such risk even if your cholesterol levels are normal. You should maintain a standard cholesterol-lowering diet during treatment.

faq.question: Can StatOR 10 Tablet be prescribed to children?
faq.answer: StatOR 10 Tablet is for adults and children aged 10 years or more whose cholesterol levels do not come down enough with exercise and a low-fat diet. It is not approved for use in patients younger than 10 years old.

faq.question: Is StatOR 10 Tablet a blood thinner?
faq.answer: No, StatOR 10 Tablet is not a blood thinner. It is a cholesterol-lowering medicine. It works by slowing down the production of cholesterol in the body. This further decreases the amount of cholesterol that may build up on the walls of the arteries and block blood flow to the part of the body. By lowering the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides it prevents the chances of stroke and heart attack.

faq.question: Will taking StatOR 10 Tablet lead to an increase in my risk of diabetes?
faq.answer: If you are at high risk of developing type 2 diabetes, taking StatOR 10 Tablet may increase this risk slightly. This is because StatOR 10 Tablet can raise your blood sugar a little. If you already have type 2 diabetes, your doctor may advise monitoring your blood sugar levels more closely for the first few months. Tell your doctor if you find it harder to control your blood sugar.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take StatOR 10 Tablet? Is it safe for long-term use?
faq.answer: You may need to take StatOR 10 Tablet life long or for the duration prescribed by your doctor. The benefits will only continue for as long as you take it. If you stop taking StatOR 10 Tablet without starting a different treatment, your cholesterol levels may rise again. It is considered to be safe and has few side effects if taken as directed by the doctor.

faq.question: Does StatOR 10 Tablet cause weight loss?
faq.answer: No, StatOR 10 Tablet has not been reported to cause weight loss. However, weight gain has been reported as an uncommon side effect. Please consult your doctor if you experience weight loss while taking StatOR 10 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I stop taking StatOR 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking StatOR 10 Tablet without consulting your doctor. If you think that StatOR 10 Tablet is causing side effects, you should consult your doctor who may accordingly lower your dose or change your medicine.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with StatOR 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is not advised to take alcohol with StatOR 10 Tablet. This is because the risk of developing liver problems increases if you drink alcohol while taking this medicine. Moreover, there is a significant increase in the triglyceride levels if StatOR 10 Tablet is taken along with alcohol. This can further lead to liver damage and also worsen some of the side effects such as muscle pain, muscle weakness, and tenderness. People with liver problems are therefore advised, not to take StatOR 10 Tablet without consulting the doctor. They should also refrain from consuming alcohol while taking this medicine to get maximum benefit.

faq.question: Does StatOR 10 Tablet cause memory loss?
faq.answer: Memory loss may occur with StatOR 10 Tablet in very rare cases. This is generally non-serious and may occur as early as 1 day or may take years to appear. These symptoms may disappear within about 3 weeks of discontinuing StatOR 10 Tablet. However, you should consult your doctor if you experience this side effect as it could be due to some other reason.

faq.question: When should I take StatOR 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: StatOR 10 Tablet is generally taken once a day. It can be taken in the morning or night or at any time of the day, with or without food. Try taking this medicine at the same time every day to help remember when to take it.

faq.question: Does StatOR 10 Tablet make you tired?
faq.answer: Yes, StatOR 10 Tablet can make you feel tired. This is because they reduce the energy supply to the muscles in the body. However, the exact reason behind the phenomenon is unknown and needs more research. Tiredness usually occurs after exertion. Generalized fatigue is more often seen in people with heart disease or those suffering from liver illness. StatOR 10 Tablet also causes muscle damage which further worsens the tiredness. Therefore, you must consult your doctor if you feel tired while taking StatOR 10 Tablet.

faq.question: What are the most common side effects of StatOR 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: The common side effects of StatOR 10 Tablet include nausea, indigestion, constipation, flatulence, diarrhea, headache, and aches and pains in your back and joints. It may also cause nosebleeds, sore throat, and cold-like symptoms, such as a runny nose, blocked nose, or sneezing.

faq.question: What is Statpure EZ 20 Tablet used for?

It is used together with a healthy diet and regular exercise to control blood sugar levels.
This helps reduce the risk of serious complications of diabetes like kidney damage and blindness.
Stig 100 Tablet is normally prescribed when diet and exercise alone or other medicines do not prove sufficient to control your blood sugar level.
Your doctor may prescribe it alone or along with other diabetes medicines.
It may be taken on an empty stomach or with a meal.
The dose will depend on your condition and blood sugar levels.
Therefore, you should use it as advised by your doctor.You should take it regularly at the same time each day to get the most benefit, and you should not stop unless your doctor recommends it.
This medicine helps you to control your blood sugar levels and prevent serious complications in the future.
It is important to stay on the diet and exercise program recommended by your doctor while taking this medicine.
Your lifestyle plays a big part in controlling diabetes.The most common side effect of taking this medicine is a headache.
This is usually minor and improves with time.
Low blood sugar level (hypoglycemia) is a possible side effect if you are also taking other diabetes medicines like insulin or sulfonylurea, so you need to know how to recognize and deal with it.
It may also cause upper respiratory tract infections like a sore throat, cough, and cold.
Contact your doctor if the side effects worry you or if they do not go away.Before taking this medicine, let your doctor know if you have ever had kidney disease, heart or pancreas problems, or if you drink a lot of alcohol.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.
Some other medicines you are taking may interfere with this medicine.
So, make sure your doctor knows about all the other medicines you are using.
Limit your alcohol intake while taking this medicine because it can increase your risk of developing low blood sugar levels.
You may need regular tests, such as kidney function and blood glucose levels, to check that the medicine is working properly.

faq.question: Does Stig 50 Tablet cause weight gain?
faq.answer: No, Stig 50 Tablet is not known to cause weight gain by itself. However, keeping a healthy weight is an important part of managing diabetes. Consult your doctor if you experience weight gain while taking Stig 50 Tablet.

faq.question: Is Stig 50 Tablet bad for your kidneys?
faq.answer: No, Stig 50 Tablet is not bad for your kidneys if your kidney function is normal. However, it is important to inform your doctor if you have, or ever had, any kidney problems. If you have kidney problems, you may need dose modification.

faq.question: Do I still have to manage my diet and exercise while on Stig 50 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, it is important to manage your diet and exercise while taking Stig 50 Tablet. In addition to the medicine, making healthy food choices and being physically active are also important to effectively manage blood sugar levels. You may consult a dietitian and follow a diet chart that suits you best. A well-balanced diet is one part of a healthy lifestyle for people with type 2 diabetes. Additionally, thirty minutes of exercise, such as a brisk walk, is recommended.

faq.question: Can my blood sugar levels go too low on Stig 50 Tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, your blood sugar levels may become very low (hypoglycemia). The chances are higher if you are on any other antidiabetic medicine or insulin along with Stig 50 Tablet. If you experience a sudden fall in your sugar levels, inform your doctor. The doctor may suggest dose modification to prevent your blood sugar levels from decreasing significantly (hypoglycemia). Follow your doctor’s advice and monitor your blood sugar levels regularly.

faq.question: What will happen if I accidentally take more than the prescribed dose of Stig 50 Tablet?

faq.question: Is Stig 50 Tablet safe to be taken for a long-term?

faq.question: What is Storvas EZ 10 Tablet used for?

faq.question: Who should not take Storvas EZ 10 Tablet?

faq.question: Can Storvas EZ 10 Tablet cause muscle problems?

description:
Storvas 10 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called statins.
It is used to lower cholesterol and triglycerides, and to reduce the risk of heart disease.
Cholesterol is a fatty substance that builds up in your blood vessels and causes narrowing, which may lead to a heart attack or stroke.
Storvas 10 Tablet is a widely prescribed medicine and is regarded as safe for long-term use when taken as per the doctor's advice.
It can be taken with a meal or on an empty stomach.
You can take it at any time of the day, but try to take it at about the same time each day.
Most people with high cholesterol do not feel ill, but stopping the medicine may increase cholesterol levels, thereby increasing the risk of heart disease and stroke.It is important to have your cholesterol levels checked regularly.
This medicine is only one part of the treatment program, which should also include a healthy diet, regular exercise, smoking cessation, moderation of alcohol intake, and weight reduction.
You can eat normally while taking this medicine, but try to avoid foods that are high in fat.Common side effects of this medicine include nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, muscle pain (on long-term use), and joint pain.
These are usually mild and disappear after a short time.

faq.question: What should I know about high cholesterol?
faq.answer: Cholesterol is a type of fat present in your blood. Total cholesterol is determined by the total amount of LDL and HDL cholesterol in the body. LDL cholesterol is called “bad” cholesterol. Bad cholesterol can build up in the wall of your blood vessels and slow or obstruct blood flow to your heart, brain, and other organs. This can cause heart disease and stroke. HDL cholesterol is called “good” cholesterol as it prevents the bad cholesterol from building up in the blood vessels. High levels of triglycerides are also harmful to you.

faq.question: Can Storvas 10 Tablet cause muscle problems or muscle injury?
faq.answer: Yes, taking Storvas 10 Tablet can cause muscle problems or muscle injury. This is because of the reduced oxygen supply to the muscle cells which leads to fatigue, muscle pain, tenderness, or muscle weakness. The soreness may be significant enough to interfere with your daily activities. Do not take it lightly and consult your doctor to know about ways to prevent this and to avoid making it worse.

faq.question: Is Storvas 10 Tablet used for lowering cholesterol?
faq.answer: Storvas 10 Tablet belongs to a group of medicines known as statins, which lowers the level of lipids or fats. Storvas 10 Tablet is used to lower lipids known as cholesterol and triglycerides in the blood when a low-fat diet and lifestyle changes fail to lower the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides. If you are at an increased risk of heart disease, Storvas 10 Tablet can also be used to reduce such risk even if your cholesterol levels are normal. You should maintain a standard cholesterol-lowering diet during treatment.

faq.question: Can Storvas 10 Tablet be prescribed to children?
faq.answer: Storvas 10 Tablet is for adults and children aged 10 years or more whose cholesterol levels do not come down enough with exercise and a low-fat diet. It is not approved for use in patients younger than 10 years old.

faq.question: Is Storvas 10 Tablet a blood thinner?
faq.answer: No, Storvas 10 Tablet is not a blood thinner. It is a cholesterol-lowering medicine. It works by slowing down the production of cholesterol in the body. This further decreases the amount of cholesterol that may build up on the walls of the arteries and block blood flow to the part of the body. By lowering the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides it prevents the chances of stroke and heart attack.

faq.question: Will taking Storvas 10 Tablet lead to an increase in my risk of diabetes?
faq.answer: If you are at high risk of developing type 2 diabetes, taking Storvas 10 Tablet may increase this risk slightly. This is because Storvas 10 Tablet can raise your blood sugar a little. If you already have type 2 diabetes, your doctor may advise monitoring your blood sugar levels more closely for the first few months. Tell your doctor if you find it harder to control your blood sugar.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take Storvas 10 Tablet? Is it safe for long-term use?
faq.answer: You may need to take Storvas 10 Tablet life long or for the duration prescribed by your doctor. The benefits will only continue for as long as you take it. If you stop taking Storvas 10 Tablet without starting a different treatment, your cholesterol levels may rise again. It is considered to be safe and has few side effects if taken as directed by the doctor.

faq.question: Does Storvas 10 Tablet cause weight loss?
faq.answer: No, Storvas 10 Tablet has not been reported to cause weight loss. However, weight gain has been reported as an uncommon side effect. Please consult your doctor if you experience weight loss while taking Storvas 10 Tablet.

faq.question: Can I stop taking Storvas 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, you should not stop taking Storvas 10 Tablet without consulting your doctor. If you think that Storvas 10 Tablet is causing side effects, you should consult your doctor who may accordingly lower your dose or change your medicine.

faq.question: Can I take alcohol with Storvas 10 Tablet?
faq.answer: No, it is not advised to take alcohol with Storvas 10 Tablet. This is because the risk of developing liver problems increases if you drink alcohol while taking this medicine. Moreover, there is a significant increase in the triglyceride levels if Storvas 10 Tablet is taken along with alcohol. This can further lead to liver damage and also worsen some of the side effects such as muscle pain, muscle weakness, and tenderness. People with liver problems are therefore advised, not to take Storvas 10 Tablet without consulting the doctor. However, you should consult your doctor if you experience this side effect as it could be due to some other reason.

faq.question: How does Succisone Injection work?

faq.question: Is Succisone Injection a steroid?
faq.answer: Yes, Succisone Injection is a steroid medicine also known as corticosteroids which occur naturally in the body. These corticosteroids help to maintain health and wellbeing. Succisone Injection increases the levels of corticosteroids in the body by treating various illnesses involving inflammation (redness, tenderness, heat and swelling).

faq.question: What is Succisone Injection used for?

faq.question: How is Succisone Injection administered?

faq.question: I was given Succisone Injection in the knee as I have arthritis. Will it pain after taking Succisone Injection? What should I do about it?

description:
Sulbex Syrup is used for the treatment of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (a lung disorder in which the flow of air to the lungs is blocked).
It helps in relaxing the muscles of the air passages and making it easier to breathe.
It relieves coughing, wheezing and feeling short of breath.
Sulbex Syrup is taken without food in a dose and duration as advised by the doctor.
It is better to take it with food to avoid stomach upset.
The dose you are given will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medicine.
You should keep taking this medicine for as long as your doctor recommends.
If you stop treatment too early your symptoms may come back and your condition may worsen.
Let your healthcare team know about all other medications you are taking as some may affect, or be affected by this medicine.The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, tremor, headache, palpitations, muscle cramps, restlessness, and increased heart rate.
Most of these are temporary and usually resolve with time.
Contact your doctor straight away if you are at all concerned about any of these side effects.
This medicine may also cause dizziness and sleepiness, so do not drive or do anything that requires mental focus until you know how this medicine affects you.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine as it can worsen your sleepiness.Before taking it, you should tell your doctor if you have any kidney or liver diseases so that your doctor can prescribe a suitable dose for you.
You should also tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding.

description:
Sulsazen-DS Tablet is a medicine used to treat various inflammatory conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and psoriatic arthritis (joints), ulcerative colitis, and Crohn’s disease (bowel).
It reduces swelling and inflammation by blocking certain chemicals in the body.
Sulsazen-DS Tablet may be taken with or without food.
Take it regularly and at the same time each day to get the maximum benefit from it.
Keep taking it as recommended by your doctor and complete the dose even if you feel better.
Drinking plenty of water while taking it can help prevent kidney issues, including kidney stones.Common side effects of Sulsazen-DS Tablet include nausea, headache, vomiting, and gastrointestinal discomfort.
You should consult with your doctor if any of these side effects do not resolve with time or get worse.
Your doctor may help with ways to reduce or prevent these symptoms.To ensure Sulsazen-DS Tablet is safe for you, let your doctor know if you have any heart, kidney, or liver problems.
Additionally, inform your doctor about all other medications you are currently taking.
Your doctor may recommend regular blood tests to check your kidney and liver functions and blood components.
Pregnant and breastfeeding mothers should seek medical advice before using this medicine.

faq.question: What is Sulsazen-DS Tablet, and what is it used for?
faq.answer: Sulsazen-DS Tablet belongs to a group of medicines called anti-inflammatory agents. It is used to treat various inflammatory conditions such as Crohn’s disease, rheumatoid arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and psoriatic arthritis.

faq.question: Is Sulsazen-DS Tablet a steroid or a painkiller?
faq.answer: Sulsazen-DS Tablet is neither a steroid nor a painkiller. It is an anti-inflammatory medicine. It is used to treat and manage ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, in which the intestines become inflamed (swelling of intestines). It is also used to treat rheumatoid arthritis (painful joint disease).

faq.question: I have been prescribed Sulsazen-DS Tablet for rheumatoid arthritis. When can I expect the pain in my joints to be better?
faq.answer: Sulsazen-DS Tablet does not work right away. It takes about 6 to 12 weeks to deliver the full effect. You may start feeling better in 4 weeks after starting Sulsazen-DS Tablet, but it can vary from person to person, and some of the patients may notice improvement after 3 months. Consumption of medicine should not be stopped without consulting your doctor.

faq.question: For how long do I need to take Sulsazen-DS Tablet?
faq.answer: If you can tolerate Sulsazen-DS Tablet, which means the side effects do not bother you, then you have to continue Sulsazen-DS Tablet till the disease remains in remission. It is better to take Sulsazen-DS Tablet for the prescribed period.

faq.question: Does the use of Sulsazen-DS Tablet for the treatment of arthritis affect kidney function?
faq.answer: Though it is uncommon, Sulsazen-DS Tablet may affect your kidney function. Therefore, your kidney function must remain normal before you start taking Sulsazen-DS Tablet. If your kidney functions become abnormal during the treatment, consult your doctor.

faq.question: Do I need to get any blood tests done while on Sulsazen-DS Tablet therapy?
faq.answer: Your doctor will advise blood tests to check your blood cell counts and your kidney function before starting your treatment and regularly during treatment. The tests should also be done to measure substances produced by your liver, known as enzymes (liver function tests), and urine for protein and blood before you start treatment and at regular intervals.

faq.question: Can Sulsazen-DS Tablet affect my fertility?
faq.answer: Decreased sperm count and infertility have been reported in some males. These may disappear once the Sulsazen-DS Tablet is discontinued.

faq.question: Can I take azathioprine along with Sulsazen-DS Tablet?
faq.answer: You should avoid using Sulsazen-DS Tablet with azathioprine since there are chances of a decrease in blood cell count, which can be a serious side effect.

description:
Sultolin Inhalation Capsule belongs to a group of medicines called fast-acting bronchodilators or “relievers”.
It’s used to treat the symptoms of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary diseases (COPD) such as coughing, wheezing, and breathlessness.
Sultolin Inhalation Capsule is called "reliever" inhalers because they give you quick relief from breathing problems when you need it.
In most cases, you will be given another inhaler to prevent your symptoms (a “preventer”) and you should use this regularly every day.
Sultolin Inhalation Capsule works quickly and the effects can last several hours.
You can use it at any time of day, but only use it when you notice symptoms, such as coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, tightness in the chest or you know that you are going to do an activity that can cause breathlessness.
When an asthma attack happens, you should take the number of puffs your doctor recommends.
There are several types of inhaler devices so make sure you know how to use your inhaler correctly, otherwise, it may not work.
Do not stop using this medicine unless your doctor tells you to.
If you stop, your breathing problems could get worse.Sultolin Inhalation Capsule is generally safe and effective, but may cause some common side effects, which include tremors and headaches.
These side effects are not often dangerous and should gradually improve as your body gets used to this medicine.
There are other rare side effects, and you should call your doctor straight away if you get chest pain, a very bad headache, or very bad dizziness.Before using Sultolin Inhalation Capsule, you should tell your doctor if you have high blood pressure, an overactive thyroid gland, a history of heart problems, diabetes, or low levels of potassium in your blood to make sure it is safe.
Also, make sure your doctor knows if you are pregnant or breast-feeding before taking this medicine.
This medicine can make you feel dizzy or shaky, therefore, do not drive, use tools, or machinery until you feel better.
Avoid smoking as it causes damage to your lungs and will make your condition worse.

faq.question: What would happen if I take higher than the recommended dose of Sultolin Inhalation Capsule?
faq.answer: Taking a higher than the recommended dose of Sultolin Inhalation Capsule may cause seizures, chest pain, nervousness, headache, dry mouth, nausea, dizziness, tremors, and lack of energy. High doses of Sultolin Inhalation Capsule may also cause fast, irregular or pounding heartbeat, uncontrollable shaking of any part of the body, and difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep. In any such case, seek immediate medical attention.

faq.question: Is it safe to take Sultolin Inhalation Capsule if I have heart disease?
faq.answer: Yes, Sultolin Inhalation Capsule is considered safe, but its use depends on the severity of your heart problem. If you experience chest pain or any other symptom of worsening heart disease while taking Sultolin Inhalation Capsule, seek immediate medical advice.

faq.question: I have started using Sultolin Inhalation Capsule and I am experiencing headaches and shakiness. Is this because of Sultolin Inhalation Capsule and will these go away?
faq.answer: Yes, it could be due to Sultolin Inhalation Capsule. Feeling shaky is a common side effect of Sultolin Inhalation Capsule which goes away after some time. For headaches, drink plenty of water, get sufficient rest and avoid alcohol. Usually headaches go away after a week. If they persist for a long time, contact your doctor.

faq.question: When should I take Sultolin Inhalation Capsule?
faq.answer: Use Sultolin Inhalation Capsule as and when you need it. Sultolin Inhalation Capsule relieves the symptoms of asthma like coughing, shortness of breath and tightness in the chest. You can also take it to prevent asthma attacks in circumstances where you know it may occur (e.g., after strenuous exercise or unavoidable exposure to allergen).

faq.question: Can I smoke if I have been prescribed Sultolin Inhalation Capsule?
faq.answer: No, you should not smoke while taking Sultolin Inhalation Capsule. Smoking irritates the lungs. The medicine may make breathing more difficult, especially in patients who have asthma. Take advice from your doctor if you are finding it hard to avoid smoking.
